intro: Section 4 — bitta ma'ruzachi, akademik mavzu, o'rtada PAUZA YO'Q: 10 savolni oldindan o'qib olasiz va audio oxirigacha to'xtamaydi. Band 7 uchun asosiy ko'nikma — 5 daqiqalik ma'ruzada qayerdaligingizni yo'qotmaslik. Note completion shu ma'noda eng qulay tur: konspektning o'zi ma'ruza REJASI.

KONSPEKTNI O'QISH. SB konspektida uch bo'lim bor: "Early days" (o'tmish), "Present day" (hozir) va "Contribution of amateur astronomers" (bu esa yana uchga bo'linadi: specialised knowledge, two main types of observation, main advantages). WB da ham: Background → cardiovascular system → skeletal structure → cosmic radiation. Tayyorlanish vaqtida avval sarlavhalarni o'qing — ular ma'ruzachining signpost iboralariga to'g'ri keladi.

BASHORAT QILISH (45 soniya). Har bo'shliq uchun: 1) so'z turi — SB kalitiga ko'ra 10 dan tashqari hamma bo'shliq ot yoki ot birikmasi, 10 esa sifat ("___ observations"); 2) ma'no toifasi — "moved the focus from 2 ___ to the sky" → "sky" ga qarama-qarshi joy; "e.g. 5 ___ (Greece)" → Gretsiyadagi go'zal tasvir nomi; "an 8 ___" → unli tovush bilan boshlanadigan ot. Grammatik belgilar (a/an, ko'plik, predlog) — Band 7 dagi eng tez yordamchi.

SIGNPOST IBORALAR — ma'ruzachi yangi bo'limga o'tganini bildiradi: "So let's have a look at what the amateurs can contribute" → uchinchi bo'lim; "Firstly, they are always watching space" → a) new discoveries; "Secondly, they constantly observe..." → b); "In both types of observation, professionals can see advantages" → Main advantages. WB da: "Let's start with its effect on the cardiovascular system", "The biggest problem, though, is that of cosmic radiation". Bitta savolni o'tkazib yuborsangiz, keyingi sarlavhaning signpost iborasini kuting.

PARAPHRASE: konspektdagi so'z audioda deyarli hech qachon aynan aytilmaydi. "started" = "kicked off"; "aim to get" = "what they really want is"; "recognise changes in the ___" = "know right away when the ___ of an object alters"; "monitor" = "constantly observe". Lekin JAVOBNING o'zi — audiodagi aynan so'z.

TUZOQLAR (Band 7): 1) kutilgan javob rad etiladi — "Most professional astronomers don't care if the end result is beautiful, what they really want is research data"; 2) bir mavzuda ikki misol — "this beautiful solar eclipse that was captured in Greece ... or this incredible image of the Moon" — konspektda "(Greece)" qaysi misol kerakligini aytadi; 3) konspektda allaqachon bor so'z javob emas — "an 8 ___ or a comet" → comet emas, exploding star.

TRANSFER va SO'Z CHEGARASI: "NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS" — "accurate measurements" to'g'ri, "how to make accurate measurements" — 0 ball. WB 2 da skriptda "extended time periods" (3 so'z) — kalitda "extended periods": bo'shliqdan keyin "of time" allaqachon bor. Qavsdagi so'zlar ixtiyoriy: (the) Earth, (a) half, (bone) fractures. Imlo va ko'plik -s tekshiriladi; "long-term" chiziqcha bilan yoki "long term" — ikkalasi qabul qilinadi.
formulas: an ___ → unli bilan ot; ___ observations → sifat
So let's have a look at... / Firstly... / Secondly...
don't care if ... beautiful → research data
presentation: Section 4 da pauza yo'q. Savollarni qachon o'qiyman?
Audio boshlanishidan oldin berilgan 30–45 soniyada — avval sarlavhalar, keyin bo'shliqlar. Tinglash paytida ko'z konspekt bo'ylab yuradi.
Konspektda "an 8 ___" — bu nimani bildiradi?
Javob unli tovush bilan boshlanadi (an exploding star). Bunday grammatik belgilar javobni tekshirishga ham yordam beradi.
Ma'ruzachi bo'shliqqa mos keladigan ikki so'z aytdi. Qaysi birini yozaman?
Konspektdagi qolgan ma'lumotga mos kelganini: "e.g. 5 ___ (Greece)" — faqat Gretsiyada olingan tasvir, ya'ni solar eclipse.
Skriptda "extended time periods" — nega kalitda "extended periods"?
Konspektda "2 ___ of time" — "time" allaqachon bor, uch so'z esa chegaradan chiqadi. Gapga qo'yib o'qing.
"Moon photo" deb yozsam bo'ladimi?
Ha, kalitda moon photo(graph) — ikkalasi to'g'ri. Lekin "first Moon photograph" — "First" konspektda bor, takrorlash chegarani buzadi.
Bitta savolni o'tkazib yubordim — nima qilaman?
To'xtamang. Keyingi bo'shliq va sarlavhani kuting; oxirida bo'sh joyga so'z turi va mavzuga mos taxmin yozing — bo'sh qoldirish 0 ball.
notes: 7.0 da o'quvchilar Section 4 ni 4- va 6-unitlarda (8- va 13-darslar) ishlagan. Bu dars — oxirgi Listening darsi. Asosiy e'tibor — Band 7 tuzoqlari va tezlik: rad etish va qarama-qarshilik signallari ("what they really want is...", "You might think... but in fact...", "You'll sometimes read that... but on average...", "though") hamda pauzasiz, tezroq akademik nutq.
SB 3-mashqdagi bashoratni doskaga yozing va audiodan keyin solishtiring: qaysi bashorat to'g'ri chiqdi? Bu o'quvchilarga bashoratning qiymatini ko'rsatadi.
Tekshiruvda har javobdan keyin skriptdagi aynan gapni o'qing va paraphrase juftligini (started = kicked off) doskaga yozing.
Kuchli o'quvchilarga: WB audiosini skriptsiz ikkinchi marta tinglab, har bo'lim oldidagi signpost iborani yozib chiqish.
mistakes: "don't care if the end result is beautiful" — rad etilgan
comet konspektda bor; "an ___" unli bilan boshlanadi
"only artists were able to capture" — Draperdan OLDINGI davr
"a magnetic field shields humans" — atmosfera tilga olinmaydi

how: CORE — astronomiya va kosmos so'zlari; STRONG — ma'ruzalardagi akademik so'zlar (Section 4 da tez-tez uchraydi); SUPER — ma'ruzachi iboralari. Takror (6.0, 7-dars): amateur — yangi so'z sifatida sanalmaydi; havaskor astronomlar haqida gapirganda qayta ishlating.
Har o'quvchi 1 daqiqalik mini-ma'ruza tuzadi ("How amateurs help astronomy" yoki "What space does to the body") va kamida 4 ta so'zni ishlatadi.
core: Galileo was the first to use a telescope to study the sky.
Galiley osmonni o'rganish uchun teleskopdan birinchi bo'lib foydalangan.
The observatory sits on top of a mountain.
A strong magnetic field can deflect most of the charged particles from the Sun.
Kuchli magnit maydon Quyoshdan keladigan zaryadli zarrachalarning ko'p qismini burib yuborishi mumkin.
Thousands of people travelled to see the solar eclipse.
Minglab odamlar quyosh tutilishini ko'rish uchun safar qildi.
A comet is a small object made of dust and ice.
Kometa — chang va muzdan iborat kichik jism.
Our galaxy contains billions of stars.
The station orbits the Earth every 90 minutes.
Stansiya Yerni har 90 daqiqada aylanib chiqadi.
In space, the lack of gravity affects the bones.
Kosmosda tortishish kuchining yo'qligi suyaklarga ta'sir qiladi.
Accurate measurements are essential in astrophysics.
strong: Artists painted the celestial images they saw.
Cosmic radiation can damage human DNA.
Kosmik nurlanish inson DNKsiga zarar yetkazishi mumkin.
After ten days of weightlessness, bones become weaker.
O'n kunlik vaznsizlikdan keyin suyaklar zaiflashadi.
Space travel affects the cardiovascular system.
Kosmik sayohat yurak-qon tomir tizimiga ta'sir qiladi.
Exercise is the main countermeasure against bone loss.
Jismoniy mashq — suyak yo'qotilishiga qarshi asosiy chora.
Scientists are struggling to mitigate the effects of radiation.
Olimlar nurlanish ta'sirini kamaytirish uchun kurashmoqda.
super: Telescopes kicked off the scientific revolution.
Amateurs keep a constant eye on the skies.
The symptoms usually wear off after a few days.
Belgilar odatda bir necha kundan keyin o'tib ketadi.
Long missions take a toll on the human body.
Uzoq missiyalar inson tanasiga og'ir ta'sir qiladi.

class_ex.title: Listening testi bo'yicha to'g'ri maslahat (SB, 1-mashq)
class_ex.instr: Har gapda qiya harf bilan berilgan ikki variantdan to'g'risini tanlang. Juftlikda ishlang, keyin ustoz tekshiradi.
items: 1 Use the preparation time to relax / decide what you need to listen for.
2 If you lose your place, wait for the next section to begin / listen for key ideas in the questions.
3 It matters / does not matter how clearly you write your answers on the question paper, because you will transfer them later.
4 Standard abbreviations (e.g. km) are acceptable in answers; they count / do not count as words.
5 If you miss an answer, leave a blank / make a guess.
6 If you go over the word limit, you will / will not necessarily lose the mark for the question.
answers: decide what you need to listen for
listen for key ideas in the questions
why: Tayyorlanish vaqtini to'liq ishlating: kalit g'oyalarni tagiga chizing, so'z turini bashorat qiling.
Tagiga chizilgan kalit so'zlar va sarlavhalar joyingizni qayta topishga yordam beradi — Section 4 da keyingi section yo'q!
Ko'chirishda javob grammatik to'g'ri va imlosi to'g'ri bo'lishi kerak — noaniq yozuv ko'chirishda xatoga olib keladi.
Qisqartmalar (km, 3rd) so'z sifatida hisoblanadi — chegarani eslang.
Bilmasangiz ham taxmin yozing: bo'sh joy — aniq 0 ball.
Chegaradan oshsangiz, javob albatta noto'g'ri hisoblanadi.
class_ex.note: Kalitdagi izohlar (SB, 182-bet) bilan. Mashqdan keyin doskaga: "prepare → underline → predict → follow headings → guess → check limit".

class_ex.title: Signpost iboralar: ma'ruzachi qayerga o'tdi?
class_ex.instr: Ustoz ma'ruzalardan iborani o'qiydi. O'quvchilar aytadi: bu ibora konspektdagi qaysi sarlavha yoki bo'limni boshlaydi (SB yoki WB konspekti)?
items: "So let's have a look at what the amateurs can contribute."
"Firstly, they are always watching space..."
"Secondly, they constantly observe..."
"In both types of observation, professionals can see advantages..."
"Let's start with its effect on the cardiovascular system."
"The biggest problem, though, is that of cosmic radiation."
why: "Let's have a look at" — yangi katta bo'lim. Keyin "specialised knowledge" (Q6–7) keladi.
"Firstly" — ro'yxatning birinchi bandi: a) new discoveries.
"Secondly" — ikkinchi band: b) monitor = constantly observe.
"Advantages" so'zi konspektdagi "Main advantages" bilan bir xil — Q10 yaqin.
"Let's start with" — birinchi tana tizimi.
"The biggest problem, though" — oxirgi va eng muhim bo'lim.
class_ex.note: Tinglash paytida o'quvchilar har signpost iborada qalamini konspektdagi tegishli sarlavhaga qo'yadi — bu "joyni yo'qotmaslik" ko'nikmasi.

listenings.title: Student's Book, CD2 Track 17: Space observation (Q1–10)
intro: Fizika fanlari ma'ruzachisi kosmosni kuzatish haqida gapiradi: ilk teleskoplar, hozirgi professional va havaskor astronomlar, havaskorlarning fanga hissasi.
Avval 3-mashq (bo'shliqlarni bashorat qilish), keyin 45 soniya tayyorlanish. Ko'rsatma: Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS for each answer. Savollar sahifasi quyida rasm sifatida.

tasks.title: 3-mashq: har bo'shliqqa qanday ma'lumot kerak?
tasks.type: Bashorat (tinglashdan oldin)
tasks.instr: Har bo'shliq uchun so'z turi va ma'no toifasini ayting. Javoblarni doskaga yozing — audiodan keyin solishtiramiz.
items: 1 First telescopes — started the 1 '___'
2 moved the focus from 2 ___ to the sky
3 First 3 ___ — by John William Draper (1839)
4 Professional astronomers — aim to get 4 ___
5 e.g. 5 ___ (Greece)
6 recognise changes in the 6 ___ of a space object
7 are able to produce 7 ___ of space
8 new discoveries, e.g. an 8 ___ or a comet
9 monitor the 9 ___ of objects in space
10 can conduct 10 ___ observations
answers: ot birikmasi — teleskoplar boshlab bergan jarayon/davr
ot — Gretsiya bilan bog'liq go'zal tasvir nomi
ot — unli tovush bilan boshlanadigan kashfiyot
why: SB kaliti: "describes an activity that was started by the first telescopes"; qo'shtirnoq — nom yoki termin.
"something that contrasts with sky".
"a 'first' in space or in relation to space observation"; 1839 — fotografiya davri.
"something astronomers want to find or look for".
"the name of a beautiful image linked with Greece".
"something about a space object that changes".
"something that amateur astronomers can produce".
"a type of discovery ... (beginning with a vowel)" — "an" artikli belgi.
"something to do with objects in space".
"describes a type of observation" — faqat shu bo'shliqda sifat.
tasks.note: SB kaliti (182-bet): 10 dan tashqari hamma bo'shliq — ot yoki ot birikmasi. Audiodan keyin qaytib keling: nechta bashorat to'g'ri chiqdi?

tasks.title: Questions 1–10 — Space observation
tasks.type: Complete the notes below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS for each answer.
tasks.instr: Konspekt ma'ruza tartibida: Early days (1–3) → Present day (4–5) → Contribution of amateur astronomers (6–10). Pauza yo'q.
items: 1 Early days: first telescopes — started the '___'
2 Galileo's telescope — moved the focus from ___ to the sky
3 First ___ — by John William Draper (1839)
4 Present day: professional astronomers — aim to get ___
5 Amateur astronomers — aim to photograph beautiful images, e.g. ___ (Greece)
6 Specialised knowledge: recognise changes in the ___ of a space object
7 are able to produce ___ of space
8 Two main types of observation: a new discoveries, e.g. an ___ or a comet
9 b monitor the ___ of objects in space
10 Main advantages: great patience and passion; can conduct ___ observations
why: "It was instruments – and particularly telescopes – that kicked off what was known as the 'scientific revolution'." Kicked off = started.
"Until this time, scientists had been looking at objects on the Earth, but suddenly the skies held a much greater fascination."
"For John William Draper ... to produce the first recorded Moon photograph." Tuzoq: "only artists were able to capture" — bu Draperdan oldingi davr.
"Most professional astronomers don't care if the end result is beautiful, what they really want is research data." "Beautiful" — rad etilgan variant.
"Like this beautiful solar eclipse that was captured in Greece ... or this incredible image of the Moon with a plane crossing it." (Greece) — birinchi misol.
"They know right away when something new appears or when the brightness of an object alters." Recognise changes = know when ... alters.
"Another vital skill is that they know how to make accurate measurements." Produce = make.
"Any new discovery, such as an exploding star ... or a comet." "Comet" konspektda bor — javob emas.
"Secondly, they constantly observe the evolution of stars, planets and other celestial features." Monitor = constantly observe.
"It's not possible for professional astronomers to undertake these long-term studies ... But amateurs can."
tasks.note: 4- va 5-savollar — darsning asosiy tuzoqlari: 4 da kutilgan javob (beautiful) rad etiladi, 5 da ikki misoldan konspektdagi belgi (Greece) bo'yicha tanlanadi.

listenings.title: Student's Book: recording script (CD2 Track 17) — ustoz uchun
intro: Tekshiruvdan keyin ekranga chiqaring. Har javob gapini, tuzoq so'zni (beautiful, the Moon with a plane, comet) va signpost iboralarni (So let's have a look at, Firstly, Secondly, In both types of observation) alohida rang bilan ko'rsating.

listenings.title: Workbook, Track 13: Space travel — health issues (Q1–10)
intro: Ma'ruzachi kosmik sayohat va kosmosda yashashning inson salomatligiga ta'siri haqida gapiradi: yurak-qon tomir tizimi, suyaklar, kosmik nurlanish.
Avval Workbook 1–2-mashqlari (qanday muammolar bo'lishi mumkin? qaysi so'z turi kerak?), keyin imtihondagidek: tayyorlanish, audio BIR MARTA, 10 savol. Ko'rsatma: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS.

tasks.title: 2-mashq: so'z turi va bashorat
tasks.type: Og'zaki
tasks.instr: Konspektni ko'zdan kechiring va ikki savolga javob bering.
items: 1 What sort of word or words would you need to complete most of the answers?
2 Are there any answers you might be able to predict without listening?
answers: Masalan: 3 (blood / blood flow), 7 (fractures), 8 (muscle strength / muscles), 9 (atmosphere yoki magnetic field) — lekin bashoratni audio bilan tekshirish shart.
why: WB kaliti: "a noun or noun phrase". Konspektda deyarli har bo'shliqdan oldin artikl yoki raqam, keyin fe'l keladi.
Umumiy bilim yordam beradi, lekin tuzoq ham bo'lishi mumkin: 9 da ko'p o'quvchi "atmosphere" deb bashorat qiladi, to'g'ri javob — magnetic field. Bashorat — gipoteza, javob emas.

tasks.title: Questions 1–10 — Space travel: health issues
tasks.type: Complete the notes below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS for each answer.
tasks.instr: Konspekt to'rt qismga bo'lingan: Background → cardiovascular → skeletal → cosmic radiation. Pauza yo'q.
items: 1 Background: crew on board ISS conduct ___ which establish effects of space travel on their bodies.
2 Findings: ___ of time in space have a negative impact on human body.
3 Cardiovascular system — on Earth: human body can regulate ___ to compensate for effects of gravity.
4 Results: cold-like ___, including headache and 'moon face'.
5 Space motion sickness (affects roughly ___ of space travellers). Effects soon wear off.
6 Skeletal structure — results: ___ reduced by about 3.2% after 10 days in space, 2% per month thereafter.
7 ___ become more likely.
8 Exercise reduces this risk and is also good for preventing loss of ___.
9 Cosmic radiation — on Earth: people protected by a ___, which prevents radiation reaching planet's surface.
10 In space: ___ of cosmic radiation can cause serious illnesses (including cancer, cataracts, brain damage).
why: "The astronauts and scientists on board take part in medical experiments on themselves." Conduct = take part in.
"Space travel can affect us in several ways physiologically, especially over extended time periods." Konspektda "of time" bor — javob: extended periods.
"Various mechanisms to oppose gravity to maintain sufficient blood flow to the brain." Kalit "body fluids" ni ham qabul qiladi.
"Its symptoms include a blocked nose, headache and a puffy face often known as 'moon face'. Similar to ... a heavy cold."
"About a half of all astronauts experience these symptoms, but they're short-term."
"After ten days of weightlessness, the body loses about 3.2% of its bone content." Tuzoq: "calcium" — bu yo'qotiladigan modda, konspektdagi foizlar esa bone content'ga tegishli.
"This weakens bones, which greatly increases the risk of fractures."
"Incidentally, this also helps retain muscle strength." Preventing loss of = retain.
"On Earth, a magnetic field shields humans, deflecting the radiation." Shields = protected by.
"Without this shield, astronauts are exposed to dangerous levels of these high-velocity particles."
tasks.note: 2- va 6-savollar — so'z chegarasi va tuzoq: 2 da skriptdagi uch so'zdan ikkitasi olinadi; 6 da "calcium" va "phosphorus" (skriptda "phosphorous" deb xato yozilgan) raqamlar bilan aytiladi, lekin foizlar "bone content" haqida.

listenings.title: Workbook: recording script (Track 13) — ustoz uchun
intro: Skript bilan qayta tinglashda xato qilingan savollarning gapini topishga ishlatiladi. Kitobda javoblar tagiga chizilgan.

listenings.title: Jony Academy: Space weather (Q1–10)
intro: "Physics and society" kursidan ma'ruza: kosmik ob-havo — Quyosh faolligi Yerdagi texnologiyalarga qanday ta'sir qiladi. Ustoz skriptni ma'ruza tezligida BIR MARTA, pauzasiz va javob so'zlariga urg'u bermasdan o'qiydi.

Ko'rsatma: Complete the notes below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer. O'quvchilarga 45 soniya tayyorlanish vaqti beriladi (ustoz konspektni doskaga yozadi yoki ekranga chiqaradi).
transcript: LECTURER: Good morning, everyone. In this session of our physics and society series, I'd like to talk about something that most people have never heard of, but which affects modern life in some surprising ways — space weather.

LECTURER: So what do we mean by space weather? Put simply, it's the changing conditions in space around the Earth, and they're caused mainly by the Sun. Now, the Sun doesn't only give us light and heat. It also sends out a constant stream of electrically charged particles in every direction, and this stream is called the solar wind. It's the solar wind that produces most of the effects I'll describe today.

LECTURER: The Sun's activity isn't the same from year to year. It rises and falls in a cycle. You'll sometimes read that this cycle lasts ten years, and individual cycles do vary a little, but on average it's about eleven years from one peak to the next. And how do we know how active the Sun is at any moment? Well, there are sophisticated instruments these days, but the simplest measure — and the one astronomers have used for centuries — is still the number of sunspots, the dark, slightly cooler patches that appear on the Sun's surface.

LECTURER: The events that concern scientists most are called coronal mass ejections — enormous clouds of charged gas thrown out from the Sun. When one of these is heading our way, it usually reaches the Earth within one to three days, and it can have a whole range of effects.

LECTURER: The most visible effect is actually harmless, and rather beautiful. During a strong event, the aurora — what people in Scandinavia call the northern lights — can be seen much further from the poles than usual; occasionally it's been visible as far south as the Mediterranean.

LECTURER: Other effects are more serious. Electricity networks are vulnerable. You might think the long power lines would be the weak point, but in fact they're fairly robust. It's the transformers that are really at risk, because the extra currents can make them overheat, and they're very difficult to replace quickly.

LECTURER: Satellites are affected too. The signals used for satellite navigation have to pass through a disturbed upper atmosphere, so the positions your phone or your car calculates become less accurate — errors of several metres are common. The signals don't usually disappear altogether, but for pilots or surveyors, a few metres matters a great deal.

LECTURER: Airlines take space weather seriously as well. Radio communication can fail at high latitudes, and crews receive higher doses of radiation, so during strong events, flights on polar routes — for example between North America and Asia — are sometimes diverted to lower latitudes.

LECTURER: Now, the most famous historical example happened in 1859, and it's known as the Carrington Event, after the British astronomer who observed the flare. There was no electricity network then, of course, and the railways weren't seriously affected. But the telegraph systems in Europe and North America failed, and some operators even received electric shocks from their equipment.

LECTURER: So can we predict space weather? To some extent. We can see a coronal mass ejection leaving the Sun, so we usually get a day or two's notice that something is coming. But we only find out how strong it really is when it passes spacecraft positioned between the Sun and the Earth, and that gives us a warning of less than an hour.

LECTURER: The long-term aim of researchers is to make space weather forecasts as reliable as ordinary weather forecasts are today. We're not there yet, but as our dependence on technology grows, it's becoming one of the most important challenges in applied physics. Right, next week we'll look at...

tasks.title: Questions 1–10 — Space weather: the Sun and the Earth
tasks.type: Complete the notes below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
tasks.instr: Konspekt bo'limlari: Background (1–3) → Coronal mass ejections: effects (4–7) → Historical example (8) → Forecasting (9–10). Ustoz skriptni bir marta o'qiydi.
items: 1 Background: constant stream of charged particles from the Sun = the ___
2 Solar cycle: lasts about ___ on average
3 Simplest measure of solar activity: number of ___
4 Coronal mass ejections — effects: ___ can be seen further from the poles than usual
5 Electricity networks: ___ may overheat
6 Satellite navigation: positions become less ___
7 Airlines: flights on ___ routes may be diverted
8 Historical example (1859): ___ systems failed; some operators got electric shocks
9 Forecasting: spacecraft between the Sun and the Earth give a warning of less than ___
10 Long-term aim: forecasts as reliable as ordinary ___ forecasts
why: "A constant stream of electrically charged particles ... and this stream is called the solar wind."

"You'll sometimes read that this cycle lasts ten years ... but on average it's about eleven years." Tuzoq: ten — ma'ruzachi rad etadi. Konspektda birlik yo'q ("lasts about ___ on average"), shuning uchun "years" ham yoziladi: yolg'iz "11" — to'liq javob emas, ball berilmaydi.
"The simplest measure ... is still the number of sunspots." Tuzoq: "sophisticated instruments" — eng oddiy o'lchov emas.

"The aurora — what people in Scandinavia call the northern lights — can be seen much further from the poles than usual." Ikkalasi ham qabul qilinadi, lekin "the northern lights" — uch so'z, chegaradan chiqadi: artiklsiz yozing ("the aurora" — ikki so'z, to'g'ri).
"It's the transformers that are really at risk, because the extra currents can make them overheat." Tuzoq: "power lines" — "fairly robust".
"The positions your phone or your car calculates become less accurate." Tuzoq: signallar "don't usually disappear altogether".
"Flights on polar routes ... are sometimes diverted to lower latitudes."
"The telegraph systems in Europe and North America failed." Tuzoq: "electricity network" o'sha paytda yo'q edi, "railways" jiddiy zarar ko'rmagan.
"That gives us a warning of less than an hour." Tuzoq: "a day or two's notice" — bu CME Quyoshdan chiqqanini ko'rish, kosmik apparat ogohlantirishi emas.
"As reliable as ordinary weather forecasts are today."
tasks.note: O'qish qoidasi: ustoz skriptni ma'ruza tezligida (daqiqasiga ~150 so'z), pauzasiz o'qiydi va tuzoq so'zlarni (ten years, power lines, a day or two, railways) ham aniq talaffuz qiladi. Tekshiruvda 2-, 5- va 9-savollarni skript bilan ko'rsating — har birida rad etilgan variant bor.

homework_intro: Bugun Section 4 da note completion'ni Band 7 darajasida ishladik: konspekt — ma'ruza rejasi, bo'shliqni grammatik belgilar bilan bashorat qilish, signpost iboralar va rad etilgan variant tuzog'i.

Birinchi vazifa — diktant: Workbook Track 13 audiosining birinchi 2 daqiqasini (ISS va yurak-qon tomir tizimi haqidagi qism) eshitib, so'zma-so'z yozing. Audio va skript parchasi guruh chatida (ustoz dars oxirida yuboradi). Diktantni yozib bo'lgach, skriptni oching: o'zingiz tekshiring va xatolar sonini diktant ostiga yozing.

Ikkinchi vazifa — shadowing: Student's Book CD2 Track 17 dan 1 daqiqalik parchani (Galileo va Draper haqidagi qism) ma'ruzachi bilan birga, bir xil tezlikda takrorlang (audio parcha guruh chatida). Ovozli xabarni guruhga yuboring.

Uchinchi vazifa — Workbook, 51-bet, Vocabulary 1-mashq ("It's travel sickness, but not as we know it": 12 ta fe'l + predlog) va xatolar daftari: bugungi har xato javobni sababi bilan yozing (paraphrase / tuzoq / so'z chegarasi / imlo).

homework.title: Diktant: Workbook Track 13 (birinchi 2 daqiqa)
homework.instr: So'zma-so'z yozish, keyin skript bilan tekshirish; xatolar soni yoziladi.
homework.answers: O'quvchi diktantni skript bilan o'zi tekshiradi va xatolar sonini yozadi; ustoz tasodifiy 3 ta ishni qayta sanab ko'radi. 12 ta va undan ko'p xato bo'lsa, diktant qayta yoziladi.

homework.title: Shadowing: Student's Book CD2 Track 17 (1 daqiqa)
homework.instr: Ma'ruzachi bilan birga takrorlash; ovozli xabar guruhga.
homework.answers: Ustoz talaffuz, urg'u va tezlikni baholaydi.

homework.title: Workbook 51-bet Vocabulary 1-mashq + xatolar daftari
homework.instr: 12 bo'shliq (as, from, in, on, to, with); har xato: savol — to'g'ri javob — sabab.
homework.answers: 1 on 2 from 3 with 4 as 5 in 6 to 7 from 8 as 9 to 10 as 11 on 12 to.

normativ: diktantda 12 tadan kam xato; ovozli xabar vaqtida
12 dan 10 tasi to'g'ri; har xato sababi bilan

kahoot.q: What is special about IELTS Listening Section 4?
options: One speaker, academic topic, no break
One speaker, with a break after question 5
kahoot.explain: Section 4 — bitta ma'ruzachi, akademik mavzu, o'rtada pauza yo'q. 10 savolni oldindan o'qib olasiz.

kahoot.q: In note completion, what should you read FIRST in the preparation time?
kahoot.explain: Sarlavhalar — ma'ruza rejasi. Ular signpost iboralarga mos keladi va joyingizni yo'qotmaslikka yordam beradi.

kahoot.q: Notes: 'e.g. an ___ or a comet'. What does 'an' tell you?
options: The answer begins with a vowel sound
The answer is a plural noun phrase
The answer is a verb in the past tense
kahoot.explain: "An" — unli tovush bilan boshlanadigan ot: an exploding star.

kahoot.q: Notes: 'can conduct ___ observations'. What type of word is missing?
kahoot.explain: Ot (observations) oldidan — sifat: long-term observations.

kahoot.q: Notes: 'professional astronomers aim to get ___'. Lecturer: 'They don't care if it's beautiful — what they really want is research data.' Answer?
kahoot.explain: Kutilgan variant (beautiful) rad etiladi. Javob — ma'ruzachi TASDIQLAGAN narsa.

kahoot.q: Notes: 'e.g. ___ (Greece)'. You hear two examples. How do you choose?
options: Use the clue in the notes: Greece
Write the first one you hear
Write the last one you hear
kahoot.explain: Konspektdagi belgi (Greece) qaysi misol kerakligini aytadi: solar eclipse, Moon with a plane emas.

kahoot.q: Which phrase signals a NEW main section of the lecture?
options: So let's have a look at...
kahoot.explain: "Let's have a look at" — yangi bo'lim. For example — misol, in other words — izoh.

kahoot.q: Script: 'extended time periods'. Notes: '___ of time'. Limit: TWO WORDS. Correct answer?
kahoot.explain: "Of time" konspektda bor; uch so'z chegaradan chiqadi. Kalit: extended periods.

kahoot.q: Notes say 'monitor'. Which phrase in the lecture is the paraphrase?
kahoot.explain: Monitor = constantly observe (SB 9: evolution). Paraphrase savolda, javob — audiodagi aynan so'z.

kahoot.q: The notes already contain the word 'comet'. Can 'comet' be the answer for that gap?
options: No — words in the notes are not the answer
Yes, if the lecturer says it more than once
kahoot.explain: Konspektdagi so'z bo'shliqqa takror yozilmaydi — javob boshqa so'z (exploding star).

kahoot.q: You missed question 6. What should you do?
options: Listen for question 7 and guess 6 later
Stop writing and wait for the audio to repeat
kahoot.explain: Audio qaytarilmaydi. Keyingi savolga o'ting, oxirida bo'sh joyga mantiqiy taxmin yozing.

kahoot.q: Do abbreviations like 'km' count as words in the word limit?
kahoot.explain: SB 1-mashq kaliti: standart qisqartmalar qabul qilinadi, lekin so'z sifatida hisoblanadi.

kahoot.q: Telescopes ___ the scientific revolution.
kahoot.explain: Kick off — boshlab bermoq. Wear off — (ta'sir) o'tib ketmoq.

kahoot.q: Galileo's lens could ___ objects in the sky enough to study them.
kahoot.explain: Magnify — kattalashtirmoq.

kahoot.q: A ___ is a very small object made of dust and ice orbiting the Sun.
kahoot.explain: Comet — kometa: chang va muzdan iborat kichik jism.

kahoot.q: Amateurs keep a constant ___ on the skies for new discoveries.
kahoot.explain: Keep an eye on (yoki keep watch on) — kuzatib turmoq. Look, view va glance bu iborada ishlatilmaydi.

kahoot.q: Space sickness symptoms usually ___ after a few days.
kahoot.explain: Wear off — asta-sekin o'tib ketmoq (og'riq, dori ta'siri, belgilar).

kahoot.q: Exercise helps astronauts ___ muscle strength.
kahoot.explain: Retain — saqlab qolmoq = prevent loss of (konspektdagi paraphrase).

kahoot.q: On Earth, a magnetic field ___ us from cosmic radiation.
kahoot.explain: Shield — himoya qilmoq = protected by. Expose — teskari: ta'sirga ochiq qoldirmoq.

kahoot.q: Scientists are struggling to ___ the effects of radiation in deep space.
kahoot.explain: Mitigate — yumshatmoq, kamaytirmoq. Magnify — aksincha, kattalashtirmoq.

lessons.title: Writing Task 1 (1): Band 7+ talablari — Task achievement va Coherence
lessons.grammar_topic: Band 7 Task Achievement (tanlash, aniq overview, aniq tafsilot, shaxsiy xulosasiz) va Coherence & Cohesion (mantiqiy guruhlash, xatboshi, gap ichidagi va gaplar orasidagi bog'lanish)
lessons.vocab_topic: Aniq tendensiya va bog'lovchi tili: "ko'z-ko'z qiluvchi" so'zlar o'rniga aniq va to'g'ri so'zlar
lessons.book_ref: Pauline Cullen, "The Key to IELTS Writing Task 1" (Bands 7–9): Lesson 1 — Task achievement (1.1–1.3), Lesson 2 — Coherence and cohesion problems in Task 1 (2.1–2.3); PDF 2–26-betlar.
objectives: Task 1 ko'rsatmasidagi uch ishni (summarise — select main features — compare) bajarish Band 7 ning asosi ekanini tushunish; "hammasini sanab chiqish" Band 5–6 ga olib kelishini bilish.
Band 6 va Band 7 Task Achievement farqini aytib bera olish: aniq overview, asosiy xususiyatlarni ajratib ko'rsatish, noto'g'ri yoki ahamiyatsiz tafsilotlarsiz yozish.
Noaniq "high-level" so'zlarni (plummet, undergo, register, oscillate) aniq so'zlar bilan almashtira olish; sinonim guruhni o'zgartirmasligi kerakligini bilish.
Shaxsiy xulosa, sabab va maslahat Task 1 da "irrelevant detail" ekanini tanib, ularni javobdan chiqara olish.
Cohesive device faqat gap boshidagi so'z emasligini bilish: olmosh, which-clause, bog'lovchi va substitution orqali gap ichida bog'lash; mexanik bog'lovchi xatolarini tuzatish.
Ma'lumotni mantiqiy guruhlab (masalan, o'sganlar / kamayganlar) ikki body xatboshi rejasini tuza olish.
materials: Kitob sahifalari: Task achievement (PDF 5, 9, 10) va Coherence and cohesion (PDF 13, 15, 16, 25) — quyidagi Reading bo'limidagi ikki rasm, proyektorda.
Jony Academy grafigi: "Average consumption of four drinks" (line graph, mashq uchun to'qilgan) — har o'quvchiga chop etilgan.
Namuna javob (200 so'z) — chop etilgan, uch rangli marker bilan (overview / asosiy xususiyat / bog'lovchi).
Doskada ikki ustun: "Band 6 odati" — "Band 7 odati"; dars davomida to'ldiriladi.
Kahoot (20 savol) — dars oxirida.
timeline: Kirish
Savol: "Task 1 osonmi?" Javoblar doskaga. Ustoz: kitob muallifi fikricha, Task 1 da past ball olish Task 2 dan ham osonroq — nega? (shoshilish, overview yo'q).
Task achievement: Band 6 va Band 7 (kitob, PDF 5)
Band descriptorlar jadvali: Band 7 "clear overview" va "highlights key features"; Band 6 "details may be irrelevant, inappropriate or inaccurate". Doskadagi ikki ustun to'ldiriladi.
Aniqlik: flexibility va precision (PDF 9–10)
Pedestrian way / mall misoli g'oyasi, "magpie" so'zlar, sinonim tuzog'i. 1-mashq.
Shaxsiy xulosa va "conclusion" afsonasi (PDF 10)
Task 1 — hisobotning "Results" qismi, "Discussion" emas. 2-mashq.
Coherence: bog'lovchilar va gap ichidagi bog'lanish (PDF 13, 15–16)
Mexanik bog'lovchilar (First, On contrary, Also, Likewise). 3- va 4-mashq.
Progression: guruhlash va xatboshi (PDF 25)
Har kategoriyani bir xil qolipda yozish — ro'yxat. 5-mashq: drinks grafigi uchun reja.
Namuna javob tahlili
Avval grafikdan o'quvchilar o'zi 3 ta asosiy xususiyat topadi; keyin Jony Academy namunasi o'qiladi va uch rang bilan belgilanadi.
Kahoot va vazifa
20 savolli kahoot; uyga: eski javobni (yo'q bo'lsa — yangi javobni) ikki checklist bilan tekshirish va yangi to'liq javob.

intro: Task 1 da "Task Response" emas, "Task ACHIEVEMENT" baholanadi — ya'ni ko'rsatmani qanchalik bajarganingiz. Ko'rsatmada uchta ish bor: ma'lumotni XULOSALASH (summarise), asosiy xususiyatlarni TANLASH (select the main features) va o'rinli joyda SOLISHTIRISH (compare). Band 6 javoblarning ko'pi esa "hamma narsani sanab chiq" deganday yoziladi.

Band 7 uchun: talablarni qamrash + asosiy tendensiya, farq yoki bosqichlarning ANIQ overview'i + asosiy xususiyatlarni ajratib ko'rsatish. Band 6 da overview bor, lekin tafsilotlar ahamiyatsiz, o'rinsiz yoki noto'g'ri bo'lishi mumkin — Band 7 ga chiqishning birinchi sharti shu xatolardan qutulish.

Eski materiallar tuzog'i: 2007 yilgacha savol "describe the information" deb berilardi. Eski kitoblar va internetdagi tasodifiy infografikalar bilan mashq qilsangiz, "sanab chiqish"ga o'rganib qolasiz. Cambridge IELTS 9 va undan keyingi kitoblardan foydalaning.

Task 1 "oson" emas — bu real hayotdagi hisobotning "natijalar" qismiga o'xshaydi. Vaqtni Task 2 ga "o'g'irlab" shoshilib yozish Band 3–5 belgilariga olib keladi: overview yo'q, tafsilotlar mexanik sanalgan, ba'zi ma'lumot noto'g'ri. Task achievement vaqtni to'g'ri taqsimlash va yozishdan oldin o'ylash bilan bog'liq.

Aniqlik (precision): Task 1 da noto'g'ri so'z = noto'g'ri fakt. So'zni bilmasangiz ham ma'noni aniq bering (yo'lka o'rniga "pedestrian way" — tushunarli; "mall" — boshqa narsa, xato). Kichik pasayishga "plummet", raqamga "register" yoki "undergo" ishlatish — ko'z-ko'z qilish uchun so'z tanlash, bu Band 6 belgisi.

Sinonim ham aniq bo'lishi kerak: ma'lumot "teenagers" haqida bo'lsa, "young people" deb kengaytirib bo'lmaydi. Ko'pincha eng oddiy so'z eng aniq so'z bo'ladi — uni bir necha marta ishlatishdan qo'rqmang.

Shaxsiy xulosa = ahamiyatsiz (irrelevant) tafsilot: "which is good because...", "this suggests people should...", sabab va taxminlar. Task 1 — xolis xulosa (summary), Task 2 dagidek "conclusion" kerak emas. Overview'ni oxirida bersangiz bo'ladi, lekin uni ikki marta takrorlash shart emas.

Coherence: Task 1 da "central topic" talab qilinmaydi, lekin Band 7 "logically organises information" — buni xatboshisiz ko'rsatib bo'lmaydi. Har body xatboshining asosiy g'oyasi (birinchi gapi) examinerga guruhlash mantiqini ko'rsatsin.

Cohesion faqat gap boshidagi bog'lovchi emas: olmosh (it, this), which-clause, conjunction (but, while), substitution (both, such spending) ham baholanadi. Ro'yxatdan yodlangan bog'lovchilarni mexanik ishlatish (First — process uchun; "On contrary" — xato ibora; gap boshida Also — so'zlashuv) Band 5–6 belgisi. Har kategoriyani bir xil qolipda alohida yozish esa progression va solishtirishni yo'qotadi.
formulas: Yo'q, yoki tafsilot va raqamlarga to'la
"Overall, consumption of bottled water and coffee rose considerably, while tea consumption declined steadily."
Eng katta / kichik, eng ko'p o'zgargan, kesishuv, istisno
Oddiy, lekin aniq: rose, fell, stood at, reached, a peak of
"rose moderately to a peak of 105 litres in 2010"
"Soft drinks showed relatively little overall change."
Har kategoriya alohida, bir xil qolipda
O'xshash tendensiyalar bitta xatboshida; birinchi gap — asosiy g'oya
"tea, which had been the most widely consumed drink in 2000, had become the least consumed..."
presentation: Overview bor, lekin baribir Band 6 olyapman. Nega?

Band 6 descriptorida overview bor. Farq — tafsilotlarda: noto'g'ri so'z, noto'g'ri raqam yoki shaxsiy izoh bo'lsa, Band 7 ga chiqmaysiz. Band 7 overview "clear" bo'lishi va asosiy xususiyatlar ajratib ko'rsatilishi kerak.
"Plummet", "soar" kabi so'zlar ballni oshirmaydimi?
Faqat to'g'ri joyda. Plummet — juda keskin tushish; 6% dan 5.8% ga tushishga ishlatilsa, bu noto'g'ri tafsilot (TA va LR ikkalasi pasayadi).
Takrordan qochish uchun ko'p sinonim ishlataymi?
Ehtiyot bo'ling: "teenagers" ≠ "young people", "tigers" ≠ "cats". Takrorni kamaytirishning xavfsiz yo'li — olmosh (it, this figure), substitution (both drinks) va which-clause.
Task 1 ga xulosa (conclusion) yozish kerakmi?
Yo'q. Overview yetarli; uni kirishdan keyin yoki oxirida berish mumkin. Fikr, sabab yoki maslahat bilan tugatish — Task 2 uslubi, TA ni pasaytiradi.
Bog'lovchilar ro'yxatini yodlash foydalimi?

Boshlash uchun ha, lekin ro'yxatdagi so'zlar sinonim emas: however — gaplar orasida, although — gap ichida; First — jarayon uchun; Furthermore — muhimroq qo'shimcha uchun. Mexanik ishlatish — Band 6 ("faulty or mechanical").
Xatboshilarni qanday bo'laman?

Yozishdan oldin guruhni tanlang: o'sganlar / kamayganlar, eng yuqori / eng past ko'rsatkichlar, ikki jadval — ikki xatboshi. Agar "nega shunday bo'ldingiz?" savoliga javob bera olmasangiz — reja yo'q.
notes: Kitob matni proyektorda faqat rasm sifatida ko'rsatiladi; ustoz g'oyani o'zbekcha tushuntiradi va o'quvchi o'z so'zi bilan qayta aytadi. Kitobdagi Cambridge savollari o'rniga darsda Jony Academy grafigi ishlatiladi.
Doskadagi "Band 6 odati — Band 7 odati" jadvali butun Task 1 turkumi (18–24-darslar) davomida devorda tursin; keyingi darslarda unga yangi qatorlar qo'shiladi.
Namuna grafik va javobdagi raqamlar mashq uchun to'qilgan — o'quvchilarga ayting. Kahoot savollari shu grafik va dars qoidalariga asoslangan.
mistakes: "Tea consumption fell slightly, from 110 to 104 litres."
Plummet — juda keskin; kichik o'zgarishga ishlatilsa, tafsilot noto'g'ri bo'ladi
Raqam hech narsani "register" qilmaydi — asbob qiladi; stilga befarqlik
"...which is good because people are healthier now."
Shaxsiy xulosa — irrelevant detail, Band 6 belgisi
Noto'g'ri ibora; gap boshidagi Also — so'zlashuv uslubi
"Tea, despite its early lead, it fell to 70 litres."
"Tea, despite its early lead, fell to 70 litres."
Ega ikki marta: which / despite bo'lagidan keyin "it" kerak emas

how: CORE — har Task 1 javobida kerak bo'ladigan aniq so'zlar; STRONG — o'zgarish darajasini aniq beruvchi so'zlar; SUPER — Band 7–8 javoblaridagi tayyor iboralar.
Har so'z bilan namuna grafik (drinks) haqida bitta TO'G'RI gap tuzing — raqam grafikka mos kelishi shart.
core: The overview should mention the rise of water and the fall of tea.
Overview suv o'sishi va choy kamayishini aytishi kerak.
The crossing of the lines in 2015 is a key feature.
Coffee consumption stood at 40 litres in 2000.
By 2015, bottled water had overtaken every other drink.
2015 yilga kelib shishadagi suv boshqa barcha ichimliklarni quvib o'tgan edi.
Coffee followed a similar upward trend.
Qahva ham xuddi shunday o'sish tendensiyasiga ega bo'ldi.
Tea fell, whereas bottled water rose fourfold.
Choy kamaydi, shishadagi suv esa to'rt barobar oshdi.
Tea, by contrast, fell throughout the period.
Choy, aksincha, butun davr mobaynida kamaydi.
Similarly, coffee consumption rose throughout the period.
Xuddi shunday, qahva iste'moli butun davr mobaynida oshdi.
strong: Coffee rose steadily from 40 to 95 litres.
Qahva 40 dan 95 litrga bir tekis oshdi.
Soft drinks reached a peak of 105 litres in 2010.
Gazli ichimliklar 2010 yilda 105 litr bilan eng yuqori nuqtaga chiqdi.
Initially, soft drinks rose, but after 2010 they fell.
Dastlab gazli ichimliklar oshdi, lekin 2010 dan keyin kamaydi.
super: It finished at 120 litres, four times its initial level.
U 120 litrda, boshlang'ich darajasidan to'rt barobar yuqori yakunladi.
rise from last place to first
Bottled water rose from last place to first.
Shishadagi suv oxirgi o'rindan birinchiga chiqdi.
raɪz frəm lɑːst pleɪs tə fɜːst
Soft drinks showed relatively little overall change.
Gazli ichimliklar umuman nisbatan kam o'zgardi.
It ended at 85 litres, slightly below its starting point.
U 85 litrda, boshlang'ich nuqtasidan biroz pastda yakunladi.

class_ex.title: 1-mashq: "Ko'z-ko'z qiluvchi" so'zni aniq so'zga almashtiring
class_ex.instr: Drinks grafigiga qarang. Har gapdagi noaniq so'zni toping va aniq so'z bilan almashtiring. Nega noto'g'ri ekanini ayting.
items: Tea consumption plummeted from 110 to 104 litres between 2000 and 2005.
The figure for coffee registered 40 litres in 2000.
Bottled water underwent a rise of 25 litres between 2005 and 2010.
Soft drink consumption oscillated to 105 litres in 2010.
Young people drank far more bottled water in 2020 than in 2000.
Bottled water climbed to its zenith of 120 litres in 2020.
answers: rose to 105 litres (a peak of 105 litres)
reached a high of 120 litres / finished at 120 litres
why: Plummet — juda keskin tushish; 6 litrlik farq uchun noto'g'ri tafsilot (TA ham pasayadi).
Raqam "register" qila olmaydi — bu asbob uchun. Stilga befarqlik — LR muammosi.
Undergo — odatda salbiy tajriba (operatsiya, tekshiruv) bilan; raqam o'sishiga ishlatilmaydi.
Oscillate — bir necha marta u yoqqa-bu yoqqa (masalan, asbob mili); bu yerda bitta o'sish.
Grafik o'rtacha odam haqida, yoshlar haqida emas: sinonim guruhni o'zgartirib yubordi — noto'g'ri fakt.
"Zenith" — adabiy, stilga mos emas; bundan tashqari 2020 — oxirgi yil, "peak" dan keyin pasayish yo'q.

class_ex.title: 2-mashq: Bu gap Task 1 javobiga kiradimi?
class_ex.instr: Drinks grafigi haqidagi gaplar. "Ha" (asosiy xususiyat yoki overview) yoki "yo'q" (shaxsiy xulosa, sabab, maslahat) deng.
items: This suggests that people are becoming more health-conscious.
Tea was the most widely consumed drink in 2000.
The rise in bottled water is worrying because plastic bottles harm the environment.
To conclude, the government should encourage people to drink more tea.
Soft drink consumption peaked at 105 litres in 2010.
Overall, water and coffee consumption grew, while tea consumption declined.
why: Sabab / taxmin — grafikda yo'q. Band 6: "irrelevant details".
Solishtirish bilan berilgan asosiy xususiyat.
Shaxsiy fikr — bu "Discussion", "Results" emas.
Task 2 uslubidagi xulosa va maslahat — Task 1 talabiga zid.
Aniq tafsilot: eng yuqori nuqta va yil.
Overview — raqamsiz umumiy tendensiya.

class_ex.title: 3-mashq: Bog'lovchidagi muammo qaysi turga kiradi?
class_ex.instr: A — bu kontekstda noto'g'ri (ma'nosi mos emas); B — juda norasmiy (so'zlashuv); C — ibora / kollokatsiya xatosi; D — grammatik xato (ortiqcha "it", vergul). Harfni yozing va gapni tuzating.
items: First, bottled water consumption stood at 30 litres in 2000.
On contrary, tea fell throughout the period.
Also, coffee rose steadily.
Tea, despite being the most widely consumed drink in 2000, it fell to 70 litres.
Soft drinks which peaked in 2010 ended the period at 85 litres.
Furthermore, coffee consumption was 62 litres in 2010.
answers: A — "In 2000, bottled water consumption stood at just 30 litres."
C (va A) — "By contrast, tea fell throughout the period."
D — "Tea, despite being ..., fell to 70 litres."
D — "Soft drinks, which peaked in 2010, ended the period at 85 litres."
A — "Coffee consumption reached 62 litres in 2010." (yoki bu tafsilotni umuman olib tashlash)
why: First — jarayonning birinchi bosqichi uchun; grafikda "birinchi" narsa yo'q.
To'g'ri ibora "on THE contrary" bo'lardi, lekin u oldingi fikrni rad etish uchun. Farqni ko'rsatish — by / in contrast.
Gap boshidagi Also — og'zaki nutqqa xos; gap ichiga olinadi.
Ega (tea) allaqachon bor — "it" ikkinchi ega bo'lib qoladi.
Qo'shimcha ma'lumot beruvchi which-clause ikki tomondan vergul bilan ajratiladi.
Furthermore — undan ham MUHIMROQ ma'lumot qo'shadi; bu yerda oddiy (va kichik) tafsilot.

class_ex.title: 4-mashq: To'g'ri bog'lovchini tanlang
class_ex.instr: Har bo'shliqqa ma'no va grammatika jihatidan mos variantni tanlang.
items: 1 ____ tea was the most widely consumed drink in 2000, it was the least consumed in 2020. A) However B) Although C) Furthermore
2 Bottled water rose continuously. ____, coffee followed an upward trend. A) In contrast B) First C) Similarly
3 Tea declined steadily, ____ bottled water rose fourfold. A) whereas B) similarly C) furthermore
4 ____, soft drink consumption rose, but after 2010 it fell. A) First B) Initially C) Meanwhile
5 Coffee rose to 95 litres. Tea, ____, fell to 70. A) likewise B) also C) by contrast
6 ____, the bottles are washed and then filled with water. (process) A) First B) Overall C) Initially
why: Although — gap ICHIDA qarama-qarshilik (bir gapda ikki qism). However — ikki gap orasida.
Similarly — keyingi narsa xuddi shunday tendensiyaga ega.
Whereas — bir gap ichida ikki narsani qarama-qarshi qo'yadi.
Initially — boshida shunday edi, keyin o'zgardi. First — jarayon bosqichi uchun.
By contrast — farqni ta'kidlaydi; likewise/also o'xshashlik uchun.
Jarayon (process) — First, Next, Then... Initially esa "keyin o'zgargan" ma'nosini beradi.

class_ex.title: 5-mashq: Drinks grafigi uchun eng yaxshi reja qaysi?
class_ex.instr: Uch reja berilgan. Har biri haqidagi savolga javob bering; keyin eng yaxshisini tanlang.
items: Reja A: 3-xatboshi — water; 4 — coffee; 5 — tea; 6 — soft drinks. Qanday muammo bor?
Reja B: 3-xatboshi — 2000 yil; 4-xatboshi — 2020 yil. Line graph uchun nimani yo'qotadi?
Reja C: 3-xatboshi — o'sganlar (water, coffee); 4-xatboshi — kamayganlar / kam o'zgarganlar (tea, soft drinks). Nega eng yaxshi?
Reja C da 3-xatboshining birinchi gapi qanday bo'lishi mumkin?
answers: Har ichimlik alohida, bir xil qolipda — ro'yxat; solishtirish deyarli yo'q; progression yo'q.
O'rtadagi o'zgarishlar yo'qoladi: 2010 dagi cho'qqi, 2015 dagi kesishuvlar.
O'xshash tendensiyalar bir joyda — solishtirish o'z-o'zidan chiqadi (TA), mantiq aniq (CC).
Masalan: "The most dramatic growth was in bottled water."
why: Kitobdagi (PDF 25) Band 6 namunasi muammosi: har kategoriya — "1979 da ... 2004 da ..." qolipi.
Yillar bo'yicha bo'lish jadval uchun ba'zan qulay, lekin line graph'da tendensiya muhim.
Band 7 CC: "logically organises information"; TA: "make comparisons where relevant".
Birinchi gap xatboshining asosiy g'oyasini ko'rsatadi — examiner guruhlashni darhol ko'radi.

tasks.title: Sahifalar bo'yicha savollar
tasks.type: Og'zaki
tasks.instr: Ustoz sahifani ko'rsatadi, o'quvchilar o'z so'zi bilan javob beradi.
items: Band 7 va Band 6 descriptorlaridagi overview haqidagi farq nima?
"Don't" ro'yxatidagi yagona band nimani taqiqlaydi?
Muallif so'z to'playdigan qaysi qushni misol qiladi va nega?
Nega "teenagers" o'rniga "young people" yozish xato?
Muallif fikricha, Task 1 hisobotning qaysi qismiga o'xshaydi?
answers: Band 7 — "clear overview of main trends, differences or stages"; Band 6 — overview bor, lekin tafsilotlar noto'g'ri/ahamiyatsiz bo'lishi mumkin.
Ahamiyatsiz, o'rinsiz yoki noto'g'ri tafsilot berish.
Zag'izg'on (magpie) — yaltiroq narsani qimmatini bilmay yig'adi; so'zni ma'nosini bilmay yig'ish.
Guruh o'zgaradi — ma'lumot faqat o'smirlar haqida; fakt noto'g'ri bo'lib qoladi.
"Results" (natijalar) qismiga — fikr va muhokama esa boshqa qismda bo'ladi.
why: Overview'ning o'zi yetmaydi — aniq bo'lishi va tafsilotlar to'g'ri bo'lishi kerak.
Band 6 dan Band 7 ga chiqishning asosiy to'sig'i.
Kitobdagi metafora; ustoz "peacock" (tovus) misolini ham eslatishi mumkin.
Task 1 da fakt grafikka mos bo'lishi shart — Task 2 dan asosiy farq.
Shuning uchun shaxsiy xulosa "irrelevant".

readings.source: Pauline Cullen, The Key to IELTS Writing Task 1 — Lesson 2 (PDF 13, 15, 16, 25-betlar)
readings.book_ref: 13: CC descriptorlari Task 1 va Task 2 da; 15: bog'lovchilar mexanik ishlatilgan Band 6 parchasi; 16: har bog'lovchidagi muammo (A–C) va javoblar; 25: 2.3 — xatboshilar va progression yo'qligi.

tasks.title: Sahifalar bo'yicha savollar
tasks.type: Og'zaki
tasks.instr: Ustoz sahifani ko'rsatadi, o'quvchilar o'z so'zi bilan javob beradi.
items: 13-bet: CC descriptorlarida qaysi talab faqat Task 2 da bor (sariq rang)?
Muallif nega noto'g'ri bog'lovchini mixga ishlatilgan otvyortkaga (screwdriver) o'xshatadi?
15-betdagi parchada har gap orasida bog'lovchi bor. Nega bu baribir Band 6 (hatto Band 5 belgilari ham bor)?
25-bet (2.3): bog'lovchilar olib tashlangan to'rt gapda qanday qolip ko'rinadi?
answers: Task 2 da "clear central topic within each paragraph" va xatboshidan to'g'ri foydalanish talab qilinadi; Task 1 descriptorida xatboshi haqida gap yo'q.
Otvyortka foydali asbob, lekin bu ish uchun yaramaydi (not effective) — bog'lovchi ham ma'nosi va vazifasi mos kelmasa, foyda bermaydi.
Bog'lovchilar mexanik tanlangan: faqat bog'lanish "ko'rinishini" beradi, ko'pi esa bu kontekstda noto'g'ri yoki norasmiy (First, After this, On contrary, Likewise, Also).
Har gap bitta ovqat haqida: nomi + 1979 dagi raqam + 2004 dagi raqam — har kategoriya alohida, bir xil qolipda; solishtirish va progression yo'q.
why: Lekin muallif xulosasi: Band 7 "logically organises" ni xatboshisiz ko'rsatib bo'lmaydi — Task 1 da ham xatboshi kerak.
Band 6: cohesion "faulty or mechanical" — so'z bor, lekin vazifasini bajarmaydi.
Noto'g'ri ishlatilgani uchun kitob bu parchada Band 5 belgilarini ham ko'radi; batafsil — 3-mashqda.
Shuning uchun bog'lovchini almashtirish yetmaydi — avval guruhlash kerak (5-mashq, Reja C).

readings.title: NAMUNA JAVOB — Band 7+ TA va CC qayerda ko'rinadi
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna javobi (200 so'z: 26 + 57 + 58 + 59; grafik ma'lumotlari mashq uchun to'qilgan)
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: The graph below shows the average amount of four types of drink consumed per person per year in one country between 2000 and 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.  |  REJA: O — water, coffee ↑↑; tea ↓; soft ≈. P3 — water (30 → 120, top by 2015) + coffee (40 → 95). P4 — tea (110 → 70, overtaken) + soft drinks (pk 105 in 2010 → 85).
text: The line graph compares how much bottled water, coffee, tea and soft drinks an average person in one country consumed each year between 2000 and 2020.

Overall, consumption of bottled water and coffee rose considerably over the period, while tea consumption declined steadily. As a result, tea, which had been the most widely consumed drink in 2000, had become the least consumed of the four by 2020, whereas bottled water rose from last place to first. Soft drinks showed relatively little overall change.

The most dramatic growth was in bottled water. Consumption stood at just 30 litres per person in 2000, the lowest figure on the graph, but it rose continuously, overtaking every other drink by 2015 and finishing at 120 litres, four times its initial level. Coffee followed a similar upward trend, more than doubling from 40 to 95 litres.

Tea, by contrast, fell throughout the two decades, from 110 litres to 70. It was overtaken by soft drinks between 2005 and 2010, and by coffee after 2015, when both drinks stood at 80 litres. Soft drink consumption rose moderately to a peak of 105 litres in 2010 before falling back to 85 litres, slightly below its starting point.
glossary: continuously — uzluksiz, to'xtamasdan (har bir o'lchovda o'sgan); continually esa — tez-tez, qayta-qayta
fall back to — ... ga qaytib tushmoq

tasks.title: Grafik ma'lumotlari (litr / kishi / yil)
tasks.type: Jadval — o'quvchiga grafik bilan birga
tasks.instr: Namunani o'qishdan oldin jadvaldan uchta asosiy xususiyatni o'zingiz toping: eng katta o'zgarish, kesishuv, istisno.
items: Eng katta o'zgarish
Kesishuv
Istisno
answers: Eng katta o'zgarish — bottled water: 30 → 120 litr (to'rt barobar), oxirgi o'rindan birinchi o'ringa chiqdi.
Kesishuv — 2015 ga kelib water hammasidan o'tib ketadi; choy 2005–2010 oralig'ida soft drinks'dan, 2015 dan keyin esa qahvadan ortda qoladi (2015 da choy ham, qahva ham — 80 litr).
Istisno — soft drinks: 2010 da 105 litr bilan cho'qqi, keyin 85 ga tushadi; umuman deyarli o'zgarmagan (90 → 85).
why: Overview va 3-xatboshining asosiy g'oyasi shu.
Kesishuvda tartib o'zgaradi — line graph'ning eng muhim tafsiloti.
Umumiy o'sish/kamayish manzarasiga mos kelmaydi — overview'da alohida aytiladi.
