tasks.title: Namunani Band 7 mezonlari bilan tekshiring
tasks.type: Uch rang bilan belgilash
tasks.instr: Har savolga namunadan misol keltiring.
items: Overview qaysi xatboshida? Unda raqam bormi?
Nega 3- va 4-xatboshilar aynan shunday guruhlangan?
Bitta which-clause toping. U qanday ish qilyapti?
"both drinks" nimani almashtiryapti? Bu qanday cohesive device?
Namunada "plummet" yoki "soar" bormi? Nega?
Javobda shaxsiy xulosa yoki sabab bormi?
answers: 3 — o'sganlar (water, coffee); 4 — kamaygan / kam o'zgargan (tea, soft drinks).
"tea, which had been the most widely consumed drink in 2000, ..." — ikki faktni bir gapda bog'laydi.
Tea va coffee — substitution; takrorsiz bog'lash.
Yo'q: o'zgarishlar keskin emas yoki "rose continuously", "more than doubling" aniqroq.
why: TA Band 7: clear overview of main trends.
CC Band 7: logical organisation; birinchi gaplar guruhni ko'rsatadi.
GRA va CC: murakkab gap + gap ichidagi bog'lanish.
Band 5 muammosi — "lack of referencing and substitution" — bu yerda yo'q.
Precision: kerakli joyda oddiy, lekin aniq so'z.
Irrelevant detail yo'q — Band 7 TA sharti.

homework_intro: Bugun Band 7 Task achievement va Coherence nimani talab qilishini ko'rdik: aniq overview, to'g'ri tafsilot, xolislik va mantiqiy guruhlash.

Birinchi vazifa — oldingi Task 1 javoblaringizdan birini (Cambridge 9+ savoli) ikki checklist bilan tekshiring: TA (overview bormi? key features ajratilganmi? shaxsiy xulosa yo'qmi? sinonimlar aniqmi?) va CC (kamida 2 body xatboshi? guruhlash mantig'i ko'rinadimi? bog'lovchilar aniqmi? which-clause to'g'rimi?). Eski Task 1 javobingiz bo'lmasa — ikkinchi vazifadagi yangi javobingizni yozib bo'lgach, uni shu ikki checklist bilan tekshiring.

Ikkinchi vazifa — quyidagi ma'lumot bo'yicha to'liq javob (170–200 so'z, 20 daqiqa): "The table shows the number of visitors (millions) to four types of attraction in one country in 2004, 2014 and 2024: museums 8 → 10 → 14; theme parks 12 → 9 → 7; national parks 5 → 9 → 15; zoos 6 → 6 → 5."
Uchinchi vazifa — quyidagi aniq so'zlar (stand at, reach, overtake, remain stable at, steadily, by contrast) bilan visitors jadvali haqida 6 ta to'g'ri gap yozing; raqamlar jadvalga mos bo'lsin.

homework.title: Eski javobni ikki checklist bilan tekshirish
homework.instr: Javob ostiga TA (4 savol) va CC (4 savol) — har biriga "ha / yo'q / bilmayman" va bitta dalil (javobdan iqtibos). Eski javob bo'lmasa — 2-vazifadagi visitors javobingizni tekshiring.
homework.answers: "Yo'q" va "bilmayman" javoblari — sizning keyingi darslardagi maqsadingiz. Ustoz ikki o'quvchining tekshiruvini sinfda ko'rsatadi.

homework.title: To'liq javob: visitors jadvali
homework.instr: Avval 2 daqiqalik reja: overview (2 fikr) + qaysi guruhlar qaysi xatboshida. Keyin 4 xatboshi, 170–200 so'z.
homework.answers: Namuna reja: O — national parks va museums ↑ (parks 3 barobar, 2024 da eng ko'p); theme parks ↓; zoos ≈. P3 — o'sganlar (national parks 5 → 15, museums 8 → 14). P4 — kamaygan / barqaror (theme parks 12 → 7, 1-o'rindan 3-o'ringa tushdi; zoos 6 → 5). Namuna overview: "Overall, visitor numbers rose considerably at national parks and museums over the period, whereas theme parks attracted fewer visitors and zoo attendance changed little."

homework.title: Aniq so'zlar bilan 6 gap
homework.instr: stand at, reach, overtake, remain stable at, steadily, by contrast — har biri bilan visitors jadvali haqida bitta to'g'ri gap.
homework.answers: Namuna gaplar (raqamni jadval bilan tekshiring): 1) In 2004, the number of visitors to theme parks stood at 12 million, the highest figure of the four. 2) Museum visitor numbers reached 14 million in 2024. 3) National parks drew level with theme parks in 2014, at 9 million visitors each, and overtook them over the following decade. 4) Zoo attendance remained stable at 6 million between 2004 and 2014, before dipping slightly to 5 million in 2024. 5) Visitor numbers at theme parks fell steadily, from 12 million in 2004 to 7 million in 2024. 6) Visitor numbers at museums and national parks rose; theme parks, by contrast, lost 5 million visitors over the period. Diqqat: bu jadvalda "a peak of" ishlatilmaydi — hech bir ko'rsatkich o'rtadagi yilda (2014) eng yuqori nuqtaga chiqib, keyin tushmaydi.

normativ: 8 savolning har biriga dalil bilan javob
170–200 so'z, raqamsiz overview, 2 mantiqiy body xatboshi, shaxsiy xulosasiz

kahoot.q: Which is a Band 7 requirement for Task Achievement in Task 1?
options: A clear overview of the main trends
Every figure in the chart described in detail
A personal conclusion at the end
kahoot.explain: Band 7: talablarni qamrash va asosiy tendensiya/farqlarning ANIQ overview'i. Hamma raqamni sanash — Band 5 belgisi.

kahoot.q: Which sentence is an IRRELEVANT detail in a Task 1 answer?
options: This shows people care more about their health.
By 2015, water had overtaken all the other drinks.
Soft drinks peaked at 105 litres in 2010.
kahoot.explain: Sabab va xulosa grafikda yo'q — bu "irrelevant detail" (Band 6). Qolganlari — faktlar.

kahoot.q: Tea consumption went from 110 to 104 litres. Which description is accurate?
kahoot.explain: 6 litrlik o'zgarish — kichik. Fell dramatically / plummet / crash — juda keskin tushish, noto'g'ri tafsilot.

kahoot.q: The chart gives data about teenagers. Which phrase would be accurate in your answer?
kahoot.explain: Sinonim guruhni o'zgartirmasligi kerak: young people, children, population — boshqa yoki kengroq guruh — fakt noto'g'ri bo'ladi.

kahoot.q: Which linker is typical for the first step of a PROCESS, not for a graph?
kahoot.explain: First — jarayon bosqichlari uchun. Grafik tasvirida "First, chicken stood at..." mexanik va o'rinsiz.

kahoot.q: 'On contrary, beef consumption fell.' What is the problem?
options: The phrase is too formal for Task 1
The verb is in the wrong tense
kahoot.explain: "On the contrary" oldingi fikrni rad etadi; farqni ko'rsatish uchun By contrast (yoki In contrast) kerak.

kahoot.q: Why is 'Also, coffee rose steadily.' weak in academic writing?
options: 'Also' is never used in academic writing
kahoot.explain: Gap boshidagi Also so'zlashuvga xos. To'g'risi: "Coffee also rose steadily."

kahoot.q: Correct this: 'Tea, despite its early lead, it fell to 70 litres.'
kahoot.explain: Ega (Tea) allaqachon bor; "it" ikkinchi ega bo'lib qoladi. "Tea, despite its early lead, fell to 70 litres."

kahoot.q: Which sentence is punctuated correctly?
options: Tea, which was the most widely consumed drink, fell.
Tea which was the most widely consumed drink, fell.
Tea, which was the most widely consumed drink fell.
Tea which, was the most widely consumed drink fell.
kahoot.explain: Qo'shimcha ma'lumot beruvchi which-clause ikki tomondan vergul bilan ajratiladi.

kahoot.q: A line graph shows two rising and two falling items. Best body paragraph plan?
options: Rising items together, then falling items
All the details in one long paragraph
kahoot.explain: O'xshash tendensiyalar bitta xatboshida — solishtirish o'z-o'zidan chiqadi va mantiq aniq ko'rinadi (TA + CC).

kahoot.q: Do you need a Task 2-style conclusion in Task 1?
options: No - a clear overview is enough
kahoot.explain: Task 1 — summary. Overview'ni oxirida berish mumkin, lekin fikr yoki maslahat bilan xulosa TA ni pasaytiradi.

kahoot.q: 'Furthermore' is used correctly when the new information is...
options: more important than the previous point
a contrast with the previous point
the first step in a process
kahoot.explain: Furthermore — undan ham muhimroq qo'shimcha. Oddiy tafsilot oldidan ishlatilsa, mexanik (Band 6).

kahoot.q: Tea consumption ____ at 110 litres in 2000.
kahoot.explain: stand at + raqam — boshlang'ich miqdor. Registered / underwent / oscillated bu yerda noto'g'ri ishlatiladi.

kahoot.q: Water rose from 30 to 120 litres. It finished at ____ its initial level.
kahoot.explain: 120 / 30 = 4. "four times its initial level" — Band 7+ aniq solishtirish.

kahoot.q: By 2015, bottled water ____ every other drink.
kahoot.explain: overtake — quvib o'tmoq (grafikda chiziq boshqasidan oshib ketadi). "By 2015" — shu yilgacha tugagan o'zgarish, shuning uchun had + V3.

kahoot.q: Soft drinks rose to a ____ of 105 litres in 2010, then fell.
kahoot.explain: a peak of — eng yuqori nuqta. bottom / dip — eng past nuqta, base — asos.

kahoot.q: What does 'fluctuate' mean?
options: go up and down several times
fall very sharply on one occasion
kahoot.explain: fluctuate — bir necha marta ko'tarilib-tushish. Bitta o'sish yoki tushishga ishlatilmaydi.

kahoot.q: Coffee rose in every five-year period, from 40 to 95 litres. It rose ____.
kahoot.explain: steadily — bir tekis, muntazam. Suddenly / overnight — birdan; slightly — juda kam (55 litr kam emas).

kahoot.q: Tea declined, ____ bottled water rose fourfold.
kahoot.explain: whereas — bir gap ichida qarama-qarshilik. Similarly — o'xshashlik uchun.

kahoot.q: 'Relatively little overall change' best describes which drink?
kahoot.explain: Gazli ichimliklar boshida va oxirida deyarli bir xil — umuman kam o'zgarish.

lessons.title: Writing Task 1 (2): Tahlilning 3 qadami va kirish gap (paraphrase)
lessons.grammar_topic: Yozishdan oldingi 3 qadam (details → key features → grouping) va kirish gap: what / where / when, "show" ni to'g'ri paraphrase qilish, relative clause, namely, vaqt predloglari, map / plan kirish gapi
lessons.vocab_topic: Kirish gap va paraphrase tili: grafik turlari, "show" o'rnidagi fe'llar, vaqt va joy iboralari, map / plan fe'llari
lessons.book_ref: Pauline Cullen, "The Key to IELTS Writing Task 1" (Bands 7–9): Lesson 3 — Getting started (3.1 Noticing details, 3.2 Identifying key features, 3.3 Organising information), Lesson 4 — Introductory sentences (4.1–4.3); PDF 27–55-betlar.
objectives: Yozishdan oldingi 3 qadamni 5 daqiqadan kam vaqtda bajara olish: 1) aniq nima o'lchanganini ko'rish; 2) asosiy xususiyatlarni belgilar bilan ajratish; 3) ma'lumotni xatboshilarga guruhlash.
Savolni noto'g'ri tushunish (Band 3 TA) qanday sodir bo'lishini bilish va "sales", "earned", "produced", "used" kabi farqlarni sezish.

Savol qog'ozida belgilar tizimidan foydalanish: ↑ ↓ ↑↑↑, (1) / (2) — ustundagi 1- va 2-o'rin, * — muhim nuqta (eng yuqori / eng past raqam, katta o'zgarish), ! — g'ayrioddiy raqam, } — o'xshash guruh.
Kirish gapni what + where + when formulasi bilan tez va aniq yozish; uni overview bilan aralashtirmaslik.
"Show" o'rniga noto'g'ri sinonimlardan (display, demonstrate, reveal, tell) qochish; noun ↔ verb, active ↔ passive, relative clause, namely va predloglar bilan paraphrase qilish.
Map / plan savollari uchun kirish gap yozish: prior to / following, construct, redevelop, refurbish.
materials: Kitob sahifalari: 3 qadam (PDF 28, 30, 33, 37) va kirish gap (PDF 41, 46, 50, 55) — quyidagi Reading bo'limidagi ikki rasm, proyektorda.
Jony Academy jadvallari: bitta onlayn chipta agentligi orqali sotilgan teatr va festival chiptalari (mashq uchun to'qilgan) — har o'quvchiga toza nusxa (grid) va ustoz belgilari tushirilgan rasm.
Rangli qalamlar: o'quvchilar savol qog'oziga belgilar qo'yadi.
Namuna javob (201 so'z) — chop etilgan.
Taymer: har qadamga vaqt (step 1 — 1 daqiqa, step 2 — 2–3 daqiqa, step 3 — 1 daqiqa).
Kahoot (20 savol) — dars oxirida.
timeline: Kirish
Savol: "Savolni o'qib bo'lgach, darhol yozishni boshlaysizmi?" Ustoz: yozishdan oldingi 5 daqiqa — butun javobning sifatini hal qiladi.
1-qadam: Noticing details (kitob, PDF 28, 30)
Shar tajribasi: grafik "qancha vaqtda 20 sm ga ko'tarildi"ni o'lchaydi — kam soniya = yaxshi. Fairtrade jadvali: "sales" ≠ "earned". 1-mashq.
2-qadam: Key features va belgilar (PDF 33, 37)
Ustoz teatr jadvalida belgilarni ko'rsatadi (rasm); o'quvchilar festival jadvaliga o'zi belgilaydi.
3-qadam: Guruhlash
Eng mantiqiy guruh ko'pincha eng oddiysi: ikki jadval — ikki xatboshi. 2-mashq.
Kirish gap: what / where / when va "show" (PDF 41, 46)
Savol gapini bo'laklarga ajratish; noto'g'ri "show"-sinonimlari. 3- va 4-mashq.
Relative clause, namely, predloglar (PDF 50)
Defining / reduced relative clause; in / from ... to / between ... and / during / for. 5-mashq.
Map / plan kirish gapi (PDF 55)
prior to / following, construct, redevelop; kirish gapga izoh qo'shmaslik.
Namuna javob tahlili
3 qadam → reja → javob: o'quvchilar belgilar va namunadagi gaplarni moslashtiradi.
Kahoot va vazifa
20 savolli kahoot; uyga: yangi ma'lumot bo'yicha 3 qadam + kirish gap + to'liq javob.

intro: Task 1 dagi ko'p muammolar juda erta yozishni boshlashdan kelib chiqadi. Yozishdan oldingi bosqich testda 5 daqiqadan oshmasligi kerak, shuning uchun uni tez-tez mashq qilish lozim. Rejani alohida qog'ozda emas, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri savol qog'ozidagi grafik ustida qilasiz.

1-QADAM — Noticing details: aniq NIMA o'lchanganini ko'ring (vaqt, soni, foiz, pul, birlik — thousands, millions of euros). Savolni butunlay noto'g'ri tushunish — Band 3 TA. Masalan, grafik "qancha vaqtda" ni o'lchasa, kichik raqam — yaxshi natija; "sales" jadvali kim pul "ishlagani" yoki kim "yetishtirgani" haqida hech narsa demaydi.
Faqat detallarni ko'rish yetarli emas: agar shu bilan to'xtasangiz, hamma raqamni sanab chiqasiz (Band 5 — "focuses on details"). Shuning uchun 2-qadam kerak.

2-QADAM — Key features: eng katta o'zgarishlar, eng yuqori / eng past raqamlar, o'xshashliklar, o'zgarmay qolganlar va g'ayrioddiy raqamlar. Ularni belgilar bilan savol qog'oziga tushiring: ↑ ↓ (o'sish / kamayish), ↑↑↑ (keskin o'zgarish), (1) / (2) — ustundagi 1- va 2-o'rin (eng yuqori raqamlar), * — muhim nuqta (eng yuqori / eng past raqam yoki katta o'zgarish), ! — g'ayrioddiy raqam, } — o'xshash narsalarni birlashtirish, strelka — gapda bog'lanadigan ikki raqam.

3-QADAM — Guruhlash: har body xatboshiga qaysi ma'lumot kirishini hal qiling. Eng mantiqiy tanlov ko'pincha eng oddiysi: ikki jadval — ikki xatboshi; pie chart + jadval — ikki xatboshi; map "oldin" va "keyin". Line graph'da 2–3 kategoriya o'ylab toping (masalan, eng yuqori / eng past ko'rsatkichlilar yoki erkaklar / ayollar). Yagona to'g'ri javob yo'q, lekin mantiq bo'lishi va javobda ko'rinishi shart.

KIRISH GAP — eng kam vaqt sarflanadigan gap. U uch savolga javob beradi: WHAT (grafik turi + show + nima o'lchangan), WHERE va WHEN (ba'zan WHO). Kirish gap — overview EMAS; unga izoh yoki xulosa qo'shmang.

"SHOW" ni almashtirish shart emas: "The tables show" o'rniga turini aniqlashtirish ("The two pie charts show") yetarli. Grafik va raqamlar ko'p narsa "qila olmaydi": display, demonstrate, indicate, reveal, represent, tell — ko'pincha noto'g'ri. "Illustrate how X changed" va (solishtirish bo'lsa) "compare" — to'g'ri.

Paraphrase usullari: noun → verb (sales of tickets → the number of tickets sold; the construction of → were constructed), active ↔ passive, grammatik tuzilmani o'zgartirish (tourist facilities → facilities for tourists), joy va vaqt tartibini almashtirish, "namely" bilan aniqlashtirish (in five countries, namely ...). "Changes in" faqat vaqt bo'yicha o'zgarish bo'lsa. Katta bo'laklarni ko'chirmang, lekin noaniq sinonimga ham o'tib ketmang; "below" va "the given" shart emas.

Relative clause: ega vazifasidagi who / that tushib qolmaydi (people WHO used buses); to'ldiruvchi bo'lsa tushirsa bo'ladi (the money (that) they earn); qisqartirilgan shakl: tourists visiting, tea drunk. Map / plan: "maps" so'zini o'zgartirmang; prior to / following, before / after, construct, develop, redevelop, refurbish.
formulas: Turini aniqlashtirish; shows / compares / illustrates how
noun → verb / passive; the number / proportion / amount of
"in five cities in Europe, namely Vienna, Prague, ..."
in the years ...; in two separate years; from ... to; over a thirty-year period
before and after the construction of ...
"maps" qoladi; prior to / following; were constructed; its development
"The maps show a town centre prior to and following its redevelopment."
the number of people who used buses
"the amount of tea drunk", "tourists visiting an island"
presentation: Vaqt yetmaydi — 5 daqiqani tahlilga sarflash shartmi?
Ha. Tahlilsiz javob — sanash (Band 5) va tartibsizlik (CC Band 5–6). Tahlil qilingan javob tezroq yoziladi, chunki har xatboshining mazmuni oldindan ma'lum.
Savoldan ketma-ket ikki so'zdan ortiq olsam jazolanamanmi?
Bunday qoida yo'q. Faqat katta bo'laklar va to'liq iboralarni ko'chirmang. So'z sanashga vaqt yo'q va bu xatoga olib keladi; ba'zi mavzularda ko'proq so'z bir xil qolishi tabiiy.
"Show" ni har doim almashtirishim kerakmi?
Yo'q. "The charts below show" → "The two pie charts show" yetarli farq. Noto'g'ri sinonim (display, reveal) — aniqlikni yo'qotadi.
Kirish gapga asosiy tendensiyani ham qo'shaymi?
Yo'q. Kirish gap — what / where / when. Tendensiya — overview'ning ishi. Izoh qo'shilsa, kirish gap uzun va chalkash bo'ladi.
Belgilarni qog'ozga qo'yishga ruxsat bormi?
Ha, savol qog'ozida ishlash mumkin. Har doim bir xil belgilardan foydalaning — shunda tahlil tezlashadi.
Line graph'da xatboshilarni qanday bo'laman?
2–3 kategoriya tanlang: o'sganlar / kamayganlar, eng yuqori / eng past ko'rsatkichlilar, erkaklar / ayollar. Eng muhimi — mantiq bo'lsin va xatboshining birinchi gapida ko'rinsin.
notes: Kitobdagi Cambridge savollari (Fairtrade, land degradation, island map) faqat sahifa rasmida ko'rsatiladi; mashqlar va namuna javob Jony Academy jadvallariga asoslangan.
Ustoz belgilari tushirilgan rasmni avval yopib turing: o'quvchilar toza jadvalga o'zi belgi qo'ysin, keyin solishtiriladi.
Kirish gapni har darsda 1 daqiqalik "isitish" mashqi sifatida qaytaring: ustoz savol gapini o'qiydi — o'quvchilar 60 soniyada paraphrase qiladi.
mistakes: "Vienna earned 96 million euros from theatre tickets."
"96,000 theatre tickets were sold for Vienna."
Jadval pul emas, sotilgan chiptalar sonini ko'rsatadi (1-qadam xatosi)
"The table displays / reveals the sales of ..."
"The table shows / compares the number of ... sold"
display — ko'rgazmaga qo'yish; reveal — yashirinni ochish
"below" va "the given" kerak emas; tabiiy emas
"The chart shows the number of people used buses."
"... the number of people who used buses."
"The maps illustrate the island, which became a place full of amenities."
"The maps show an island prior to and following its development."
Kirish gapga izoh qo'shilgan; "the island" — hali tanishtirilmagan

how: CORE — kirish gap va tahlil uchun asosiy so'zlar; STRONG — map / plan va o'zgarish darajasi; SUPER — Band 7–8 javoblaridagi solishtirish iboralari.
Har so'z bilan teatr / festival chiptalari jadvali yoki o'zingiz tanlagan Cambridge savoli haqida bitta gap tuzing.
core: The line graph illustrates how electricity production changed.
Chiziqli grafik elektr ishlab chiqarish qanday o'zgarganini ko'rsatadi.
The tables compare sales in five cities.
...in three countries, namely Japan, Korea and China.
...uch mamlakatda, ya'ni Yaponiya, Koreya va Xitoyda.
The maps show the town prior to its redevelopment.
Xaritalar shaharni qayta qurilishdan oldin ko'rsatadi.
...and following the construction of a new bridge.
Two hotels were constructed near the beach.
The maps show an island before and after its development.
Xaritalar orolni rivojlantirishdan oldin va keyin ko'rsatadi.
Sales of festival tickets rose in every city.
Festival chiptalari sotuvi har bir shaharda oshdi.
The chart shows the proportion of adults who cycle.
Diagramma velosiped haydaydigan kattalar ulushini ko'rsatadi.
Sales are given in thousands of units.
strong: The old market area was redeveloped.
Prague saw its figure roughly triple to 55,000.
Pragada ko'rsatkich taxminan uch barobar oshib, 55 000 ga yetdi.
Theatre ticket sales for Naples dipped slightly from 5,000 to 4,000.
Neapol uchun teatr chiptalari sotuvi 5 000 dan 4 000 ga biroz pasaydi.
Festival ticket sales were modest everywhere in 2015.
2015 yilda festival chiptalari sotuvi hamma joyda uncha katta emas edi.
In 2015, festival ticket sales ranged from 1,000 for Krakow to 14,000 for Naples.
2015 yilda festival chiptalari sotuvi Krakov uchun 1 000 dan Neapol uchun 14 000 gacha bo'ldi.
super: albeit from a very low base
garchi juda past boshlang'ich darajadan bo'lsa-da
Theatre ticket sales for Krakow also rose, albeit from a very low base.
Krakov uchun teatr chiptalari sotuvi ham oshdi, garchi juda past darajadan bo'lsa-da.
ɔːlˈbiːɪt frəm ə ˈveri ləʊ beɪs
Naples and Lisbon led the way for festivals.
Festivallar bo'yicha Neapol va Lissabon yetakchi bo'ldi.
more than twice the figure for
In 2015, theatre ticket sales for Vienna were more than twice the figure for Prague.
2015 yilda Vena uchun teatr chiptalari sotuvi Praga ko'rsatkichidan ikki barobardan ko'proq edi.
mɔː ðən twaɪs ðə ˈfɪɡə fə
Theatre ticket sales rose in four of the five cities; Naples was the only exception, with sales dipping slightly.
Teatr chiptalari sotuvi besh shahardan to'rttasida oshdi; Neapol yagona istisno bo'ldi — sotuv biroz pasaydi.

class_ex.title: 1-mashq (1-qadam): Jadvalni noto'g'ri tushungan gaplar
class_ex.instr: Teatr / festival chiptalari jadvaliga qarang (bitta onlayn agentlik sotgan chiptalar, ming dona). Har gapda nima noto'g'ri tushunilganini ayting va tuzating. Bitta gap to'g'ri.
items: The agency earned 96 million euros from theatre tickets for Vienna in 2025.
Naples organised 70 festivals in 2025.
Fewer people in Naples went to the theatre in 2025 than in 2015.
Only 26 festival tickets were sold for Krakow in 2025.
Festival ticket sales for Prague rose by 48,000 over the decade.
In 2025, the agency sold 70,000 festival tickets for Naples.
answers: Xato: pul emas, chipta soni — "96,000 theatre tickets were sold for Vienna".
Xato: festivallar soni emas, sotilgan chiptalar soni — 70,000 tickets.
Xato: jadval teatrga borganlarni emas, bitta agentlik sotgan chiptalarni ko'rsatadi — "theatre ticket sales for Naples dipped slightly".
Xato: 9 dan 48 ga — "rose to 48,000" (39,000 ga oshdi).
why: Birlik (thousands) va o'lchov (tickets sold) — 1-qadamda doira ichiga olinadi.
Jadval tadbirlar sonini emas, chiptalarni sanaydi — Fairtrade misolidagi kabi "nima" aniq o'qilsin.
Chipta sotuvi ≠ teatrga borganlar soni (boshqa yo'llar bilan ham chipta olinadi). Bunday gap noto'g'ri fakt, TA pasayadi.
Birlikni o'tkazib yuborish — eng tez-tez uchraydigan noto'g'ri tafsilot.
"by" — farq, "to" — yakuniy raqam; predlog xatosi ham noto'g'ri tafsilot.
Savolda sotuvchi aytilgan (one online agency) — gap jadvalga to'liq mos.

class_ex.title: 2-mashq (3-qadam): Eng mantiqiy guruhlash qaysi?
class_ex.instr: Har savol turi uchun body xatboshilar rejasini tanlang.
items: 1 Two tables: theatre tickets and festival tickets sold in five cities (2015, 2025). A) P3 — 2015, P4 — 2025 B) P3 — theatre, P4 — festivals C) one paragraph per city
2 Two maps: a village in 2000 and today. A) one paragraph per building B) P3 — north, P4 — south, always C) P3 — the village in 2000, P4 — what changed since then
3 Line graph: men and women studying five university courses, 2000–2020. A) one paragraph per year B) one paragraph per course C) P3 — women, P4 — men (or the courses with the most / fewest students)
4 A pie chart (causes worldwide) and a table (causes in three regions). A) P3 — the pie chart, P4 — the table B) P3 — the highest figures, P4 — the lowest C) everything in one paragraph
why: Ikki jadval, ikki xil chipta — ikki xatboshi: eng oddiy va eng aniq mantiq.
Map: "oldin" va "keyin" (yoki nima olib tashlandi / nima qo'shildi). Shimol / janub faqat o'zgarishlar shunday bo'lingan bo'lsa.
Line graph'da o'zingiz 2 kategoriya tanlaysiz; har kurs alohida — ro'yxat.
Har grafik o'z xatboshisida; ichida eng yuqori / eng past raqamlar solishtiriladi.

class_ex.title: 3-mashq: What / where / when — va paraphrase
class_ex.instr: Har savol gapida WHAT, WHERE, WHEN ni belgilang, keyin kirish gapni o'z so'zingiz bilan yozing (1 daqiqa).
items: The graph below shows the amount of electricity produced from four sources in Australia between 1990 and 2020.
The table below gives information about the number of international students enrolled at universities in three countries in 2010 and 2020.
The bar chart below shows the percentage of adults in one city who used public transport every day, by age group, in 2022.
The diagrams below show a town centre in 2005 and plans for its redevelopment.
answers: The line graph illustrates how much electricity was generated from four sources in Australia over a thirty-year period, from 1990 to 2020.
The table compares how many international students were studying at universities in three countries in two separate years, 2010 and 2020.
The bar chart shows the proportion of adults in different age groups in one city who travelled by public transport daily in 2022.
The plans show a town centre as it was in 2005 and how it will look following its redevelopment.
why: noun → passive (produced → was generated); "between ... and" → "over a thirty-year period, from ... to".
"number of ... enrolled" → "how many ... were studying"; "compares" — jadvalda ikki yil solishtiriladi.
percentage → proportion; every day → daily; who-clause saqlanadi (ega).

diagrams → plans: faqat turini aniqlashtiramiz. "map" / "plan" so'zining o'zini sinonim bilan almashtirmang — paraphrase gapning qolgan qismida: "in 2005" → "as it was in 2005", "plans for its redevelopment" → "how it will look following its redevelopment".

class_ex.title: 4-mashq: "Show" o'rnidagi fe'l to'g'rimi?
class_ex.instr: Fe'l aniq ishlatilganmi? "Yo'q" bo'lsa, tuzating.
items: The table displays the number of students enrolled in three countries.
The graph demonstrates how much electricity was produced from coal.
The line graph illustrates how electricity production changed over thirty years.
The charts reveal the percentage of adults who used buses.
The table compares the number of students in three countries.
The bar chart tells the percentage of adults in each age group.
why: display — narsani ko'rinadigan joyga qo'yish (vitrinada).
demonstrate — biror narsani qanday qilishni ko'rsatish yoki isbotlash.
"illustrate how ... changed" — idiomatik va aniq.
reveal — yashirin narsani ochish; grafikda yashirin narsa yo'q.
Jadvalda solishtirish bor — compare o'rinli.
tell kimgadir to'ldiruvchi talab qiladi (tell someone something).

class_ex.title: 5-mashq: Relative clause, namely va predloglar
class_ex.instr: Bo'shliqqa bitta so'z yoki shakl yozing (kerak bo'lmasa "—").
items: The chart shows the number of students ____ attended evening classes.
The graph shows the amount of energy ____ (produce) by wind. (qisqartirilgan shakl)
The table shows the number of tourists ____ (visit) three islands. (qisqartirilgan shakl)
The figure remained stable ____ the first five years.
...in three countries, ____ Japan, Korea and China.
The maps show a town centre ____ and ____ its redevelopment.
The pie chart shows household spending ____ 1995.
why: students — "attended" ning egasi; who / that tushirilmaydi.
that was produced → produced (passiv qisqartma).
who visited / visit → visiting (aktiv qisqartma).
Davrning boshi va oxiri: from ... to yoki between ... and.
Davomiylik: for; davr davomida: during / over.
Nomlarni sanashdan oldin; vergul namely dan OLDIN.
Map / plan kirish gapi uchun tayyor juftlik.
Aniq bir yil — in.

readings.title: Kitob: Yozishdan oldingi 3 qadam
readings.source: Pauline Cullen, The Key to IELTS Writing Task 1 — Lesson 3 (PDF 28, 30, 33, 37-betlar)
readings.book_ref: 28: shar tajribasi — ma'lumotni noto'g'ri tushunish (Band 3); 30: Fairtrade jadvali — 30 soniyada detallarni topish; 33: key features belgilari va land degradation mashqi; 37: muallifning to'liq belgilari (Fairtrade).

tasks.title: Sahifalar bo'yicha savollar
tasks.type: Og'zaki
tasks.instr: Ustoz sahifani ko'rsatadi, o'quvchilar o'z so'zi bilan javob beradi.
items: Shar tajribasida grafik aslida nimani o'lchaydi? Nega "1 candle is better" xato?
Fairtrade jadvali kim pul ishlagani haqida nima deydi?
Muallif (1) va * belgilarini qayerga qo'yadi?
"!" belgisi nimani bildiradi?
Fairtrade savoli uchun muallif xatboshilarni qanday bo'lgan?
answers: Shar 20 sm balandlikka qancha soniyada chiqqanini; kam soniya — tezroq, ya'ni 3 sham yaxshiroq.
Hech narsa: faqat sotuv qiymati; kim sotgani va kim ishlagani noma'lum.

(1) — har ustundagi eng yuqori raqam yoniga (coffee: Switzerland 1999, UK 2004; bananas: Switzerland); * — muhim ma'lumot yoniga (katta o'zgarish, eng yuqori yoki eng past nuqta). Muhim raqamlar doiraga olinadi.
G'ayrioddiy narsa: umumiy o'sish fonida kamayish (Fairtrade bananlari — Sweden va Denmark ↓!) yoki 0 kabi raqam.
Ikki jadval — ikki xatboshi: coffee va bananas.
why: 1-qadam: o'lchov birligi va ma'nosi. Butun javob shunga qurilsa — Band 3 TA.
1-qadam: "sales" so'zini aniq o'qish.
2-qadam: qaysi hudud / shahar tez-tez eng yuqori ekanini ko'rish.
2-qadam: istisnolar — asosiy xususiyat.
3-qadam: eng oddiy guruh — eng mantiqiy.

readings.title: Kitob: Kirish gap va paraphrase
readings.source: Pauline Cullen, The Key to IELTS Writing Task 1 — Lesson 4 (PDF 41, 46, 50, 55-betlar)
readings.book_ref: 41: savol gapi qanday bo'laklardan iborat (what / where / when); 46: "show" o'rniga noto'g'ri ishlatiladigan fe'llar; 50: where / when ni paraphrase qilish, namely, predloglar; 55: kirish gapga ortiqcha izoh qo'shish xatosi.

tasks.title: Sahifalar bo'yicha savollar
tasks.type: Og'zaki
tasks.instr: Ustoz sahifani ko'rsatadi, o'quvchilar o'z so'zi bilan javob beradi.
items: 41-bet: Fairtrade savol gapida WHAT, WHEN va WHERE qaysi bo'laklar? WHEN va WHERE tartibini almashtirish mumkinmi?
46-bet: "display", "demonstrate", "reveal" va "tell" nega "show" o'rnida ko'pincha noto'g'ri?
50-bet: "in 1999 and 2004" va "in five European countries" ni qanday paraphrase qilish mumkin? "namely" bilan vergul qayerga qo'yiladi?
55-bet: Orol xaritasi haqidagi kirish gapda qanday ikki xato bor? To'g'ri variant qanday?
answers: WHAT — jadval turi + give information about + sales of Fairtrade-labelled coffee and bananas; WHEN — in 1999 and 2004; WHERE — in five European countries. Ha, WHEN va WHERE ba'zan o'rin almashadi.

display — narsani ko'rinadigan joyga qo'yish; demonstrate — qanday qilinishini ko'rsatish yoki isbotlash; reveal — yashirin narsani ochish; tell — to'ldiruvchi talab qiladi (tell someone something). Raqam va grafiklar ko'p narsa "qila olmaydi".

Vaqt: "in the years 1999 and 2004", "in two separate years". Joy: "in five countries in Europe" yoki nomlari bilan: "..., namely the UK, Switzerland, Denmark, Belgium and Sweden". Vergul namely dan OLDIN qo'yiladi.

1) "the island" — orol hali tanishtirilmagan (an island bo'lishi kerak); 2) izoh qo'shilgan (huvillagan joy turistlar uchun qulay joyga aylangani) — bu what / where / when ga javob emas. To'g'risi (kitob, 55-bet): "The maps show an island prior to and following its development as a tourist destination."
why: Kirish gap formulasi: what + where + when (ba'zan who).
Noaniq sinonim aniqlikni yo'qotadi; show, compare, illustrate how ... — xavfsiz.
Predlog, tartib yoki sinonim bilan paraphrase; nomlarni sanash — namely.
Kirish gap — overview emas; izoh va baho keyingi xatboshilarga qoladi.

readings.title: NAMUNA: 3 qadam → reja → javob
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna javobi (201 so'z: 31 + 48 + 62 + 60; jadval ma'lumotlari mashq uchun to'qilgan)
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: The tables below give information about sales of theatre tickets and music festival tickets through one online ticket agency in five European cities in 2015 and 2025. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.  |  RASM: ustozning 2-qadam belgilari.  |  REJA: O — both ↑ almost everywhere, festivals ↑↑↑ (total 37 → 215 > theatre 190); Vienna (1) theatre, Naples / Lisbon (1)(2) festivals. P3 — theatre. P4 — festivals.
text: The tables compare the number of theatre and music festival tickets sold by one online agency in five European cities, namely Vienna, Prague, Lisbon, Krakow and Naples, in 2015 and 2025.

Overall, sales of both types of ticket rose in almost every city over the decade, but festival tickets grew far more dramatically, and by 2025 they had overtaken theatre tickets. Vienna was by far the largest market for theatre, whereas Naples and Lisbon led the way for festivals.

In 2015, 42,000 theatre tickets were sold for Vienna, more than twice the figure for Prague, and by 2025 sales there had more than doubled to 96,000. Prague saw its figure roughly triple to 55,000, and sales for Lisbon and Krakow also increased, albeit from a very low base. Naples was the only exception, with sales dipping slightly from 5,000 to 4,000.

Festival ticket sales, on the other hand, were modest everywhere in 2015, ranging from just 1,000 for Krakow to 14,000 for Naples. By 2025, however, they had reached 70,000 for Naples and 62,000 for Lisbon, while the figure for Prague had risen more than fivefold to 48,000. For Vienna, by comparison, only 9,000 were sold, the lowest figure in 2025.
paraphrases: The tables below give information about
The tables compare
sales of theatre tickets and music festival tickets
the number of theatre and music festival tickets sold
in five European cities
in five European cities, namely Vienna, Prague, Lisbon, Krakow and Naples
over the decade, in 2015, by 2025

tasks.title: Jadvallar (o'quvchiga toza nusxa — ming chipta)
tasks.type: Tickets sold, thousands
tasks.instr: Rasmni ko'rmasdan oldin 3 qadamni o'zingiz bajaring: nima o'lchangan, belgilar, ikki xatboshi rejasi (5 daqiqa).
head: City
Theatre 2015
Theatre 2025
Festivals 2015
Festivals 2025

tasks.title: Belgilar va namuna javobni moslashtiring
tasks.type: Og'zaki
tasks.instr: Ustoz belgilari (rasm) va namuna javobga qarab javob bering.
items: Kirish gapda what / where / when qayerda? Qaysi paraphrase usullari ishlatilgan?
"TOTAL 37 → 215" belgisi javobning qaysi gapiga aylangan?
"Naples ↓ ! only fall" belgisi qaysi gapda?
Nega javobda "Vienna sold 9,000" emas, "only 9,000 were sold for Vienna" yozilgan?
"albeit from a very low base" qaysi belgidan kelib chiqqan?
Kirish gapda overview yoki izoh bormi?
answers: What — the number of ... sold; where — five European cities, namely ...; when — in 2015 and 2025. Noun → passive (sales of → sold), namely.
Overview: "by 2025 they had overtaken theatre tickets" (215 > 190).
"Naples was the only exception, with sales dipping slightly from 5,000 to 4,000."
Shahar chipta sotmaydi — agentlik sotadi; passiv aniqroq (1-qadam).
Lisbon va Krakow yonidagi "} (low base)" belgisidan.
why: Kirish gap formulasi — PDF 41.
Jami raqamlar belgisi — asosiy xususiyat, shuning uchun overview'da.
"!" — istisno: Band 7 da "highlight key features".
Noticing details — Fairtrade xatosining takrorlanmasligi.
} — o'xshash narsalarni bitta gapda birlashtirish.
PDF 55: kirish gapga izoh qo'shish xatosi.

homework_intro: Bugun yozishdan oldingi 3 qadamni va kirish gap formulasini (what / where / when) o'rgandik.

Birinchi vazifa — quyidagi ma'lumot uchun 3 qadamni yozma bajaring: "The tables below show the percentage of people in three age groups in one country who mainly paid in shops by cash, card or phone in 2014 and 2024. 2014 — cash: 16–30 40%, 31–50 55%, 51+ 75%; card: 50%, 40%, 23%; phone: 10%, 5%, 2%. 2024 — cash: 5%, 15%, 35%; card: 42%, 57%, 53%; phone: 53%, 28%, 12%."
Ikkinchi vazifa — sinfdagi 3-mashqdagi to'rt savol gapi uchun kirish gapni har biriga IKKI xil usulda yozing (bitta noun → verb, bitta boshqa usul).
Uchinchi vazifa — to'lov jadvallari bo'yicha to'liq javob, 170–200 so'z, 20 daqiqa (5 daqiqa — tahlil, 15 — yozish).

homework.title: 3 qadam: to'lov usullari jadvallari
homework.instr: 1) Nima o'lchanganini 2 gapda yozing (foiz, "mainly paid"). 2) Belgilar bilan kamida 5 ta key feature. 3) Ikki xatboshi rejasi.
homework.answers: Namuna: 1) foiz — asosiy to'lov usuli, soni emas. 2) cash ↓↓↓ hamma guruhda (51+ hali ham (1)); phone ↑↑↑, 16–30 (1) 53%; card ↑ 31–50 va 51+, lekin 16–30 da ↓ (!); 2024 da 16–30 uchun phone > card; 51+ — naqd pulga eng sodiq. 3) P3 — cash va card; P4 — phone (yoki P3 — 2014, P4 — 2024 emas: tendensiya yo'qoladi).

homework.title: Kirish gap: 4 savol × 2 usul
homework.instr: Har savolga ikki xil kirish gap. "Show" o'rnida faqat aniq fe'l; "below" va "the given" ishlatmang.
homework.answers: Ustoz eng yaxshi uchta variantni keyingi dars boshida "1 daqiqalik isitish"da o'qiydi.

homework.title: To'liq javob: to'lov usullari
homework.instr: Kirish (what / where / when) + raqamsiz overview + 2 body xatboshi, 170–200 so'z.
homework.answers: Namuna kirish: "The tables compare the proportion of people in three age groups in one country who mainly used cash, cards or phones to pay in shops in 2014 and 2024." Namuna overview: "Overall, cash became far less common in every age group, while phone payments rose sharply, especially among the youngest people; older shoppers, however, still relied on cash more than any other group."

normativ: o'lchov to'g'ri yozilgan, 5+ key feature, mantiqiy reja
what / where / when to'liq, noto'g'ri sinonim yo'q
170–200 so'z, ma'lumot to'g'ri tushunilgan, overview raqamsiz, 2 body xatboshi

kahoot.q: How long should the pre-writing stage (the 3 steps) take in the real test?
options: No time - start writing at once
kahoot.explain: Tahlil 5 daqiqadan oshmasin — shuning uchun uni ko'p mashq qilish kerak. Umuman qilmaslik — Band 5 (sanash) xavfi.

kahoot.q: A chart shows the SECONDS a balloon needed to reach 20 cm. A lower bar means...
options: a longer time in the air
kahoot.explain: O'lchov — balandlikka yetish vaqti: kam soniya = tezroq. Buni tushunmaslik — Band 3 TA (savol noto'g'ri tushunilgan).

kahoot.q: Step 1 (noticing details) mainly checks...
options: what is measured and in which units
your own opinion of what the data shows
which linking words to use in each paragraph
how many words you should write in total
kahoot.explain: O'lchov va birlik (thousands, %, euros) — doira ichiga olinadi. Aks holda noto'g'ri tafsilot yoziladi.

kahoot.q: What belongs in the INTRODUCTORY sentence?
options: What is shown, where and when
The main trend over the period
kahoot.explain: Kirish gap — what / where / when. Asosiy tendensiya va eng yuqori / eng past ko'rsatkichlar (raqamsiz) — overview'da, aniq raqamlar — body'da; izoh — umuman kerak emas.

kahoot.q: Best paraphrase of 'The table below shows sales of theatre tickets in 2015 and 2025'?
options: The table compares the number of theatre tickets sold in 2015 and 2025.
The given table displays the theatre tickets in 2015 and 2025.
The table reveals how much money theatre tickets earned in 2015 and 2025.
Below table shows sales of theatre tickets in 2015 and 2025.
kahoot.explain: sales of → the number of ... sold (noun → passive), show → compare. Display / reveal / earned — noto'g'ri.

kahoot.q: Which verb is NOT an accurate replacement for 'show'?
kahoot.explain: display — narsani ko'rgazmaga qo'yish. Grafik uchun show, compare, illustrate how ..., give information about.

kahoot.q: 'The chart shows the number of people ____ used buses.' Which is correct?
kahoot.explain: people — "used" ning egasi, shuning uchun who tushirilmaydi.

kahoot.q: Reduce the clause: 'the amount of tea that was drunk' →
options: the amount of tea was drunk
the amount of tea that drunk
kahoot.explain: that was + V3 → faqat V3 (passiv qisqartma): tea drunk, energy produced.

kahoot.q: '...in five countries, ____ the UK, Spain, Italy, Poland and Greece.'
kahoot.explain: namely — "ya'ni", nomlarni sanashdan oldin; vergul namely dan oldin keladi.

kahoot.q: 'The line graph shows changes ____ 1990 and 2020.'
kahoot.explain: between ... and yoki from ... to. "from 1990 and 2020" — xato juftlik.

kahoot.q: Two tables: coffee sales and banana sales in five countries. Best body paragraphs?
kahoot.explain: Eng mantiqiy guruh — eng oddiysi: ikki jadval — ikki xatboshi.

kahoot.q: Which introductory sentence wrongly adds a comment?
options: The maps show how an island changed, making it far more attractive.
The maps show an island before and after tourist facilities were built.
The maps show changes made to an island after its development.
The maps show an island prior to and following its development.
kahoot.explain: "making it far more attractive" — izoh / baho; kirish gapga kirmaydi.

kahoot.q: 'Prior to' means...
kahoot.explain: prior to = before; following = after. "prior to and following its development".

kahoot.q: To ____ a building = to repair and decorate it so it looks new again.
kahoot.explain: refurbish — ta'mirlab yangilash. construct — qurish, demolish — buzish, relocate — ko'chirish.

kahoot.q: Replacing old buildings in an area with new ones = to ____ the area.
kahoot.explain: redevelop — eskisini yangisiga almashtirib qayta qurish; refurbish / renovate — mavjud binoni ta'mirlash.

kahoot.q: A chart with each bar divided into coloured sections is a...
kahoot.explain: stacked bar chart — har ustun qismlarga bo'lingan; clustered bar chart — ustunlar yonma-yon guruhlangan, bo'linmagan. Kirish gapda turini aniq aytish — oson paraphrase.

kahoot.q: 'Sales rose, albeit from a very low base' means sales rose...
options: although the starting figure was very small
because the starting figure was already large
only in the cities at the bottom of the table
except at the very start of the period
kahoot.explain: albeit = although; "low base" — boshlang'ich raqam juda kichik edi.

kahoot.q: Festival ticket sales for Prague went from 9,000 to 48,000. They rose roughly...
kahoot.explain: 48 / 9 ≈ 5.3 — "more than fivefold".

kahoot.q: 'Construct' is closest in meaning to...
kahoot.explain: construct = build; "the construction of" → "were constructed / built".

kahoot.q: 'Naples and Lisbon led the way for festivals' means they...
options: had the highest festival ticket sales
organised the most festivals of all
built new roads to the festivals
kahoot.explain: lead the way — yetakchi bo'lish (eng yuqori ko'rsatkich). Festivallar soni — jadvalda yo'q ma'lumot.

lessons.title: Writing Task 1 (3): Overview va asosiy xususiyatlarni tanlash
lessons.grammar_topic: Aniq (clear) overview: "Overall" + determinerlar (all of, only one of, most of) + umbrella terms + qarama-qarshilik; key features'ni present qilish, highlight qilish va raqam bilan isbotlash
lessons.vocab_topic: Trend kollokatsiyalari (experience / see / witness a rising trend), umbrella terms, natija tili (marginal gains, mixed results), ajratib ko'rsatish iboralari (by far, considerably higher than)
lessons.book_ref: Pauline Cullen, "The Key to IELTS Writing Task 1" — Lesson 5: The Overview and Highlighting Key Features (PDF bet 56–69): 5.1 overview vazifasi va tili, 5.2 aniq overview yozish, 5.3 key features'ni present va highlight qilish.
objectives: Band 5, 6 va 7 farqini bilish: overview bo'lmasa — Band 5 dan yuqori emas; overview bor, lekin aniq emas — Band 6 dan yuqori emas; Band 7 uchun overview ANIQ bo'lishi va barcha asosiy tendensiyalarni qamrab olishi shart.
Overview'ni "Overall," bilan boshlash va uni raqamsiz, tafsilotsiz, 1–2 gapda yozish.
Tafsilotdan qochish uchun determinerlar (all of, several of, only one of, both, neither) va umbrella terms (types of transport, dairy products) ishlatish.
Noaniq overview'ning 4 sababini tanib, tuzatish: faqat bitta tendensiya, noto'g'ri til, ortiqcha tafsilot, noaniq havola (these, the former).
Key feature'ni "ro'yxat" qilib emas, HIGHLIGHT qilib yozish: nima uchun muhimligini aytish (by far the biggest increase) va raqam bilan isbotlash.
Xatboshini mavzu bilan boshlash va har body paragraph'da faqat bitta guruh haqida yozish.
materials: Kitob sahifalari (Reading bo'limida, 2 ta rasm) — proyektorda: band descriptorlari, overview tili, umbrella terms, 5 ta overview tahlili, highlighting.
Jony Academy bar chart'i: e-bikes va e-scooters, 5 shahar, 2015 va 2025 — chop etilgan yoki ekranda.
Doskada overview formulasi: Overall, + [determiner] + [umbrella term] + [trend 1], while/whereas + [trend 2].
Rangli qalamlar: ko'k — umumiy gap (general statement), qizil — dalil (raqam).
Taymer: overview uchun 3 daqiqa, to'liq javob uchun 20 daqiqa.
timeline: Takrorlash
19-dars: tahlilning 3 qadami va kirish gap — bitta savolni birga paraphrase qilish.
Band talablari va overview vazifasi
Kitob sahifalari 57–58: Band 5/6/7 farqi; overview = qisqa, umumiy, tafsilotsiz; "Overall," signali.
Tafsilotsiz umumlashtirish
Determinerlar va umbrella terms (sahifalar 59, 61); 1- va 2-mashq.
Aniq va noaniq overview
Sahifalar 62, 64: bitta tendensiya, ortiqcha tafsilot, noto'g'ri til, noaniq havola; 3-mashq.
Present + highlight
Sahifalar 65–66: ro'yxat gap va highlight gap farqi; solishtirish orqali muhimlikni ko'rsatish; 4-mashq.
Namuna: chart → overview → javob
E-bike chart'i; 5-mashq (reja jadvali, juftlikda), keyin o'quvchilar 3 daqiqada overview yozadi, so'ng namuna javob o'qiladi va tahlil qilinadi.
Sinfda yozish
Namuna javobning 3–4-xatboshisini o'z so'zlari bilan qayta qurish (highlight + dalil); juftlik tekshiradi.
Xulosa va vazifa
Overview uchun 6 savolli tekshiruv ro'yxati (grammar notes oxirida; doskaga yoziladi); uy vazifasini tushuntirish.

intro: Band talabi (kitob, 57–58-betlar): Band 5 — tafsilotlarni mexanik sanaydi, aniq overview yo'q. Band 6 — overview bor, ma'lumot to'g'ri tanlangan. Band 7 — ASOSIY TENDENSIYALAR, farqlar yoki bosqichlarning ANIQ overview'i bor, key features aniq ajratib ko'rsatilgan. Band 8 — key features ko'rsatilgan, ajratilgan va misol bilan isbotlangan. Xulosa: overview'siz Band 6 ham yo'q.

Overview nima: grafikning qisqa, UMUMIY tasviri — tafsilotsiz, raqamsiz. U key features'ning qisqa xulosasi. Kitob muallifi overview'ni doimo "Overall," bilan boshlaydi: bu examinerga "hozir overview keladi" degan signal. Lekin so'zdan keyin haqiqatan umumiy gap kelishi shart.

Tafsilotdan qochishning ikki vositasi: 1) DETERMINERLAR — all of, most of, several of, some of, only one of, not all of, both, neither, each; 2) UMBRELLA TERMS — bir guruhni bitta nom bilan atash: "UK, Switzerland, Denmark" → "these countries"; "coffee and bananas" → "both products".

Trend kollokatsiyalari: experience / see / witness + a rising / falling / upward / downward / clear trend; "the opposite trend". Sotuv yoki foyda haqida: marginal / significant gains, mixed results. Diqqat: gains / losses faqat haqiqatan nimadir yutilgan yoki yo'qotilgan bo'lsa (sotuv) — energiya sarfi uchun emas.

Noaniq (unclear) overview'ning 4 sababi: 1) faqat BITTA tendensiya (ko'pincha faqat "eng yuqori" yoki "eng past"); 2) ma'lumotga mos kelmaydigan til yoki shaxsiy baho (worrying, exciting); 3) ortiqcha tafsilot — raqamlar, har bir davlat nomi; 4) noaniq havola — "these countries", "the former" nimaga ishora qilishi tushunarsiz.

Deyarli hech qachon hamma ma'lumot bir xil o'zgarmaydi — shuning uchun overview odatda QARAMA-QARSHILIK ko'rsatadi: while, whereas, although, however, despite. Formula: Overall, + tendensiya 1, while/whereas + tendensiya 2 (+ yana bitta muhim xususiyat).

Nima kiradi: 19-darsdagi tahlil (Step 2) da topilgan 5–6 key feature'ning UMUMIY xulosasi. Savol: "Grafikni 5 soniya ko'rsam, nimani eslab qolaman?" — asosiy yo'nalishlar, eng katta farq, kim yetakchi.

PRESENT va HIGHLIGHT: "The UK had sales of 1.5 million in 1999 and 20 million in 2004" — bu RO'YXAT (examiner: "Nega buni aytyapsiz?"). "The UK had BY FAR THE BIGGEST increase, rising from ... to ..." — bu HIGHLIGHT: avval nima muhimligini aytasiz, keyin raqam bilan isbotlaysiz. Solishtirish (the biggest, much higher than any other) muhimlikni ko'rsatishning eng oson yo'li.

Body paragraph tuzilmasi: xatboshi mavzu bilan boshlanadi ("Sales of e-bikes ...", "Electric scooters ...") va faqat shu mavzu haqida yozadi. Kitob muallifi har fikrni raqam bilan tasdiqlaydi — biz ham shunday qilamiz: umumiy gap + dalil.
formulas: Overall, e-bike sales rose in every city, whereas ...
"Overall" dan keyin raqam yozilsa — overview emas
all / most / only one of + these + [guruh nomi]
Only one of these countries witnessed a downward trend.
experience / see / witness + a rising / falling trend
Most cities saw a rising trend in scooter sales.
..., while the scooter market had mixed results.
Faqat bitta tendensiya — ko'pi bilan Band 6
muhimlik (by far the largest / the most dramatic) + raqam
Berlin saw the most dramatic growth, with sales quadrupling to 56,000.
Paragraph = bitta guruh, birinchi so'zlarda nomi
Electric scooters followed a less consistent pattern.
presentation: Overview'da umuman raqam bo'lmasinmi?
Ha. Overview — umumiy tasvir. Raqamlar body paragraph'larda dalil sifatida keladi. Raqam kirsa, overview "too much detail" bo'lib qoladi.
"Overall, the UK had the highest sales" — yetarlimi?
Yo'q. Bu faqat bitta xususiyat (eng yuqori). Aniq overview asosiy tendensiyalarni ko'rsatadi: nima oshdi, nima kamaydi, qayerda farq bor.
Overview qayerda bo'ladi?
Kirish gapidan keyin (bir xatboshida yoki alohida). Kitob muallifi uni kirishdan keyin darhol yozadi — examiner uni birinchi o'qiydi.
Umbrella term nima uchun kerak?
Beshta davlat nomini sanash o'rniga "these countries", "all five cities" deysiz — tafsilot yo'qoladi, gap umumiy bo'ladi.
Har fikrga raqam berish shartmi?
Band 8 da "illustrate key features" — ya'ni misol bilan ko'rsatish. Eng xavfsiz yo'l — har muhim fikrni tegishli raqam bilan tasdiqlash.
"Mixed results" qachon ishlatiladi?
Bir guruh ichida ba'zilari oshgan, ba'zilari kamaygan bo'lsa: "The scooter market had mixed results." Bu tafsilotsiz qarama-qarshilikni ko'rsatadi.
notes: Kitobdagi misol ma'lumotlari (Fairtrade coffee va bananas, Cambridge IELTS 10) faqat sahifa rasmida ko'rsatiladi; namuna javob — Jony Academy'niki, boshqa grafik bo'yicha.
Kitobning asosiy xabari: overview va key features'ni yozishdan OLDIN rejada belgilang — yozib bo'lgandan keyin tuzatish qiyin.
E-bike grafikdagi ma'lumotlar mashq uchun to'qilgan.

Overview tekshiruv ro'yxati (6 savol; dars oxirida doskaga yoziladi, 2-uy vazifasida ishlatiladi): 1) "Overall," bilan boshlanadimi? 2) Raqam va ortiqcha tafsilot (shahar/davlat nomlarini sanash) yo'qmi? Aniq yetakchini nomlash mumkin ("Amsterdam led ... by a wide margin"). 3) Barcha asosiy tendensiyalar (kamida 2 ta) bormi — faqat "eng yuqori/eng past" emasmi? 4) Determiner yoki umbrella term ishlatilganmi (all of, only one of, all five cities)? 5) Qarama-qarshilik ko'rsatilganmi (while, whereas)? 6) Til ma'lumotga mosmi va havola aniqmi (shaxsiy baho yo'q; "the former", "these" nimaga ishora qilishi aniq)?

class_ex.title: 3-mashq: Qaysi overview aniq? (e-bike chart'i bo'yicha)
class_ex.type: Choose A, B, C or D
class_ex.instr: Har savolda eng yaxshi variantni tanlang va qolganlarining muammosini nomlang: bitta tendensiya / ortiqcha tafsilot / noto'g'ri til / noaniq havola.
items: 1 Which overview is clear and complete? A) Overall, Amsterdam had the highest e-bike sales. B) Overall, e-bike sales rose in every city, whereas scooter sales had mixed results, and Amsterdam led the bicycle market by a wide margin. C) Overall, e-bike sales rose from 38,000 to 92,000 in Amsterdam and from 14,000 to 56,000 in Berlin. D) Overall, both vehicles experienced a rising trend.
2 What is wrong with: "Overall, the former grew, while the latter fell in these cities."? A) too much detail B) only one trend C) unclear referencing D) no contrast
3 What is wrong with: "Overall, the worrying decline of scooters shows people prefer bikes."? A) language not accurate / personal comment B) unclear referencing C) too much detail D) nothing
why: A — faqat bitta xususiyat; C — raqamlar (tafsilot); D — noto'g'ri: skuterlar hamma joyda oshmagan. B — ikki asosiy tendensiya + yetakchi, raqamsiz.
"the former / the latter / these" — nimaga ishora qilishi aniq emas. Kitob, 64-bet, 5-overview xuddi shu muammo.
"worrying" — shaxsiy baho; "people prefer" — grafikda afzallik haqida ma'lumot yo'q. Bundan tashqari skuterlar asosan oshgan.

class_ex.title: 4-mashq: Ro'yxatdan highlight'ga
class_ex.instr: Har "ro'yxat" gapni highlight gapga aylantiring: avval nega muhimligini ayting (the biggest, by far, the only, much higher than), keyin raqamni dalil qilib bering.
items: Berlin sold 14,000 e-bikes in 2015 and 56,000 in 2025.
Madrid sold 3,000 scooters in 2015 and 19,000 in 2025.
Amsterdam sold 5,000 scooters in 2015 and 3,000 in 2025.
Rome sold 4,000 e-bikes in 2015 and 6,000 in 2025.
answers: The most dramatic growth in e-bike sales was in Berlin, where the figure quadrupled to 56,000.
Madrid saw the steepest relative rise in scooter sales, which increased more than sixfold to 19,000.
Amsterdam was one of only two cities where scooter sales fell, dropping to just 3,000.
Rome remained the smallest e-bike market, with only a marginal rise to 6,000.
why: "the most dramatic" — solishtirish muhimlikni ko'rsatadi.
Nisbiy o'sish (sixfold) — raqam kichik bo'lsa ham key feature.
"one of only two" — istisno ekanini ta'kidlaydi.
"the smallest" + "marginal" — nega aytilayotgani aniq.

readings.title: NAMUNA: bar chart → overview → javob
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna javobi (192 so'z; grafik ma'lumotlari mashq uchun to'qilgan)
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: The charts below show the number of electric bicycles and electric scooters sold in five European cities in 2015 and 2025. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.  |  REJA: O: bikes ↑ hamma joyda // scooters mixed (3↑ 2↓) // Amsterdam ++ bikes. BP1: bikes (Ams ++, Ber x4, Par ↑, Mad/Rom kichik). BP2: scooters (Par x3, Mad x6, Ber ↑, Rom/Ams ↓).
text: The bar charts compare the number of electric bicycles and electric scooters sold in five European cities in 2015 and 2025, measured in thousands of units.

Overall, e-bike sales rose in every city, whereas the scooter market had mixed results, expanding in three cities but shrinking slightly in the other two. It is also clear that Amsterdam led the bicycle market by a wide margin in both years.

Amsterdam dominated e-bike sales throughout, with its figure more than doubling from 38,000 to 92,000 units, far higher than in any other city. The most dramatic growth, however, took place in Berlin, where sales quadrupled to 56,000, and Paris also recorded a substantial rise, from 11,000 to 30,000. By contrast, Madrid and Rome remained small markets, adding just 3,000 and 2,000 units respectively.

Electric scooters followed a less consistent pattern. Paris, already the leader in 2015, tripled its sales to 27,000, while Madrid saw the steepest relative increase, with sales rising more than sixfold from 3,000 to 19,000. Berlin's figure also grew considerably, reaching 15,000. In Rome and Amsterdam, however, scooter sales fell to 5,000 and 3,000 respectively, the only declines in either chart.

homework_intro: Bugun overview va key features'ni o'rgandik: overview — "Overall," bilan, raqamsiz, barcha asosiy tendensiyalar; body paragraph — highlight + raqamli dalil.

Birinchi vazifa — to'liq javob, 20 daqiqa: "The table shows the number of visitors (millions) to museums and theme parks in four countries in 2010 and 2020: museums — France 8 → 12, Italy 6 → 9, Spain 4 → 5, Greece 3 → 2; theme parks — France 10 → 16, Spain 5 → 11, Italy 3 → 2, Greece 1 → 1." homework.title: 6 ta highlight gap
homework.instr: Formula: muhimlik (the most dramatic / by far / the only) + raqam. Har gapda boshqa shahar yoki mahsulot.
homework.answers: Masalan: "Paris led the scooter market in both years, tripling its sales to 27,000."

normativ: overview raqamsiz, 2+ tendensiya, har fikrga dalil, 170+ so'z
har o'zgarish yonida sabab yozilgan (6 savolli tekshiruv ro'yxati bo'yicha)

kahoot.q: Which is the best overview?
kahoot.sub: E-bike and scooter sales, 5 cities, 2015 vs 2025
options: Overall, e-bike sales rose everywhere, whereas scooters had mixed results.
Overall, Amsterdam had by far the highest e-bike sales in both 2015 and 2025.
Overall, Berlin's e-bike sales rose from 14,000 to 56,000 between 2015 and 2025.
Overall, both types of vehicle experienced a rising trend in all five cities.
kahoot.explain: Aniq overview barcha asosiy tendensiyalarni raqamsiz beradi. Bitta xususiyat, raqam yoki noto'g'ri umumlashtirish — noaniq overview.

kahoot.q: What word does the author always use to start an overview?
kahoot.explain: "Overall," examinerga overview kelayotganini aniq bildiradi. "In conclusion" — xulosa, Task 1 da kerak emas.

kahoot.q: What is wrong: "Overall, the UK had the biggest increase in coffee sales."?
options: It gives only one feature, not the main trends
It uses unclear references to the countries
It contains a personal comment about the trends
kahoot.explain: Faqat eng katta o'sish — grafikning kichik qismi. Aniq overview asosiy tendensiyalarni to'liq ko'rsatadi.

kahoot.q: Choose the correct determiner: "___ of these countries witnessed a downward trend."
kahoot.sub: Only Japan fell; four others rose
kahoot.explain: Beshtadan bittasi pasaygan — "Only one of these countries". Davlat nomisiz istisno ko'rsatiladi.

kahoot.q: Which sentence HIGHLIGHTS a key feature?
options: Berlin saw the most dramatic growth, with sales quadrupling to 56,000.
Berlin sold 14,000 e-bikes in 2015 and then 56,000 e-bikes in 2025.
In Berlin, there were 14,000 e-bike sales in 2015 and 56,000 in 2025.
The figures for e-bike sales in Berlin were 14,000 in 2015 and 56,000 in 2025.
kahoot.explain: Highlight — avval nega muhimligini aytish (the most dramatic), keyin raqam bilan isbotlash; qolganlari shunchaki ro'yxat. Berlinda o'sish eng tez (x4), lekin mutlaq o'sish Amsterdamda kattaroq (Amsterdam +54,000, Berlin +42,000) — shuning uchun "the biggest rise" emas, "the most dramatic growth".

kahoot.q: What is the problem: "Overall, the former grew, while the latter fell."?
kahoot.explain: "the former / the latter" nimaga ishora qilishi aniq emas. O'quvchi qaytib qidirishga majbur.

kahoot.q: Which verb collocates with "a rising trend"?
kahoot.explain: experience / see / witness a trend — to'g'ri kollokatsiya. "did / made a trend" — xato.

kahoot.q: Should an overview contain figures?
options: No, figures go in the body paragraphs
Yes, at least two figures to support the trends
kahoot.explain: Overview — umumiy tasvir, tafsilotsiz. Raqamlar body paragraph'larda dalil sifatida keladi.

kahoot.q: Without a clear overview of main trends, what is the maximum Task Achievement band?
kahoot.explain: Band 7 uchun asosiy tendensiyalarning ANIQ overview'i kerak. Overview umuman bo'lmasa — Band 5.

kahoot.q: Which is inaccurate language in an overview?
options: The worrying fall in scooters shows people prefer bikes.
Most of the five cities saw a rise in scooter sales over the period.
Scooter sales fell in only two cities.
kahoot.explain: "worrying" — shaxsiy baho, "prefer" — grafikda afzallik haqida ma'lumot yo'q. Til faqat ma'lumotni aks ettiradi.

kahoot.q: Best way to show contrast inside an overview?
options: Overall, X rose, whereas Y fell.
Overall, X rose and Y fell and Z fell.
Overall, X rose, moreover Y fell.
kahoot.explain: whereas / while — bitta gapda qarama-qarshilik. "moreover" qo'shimcha fikr uchun, qarama-qarshilik uchun emas.

kahoot.q: How should a body paragraph begin?
options: With its topic, e.g. "Electric scooters followed..."
With the smallest figure in the chart, to show the range
With "Overall," to remind the examiner of the overview
With a question to make the paragraph more interesting
kahoot.explain: Kitob: xatboshi mavzusini birinchi so'zlarda signal qiling va faqat shu mavzu haqida yozing.

kahoot.q: "Bus, metro and tram" — best umbrella term?
kahoot.explain: public transport / modes of transport — uchalasini ham qamraydi va akademik uslubda.

kahoot.q: Amsterdam led the market ___ a wide margin.
kahoot.explain: by a wide margin — katta farq bilan. Doimo "by" bilan.

kahoot.q: The increase in Rome was ___: only 2,000 units.
kahoot.explain: marginal — juda kichik, arzimas. substantial / dramatic / considerable — katta o'zgarish.

kahoot.q: Sales rose in some cities but fell in others. The market had ___.
kahoot.explain: mixed results — ba'zilari oshgan, ba'zilari kamaygan. Tafsilotsiz qarama-qarshilik.
56 = 14 × 4 — quadrupled (to'rt barobar oshdi).

kahoot.q: Madrid and Rome added 3,000 and 2,000 ___.
kahoot.explain: respectively — mos ravishda: birinchi raqam birinchi shaharga, ikkinchisi ikkinchisiga.

kahoot.q: Amsterdam ___ e-bike sales in both years.
kahoot.explain: dominate — ustunlik qilmoq, yetakchi bo'lmoq.

kahoot.q: Madrid saw the steepest ___ increase (3,000 → 19,000).
kahoot.explain: relative increase — nisbiy o'sish (olti barobardan ko'p). Skuterlarda mutlaq o'sish esa Parijda eng katta (+18,000; Madridda +16,000).

lessons.title: Writing Task 1 (4): Line graph — tendensiya tili va aniqlik
lessons.grammar_topic: Line graph: taxminiy raqamlar (approximately, just under, close to), past simple va past perfect (by + yil), reach / over / close to aniqligi, overview'da tendensiyalar, o'xshash tendensiyalarni guruhlash va xronologik tartib, ma'lumotni to'g'ri talqin qilish (correlation ≠ causation)
lessons.vocab_topic: Tendensiya fe'llari (climb, slide, recover, overtake), taxmin iboralari, mirror / correspond with, share / proportion, aniq sinonimlar (consumption → eaten, lekin ingestion emas)
lessons.book_ref: Pauline Cullen, "The Key to IELTS Writing Task 1" — Lesson 6: Line Graphs (PDF bet 70–89): 6.1 line graph'ni tushunish, 6.2 Band 6 muammolari, 6.3 tahlil va tartiblash; qo'shimcha: Lesson 11–12 (PDF bet 164–189) — ma'lumotni to'g'ri talqin qilish, correlation va causation, raqamlar ortidagi odamlar.
objectives: Line graph'ning xususiyatini bilish: vaqt bo'yicha o'zgarish, ko'p nuqta — shuning uchun ko'proq TANLASH va raqamlarni TAXMIN qilish kerak.
Taxmin tilini aniq ishlatish: approximately, around, roughly, just under, just over, close to, nearly — raqamning qaysi tomonda ekaniga mos.
Past simple va past perfect'ni to'g'ri tanlash: past perfect faqat ikki vaqtni bog'laganda, ko'pincha "by + yil" bilan; javobda bir marta yetarli.
Overview'da eng yuqori/eng past raqamni emas, TENDENSIYALARNI yozish; savoldagi ma'lumotdan umbrella term topish (fish ≠ meat).
Chiziqlarni o'xshash tendensiya bo'yicha guruhlash, xatboshi ichida xronologik tartib; davr bo'yicha (1979–1989 / 1989–2004) bo'lish nega zaif ekanini tushunish.
Ma'lumot aytmagan narsani yozmaslik: afzallik (popular, prefer), sabab (because) yoki odamlarning harakati haqida xulosa chiqarmaslik — correlation, causation emas.
materials: Kitob sahifalari (Reading bo'limida, 2 ta rasm): line graph qoidalari, past perfect, overview tahlili, Band 6 javob izohlari; ma'lumot talqini (Lesson 11).
Jony Academy line graph'i: ishga qatnash usullari, 1995–2020 — chop etilgan yoki ekranda.
Chizg'ich yoki qog'oz chiziq — grafikda raqamni taxmin qilish uchun (kitob maslahati).
Doskada taxmin shkalasi: just under 50 | 50 | just over 50; close to / nearly = biroz kam.
Taymer: 20 daqiqa to'liq javob uchun.
timeline: Takrorlash
20-dars: aniq overview formulasi — e-bike grafigi overview'ini og'zaki tiklash.
Line graph xususiyatlari va taxmin
Kitob 71-bet: vaqt, ko'p nuqta, tanlash, taxmin; 1-mashq (taxmin iboralari).
Zamonlar: past simple va past perfect
Kitob 72-bet: "by 2004 it had fallen"; xato gapni tuzatish; 2-mashq.
Overview va umbrella term
Kitob 76, 79-betlar: fish ≠ meat; eng yuqori/past emas, tendensiyalar; to'rt overview va izohlar.
Band 6 muammolari va tartiblash
Kitob 79, 82-betlar: ingest, citizens, ebb and flow; davr bo'yicha bo'lish muammosi; 4-mashq (reja tanlash).
Ma'lumot nimani aytadi?
Kitob 165–167: so'rovnoma savoli, popular/prefer yo'q, correlation ≠ causation; 3- va 5-mashq.
Namuna va yozish
Commute grafigi: reja → namuna javob tahlili (10 daq.); o'quvchilar 20 daqiqada o'z javobining 3-xatboshisini yozadi va juftlikda tekshiradi.
Xulosa va vazifa
Line graph tekshiruv ro'yxati: tendensiyali overview, guruh, taxmin, bitta past perfect, sabab yo'q.

intro: Line graph vaqt bo'yicha o'zgarishni ko'rsatadi — uzoq davr (yillar) yoki qisqa oraliqlar (oylar, soatlar). Nuqtalar ko'p bo'lgani uchun kichik tafsilotlar ham ko'p: TANLASH jadvalga qaraganda muhimroq. X o'qidagi oraliqqa (masalan, 5 yil) e'tibor bering.

TAXMIN: jadvaldan farqli, raqamni grafikdan o'zingiz o'qiysiz, shuning uchun taxmin so'zlari kerak: about, around, approximately, roughly, nearly, almost, close to, just under, just over. Aniq bo'ling: 48% — "just under half", 58% — "close to 60%", 21% — "just over 20%". Kitob maslahati: raqamni aniqlash uchun grafik ustiga chizg'ich bilan chiziq torting.

ZAMON: ikki vaqtni bog'laganda — past perfect (had + V3), ko'pincha "by + yil" bilan: "By 2020, car use had fallen to 38%." Faqat bitta vaqt aytilsa — past simple: "Car use fell to 38% in 2020." Past perfect'ni bir marta to'g'ri ishlatish grammatik diapazonni ko'rsatish uchun yetarli.

SO'Z ANIQLIGI: "reach" odatda yuqori darajaga yetishni bildiradi — pasayishda "fell to", "dropped to" deng. "over 50" o'sishni eslatadi — pasayib kelgan raqam uchun "close to 50" aniqroq. Chiroyli, lekin noto'g'ri so'z (ingest, citizens, ebb and flow, dwindling ingestion) ball tushiradi: yuqori darajadagi so'z emas, MA'NOGA MOS so'z kerak.

SAVOLDAN FOYDALANING: savol faqat paraphrase uchun emas. "fish and different kinds of meat" — demak baliq go'sht emas, "meat" umbrella term bo'la olmaydi; "foods", "types of food" to'g'ri. O'lchov birligi (grams per person per week) birinchi raqam bilan bir marta aytiladi.

OVERVIEW line graph'da: eng yuqori va eng past raqam emas, TENDENSIYALAR — nima oshdi, nima kamaydi, kim yetakchilikni oldi. "To sum up" bilan oxirida qo'shimcha xulosa yozish ball qo'shmaydi — ko'pincha grafikda yo'q ma'lumot (preferred, relied on) qo'shilib, ballni tushiradi.

TARTIBLASH: o'xshash tendensiyali chiziqlarni bitta xatboshiga (masalan, ikkala pasayayotgan chiziq), boshqa naqshdagilarni alohida. Boshida eng yuqori bo'lgan guruhdan boshlang va xatboshi ichida XRONOLOGIK yozing. Davr bo'yicha bo'lish (1-xatboshi: 1979–1989, 2-xatboshi: 1989–2004) solishtirishni kamaytiradi va takrorga olib keladi.

MA'LUMOT TALQINI (Lesson 11): ma'lumot odatda bitta so'rovnoma savolidan keladi. Grafik "qancha" deydi, "nega" yoki "nimani afzal ko'rdi" demaydi. "more popular", "people preferred", "moved out of", "because" — dalilsiz xulosa. To'g'ri: "more common", "a larger share". Ikki chiziq bir vaqtda o'zgarsa — "corresponded with" (correlation), "caused" emas (causation).

XILMA-XILLIK: faqat raqamlar haqida (the figure rose) yozmang — raqamlar ortidagi odamlar haqida ham yozing: "fewer commuters travelled by bus", "the share of people cycling to work". Bu takrorni kamaytiradi va Lexical Resource'ni oshiradi.
formulas: approximately / around / just under / close to + raqam
Car use climbed to close to 60% in 2005.
subject + V2 + (from X) to Y + in / between
began to V in X, and by Y it had V3
Car use began to fall in 2005, and by 2020 it had dropped to 38%.
By 2010, bus use had slid to approximately 20%.
the increases in X corresponded with the fall in Y
The rise in cycling corresponded with the fall in car use.
the share of / fewer / more + odamlar + fe'l
presentation: Grafikdagi raqamni aniq bilmasam-chi?
Taxmin qiling va buni ko'rsating: approximately, roughly, just under. Examiner aniq raqam emas, TO'G'RI taxmin va to'g'ri iborani kutadi.
Past perfect'ni har gapda ishlataymi?
Yo'q. Bir marta, to'g'ri joyda (by + yil) — yetarli. Ko'p ishlatish xatoga olib keladi.
Overview'da "chicken was the highest" desam bo'ladimi?
Bu tendensiya emas. Line graph'da overview o'zgarishni aytadi: "chicken rose and became dominant, while beef and lamb declined".
Nega davr bo'yicha xatboshi zaif?
Har xatboshida hamma chiziqni qayta aytishga majbur bo'lasiz — takror, kam solishtirish, chalkash birinchi gap. Tendensiya bo'yicha guruhlang.
"Became more popular" deyish mumkinmi?
Faqat grafik afzallik haqida bo'lsa. Ko'pincha u faqat "qancha odam" deydi — "became more common" yoki "a larger share" deng.
Ikki chiziq bir vaqtda o'zgarsa, sababini yozaymi?
Yo'q. "corresponded with", "mirrored" — faqat bog'liqlikni ko'rsating; sababni grafik bermaydi.
notes: Kitobdagi misol (Fish and Meat Consumption, Cambridge IELTS 7) va Band 6 javob faqat sahifa rasmida ko'rsatiladi; namuna javob — Jony Academy'niki, boshqa grafik bo'yicha.
Kitob muallifining xulosasi: tartiblash muammolarini yozib bo'lgandan keyin tuzatish juda qiyin — overview va guruhlarni yozishdan OLDIN rejalang.
Commute grafigidagi ma'lumotlar mashq uchun to'qilgan.
mistakes: In 2020 car use had fallen to 38%.
By 2020, car use had fallen to 38%. / In 2020 it fell to 38%.
Past perfect ikki vaqtni bog'laydi (by + yil)
People left their cars because trains improved.
The rise in rail travel corresponded with the fall in car use.
People in this country ate less beef.
So'z ma'nosi va uslubi kontekstga mos emas

how: CORE — tendensiya fe'llari va taxmin; STRONG — aniqroq harakat fe'llari; SUPER — solishtirish va bog'liqlik iboralari.
Commute grafigidagi har chiziq uchun CORE fe'l + taxmin iborasi bilan bitta gap; kamida bitta gap past perfect bilan.
core: Car use climbed to close to 60% in 2005.
Avtomobil ulushi 2005 da 60% ga yaqin ko'tarildi.
Just under half of commuters drove.
Qatnovchilarning yarmidan biroz kami mashinada yurdi.
The figure peaked at close to 60%.
The share of rail commuters doubled.
Poyezdda qatnovchilar ulushi ikki barobar oshdi.
By 2020 cycling had overtaken the bus.
2020 ga kelib velosiped avtobusni quvib o'tgan edi.
qayta-qayta, har bosqichda (continuously — uzluksiz, bir zum to'xtamay)
2005 dan keyin avtomobil ulushi har bosqichda pasayib bordi.
Cycling was the fastest-growing mode of transport.
Velosiped eng tez o'sgan transport turi edi.
strong: Avtobus ulushi 30% dan 20% ga asta tushdi.
Train use fluctuated slightly at first.
Velosiped ulushi deyarli besh barobar oshdi.
Velosiped avtobusni ozgina farq bilan quvib o'tdi.
super: The rise in cycling corresponded with the fall in car use.
Velosipedning o'sishi avtomobilning kamayishiga mos keldi.
Cycling broadly mirrored the pattern for rail: little change until 2005, then growth.
Velosiped ulushi asosan temir yo'l naqshini takrorladi: 2005 gacha deyarli o'zgarmadi, keyin o'sdi.
Car use fell by ten percentage points.
Avtomobil ulushi o'n foiz punktga tushdi.
For trains, the reverse was true.

class_ex.title: 1-mashq: Raqamni taxmin iborasi bilan ayting
class_ex.instr: Commute grafigidagi raqamni aniq taxmin iborasi bilan ayting. Iborani raqamning qaysi tomonda ekaniga moslang.
items: Bicycle, 2020: 19%
why: "just under" — biroz kam; "half" foizni takrorlamaslik uchun.
58 — 60 dan kam: "over 60%" noto'g'ri.
21 — 20 dan biroz ko'p.
38 — 40 dan kam; pasayishda "close to" ham mos.
19 — 20 ga yaqin, lekin undan kam.
Tebranish kichik — "roughly" bilan barqarorlikni ko'rsatish.

class_ex.title: 2-mashq: Past simple yoki past perfect?
class_ex.instr: Har gapni tekshiring: to'g'ri bo'lsa "OK", xato bo'lsa tuzating.
items: In 2020, car use had fallen to 38%.
By 2020, the share of rail commuters had doubled.
Bus use has fallen from 30% to 18% between 1995 and 2020.
Cycling began to rise in 2005, and by 2020 it reached 19%.
By 2010, bus travel slid to approximately 20%.
answers: In 2020, car use fell to 38%. / By 2020, car use had fallen to 38%.
Bus use fell from 30% to 18% between 1995 and 2020.
By 2010, bus travel had slid to approximately 20%.
why: Bitta vaqt (in 2020) — past simple; past perfect uchun "by 2020".
"by + yil" + natija — past perfect to'g'ri.
Tugagan o'tgan davr — present perfect emas, past simple.
"by 2020" — ikki vaqtni bog'laydi: had reached (o'sishda reach to'g'ri).
"By 2010" ikki vaqtni bog'laydi — gapning asosiy fe'li past perfect bo'ladi: had slid. Namunadagi "sliding ... by 2010" esa -ing ibora: zamon ko'rsatmaydi, shuning uchun xato emas.

class_ex.title: 3-mashq: Grafik buni aytadimi? (ma'lumot talqini)
class_ex.instr: Commute grafigiga qarang. TRUE — grafik ko'rsatadi; FALSE — grafikka zid; NOT GIVEN — grafikda bunday ma'lumot yo'q (javobda yozmaslik kerak).
items: The car was the most common way of commuting in every year shown.
Commuters preferred trains to buses in 2020.
The share of rail commuters doubled between 2005 and 2020.
Bus use fell in every five-year interval.
Cycling increased because new bike lanes were built.
More people owned a car in 2005 than in 2020.
By 2020, both trains and bicycles had overtaken the bus.
why: Har yili car chizig'i eng yuqorida.
Grafik afzallik (prefer) haqida emas, qaysi usul ishlatilgani haqida.
2010 dan 2015 gacha 20% → 21% — biroz o'sgan.
Sabab grafikda yo'q — causation yozilmaydi.
Grafik mashinada qatnashni ko'rsatadi, mashina egaligini emas.
2020: train 24%, bicycle 19%, bus 18%.

class_ex.title: 4-mashq: Eng yaxshi overview va reja
class_ex.type: Choose A, B, C or D
class_ex.instr: Commute grafigi uchun eng yaxshi variantni tanlang va qolganlarining muammosini ayting.
items: 1 Best overview? A) Overall, the car was the highest and the bicycle was the lowest. B) Overall, although the car remained the most common way of commuting, its share declined after an initial rise, and bus travel also fell, whereas rail and cycling grew considerably. C) Overall, car use rose from 48% to 58% and then fell to 38%. D) To sum up, people started to prefer greener transport.

2 Best paragraph plan? A) BP1: 1995–2005; BP2: 2005–2020 B) BP1: car + bus (overall decline); BP2: train + bicycle (growth) C) four paragraphs, one per line, plus a conclusion D) BP1: highest figures; BP2: lowest figures
why: A — faqat eng yuqori/past, tendensiya yo'q; C — raqamlar (tafsilot); D — "prefer" va "greener" grafikda yo'q, to sum up keraksiz. B — barcha asosiy tendensiyalar, raqamsiz.
A — davr bo'yicha: har xatboshida hamma chiziq takrorlanadi (kitob 82-bet); C — solishtirish yo'q, keraksiz xulosa; D — mantiqsiz. B — o'xshash tendensiyalar birga, xronologik yozish oson.

class_ex.title: 5-mashq: Aniq va mos so'z
class_ex.instr: Kitobdagi Band 6 javob izohlari uslubida: har iborani ma'noga mos, aniq variant bilan almashtiring.
items: citizens ingested less beef
the tendency of these four food intakes remained
after tiny ebbs and flows, fish remained stable
The line graph demonstrates the consumption of ...
bus use was the least welcome
cycling was over 15% in 2020 (19%)
answers: people in this country ate / consumed less beef
the trends for these four foods generally continued
despite slight fluctuations, fish remained relatively stable
bus use was the least common / the lowest
why: "citizens" — hukumat kontekstida; "ingest" — biologiya matni uchun.
"tendency" va "intake" bu yerda aniq emas; "remained" dan keyin so'z kerak.
"ebb and flow" — dengiz suvi uchun; tebranish butun davr bo'yi — "after" emas.
Grafik "isbotlamaydi" — faqat ko'rsatadi.
"welcome" — his-tuyg'u; grafik buni aytmaydi.
19% — 20% ga yaqin; "over 15%" noaniq va zaif.

tasks.title: Sahifalar bo'yicha savollar
tasks.type: Og'zaki
tasks.instr: Ustoz sahifani ko'rsatadi, o'quvchilar o'zbekcha javob beradi.
items: 71-bet: Line graph'da nega tanlash jadvaldagidan qiyinroq?
72-bet: Lamb haqidagi gapda past perfect nega xato edi?
72-bet: Muallif nega "over" ni "close to" ga, "reach" ni "fall" ga almashtirdi?
76-bet: Nega "meat" umbrella term bo'la olmaydi?
79-bet: To'rt overview'dan qaysi biri eng yaxshi va unda nima yetishmaydi?
82-bet: Davr bo'yicha xatboshi qanday 3 muammo keltirib chiqardi?
answers: Nuqtalar ko'p — kichik tafsilotlar ko'p; raqamni o'zingiz taxmin qilasiz
Faqat bitta vaqt (in the final year) aytilgan — past simple kerak
"over" o'sishni eslatadi; "reach" asosan yuqori darajaga yetish
Savol "fish and different kinds of meat" deydi — baliq go'sht emas
Kam solishtirish, chalkash birinchi gap, takroriy g'oyalar
why: Kitob: "more selective" bo'lish kerak.
Past perfect ikki vaqtni bog'laydi (by + yil).
So'z ma'nosi ma'lumot yo'nalishiga mos bo'lishi kerak.
Savol til yordamchisi ham: foods, types of food.
Overview barcha asosiy tendensiyalarni qamrashi kerak.
Tartibni yozishdan oldin rejalash kerak.

readings.title: Kitob (2): Ma'lumot aslida nimani aytadi?
readings.source: Pauline Cullen, The Key to IELTS Writing Task 1, Lesson 11 (PDF bet 165, 166, 167)

tasks.title: Sahifalar bo'yicha savollar
tasks.type: Og'zaki
tasks.instr: Kitobdagi g'oyani commute grafigiga qo'llang.
items: Commute grafigi qaysi so'rovnoma savolidan kelgan bo'lishi mumkin?

Grafik afzallikni emas, qancha odam qaysi usulda qatnashini ko'rsatadi

readings.title: NAMUNA: line graph → reja → javob
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna javobi (196 so'z; grafik ma'lumotlari mashq uchun to'qilgan)
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: The graph below shows the main way people in one city travelled to work between 1995 and 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.  |  REJA: O: car ++ lekin ↑→↓ // bus ↓ // train, bike ↑ (2005 dan keyin). BP1: car + bus (1995 da eng yuqori; xronologik). BP2: train + bike (≈ keyin ↑; 2020 da bus'dan o'tdi; corresponded).
text: The line graph illustrates the proportion of commuters in one city who mainly used four different modes of transport to get to work over a 25-year period from 1995.

Overall, although the car remained the most common way of commuting throughout, its share declined after an initial rise, and bus travel also became less common. By contrast, rail and cycling grew considerably, particularly in the second half of the period.

In 1995, just under half of all commuters (48%) travelled by car, and this figure climbed to close to 60% in 2005. From then on, however, it fell continually, dropping to 38% in 2020. Bus use followed a gradual downward trend, sliding from 30% to approximately 20% by 2010, and despite a brief recovery in 2015, it ended the period at its lowest point of 18%.

The pattern for trains and bicycles was the reverse. Both changed very little in the first decade, remaining at roughly 12% and 4–5% respectively. After 2005, however, the share of rail commuters doubled to 24%, while cycling grew almost fivefold to 19%, and by 2020 both had overtaken the bus. Notably, these increases corresponded with the fall in car use.
glossary: correspond with — ... bilan bir vaqtda mos kelmoq
paraphrases: The graph below shows
The line graph illustrates
the main way people ... travelled to work
the proportion of commuters who mainly used ... modes of transport
between 1995 and 2020

people in one city
