tasks.title: Namunani dars qoidalari bilan tekshiring
tasks.type: Og'zaki
tasks.instr: Grafik va namuna javobga qarab javob bering.
items: Overview'da qaysi tendensiyalar bor? Eng yuqori/eng past raqam bormi?
Barcha taxmin iboralarini toping va grafik bilan solishtiring.
Past perfect qaysi gapda va nega aynan u yerda?
Nega car va bus bitta xatboshida?
Oxirgi gapda nega "because" emas?
Qaysi gaplar raqam haqida, qaysilari odamlar haqida?
answers: car ↑ keyin ↓ (lekin eng keng tarqalgan), bus ↓, rail va cycling ↑; raqam yo'q
just under half (48), close to 60% (58), approximately 20% (20), roughly 12% (11–12)
"by 2020 both had overtaken the bus" — 2020 gacha bo'lgan jarayon natijasi. "sliding from 30% to approximately 20% by 2010" — -ing ibora, zamonsiz: xato emas (gapning asosiy fe'li bo'lsa — had slid).
Ikkalasi 1995 da eng yuqori va umuman pasaygan — o'xshash tendensiya
Grafik sababni ko'rsatmaydi — "corresponded with" faqat bog'liqlik
"this figure climbed" — raqam; "commuters travelled by car", "the share of rail commuters" — odamlar
why: Line graph overview'i — tendensiyalar.
Taxmin ibora raqam tomoniga mos.
by + yil + had V3 — bir marta yetarli. -ing ibora (sliding, dropping) zamon ko'rsatmaydi — "by + yil" bilan ham to'g'ri.
Guruhlash + xronologik tartib (kitob modeli kabi).
Correlation ≠ causation (Lesson 11).
Xilma-xillik — takror kamayadi.

homework_intro: Bugun line graph'ni o'rgandik: overview — tendensiyalar, guruhlash — o'xshash chiziqlar, til — aniq taxmin, bitta to'g'ri past perfect, va grafik aytmagan narsani yozmaslik.

Birinchi vazifa — to'liq javob, 20 daqiqa: "The graph shows the average number of hours per week that teenagers in one country spent on four activities, 2004–2024 (har 5 yilda): TV 18 → 17 → 14 → 10 → 7; online gaming 3 → 5 → 9 → 12 → 13; sport 7 → 7 → 6 → 6 → 5; reading 6 → 5 → 5 → 4 → 4." Avval chiziqli grafikni o'zingiz chizing, keyin reja va 4 xatboshi.
Ikkinchi vazifa — kitobdagi Fish and Meat grafigi (1-reading rasmidagi 72-bet) uchun faqat overview va reja: guruhlar va har guruh uchun 2 ta asosiy fikr.
Uchinchi vazifa — 8 gap: 4 tasi taxmin iborasi bilan, 2 tasi past perfect (by + yil) bilan, 2 tasi "corresponded with" yoki "mirrored" bilan.

homework.title: To'liq javob: o'smirlarning bo'sh vaqti
homework.instr: Reja + 4 xatboshi, 170–190 so'z, 20 daqiqa. Overview tendensiyalar bilan, raqamsiz; bitta past perfect; "popular" va "because" yo'q.
homework.answers: Namuna overview: "Overall, the time teenagers spent watching television fell steadily, while online gaming rose sharply and overtook TV as the most time-consuming activity; sport and reading changed only slightly, declining marginally." BP1: TV + gaming (qarama-qarshi; 2019 ga kelib gaming TV'dan o'tgan: 12 va 10); BP2: sport + reading (barqaror, biroz ↓).

homework.title: Fish and Meat: overview + reja
homework.instr: Kitob grafigiga qarab (72-bet rasmi), 1–2 gap overview va P3/P4/P5 guruhlari. O'z so'zlaringiz bilan.
homework.answers: Kalit — namuna overview: "Overall, chicken consumption rose and overtook beef to become the most eaten of these foods, while the consumption of beef and lamb fell; fish was consistently the least eaten and changed relatively little." Guruhlar (har biriga 2 ta asosiy fikr): P3 — beef + lamb: ikkalasi pasaygan; beef boshida eng yuqori bo'lgan (cho'qqi 1980-yillar boshida), 2004 ga kelib taxminan ikki barobar kamaygan, lamb esa tebranib, ikki barobardan ham ko'proq kamaygan. P4 — chicken: deyarli butun davr o'sgan; 1980 da lamb'dan, 1980-yillar oxirida beef'dan o'tib, eng ko'p iste'mol qilinadigan oziq-ovqatga aylangan. P5 — fish: butun davr eng past, biroz pasaygan, nisbatan barqaror — boshqa naqsh, shuning uchun alohida xatboshi (kitob 82-bet). Davr bo'yicha reja (1979–1989 / 1989–2004) — zaif (kitob 82-bet). Overview'da "meat" umbrella term sifatida ishlatilmasin.

homework.title: 8 ta gap — aniqlik tili
homework.instr: Har gapda yil va raqam bo'lsin; taxmin iborasi raqam tomoniga mos kelsin.
homework.answers: Masalan: "By 2024, weekly TV viewing had fallen to less than half of its 2004 level."

normativ: tendensiyali overview, guruhlash, 1 past perfect, sabab yo'q, 170+ so'z

kahoot.q: The graph shows 58%. Which phrase is accurate?
kahoot.explain: 58 — 60 dan biroz kam: close to / nearly 60%. "over" — ko'proq degani, noto'g'ri.

kahoot.q: Choose the correct tense: "By 2020, car use ___ to 38%."
kahoot.explain: "By + yil" — past perfect (had + V3): 2020 gacha bo'lgan jarayon natijasi.

kahoot.q: Which sentence uses the past perfect WRONGLY?
options: In 2020, bus use had fallen to 18%.
By 2020, bus use had fallen to 18%.
By 2010, bus use had slid to approximately 20%.
kahoot.explain: Faqat bitta vaqt (in 2020) — past simple kerak. Past perfect "by + yil" bilan to'g'ri (by 2020, by 2010).

kahoot.q: Bus use went from 30% down to 18%. Which verb is NOT suitable?
kahoot.explain: "reach" odatda yuqori darajaga yetish uchun. Pasayishda fell / dropped to 18%.

kahoot.q: Best overview for a line graph?
options: Overall, car use fell after a rise, while rail and cycling grew.
Overall, the car was the highest and cycling the lowest.
Overall, car use rose from 48% to 58% and then fell to 38% in 2020.
To sum up, people preferred greener transport.
kahoot.explain: Line graph overview'i tendensiyalarni aytadi. Eng yuqori/past — tendensiya emas; raqamlar — body uchun tafsilot; "preferred" — grafikda yo'q.

kahoot.q: Best way to organise body paragraphs for 4 lines?
kahoot.sub: Two lines fall, two lines rise
options: Split by time: first half, second half
kahoot.explain: Kitob: o'xshash tendensiyalarni birga guruhlang, xronologik yozing. Davr bo'yicha bo'lish takror va kam solishtirish beradi.

kahoot.q: Which sentence avoids claiming causation?
options: The rise in cycling corresponded with the fall in car use.
Cycling rose because many people sold their cars to save money.
Car use fell, so people chose bikes.
People cycled more as cars got expensive.
kahoot.explain: Grafik sababni ko'rsatmaydi. "corresponded with" — faqat bir vaqtda o'zgarganini aytadi.

kahoot.q: The data shows the % of commuters using each mode of transport. Which is accurate?
kahoot.explain: Grafik qancha odam qaysi usulda qatnashini ko'rsatadi, afzallikni emas: "more common" xavfsiz.

kahoot.q: Question: "fish and different kinds of meat". Which umbrella term is correct?
kahoot.explain: Savol baliqni go'shtdan ajratadi — "meat" hammasini qamramaydi. "foods", "types of food" to'g'ri.

kahoot.q: Which sentence writes about the PEOPLE behind the data?
options: Fewer commuters travelled to work by bus.
The figure for buses fell from 30% to 18% over the period.
kahoot.explain: Kitob: raqamlar va odamlar orqali navbatma-navbat yozing — takror kamayadi, uslub tabiiyroq.

kahoot.q: Is adding "To sum up, ..." at the end needed for a high band?
options: No, a clear overview is enough
kahoot.explain: Kitob: xulosa ball qo'shmaydi; ko'pincha grafikda yo'q ma'lumot qo'shilib, ball tushadi. Overview yetarli.

kahoot.q: When should you mention "grams per person per week"?
options: With the first figure you give
With every single figure in the answer
kahoot.explain: Birlik birinchi raqam bilan bir marta aytiladi, keyin takrorlash shart emas.

kahoot.q: 48% of commuters = ___ half of commuters.
kahoot.explain: 48 — 50 dan biroz kam: just under half.

kahoot.q: Bus use rose slightly in 2015 after years of decline. It briefly ___.
kahoot.explain: recover — pasayishdan keyin qisqa tiklanish.

kahoot.q: Cycling 19%, bus 18% in 2020. Cycling ___ overtook the bus.
kahoot.explain: narrowly — ozgina farq bilan (1 foiz punkt).

kahoot.q: Car use: 48% → 38%. It fell by ten ___.
kahoot.explain: Foizlar orasidagi farq — percentage points. 48% dan 38% ga — 10 foiz punkt.

kahoot.q: Lamb followed almost exactly the same pattern as beef. Lamb ___ beef.
kahoot.explain: mirror — xuddi shunday naqshni takrorlamoq. "corresponded" dan keyin "with" kerak.

kahoot.q: Which word is NOT accurate in a Task 1 answer about food?
kahoot.explain: "ingest" — biologiya matni uchun. Ovqat haqida: ate / consumed / was eaten.

kahoot.q: 4% → 19%: cycling grew almost ___.
kahoot.explain: 19 ≈ 4 × 5 — almost fivefold (deyarli besh barobar).

kahoot.q: "After 2005, car use fell ___" — lower at each point shown.
kahoot.explain: continually — qayta-qayta, har bosqichda pasaygan (58 → 54 → 47 → 38). continuously esa — uzluksiz, bir zum to'xtamay degani.

lessons.title: Writing Task 1 (5): Pie chart, stacked bar va prognozlar — solishtirish va guruhlash
lessons.grammar_topic: Pie chart va stacked bar: breakdown / portion, "Other" qoidasi, foiz va kasrni izchil berish; prognoz tili (is predicted to, It is expected that ... will, By 2035 ... will have + V3); ma'lumotni mantiqiy guruhlash va aniq solishtirish (fewer / less, as many ... as)
lessons.vocab_topic: Ulush va prognoz tili: account for, make up, constitute, breakdown, projection, be expected to, overtake, lose ground, albeit
lessons.book_ref: Pauline Cullen, "The Key to IELTS Writing Task 1" — Lesson 13: Pie charts va Future predictions, Being precise (PDF bet 191–206); Lesson 14: Frequency va Grouping information logically (PDF bet 206–219); Lesson 15: Energy data va Cause and effect (PDF bet 220–234).
objectives: Pie chart va stacked bar'ni to'g'ri tanishtirish: "give a breakdown of", "broken down into"; ulushlarni account for / make up / constitute bilan berish.
Foiz va kasrni izchil ishlatish: kasr aytilsa, haqiqiy raqam qavsda; foizlarni o'zboshimcha qo'shib yangi raqam yaratmaslik.
"Other" kategoriyasini qachon eslatish kerakligini 4 mezon bo'yicha hal qilish va uni doim ot bilan yozish (other outlets, other costs).
Prognozni shaxssiz passiv bilan yozish: is predicted / expected / projected / estimated to; By + yil + future perfect (will have risen).
Yozishdan oldin tartibni tanlash: o'xshash ma'lumotni guruhlab, takrorsiz solishtirish (yil bo'yicha emas, tendensiya yoki guruh bo'yicha).
Solishtirish grammatikasidagi Band 6 xatolarini tuzatish: fewer / less, as many / as much ... as, far more ... than.
materials: Kitob sahifalari (Reading bo'limida, 2 ta rasm) — proyektorda: pie chart tili, "Other", prognoz tili; Yemen–Italy vazifasi, stacked bar, fast food va energiya vazifalari.
Jony Academy pie chart'lari: oziq-ovqat qayerdan sotib olinadi, 2015 va 2035 (prognoz) — chop etilgan yoki ekranda.
Doskada prognoz jadvali: It is predicted that + will ... / X is predicted to ... / By 2035, X is expected to have + V3.
Doskada 4 ta "Other" savoli: kategoriyalar kammi? 5% dan kattami? boshqasidan kattami? ikkinchi diagrammada o'zgarganmi?
Taymer: namuna bosqichida reja 3 daqiqa; 5-mashq — yozish 12 daqiqa, juftlik tekshiruvi 5 daqiqa, ustoz tahlili 8 daqiqa; uyda to'liq javob 20 daqiqa.
timeline: Takrorlash
21-dars: line graph'da tendensiya tili — rose to / rose by, peak, levelled off; 3 ta tezkor savol.
Pie chart tili
Kitob, 191 va 193-betlar: breakdown, portion, foiz va kasr, "Other" qoidasi; 2-mashq.
Prognoz tili
Kitob, 194-bet: expected / predicted / projected / estimated; future perfect; 1-mashq.
Stacked bar va tartib
Kitob, 196 va 205-betlar: Yemen–Italy; stacked bar = pie chart; ikki holatni alohida emas, o'zgarishni ko'rsatib yozish.
Guruhlash va solishtirish
Kitob, 213–214 va 229-betlar: 3 ta savol, shkala uchlari va o'rtasi, umbrella term; 3- va 4-mashq.
Namuna: pie chart → reja → javob
Jony Academy pie chart'lari; o'quvchilar avval overview yozadi, keyin namuna javob tahlil qilinadi.
Sinfda yozish

5-mashq (Italy pie chart'lari, 196-bet), jami 25 daqiqa: 12 daqiqa — bitta xatboshi yozish (2 daqiqa reja + 10 daqiqa yozish, prognoz tili bilan); 5 daqiqa — juftlik 4 talabni tekshiradi; 8 daqiqa — ustoz 2 ta xatboshini proyektorda tahlil qiladi, o'quvchilar bittadan gapini tuzatib qayta yozadi.
Xulosa va vazifa
Pie/stacked bar uchun 5 savolli tekshiruv ro'yxati (matni — grammatika eslatmalarida); uy vazifasini tushuntirish (Yemen–Italy raqamlari uy vazifasi yo'riqnomasida).

intro: PIE CHART jami 100% bo'lgandagina ishlatiladi: u butunni qismlarga "bo'ladi". Shuning uchun kirish gapida "The pie charts give a breakdown of ..." yoki "... broken down into ..." juda tabiiy. Diagramma qismlari — portion / share: "The largest portion of the budget went on ...".

FOIZ VA KASR: kasr (a quarter, a third, just over half) takrordan qutqaradi, lekin izchil bo'lsin. Kasr aytsangiz, haqiqiy raqamni qavsda bering: "just over a third (36%)". Examiner sizning matematikangizni tekshirmasligi kerak. Yozuv: 3% (raqam bilan, "three percent" emas); "percentage" so'zi va % belgisini bitta gapda takrorlamang.

"OTHER" kategoriyasi: kichik bo'lsa — minor detail, tashlab ketsa bo'ladi. Uni eslating, agar: kategoriyalar kam bo'lsa; 5% dan katta bo'lsa; boshqa biror kategoriyadan katta bo'lsa; ikkinchi diagrammada sezilarli o'sgan yoki kamaygan bo'lsa. "Other" ni hech qachon yolg'iz ot qilib ishlatmang: "other costs / other outlets made up 7%".

PROGNOZ TILI: ma'lumotni mutaxassislar HOZIR bashorat qilmoqda, shuning uchun fe'l hozirgi zamonda va shaxssiz passivda: It is predicted / expected / projected / estimated / anticipated that X will ... yoki X is predicted to .... "will probably" va "experts think" o'rniga shu shakllardan foydalaning.

FUTURE PERFECT faqat ikki vaqt nuqtasi bo'lganda: "By 2035" + will have + V3 — hozirdan kelajakdagi sanagacha bo'ladigan o'zgarish: "By 2035, online delivery is expected to have risen to 27%." Bu Grammatical Range uchun tabiiy imkoniyat — prognozli savolni "endi kelajak zamonlarni ko'rsataman" deb qabul qiling.

STACKED BAR — har ustun 100% bo'lsa, xuddi pie chart kabi yoziladi; faqat kirish gapi o'zgaradi. Tartib: yilni alohida, keyin kelajakni alohida tasvirlash ("2000 da ... . 2050 da ...") ikki rasmni alohida tasvirlashga olib keladi va solishtirish yo'qoladi. Yaxshiroq: har xatboshida bitta guruh (mamlakat yoki kategoriya) — hozir → kelajak, o'zgarish bilan.

GURUHLASH: yozishdan oldin uch savol — 1) ma'lumotni qanday tartiblayman? 2) bu tartib solishtirishga yordam beradimi? 3) o'xshash ma'lumotni birlashtira olamanmi yoki bir fikrni har xatboshida takrorlaymanmi? Takror bo'lsa — tartibni o'zgartiring. Misollar: chastota shkalasining uchlari (kam o'zgargan) va o'rtasi (ko'p o'zgargan); energiya manbalari — fossil fuels va renewables (umbrella term).

MA'LUMOTNI O'ZGARTIRMANG: bir nechta foizni o'zingiz qo'shib yangi raqam yaratmang ("59% ate fast food 1–4 times a month") — bu examinerga qo'shimcha ish va ma'lumotni buzadi. Faqat berilgan raqamlarni tanlab bering. Kichik tebranishlarni ro'yxat qilmang: "despite a brief fall" bilan umumlashtiring.

SOLISHTIRISH ANIQLIGI: fewer + sanaladigan (fewer people), less + sanalmaydigan (less sugar); as many / as much ... as; not as many ... as; far more ... than; almost the same number of ... as. Uslub: har o'sish ijobiy emas — "recovered" faqat yaxshi narsaga; ikki diagramma turli narsani o'lchasa (energiya va emissiya), ularni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri "ikki barobar" deb solishtirmang.
formulas: It is expected that supermarkets will remain the main source of food.
Local markets are projected to decline to 12%.
By + yil, X + is expected to have + V3
By 2035, online delivery is estimated to have risen to 27%.
X + account for / make up / constitute + %
Supermarkets accounted for almost half of the total (48%).
Fewer households used local markets; less money was spent on ...
Cycling followed a similar trend, albeit from a much lower base.
presentation: Pie chart'da ham overview kerakmi?
Ha. Eng katta va eng kichik ulush, eng katta o'zgarish (agar ikki yil bo'lsa) — raqamsiz, 1–2 gapda.
"Other" 4% — yozamanmi?
Odatda yo'q: 5% dan kichik va hech narsadan katta emas — minor detail. Faqat o'sgan yoki kattaroq bo'lsa eslatiladi.
Kasr yaxshimi yoki foiz?
Ikkalasi ham, lekin izchil: "a quarter (25%)". "just over a fifth" va "12%" ni aralashtirib, o'quvchini hisoblashga majburlamang.
"will" dan foydalansam bo'ladimi?
Bo'ladi, lekin faqat will emas: is expected to, is projected to, By 2035 ... will have — bu diapazon.
Prognozli savolda qanday tartib?
Guruh bo'yicha: har xatboshida hozir → kelajak. Yil bo'yicha tartib ikki diagrammani alohida tasvirlashga olib keladi.
Stacked bar chart'ni qanday yozaman?
Har ustun 100% bo'lsa — pie chart kabi. Kirish gapini o'zgartiring: "The stacked bar charts show ...".
notes: Kitob sahifalarida kitobning o'z namuna javoblari bor — ular o'quvchiga faqat rasm sifatida ko'rsatiladi; darsdagi namuna javob Jony Academy'niki.
Namuna pie chart'lardagi ma'lumotlar mashq uchun to'qilgan.

Band 7 talabi — "covers the requirements of the task" va aniq overview; Band 8 — key features ajratilgan va raqam bilan isbotlangan. Bugungi mashqlar ikkinchisiga qaratilgan: har umumiy gapga bitta dalil raqam.

Darsning "Xulosa va vazifa" bosqichi uchun 5 savolli tekshiruv ro'yxati (pie chart / stacked bar javobini topshirishdan oldin): 1) Kirish gapi savolni o'z so'zlarim bilan beradimi (give a breakdown of / broken down into) va prognoz yilini aytadimi? 2) Overview raqamsiz: eng katta ulush va eng katta o'zgarish (prognoz bo'lsa — kelajakdagi asosiy o'zgarish) aytilganmi? 3) Kasr aytilgan joyda haqiqiy raqam qavsda berilganmi; foizlarni o'zim qo'shib yangi raqam yaratmadimmi? 4) "Other" faqat 4 mezondan biriga to'g'ri kelsa eslatilganmi va ot bilan yozilganmi (other outlets)? 5) Prognoz shaxssiz passivda (is predicted / expected to), "By + yil" bilan future perfect bormi va xatboshilar guruh bo'yicha (hozir → kelajak) tartiblanganmi?
mistakes: Other outlets made up a further 4%.
The share of households using online delivery will probably reach 27%.
The share of households using online delivery is projected to reach 27%.
By 2035, online delivery will rise to 27%.
By 2035, online delivery will have risen to 27%.
The percentage of car use was 30%.

how: CORE — ulush va prognoz fe'llari; STRONG — solishtirishni kuchaytiruvchi so'zlar; SUPER — Band 8 iboralari.
Namuna pie chart bo'yicha har CORE so'z bilan bitta gap tuzing: raqam va yil bo'lsin.
core: The pie charts give a breakdown of where households bought their food.
Pie chart'lar uy xo'jaliklari oziq-ovqatni qayerdan sotib olganining taqsimotini beradi.
Supermarkets represent the largest portion of the pie in both years.
Ikkala yilda ham diagrammaning eng katta qismi supermarketlarga to'g'ri keladi.
The proportion of households using online delivery is predicted to rise.
Onlayn yetkazib berishdan foydalanadigan uy xo'jaliklari ulushi oshishi bashorat qilinmoqda.
Supermarkets accounted for 48% of the total in 2015.
2015 yilda supermarketlar jamining 48% ini tashkil etdi.
Specialist shops made up just 8% of the total.
Ixtisoslashgan do'konlar jamining atigi 8% ini tashkil qildi.
In 2035, households using online delivery are expected to constitute over a quarter of the total.
2035 yilda onlayn yetkazib berishdan foydalanadigan uy xo'jaliklari jamining choragidan ko'pini tashkil etishi kutilmoqda.
The second chart shows projections for 2035.
Local markets are expected to decline to 12%.
Online delivery is predicted to overtake local markets.
Onlayn yetkazib berish mahalliy bozorlarni quvib o'tishi bashorat qilinmoqda.
The share of specialist shops will decline slightly.
strong: Supermarkets will remain the dominant source of food.
Supermarketlar oziq-ovqatning yetakchi manbai bo'lib qoladi.
Online delivery shows by far the fastest growth.
Onlayn yetkazib berish boshqalardan ancha tez o'sadi (eng tez o'sish).
In 2015, the figures for supermarkets and local markets were 48% and 20% respectively.
2015 yilda supermarketlar va mahalliy bozorlar ko'rsatkichlari mos ravishda 48% va 20% edi.
Convenience stores are expected to see only a marginal fall.
Kichik do'konlarda faqat juda kichik pasayish kutilmoqda.
The projected fall in traditional outlets is matched by a corresponding rise in online delivery.
An'anaviy savdo joylaridagi kutilayotgan pasayishga onlayn yetkazib berishdagi mos o'sish to'g'ri keladi.
The share of households using online delivery is expected to more than quadruple.
Onlayn yetkazib berishdan foydalanadigan uy xo'jaliklari ulushi to'rt baravardan ko'proq oshishi kutilmoqda.
super: Specialist shops are projected to follow the same downward trend as local markets, albeit less steeply.
Ixtisoslashgan do'konlar ham mahalliy bozorlar kabi pasayishi prognoz qilinmoqda, garchi kamroq keskin bo'lsa ham.
Traditional outlets are forecast to lose ground.
An'anaviy savdo joylari mavqeini yo'qotishi prognoz qilinmoqda.
In stark contrast to markets, online delivery will boom.
Bozorlardan keskin farqli o'laroq, onlayn yetkazib berish gurkiraydi.
The online delivery share is predicted to grow fastest, albeit from a much lower base.
Onlayn yetkazib berish ulushi eng tez o'sishi bashorat qilinmoqda, garchi ancha pastroq boshlang'ich darajadan bo'lsa ham.

class_ex.title: 1-mashq: Prognoz gaplari (namuna pie chart bo'yicha)
class_ex.instr: Qavsdagi so'zlar bilan to'liq gap tuzing. Zamon va predloglarni o'zingiz qo'shing. Raqamlar namuna pie chart'lardan.
items: (predict / the supermarket share / fall / 40%)
(it / expect / local markets / decline / 12%)
(By 2035 / online delivery / estimate / rise / 27%)
(project / convenience stores / remain / around 13%)
(it / anticipate / specialist shops / shrink / 5%)
(pie charts / breakdown / 2015 / projections / 2035)
answers: The supermarket share is predicted to fall to 40%.
It is expected that local markets will decline to 12%.
By 2035, online delivery is estimated to have risen to 27%.
Convenience stores are projected to remain at around 13%.
It is anticipated that specialist shops will shrink to 5%.
The pie charts give a breakdown of where households bought their food in 2015, together with projections for 2035.
why: X + is + V3 + to + V — ega gap boshida. Grafik uy xo'jaliklari ULUSHINI o'lchaydi: "the supermarket share"; "sales / orders / purchases" emas.
It is + V3 + that ... will — butun gap shaklida.
By + kelajak sana → future perfect: is estimated to have risen.
remain AT around 13% — daraja "at" bilan.
Fe'l hozirgi zamonda: bashorat hozir qilinmoqda.
Kirish gapi: breakdown OF + prognoz FOR 2035.

class_ex.title: 2-mashq: "Other" ni eslatamizmi?
class_ex.instr: Har vaziyatda "Other" ni javobda eslatish kerakmi (Ha / Yo'q)? Kitobdagi 4 mezondan qaysi biri sabab bo'ladi?
items: 8 kategoriya; Other = 3%, eng kichik kategoriya 4%.
3 kategoriya; Other = 18%.
6 kategoriya; Other 2015 da 4%, 2035 da 15% (prognoz).
7 kategoriya; Other = 6%, Rent = 5%.
Namuna pie chart: Other 4% → 3%.
why: Kichik, 5% dan kam, hech narsadan katta emas — minor detail.
Kategoriyalar kam va ulush katta — key feature.
Ikkinchi diagrammada keskin o'sgan — o'zgarish muhim.
5% dan katta va boshqa kategoriyadan (Rent) katta.
Hech bir mezonga to'g'ri kelmaydi — namuna javobda eslatilmagan.

class_ex.title: 3-mashq: Solishtirish xatolarini tuzating
class_ex.instr: Har gapda bitta solishtirish yoki ulush xatosi bor; 3-gapda bundan tashqari prognoz zamoni ham xato. To'g'ri variantni yozing.
items: In 2035, less households will shop at local markets.
In 2035, almost twice more households will use online delivery than used convenience stores in 2015.
Not many households used specialist shops in 2035 than in 2015.
Much less amount of money was spent on bread than on meat.
Supermarkets were far higher in 2015.
Other made up 4% in 2015.
answers: In 2035, fewer households will shop at local markets.
In 2035, almost twice as many households will use online delivery as used convenience stores in 2015.
Not as many households are expected to use specialist shops in 2035 as in 2015.
Far less money was spent on bread than on meat.
In 2015, a far higher proportion of households shopped at supermarkets than at any other outlet.
why: households — sanaladigan: fewer.
Ko'paytma bilan: twice / three times as many (much) ... as; "twice more ... than" emas. 27% va 14% — deyarli ikki baravar.
not as many ... as; prognoz yil — is expected to.
"less amount of" emas: far less + sanalmaydigan ot.
Supermarketlar "yuqori" emas — ularning ULUSHI yuqori; kim bilan solishtirilgani aytilsin.
"Other" ga ot qo'shiladi.

class_ex.title: 4-mashq: Qaysi tartib yaxshiroq?
class_ex.instr: Har vazifa uchun eng yaxshi body paragraph tartibini tanlang va sababini ayting.
items: Yemen va Italy aholisi yosh guruhlari bo'yicha, 2000 va 2050 (prognoz). A) P3: 2000 yil, P4: 2050 yil B) P3: Yemen (2000 → 2050), P4: Italy (2000 → 2050) C) P3: 0–14 yosh, P4: 60+ yosh
Fast food iste'mol chastotasi, 6 kategoriya, 3 yil. A) P3: 2003→2006, P4: 2006→2013 B) P3: har kuni + hech qachon + yiliga bir necha marta, P4: haftada / oyda C) Har kategoriyaga alohida xatboshi
Energiya iste'moli, 6 yoqilg'i, 2000–2050. A) P3: 2000–2020, P4: 2020–2050 B) Har yoqilg'iga bir gap, bitta xatboshi C) P3: fossil fuels, P4: renewables + nuclear
Namuna pie chart (oziq-ovqat). A) P3: 2015, P4: 2035 B) P3: kamayayotgan savdo joylari, P4: onlayn yetkazib berish C) P3: eng katta 3 ulush, P4: eng kichik 3 ulush
why: A — ikki holat alohida, o'zgarish ko'rinmaydi. B — har mamlakatda o'zgarish va solishtirish (grammatika, STACKED BAR bandi: har xatboshida bitta mamlakat, hozir → kelajak).
Yil bo'yicha tartib bir xil o'zgarishni takrorlaydi. Shkala uchlari kam o'zgargan, o'rtasi ko'p o'zgargan (kitob, 214-bet).
Ikki aniq guruh va umbrella term (fossil fuels / renewables) — overview ham oson.
Asosiy hikoya — an'anaviy joylar mavqeini yo'qotadi, onlayn keskin o'sadi. C ham mumkin, lekin o'zgarishni yashiradi.

class_ex.title: 5-mashq: Bir xatboshi — prognoz tili bilan
class_ex.instr: Kitobning 196-betidagi Italy pie chart'lari bo'yicha bitta body paragraph yozing (60–80 so'z). Kamida: bitta "is predicted to", bitta "By 2050 ... will have", bitta account for / make up, bitta kasr + qavsda raqam. 12 daqiqa yozing (2 daqiqa reja + 10 daqiqa yozish); keyin juftingiz shu 4 talabni tekshiradi (5 daqiqa).
items: 2000 dagi eng katta guruh va uning ulushi
2050 ga kelib kamayadigan ikki guruh
Deyarli ikki baravar o'sadigan guruh
Yemen bilan bitta solishtirish
answers: In 2000, the working-age group (15–59) was by far the largest, making up just over three-fifths of Italians (61.6%).
By 2050, the shares of the under-15 and working-age groups are expected to have shrunk to 11.5% and 46.2% respectively.
The over-60s, by contrast, are projected to rise sharply, from 24.1% to 42.3%.
Yemen, by comparison, is forecast to have only 5.7% of its people aged 60 or over.
why: Kasr + qavsda raqam — izchil.
By + future perfect + respectively.
Prognoz passivi, raqam bilan isbot.
Solishtirish — "make comparisons where relevant" talabi.
class_ex.note: Bu ustoz uchun yo'naltiruvchi iboralar, to'liq namuna emas; o'quvchi javobi o'z so'zlari bilan bo'lsin.

readings.source: Pauline Cullen, The Key to IELTS Writing Task 1, Lesson 13 (PDF bet 191, 193, 194)

tasks.title: Sahifalar bo'yicha savollar (191–194-betlar)
tasks.type: Og'zaki
tasks.instr: Ustoz sahifani ko'rsatadi, o'quvchilar o'zbekcha javob beradi.
items: 191-bet: Pie chart'ni tanishtirishda qaysi ikki ibora tabiiy va nega?
193–194-betlar: Prognoz tili ro'yxatidagi fe'llar nega hozirgi zamon passivida (is predicted / expected to)?
194-bet: "It is predicted that ..." va "... is predicted to ..." shakllarining farqi nima?
194-bet: Gapda "By 2040" bo'lsa, qaysi zamon kerak?
answers: give a breakdown of / broken down into — pie chart butunni (100%) qismlarga bo'ladi
Bashoratni mutaxassislar hozir qilmoqda; shaxssiz passiv — Task 1 uslubi ("will probably" yoki "experts think" emas)
Birinchisida It + passiv + that + will (butun gap), ikkinchisida ega gap boshida (X is predicted to + V); ma'no bir xil
Future perfect: will have + V3 yoki is expected to have + V3 — hozirdan kelajakdagi sanagacha bo'ladigan o'zgarish
why: Kirish gapi — savolni paraphrase qilish + breakdown.
Prognoz — shaxssiz passiv, taxmin emas.
Ikki shaklni almashtirib ishlatish — Grammatical Range.
By + kelajak sana → future perfect.

readings.title: Kitob (2): Yemen–Italy, stacked bar, guruhlash, energiya
readings.source: Pauline Cullen, The Key to IELTS Writing Task 1, Lessons 13–15 (PDF bet 196, 205, 213, 214, 229)
readings.book_ref: 196: prognozli budjet mashqi javoblari va Yemen–Italy vazifasi; 205: xuddi shu ma'lumot stacked bar ko'rinishida va muallif belgilari; 213: fast food vazifasi va yozishdan oldingi 3 savol; 214: shkala bo'yicha guruhlash; 229: ikki pie chart — energiya va emissiya (turli o'lchov).

tasks.title: Sahifalar bo'yicha savollar
tasks.type: Og'zaki
tasks.instr: Ustoz sahifani ko'rsatadi, o'quvchilar o'zbekcha javob beradi.
items: 191-bet: Nega "from just over a fifth to about a third" gapi o'quvchini chalkashtiradi?
193-bet: "Other" 7% — muallif qaysi 4 holatda uni key feature deb hisoblaydi?
196-bet: Yemen–Italy vazifasida qaysi ikki asosiy tendensiya overview'ga kiradi?
205-bet: Stacked bar'ni yozishda pie chart javobidan nima o'zgaradi?
213–214-betlar: Muallif nega birinchi urinishni (yil bo'yicha) tashlab, qayta boshladi?
229-bet: Nega "lighting creates double the emissions it consumes" deb yozib bo'lmaydi?
answers: Kasr va foiz aralashgan, haqiqiy raqamlar yo'q — o'quvchi hisoblashi kerak
Kategoriyalar kam; 5% dan katta; boshqa kategoriyadan katta; ikkinchi diagrammada o'zgargan
Ikkala mamlakatda aholi qariydi; Yemen 2050 da ham Italydan ancha yosh
Faqat kirish gapi (The stacked bar charts show ...)
Yil bo'yicha tartib bir xil o'zgarishlarni takrorlatdi; o'xshash kategoriyalarni guruhlash kerak edi
Energiya va emissiya turli narsani o'lchaydi — ularni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri solishtirib bo'lmaydi
why: Kasr ishlatsangiz — qavsda raqam.
Qolgan hollarda "Other" — minor detail.
Overview — raqamsiz, ikki mamlakat solishtirilgan.
Har ustun 100% — pie chart bilan bir xil mantiq.
Yozishdan oldin 3 savol: tartib, solishtirish, takror.
Task Achievement: ma'lumotni noto'g'ri talqin qilish.

readings.title: NAMUNA: pie chart → reja → javob
readings.qtype: Two pie charts with projections — to'liq javob (Jony Academy)
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna javobi (196 so'z; pie chart ma'lumotlari mashq uchun to'qilgan)
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: The pie charts below show where households in one country bought most of their food in 2015 and projections for 2035. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.  |  REJA (3 daqiqa): O: supermarkets ++ (hali ham 1-o'rin) // online ↑↑↑ (6 → 27) // an'anaviy joylar ↓. P3: supermarkets, markets, specialist ↓, convenience ≈. P4: online ↑ — faqat bitta, lekin eng katta o'zgarish. Other 4→3 — minor, yozilmaydi.
text: The pie charts give a breakdown of where households in one country bought their food in 2015, together with projections for 2035.

Overall, supermarkets were the dominant source of food in 2015 and are expected to remain so, but online delivery is predicted to see by far the most dramatic growth. By contrast, most traditional outlets are forecast to lose ground.

In 2015, almost half of all households (48%) did their food shopping mainly in supermarkets, more than twice the proportion who relied on local markets (20%). Over the next two decades, the supermarket share is projected to fall to 40%, while local markets are expected to decline more sharply, to just 12%. Specialist shops, already a minor option at 8%, are projected to shrink further to 5%, whereas convenience stores should remain almost unchanged at around 13%.

Online delivery, however, presents a very different picture. Accounting for a mere 6% of households in 2015, it is estimated to have more than quadrupled to 27% by 2035, overtaking every category except supermarkets. As a result, it is expected to become the second most common way of buying food, with over a quarter of households choosing it.
glossary: a minor option — kichik (kam tanlanadigan) variant
paraphrases: The pie charts below show
The pie charts give a breakdown of
projections for 2035
is projected to / is expected to / is estimated to have
households
the proportion who ..., the supermarket share
bought most of their food
did their food shopping, sources of food, ways of buying food

tasks.title: Namunani bugungi qoidalar bilan tekshiring
tasks.type: Og'zaki
tasks.instr: Pie chart va namuna javobga qarab javob bering.
items: Overview'dagi ikki asosiy fikr qaysi? Unda raqam bormi?
Prognoz tilining 5 xil shaklini toping.
Future perfect qaysi gapda va nega aynan u yerda?
Nega "Other" javobda umuman yo'q?
Kasr qayerda ishlatilgan va u raqam bilan qo'llab-quvvatlanganmi?
Nega onlayn yetkazib berish alohida xatboshida?
answers: Supermarketlar yetakchi bo'lib qoladi; onlayn eng keskin o'sadi (+ an'anaviy joylar kamayadi); raqam yo'q
are expected to remain, is predicted to see, are forecast to lose, is projected to fall, is estimated to have ...
"it is estimated to have more than quadrupled to 27% by 2035" — by + kelajak sana
4% → 3%: kichik, 5% dan kam, hech narsadan katta emas — minor detail
"almost half (48%)", "over a quarter" — ikkinchisi 27% bilan oldingi gapda isbotlangan
Yagona o'sayotgan kategoriya — kontrast guruhi ("presents a very different picture")
why: Aniq overview — Band 7 talabi.
Diapazon — faqat will emas.
Future perfect — ikki vaqt nuqtasi: hozir va 2035.
Kitob, 193-bet: 4 mezon.
Kasr + raqam izchil.
Guruhlash: o'xshash tendensiya birga, kontrast alohida.

homework_intro: Bugun pie chart va stacked bar'ni yozishni, "Other" qoidasini, prognoz tilini va ma'lumotni guruhlashni o'rgandik. Uyda Yemen–Italy vazifasiga to'liq javob yozasiz.

Birinchi vazifa — kitobning 196-betidagi Yemen–Italy pie chart'lari uchun to'liq javob, 20 daqiqa (3 reja + 15 yozish + 2 tekshirish). Tartib: P3 — Yemen (2000 → 2050), P4 — Italy (2000 → 2050). Kamida 3 xil prognoz shakli. Raqamlar (kitob sahifasi qo'lda bo'lmasa): Yemen — 2000: 0–14 yosh 50.1%, 15–59 yosh 46.3%, 60+ 3.6%; 2050: 37.0%, 57.3%, 5.7%. Italy — 2000: 14.3%, 61.6%, 24.1%; 2050: 11.5%, 46.2%, 42.3%.

Ikkinchi vazifa — kitobning 213-betidagi fast food vazifasi (sahifa — darsdagi "Kitob (2)" rasmida; ustoz uni guruh chatiga yuboradi) uchun faqat REJA: overview uchun 3 fikr va P3/P4 guruhlari (shkala uchlari va o'rtasi).
Uchinchi vazifa — CORE, STRONG va SUPER ro'yxatlaridan 8 so'z bilan namuna pie chart haqida 8 gap; har gapda raqam yoki solishtirish.

homework.title: To'liq javob: Yemen va Italy (2000 va 2050)
homework.instr: 4 xatboshi, 170–200 so'z, 20 daqiqa. Overview raqamsiz; kamida bitta future perfect (By 2050 ... will have); "will probably" yo'q.
homework.answers: Namuna overview: "Overall, the proportion of older people is set to grow in both countries, but Italy's population will remain considerably older than Yemen's throughout." Tekshiruv: Italy'da 60+ guruh ikki baravarga yaqin oshishi (24.1% → 42.3%) va Yemen'da 0–14 guruhning kamayishi (50.1% → 37%) key feature sifatida ajratilganmi?

homework.title: Fast food vazifasi — reja
homework.instr: 5 daqiqa: overview uchun 3 fikr, P3 va P4 guruhlari, har guruh uchun 2 dalil raqam.
homework.answers: Kutiladigan reja: tez-tez iste'mol (haftada) umuman kamaygan; kamroq iste'mol (oyda) o'sib, 2013 da eng yuqori; uchlari (har kuni / hech qachon) eng past va deyarli o'zgarmagan. Raqamlarni o'zingiz qo'shmang.

homework.title: 8 ta gap — ulush va prognoz tili
homework.instr: account for, make up, constitute, be expected to, overtake, lose ground, albeit, by far — har biri bilan bitta gap.
homework.answers: Ustoz fewer / less va account FOR xatolarini alohida tekshiradi.

normativ: overview raqamsiz, 3 xil prognoz shakli, 170+ so'z

kahoot.q: Which sentence describes a prediction in the correct Task 1 style?
options: The online delivery share is projected to reach 27%.
The online delivery share will probably reach around 27%.
I personally think the online delivery share will reach 27%.
The online delivery share is maybe going to reach 27%.
kahoot.explain: Prognoz — shaxssiz passiv: is projected / expected / predicted to. "will probably" va shaxsiy fikr Task 1 uslubiga mos emas.

kahoot.q: By 2035, online delivery ___ to 27%.
kahoot.explain: By + kelajak sana → future perfect: is expected to have risen (yoki will have risen).

kahoot.q: Which is the best way to write about the 'Other' category (4%)?
options: Other outlets made up a further 4%.
The smallest outlet was other, at 4%.
4% of food was bought in Other.
kahoot.explain: "Other" ot emas — unga ot qo'shiladi: other costs / other outlets.

kahoot.q: 'Other' is 3% and smaller than every other category. What should you do?
options: Leave it out as a minor detail
Add it to the biggest category
kahoot.explain: 5% dan kichik, hech narsadan katta emas va o'zgarmagan — minor detail. Eslatish shart emas.

kahoot.q: Which sentence uses fractions and percentages clearly?
options: The share fell from almost half (48%) to two-fifths (40%).
The share fell 8% from about a half to two-fifths.
The share fell from 48 percent to two-fifths.
The share fell from almost half of the total to 40 percentage.
kahoot.explain: Kasr aytilsa — haqiqiy raqam qavsda. Aralash kasr va foiz o'quvchini hisoblashga majbur qiladi.

kahoot.q: Choose the correct comparison.
options: Few households used local markets than before.
kahoot.explain: households — sanaladigan ot: fewer. less — sanalmaydigan ot bilan (less sugar, less money).

kahoot.q: Not ___ households will use local markets in 2035 ___ in 2015.
kahoot.explain: Sanaladigan ot bilan: not as many ... as. "than" bu tuzilmada ishlatilmaydi.

kahoot.q: A stacked bar chart where each bar totals 100% should be described...
kahoot.explain: Kitob: stacked bar — pie chart kabi. Faqat kirish gapi o'zgaradi.

kahoot.q: Pie charts show two countries in 2000 and 2050. Which paragraph plan is best?
options: P3: Country A 2000→2050; P4: Country B 2000→2050
P3: both countries in 2000; P4: both countries in 2050
One paragraph for each of the four pie charts
kahoot.explain: Yil bo'yicha tartib ikki holatni alohida tasvirlaydi; mamlakat bo'yicha — o'zgarish va solishtirish ko'rinadi.

kahoot.q: Why should you NOT add several percentages together yourself?
options: It changes the data and makes the examiner check your maths
It makes the answer too short
Numbers are not allowed in the body paragraphs of a Task 1 answer
Examiners always prefer fractions to percentages
kahoot.explain: O'z yig'indingiz ma'lumotni buzadi va examinerga qo'shimcha ish beradi. Faqat berilgan raqamlarni tanlang.

kahoot.q: Which sentence uses 'albeit' correctly?
options: Bus use fell in the same way, albeit more slowly.
Albeit bus use was much lower than car use, it fell.
Bus use fell in the same way, albeit it fell more slowly.
Albeit, bus use fell in the same way.
kahoot.explain: albeit — gap o'rtasida, qisqa ibora bilan (= although more slowly). Gap boshida va to'liq gap bilan ishlatilmaydi.

kahoot.q: Oil use rose again after 2020. Which phrase is stylistically wrong?
options: oil use recovered and finally managed to rise
oil use began to rise again
oil use increased once more in the following years
kahoot.explain: recovered / finally managed — ijobiy ma'no beradi; neft iste'molining o'sishi yaxshi narsa emas. Neytral fe'l tanlang.

kahoot.q: The pie charts give a ___ of where households buy their food.
kahoot.explain: give a breakdown of — butunning qismlarga bo'linishi. Pie chart kirish gapi uchun tabiiy ibora.

kahoot.q: Supermarkets ___ 48% of the total.
kahoot.explain: account FOR / make up / constitute + %. "make up for" — o'rnini to'ldirmoq, boshqa ma'no.

kahoot.q: Online delivery is predicted to ___ local markets.
kahoot.explain: overtake — quvib o'tmoq (27% > 12%). overcome — yengmoq (qiyinchilikni).

kahoot.q: Traditional outlets are forecast to ___ ground.
kahoot.explain: lose ground — mavqeini, ulushini yo'qotmoq. Qolgan fe'llar bu ibora bilan birikmaydi.

kahoot.q: The figures for supermarkets and local markets were 48% and 20% ___.
kahoot.explain: respectively — mos ravishda (tartib bilan). respectfully — hurmat bilan.

kahoot.q: Online delivery is projected to go from 6% to 27%. By 2035, it is expected to have ___.
kahoot.explain: 6 × 4 = 24 < 27 — to'rt baravardan ko'proq: more than quadrupled.

kahoot.q: Supermarkets were by far the ___ source of food.
kahoot.explain: the dominant source — yetakchi, ustun manba. domestic — ichki, uy.

kahoot.q: Convenience stores are projected to go from 14% to 13% — a ___ change.
kahoot.explain: 1 foizlik o'zgarish — marginal (juda kichik). Qolganlari katta o'zgarishni bildiradi.

lessons.title: Writing Task 1 (6): Map — o'zgarishlarni aniq tasvirlash
lessons.grammar_topic: Map va plan tili: passiv (was built, has been removed, will be extended), zamonlar diapazoni (oldin — hozir — nima o'zgardi — kelajak), there is / there are, umbrella terms bilan overview, joylashuvni faqat kerak bo'lganda va aniq berish
lessons.vocab_topic: Inshoot va o'zgarish so'zlari: amenities, facilities, accommodation, access, retain, relocate, extend, replace, lengthen / widen, redevelop / renovate, make way for
lessons.book_ref: Pauline Cullen, "The Key to IELTS Writing Task 1" — Lesson 7: Map tasks (PDF bet 90–107); Lesson 8: Being precise in map and plan tasks (PDF bet 108–123); Lesson 17: Review of map tasks and Task 1 language (PDF bet 248–267).
objectives: Map/plan vazifasining chart'dan farqini bilish: key features — nima qo'shildi, olib tashlandi, kattalashtirildi, ko'chirildi va nima o'zgarmadi.
Detallarni ko'rish: savoldagi ma'lumot, key (legend), scale va kompas — va ulardan faqat muhimini tanlash.
Overview'ni ikkala xaritaga qarab, umbrella terms bilan (accommodation, amenities, access) raqamsiz va tafsilotsiz yozish.
Zamonlar diapazonini asosli qo'llash: oldingi holat — past simple, hozirgi holat — present simple, o'zgarish — present perfect passive, reja — future passive.

Joylashuvni faqat key feature bo'lganda, bitta-bitta va aniq predloglar bilan berish; kompasni faqat katta hududlar va binoning butun bir tomoni uchun ishlatish (bino ichidagi kichik joylar uchun — predloglar).
Band 6 xatolarini tuzatish: shaxsiy baho so'zlari, noto'g'ri bog'lovchilar (Firstly, On the contrary), "is planned to be" kabi ortiqcha (to'g'ri, lekin cho'zilgan) passivlar, bo'sh iboralar.
materials: Kitob sahifalari (Reading bo'limida, 2 ta rasm) — proyektorda: map tili, key features ro'yxati, passiv va zamonlar, joylashuv qoidalari; orol va sport markazi vazifalari.
Kitobdagi aeroport rejasi (Cambridge 16 asosida) — namuna javob uchun, alohida rasm.
Doskada 7 savol: What did it look like? What does it look like now? What has changed / been added / been removed / been extended? What has stayed the same?
Doskada umbrella terms: accommodation, amenities, leisure facilities, access, natural features.
Taymer: reja 3 daqiqa, to'liq javob 20 daqiqa.
timeline: Takrorlash
22-dars: prognoz tili — is expected to / By 2035 ... will have; 3 ta tezkor savol.
Map vazifasi qanday farq qiladi
Kitob, 91 va 94-betlar: passiv, mavzu so'zlari, key features ro'yxati; 2-mashq — orol xaritasida detallar (key, scale, kompas) va key features.
Passiv va zamonlar diapazoni
Kitob, 97–98-betlar: there is / passiv xatolari; faqat present simple — "rasmni tasvirlash" belgisi; 1-mashq.
Overview va tartib
Umbrella terms bilan overview (2-mashqning 5-savolidagi guruhlar asosida); oldin/keyin tartibi va mirror; 4-mashq.
Aniq joylashuv va fe'llar
Kitob, 112-bet va sport markazi rejasi: bitta joylashuv, kompas faqat katta hudud yoki binoning butun bir tomoniga, lengthen / widen; 3-mashq.
Namuna: aeroport rejasi → reja → javob
O'quvchilar 3 daqiqada key features ro'yxatini tuzadi; namuna javob o'qiladi va zamonlar bo'yicha tahlil qilinadi.
Sinfda yozish
5-mashq (to'g'ri/noto'g'ri) va sport markazi rejasi uchun overview + bitta body paragraph; juftlik tekshiradi.
Xulosa va vazifa
Map uchun tekshiruv ro'yxati; uy vazifasini tushuntirish.

intro: MAP VAZIFASI FARQI: chart'da fe'llar asosan aktiv — raqamlar oshdi, kamaydi. Map va plan'da esa ko'pincha nima QILINGAN yoki QILINADI haqida yozamiz: was built, has been removed, will be extended. Agar gapingizda "they built ..." chiqsa — bu passivga o'tish signali (kim qurgani muhim emas).

KEY FEATURES (map uchun): nima qo'shildi; nima olib tashlandi; nima kattalashtirildi yoki kichraytirildi; nima almashtirildi yoki ko'chirildi; nima yaxshilandi; va eng muhimi — nima O'ZGARMAY QOLDI (saqlandi). Chart'dagi "eng yuqori/eng past nuqta" o'rnini shular egallaydi.

1-QADAM — DETALLAR: savol gapi (bu nima joy? o'zgarish nima uchun qilingan — masalan, turistlar uchun), key/legend (belgilar ma'nosi: footpath va vehicle track), scale (o'lcham — kerak bo'lsa bitta gapda) va kompas (faqat katta hududlar va binoning butun bir tomoni uchun). Kitobdagi orol xaritasi shu 4 detalning namunasi.

OVERVIEW — ikkala xaritaga qarab, eng asosiy 2–3 o'zgarish; tafsilot o'rniga UMBRELLA TERM: "restaurant, reception, huts" emas — "accommodation and amenities"; "footpath, vehicle track, pier" emas — "access". Sport markazi uchun to'liq overview uch narsani aytadi: markaz kattaroq bo'ladi, inshootlar ko'payadi, tashqi kortlar yo'qoladi.

TARTIB: oddiy yo'l — P3: oldingi holat (+ nima saqlangan), P4: keyingi holat; yoki umbrella term bo'yicha (accommodation / access). P4 P3 ning tartibini takrorlasin (mirror). Xaritani shimol-janub-sharq-g'arbga bo'lib yozish ro'yxat beradi — tavsiya etilmaydi. Eng muhimi: ikki xaritani ikki alohida rasm kabi tasvirlamang — O'ZGARISHNI ko'rsating.

ZAMONLAR DIAPAZONI: javob butunlay present simple'da bo'lsa, siz rasmni tasvirlayapsiz, o'zgarishni emas — GRA ham, TA ham pasayadi. Ichki savollar: What did it look like before? (past simple) What does it look like now? (present simple) What has been added / removed / extended? (present perfect passive). Sana yo'q bo'lsa, ikkinchi xaritani "hozir" deb olib present perfect ishlating; sanalar o'tmishda bo'lsa — past simple; reja bo'lsa — will be / is going to be + V3.

PASSIV XATOLARI: yordamchi fe'l tushib qolmasin ("A pier built" → "A pier has been built"); "There has built a café" → "A café has been built"; "is planned to be removed", "is intended to be enlarged" grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri, lekin Task 1 da ortiqcha (reja allaqachon rasmda) — qisqa va aniqroq: "will be removed", "will be lengthened". Savolni paraphrase qilishda "future plans" emas — "the current layout of a sports centre and the proposed changes".

JOYLASHUV: har bir detalning joyini yozish shart emas — faqat key feature bo'lsa (masalan, kortlar olib tashlanib, bino sharq va g'arbga kengaytiriladi). Bir vaqtda bitta joylashuv. KOMPAS QOIDASI: kompas (north, east ...) — katta hududlar va butun bino yoki maydonning bir tomoni uchun: the east coast, the western side of the centre, extended to the east and west. Bino ICHIDAGI kichik joylar (xona, kafe, o'rindiqlar) uchun kompas emas — at the front / back of, next to, opposite, between, behind. Mantiq bilan bog'lang: "changing rooms next to the new pool" (hovuz uchun kerak).

ANIQ FE'LLAR VA USLUB: lengthen, widen, deepen, shorten, lower; extend, expand, relocate, replace, convert into, demolish; develop (tabiiy joyga qurilish), redevelop (eski binolarni almashtirish), renovate (yangilash). Shaxsiy baho so'zlari (beautiful, remarkable, amazing) va xulosalar (tourists will enjoy) — TA ni pasaytiradi. Bog'lovchilar: Firstly / Lastly — jarayon uchun; On the contrary — noto'g'ri fikrni tuzatish uchun; map'da: Prior to development, Following construction, In terms of access, ... Bo'sh iboralar ("It is demonstrated that") — so'z isrofi.
formulas: X + was / has been / will be + V3
A bag-drop point will be installed.
Following redevelopment, the gate area will be expanded.
In terms of access, footpaths have been created.
As for — faqat avval aytilganga qaytishda
X + will be lengthened / widened / relocated
The gym will be lengthened to double its size.
X + will be replaced by / converted into Y
The walkway will be replaced by a sky train.
There is / are / will be + ot
There will be two new dance studios.
presentation: Map'da raqamlar yo'q — overview nima haqida?
Eng asosiy o'zgarishlar: nima qo'shildi / olib tashlandi / kattalashdi va nima o'zgarmadi — umbrella terms bilan.
Hamma gapni passivda yozamanmi?
Yo'q. Diapazon kerak: oldingi holat — past simple, hozir — present simple, o'zgarish — present perfect passive. Passiv — faqat "nima qilingan" uchun.
Kompas berilgan — hamma narsani north/south bilan yozamanmi?
Yo'q. Kompas — katta hududlar va binoning butun bir tomoni uchun (the east coast, the western side of the centre). Bino ichidagi kichik joylar uchun: at the front of, next to, opposite.
Sana berilmagan bo'lsa qaysi zamon?
Ikkinchi xaritani "hozir" deb oling: has been built, is now. O'tmishdagi sanalar bo'lsa — past simple.
Kelajak rejasi (plan) bo'lsa-chi?
will be / is going to be + V3: "The courts will be removed." "are planned to be removed" ham grammatik to'g'ri, lekin ortiqcha — will be + V3 qisqa va aniqroq.
Foydalanuvchi nuqtai nazari (visitors will benefit from ...) yaxshimi?
1–2 gapda tilni xilma-xil qilish uchun — ha. Butun javobni shunday yozsangiz, asosiy o'zgarishlar yo'qoladi.
notes: Kitobdagi orol, sport markazi va aeroport savollari o'quvchiga faqat sahifa rasmi sifatida ko'rsatiladi; kitobning o'z namuna javoblari darsda o'qitilmaydi — namuna javob Jony Academy'niki.
Aeroport savolida "next year" bor — demak ikkinchi reja kelajak: future passive va "will" asosiy zamon, hozirgi holat — present simple.
Ideal uzunlik 170–200 so'z. 230–250 so'zdan oshsa, bo'sh iboralar va ortiqcha joylashuv tafsilotlarini qidiring.
mistakes: There has built a restaurant in the centre.
A restaurant has been built in the centre.
The courts are planned to be removed.
Grammatik to'g'ri, lekin Task 1 da ortiqcha — will be + V3 qisqa va aniqroq
A beautiful new pier has been built.
A pier has been built on the south coast.
Firstly/Lastly — jarayon; On the contrary — tuzatish
The gym is intended to be enlarged eastward.
Aniq fe'l (lengthen); "is intended to be" — ortiqcha; gym bino ichidagi xona — kompas emas

how: CORE — inshootlar va asosiy o'zgarish fe'llari; STRONG — aniq o'zgarish fe'llari; SUPER — Band 8 iboralari.
Aeroport rejasi bo'yicha har CORE so'z bilan bitta passiv gap tuzing.

Keluvchi yo'lovchilar yangi qulayliklardan foydalana oladi.
The sports facilities will be moved indoors.
Hut-style accommodation has been built for tourists.
Turistlar uchun kulba uslubidagi turar joy qurilgan.

The café will be relocated closer to the entrance.
The building will be extended to the east and west.
The walkway will be replaced by a sky train.
Piyoda yo'lak osma poyezd bilan almashtiriladi.

Qurilishdan oldin orolda hech kim yashamagan.

The airport will be redeveloped next year.

Uylar uchun joy ochish maqsadida zavod buzib tashlandi.

Sport zaliga joy bo'shatish uchun maydonchalar olib tashlanadi.

class_ex.title: 1-mashq: Aktivdan passivga — aniq fe'l bilan (Bosqich 3, 15 daq. ichida)
class_ex.instr: Gapni passivga o'tkazing va "make ... bigger / longer / wider" o'rniga bitta aniq fe'l ishlating. Zamonni saqlang.
items: They will make the car park bigger.
They have made the main road wider.
They are going to make the runway longer.
They knocked down the old cinema.

answers: The car park will be extended / enlarged.
The main road has been widened.
The runway is going to be lengthened.
The bus station has been relocated to the north of the town.
The old warehouse will be converted into flats.
why: will + be + V3 — faqat yordamchi fe'l zamonni ko'rsatadi.
Present perfect passive: has been + V3.
is going to be + V3 — reja.
knock down → demolish (rasmiyroq).
move → relocate; katta hudud — kompas mumkin.
turn into → convert into.

class_ex.title: 2-mashq: Orol xaritasi — detallar va key features (kitob, 90-bet) (Bosqich 2, 15 daq. ichida)

Key (legend) nimani farqlaydi?
Scale bo'yicha orol taxminan qancha uzun?

Qo'shilgan narsalarni 3 ta umbrella term ostida guruhlang.

Accommodation (kulbalar); amenities (reception, restaurant); access (pier, tracks, footpaths)
Faqat eng sharqiy uchi (bir nechta palma) va g'arbiy plyaj tabiiy holatida qolgan; kulbalar orolning g'arbiy va sharqiy yarmida ham qurilgan.
why: Kirish va overview uchun kontekst.
Kichik belgilar ham key feature bo'lishi mumkin (access).
O'lcham — kerak bo'lsa bitta gapda, har detalga emas.
"Nima o'zgarmadi" — map key feature'i.
Umbrella term — overview va xatboshi tartibi uchun.
Orol — katta hudud, kompas bu yerda to'g'ri. Lekin "sharqiy qism tegilmagan" deyish xato: ikkinchi xaritada kulbalar ikkala yarmida ham bor.

class_ex.title: 3-mashq: Joylashuvni aniqlashtiring (sport markazi rejasi, kitob, 109-bet) (Bosqich 5, 15 daq. ichida)

answers: A leisure pool with its own changing room will be built on the western side of the centre.
The gym at the back of the building will be lengthened.
A café and a sports shop will be added near the entrance.
The seating area is next to the 25-metre pool.
The outdoor courts will be removed.
On the same side, there is going to be another changing room.
why: Bitta joylashuv; kiyinish xonasi hovuz uchun — mantiqiy bog'lanish.
Gym — bino ichidagi xona: kompas emas, at the back of; aniq fe'l — lengthen.
"mapped out" — xaritani tasvirlash; kelajak passivi kerak.
Kichik joy — next to; "in the east of" katta hudud uchun.
Grammatik to'g'ri, lekin Task 1 da ortiqcha — "will be removed" qisqa va aniqroq.
ON the same side; there IS + birlik ot.

class_ex.title: 4-mashq: Qaysi overview aniq? (sport markazi rejasi) (Bosqich 4, 15 daq. ichida)
class_ex.type: Choose A, B, C or D
class_ex.instr: Eng yaxshi overview'ni tanlang va qolganlarining muammosini nomlang: tafsilot / to'liq emas / shaxsiy baho / bo'sh ibora.
items: A) Overall, a leisure pool, a café, a sports shop, two dance studios and a new changing room will be added. B) Overall, the centre will get bigger. C) Overall, the centre will be considerably larger and offer a wider range of indoor facilities, although its outdoor courts will be lost. D) Overall, it is clearly demonstrated that the wonderful new centre will be far more attractive to students.

Qaysi overview'da faqat bitta o'zgarish bor? A) "a leisure pool, a café, a sports shop ... will be added" B) "the centre will get bigger" C) "considerably larger ... although its outdoor courts will be lost" D) "it is clearly demonstrated that the wonderful new centre ..."

Qaysi overview'da shaxsiy baho va bo'sh ibora bor? A) "a leisure pool, a café, a sports shop ... will be added" B) "the centre will get bigger" C) "considerably larger ... although its outdoor courts will be lost" D) "it is clearly demonstrated that the wonderful new centre ..."
why: C — uch asosiy o'zgarish: kattaroq, ko'proq inshoot, tashqi kortlar yo'qoladi; umbrella term, tafsilotsiz. A — tafsilotlar ro'yxati.
B — to'g'ri, lekin to'liq emas (Band 7 uchun asosiy o'zgarishlarning barchasi kerak).
"wonderful", "more attractive" — rejada ko'rinmaydi; "it is clearly demonstrated that" — so'z isrofi.

Foydalanuvchi nuqtai nazaridan 1–2 gap yozish tilni xilma-xil qiladi.

Overview asosiy o'zgarishlar haqida — ikkala xarita kerak.
Retained / remained the same — map'ning muhim xususiyati.
Faqat key feature bo'lsa; kompas — katta hududlar va binoning butun bir tomoni uchun.
Ular jarayon bosqichlari uchun; map'da Prior to / Following / In terms of.
Lekin butun javob shunday bo'lsa, asosiy o'zgarishlar yo'qoladi.

readings.qtype: Plans (now / after redevelopment) — to'liq javob (Jony Academy)
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna javobi (199 so'z); savol va rejalar — kitob, PDF bet 254 (Cambridge IELTS 16 asosida)
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: The plans below show the site of an airport now and how it will look after redevelopment next year. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.  |  KEY FEATURES (3 daqiqa): o'zgarmaydi — security / passport control, bino tuzilishi; qo'shiladi — bag drop, arrivals café, exchange, car hire, shops, sky train; ko'chadi — check-in, departures café; almashtiriladi — walkway → sky train; kattalashadi — 8 → 18 gates. P3: terminal binosi, P4: security'dan keyingi qism.
text: The plans illustrate the layout of an airport at present and the changes that will be made to it when it is redeveloped next year.

Overall, the redevelopment will greatly expand the gate area and add a much wider range of passenger facilities, while the basic structure of the terminal, including security and passport control, will stay the same.

At present, the terminal offers little beyond the essentials: departing passengers have a check-in counter and a single café, but the arrivals hall has no facilities at all. After the work, the check-in counter will be moved to the opposite side of the departures hall, a bag-drop point will be installed, and the café will be relocated closer to the entrance. Arriving travellers will be better catered for, with a café and a currency exchange, and a small car-hire office will be added as an extension to the arrivals hall.

The most significant change, however, will take place beyond security. Passengers currently walk along a walkway to reach just eight gates, but this will be replaced by a sky train serving a Y-shaped gate area with eighteen gates. In addition, shops will be built between passport control and the train.
glossary: departures / arrivals hall — jo'nash / kelish zali

the changes that will be made to it when it is redeveloped

Kirish eshiklari soni ikki baravar — minor detail, so'z chegarasi uchun tushirilgan

Guruhlash: terminal ichi va security'dan keyingi qism.
Joylashuv faqat key bo'lganda.
