homework_intro: Bugun map va plan vazifalarini yozishni o'rgandik: key features (qo'shildi, olib tashlandi, o'zgarmadi), passiv, zamonlar diapazoni, umbrella terms va aniq joylashuv. Uyda ikki xarita vazifasini yozasiz.

Birinchi vazifa — kitobning 109-betidagi universitet sport markazi rejalari uchun to'liq javob, 20 daqiqa (3 reja + 15 yozish + 2 tekshirish). Overview'da uch asosiy o'zgarish bo'lsin; kelajak passivi (will be + V3) kamida 5 marta; joylashuv faqat key bo'lganda.
Ikkinchi vazifa — kitobning 90-betidagi orol xaritalari uchun kirish + overview + bitta body paragraph (oldingi holat va nima saqlangan). Zamonlar: past simple va present perfect passive.
Uchinchi vazifa — STRONG va SUPER ro'yxatidan 8 so'z bilan o'zingiz yashaydigan mahalla yoki maktab haqida 8 ta passiv gap (masalan, "A new playground has been built next to the school.").

homework.title: To'liq javob: universitet sport markazi
homework.instr: 4 xatboshi, 170–200 so'z, 20 daqiqa. Overview raqamsiz, umbrella term bilan; kelajak passivi; P4 tartibi P3 ni takrorlaydi (mirror).
homework.answers: Tekshiruv: overview'da uch o'zgarish bormi — markaz kattaroq bo'ladi, inshootlar turi ko'payadi, ochiq kortlar yo'qoladi? Hovuz o'zgarmasligi aytilganmi? gym — lengthened, reception — widened kabi aniq fe'llar bormi? ortiqcha "is planned to be" (will be yetarli), "future plans", "on the east of" yo'qmi?

homework.title: Orol: kirish + overview + P3
homework.instr: 10 daqiqa. Past simple (oldin) va present perfect passive (nima saqlangan / qurilgan).
homework.answers: Namuna overview yo'nalishi: "Overall, the island has been developed for tourism, with accommodation in both its western and eastern halves, amenities in the centre and much better access, while the beach and most of the trees have been retained."

homework.title: 8 ta passiv gap — mahallangiz haqida
homework.instr: lengthen, widen, redevelop, renovate, demolish, convert into, make way for, remain intact — har biri bilan bitta gap.
homework.answers: Ustoz yordamchi fe'l (has been / will be) va aniq fe'l tanlovini tekshiradi.

kahoot.q: Which sentence is correct for a map task?
options: A restaurant has been built in the centre.
There has built a restaurant in the centre.
A restaurant has built in the centre.
They has built a restaurant in the centre.
kahoot.explain: Passiv: ega + has been + V3. "There has built" va yordamchi fe'lsiz shakl — xato.

kahoot.q: The plans show a sports centre now and after redevelopment. Which sentence about the second plan is correct, concise and natural?
options: The courts are intended being removed.
kahoot.explain: Reja uchun eng qisqa va tabiiy shakl — will be + V3. "will removed" — be tushib qolgan; "removed" — aktiv o'tmish; "are intended being" — noto'g'ri shakl. ("are planned to be removed" grammatik to'g'ri, lekin ortiqcha.)

kahoot.q: No dates are given. Which sentence best describes the change?
options: Most of the trees have been retained.
Most of the trees retain on the island.
Most of the trees are retaining.
Most of the trees had retained.
kahoot.explain: Sana yo'q — ikkinchi xarita "hozir": present perfect passive o'tmishni hozirga bog'laydi.

kahoot.q: An answer uses only the present simple (There is..., There are...). What is the main problem?
options: It is too formal for a Task 1 report
It uses far too many passive verb forms
kahoot.explain: Faqat present simple — rasmni tasvirlash. So'rang: nima o'zgardi, qo'shildi, olib tashlandi? Shunda zamonlar tabiiy xilma-xil bo'ladi.

kahoot.q: Which is the best overview for the sports centre plans?
options: The centre will be larger with more indoor facilities, but lose its courts.
A café and a shop will be added near the entrance.
The wonderful new centre will certainly attract far more students than before.
kahoot.explain: Aniq overview — barcha asosiy o'zgarishlar, tafsilotsiz. "A café and a shop ..." — detal; "wonderful ... attract" — shaxsiy baho; "will get bigger" — to'liq emas.

kahoot.q: Which linker is best for moving to the 'after' paragraph?
kahoot.explain: Firstly / Lastly — jarayon bosqichlari; On the contrary — noto'g'ri fikrni tuzatish. Map uchun: Prior to / Following.

kahoot.q: Where should you use compass points (north, east...)?
options: For large areas or whole sides of buildings
For every single building and room on the map
kahoot.explain: Kompas — katta hududlar va binoning butun bir tomoni uchun (the western side of the centre). Bino ichidagi kichik joylar uchun: at the front of, next to, opposite, behind.

kahoot.q: Which sentence gives location precisely?
options: The gym at the back of the building will be lengthened.
The gym will be enlarged eastward in the north of the building.
The gym will be in the neighbourhood of the studios.
The gym is to the left, on the left of the centre.
kahoot.explain: Bitta aniq joylashuv + aniq fe'l. "enlarged eastward" noaniq; "in the neighbourhood of" — norasmiy.

kahoot.q: 'Some changing rooms will be added next to the new pool.' Why is this location worth giving?
options: It links the rooms logically to the pool
Examiners count every location phrase you use
kahoot.explain: Joylashuv faqat mantiqiy sabab bo'lsa: kiyinish xonasi hovuz uchun kerak. Har detalga joy yozish takror va ro'yxat beradi.

kahoot.q: The task: plans of a university sports centre now and after redevelopment. Choose the best paraphrase of the question.
options: The plans illustrate the current layout of a sports centre and the proposed changes.
The maps illustrate the university sports centre and its future plans.
The maps illustrate the present scheme of the sports centre and its renovation plans.
The plans demonstrate the future plans of the university sports centre.
kahoot.explain: To'g'ri: show → illustrate, now → the current layout, after redevelopment → the proposed changes. "future plans" — ortiqcha (reja doim kelajak haqida); scheme / renovation — ma'noni o'zgartiradi.

kahoot.q: Which sentence avoids a personal comment?
options: A pier has been built on the south coast.
A beautiful new pier has been built on the coast.
Tourists will surely love the new pier.
An amazing pier makes the island better.
kahoot.explain: Xaritada faqat faktlar: beautiful, amazing, will love — shaxsiy baho, TA ni pasaytiradi.

kahoot.q: Walkway (now) → sky train (after). Which sentence is best?
options: The walkway will be replaced by a sky train.
The walkway will replace a sky train.
A sky train will be replaced the walkway.
The walkway will be replacing by a sky train.
kahoot.explain: X will be replaced by Y — eski narsa ega bo'ladi, yangisi "by" dan keyin.

kahoot.q: Reception, café and shops can be grouped under the umbrella term ___.
kahoot.explain: amenities — qulayliklar. vegetation — o'simliklar; access — yo'llar, pristan.

kahoot.q: The gym will be made longer. = The gym will be ___.
kahoot.explain: long → lengthen (uzaytirmoq). Xuddi shunday: wide → widen, deep → deepen, short → shorten.

kahoot.q: ___ development, the island was uninhabited.
kahoot.explain: Prior to = before (oldin). Following = after (keyin).

kahoot.q: The café will be ___ closer to the entrance.
kahoot.explain: relocate — boshqa joyga ko'chirish. retain — saqlash; renovate — yangilash; remove — olib tashlash.

kahoot.q: The courts will be removed to ___ way for a sports hall.
kahoot.explain: make way for — ... uchun joy bo'shatmoq. "way" bilan bu ma'noda faqat make keladi.

kahoot.q: Old buildings in the town centre were replaced with new ones. The area was ___.
kahoot.explain: redevelop — eski binolarni almashtirib qayta qurish. develop — tabiiy joyga qurish; renovate — binoni yangilash.

kahoot.q: The eastern tip of the island has been left in its natural ___.
kahoot.explain: in its natural state — tabiiy holatida (o'zgarmagan).

kahoot.q: Arriving passengers will be better ___ for, with a café and an exchange.
kahoot.explain: be catered for — ehtiyojlari qondiriladi. "better catered for" — foydalanuvchi nuqtai nazaridagi ibora; served up / dealt / looked "for" bilan bu ma'noni bermaydi.

lessons.title: Writing Task 1 (7): Process — bosqichlar, passiv va ketma-ketlik
lessons.grammar_topic: Process (jarayon) diagrammasi: step va stage farqi, umbrella term bilan overview, -ing yorliqdan passivga, to + infinitive, relative clause, once/after + present perfect, zig-zag bog'lanish
lessons.vocab_topic: Jarayon tili: vaqt (last, take, spend), o'zgarish (turn into, develop into), harakat (move to, flow along), ishlab chiqarish fe'llari (extract, filter, heat, cool)
lessons.book_ref: Pauline Cullen, The Key to IELTS Success — Writing Task 1: Lesson 9 (Process Tasks 1, PDF 124–147), Lesson 10 (Process Tasks 2, PDF 148–163), Lesson 16 (Reviewing Process Tasks, PDF 235–247).
objectives: Process diagrammasida trend emas, BOSQICH borligini tushunish: step (bitta qadam) va stage (bir nechta qadamdan iborat katta bosqich) farqini bilish.
To'liq overview yozish: jarayon turi (tabiiy / mexanik), qadamlar soni, 2–3 asosiy bosqich umbrella term bilan, umumiy vaqt yoki joy — tafsilotsiz.
Diagrammadagi -ing yorliqlarni to'g'ri passiv gapga aylantirish va passivda ishlatib bo'lmaydigan fe'llarni (fall, become, appear) ajratish.
Bir xil tuzilmani takrorlamaslik: to + infinitive (maqsad), which / -ing bilan natija, once / after + present perfect passive.
First... Then... Next... shablonidan qochib, zig-zag bog'lanish va marker o'rnini o'zgartirish bilan Band 7+ coherence ko'rsatish.
Texnik diagrammada notanish so'zni tasvirlash (noun + 1–2 sifat + nima qiladi) va qisqa javobni 170+ so'zgacha asosli kengaytirish.
materials: Kitob sahifalari (Reading bo'limidagi ikki rasm): Lesson 9 — jarayon tili, zig-zag, marker o'rni; Lesson 10 — stage/step, umbrella term, passiv, takrordan qochish.
Jony Academy diagrammasi "How coffee beans are grown and prepared for sale" — ekranda yoki chop etilgan.
Namuna javob (198 so'z) — har o'quvchiga chop etilgan; ikki rangli marker (passiv — ko'k, bog'lovchi / referencing — qizil).
Doskada ikki ustun: STEP (qadam) | STAGE (bosqich); pastida "-ing → passive" jadvali.
Uy vazifasi uchun ipak qurti diagrammasi (Reading bo'limida) va taymer (20 daqiqa).
timeline: Kirish
Savol: "Grafikda trend bor. Jarayonda-chi?" Coffee diagrammasini 60 soniya ko'rish; o'quvchilar qadamlar sonini va nechta katta bosqich borligini aytadi.
Step va stage, overview (Lesson 10)
Kitob sahifalari 150–153: trend va stage farqi, umbrella term; qahva uchun overview juftlikda yoziladi (2-mashq).
Jarayon grammatikasi
-ing → passiv, intransitive fe'llar; to + infinitive; which / -ing; once / after + present perfect (1- va 3-mashq).
Jarayon lug'ati (Lesson 9)
Vaqt, bosqich, o'zgarish, harakat fe'llari va predloglari; juda kuchli sifatlardan qochish (4-mashq).
Coherence: zig-zag va marker o'rni
Kitob sahifalari 131, 135: First/Then/Next shabloni nega Band 6; gaplarni tartiblash (5-mashq).
Namuna javob tahlili
Coffee namunasi o'qiladi; passiv va bog'lanishlar belgilanadi; stage bo'yicha xatboshilar muhokama qilinadi.
Amaliyot: qisqa javobni yaxshilash
Ustoz 140 so'zli zaif javobni o'qiydi (3-reading, 2-vazifa: 5 qismli zaif javob va kalit); o'quvchilar uni 4 usul bilan kengaytiradi va juftlikda solishtiradi.
Xulosa va vazifa
Uyga: ipak qurti diagrammasi bo'yicha to'liq javob, 20 daqiqa; o'z-o'zini tekshirish ro'yxati.

intro: Process diagrammasida trend (o'sish/kamayish) yo'q — bosqichlar bor. Shuning uchun overview'da "jarayon A dan boshlanib B bilan tugaydi" deb yozish yetarli emas: bu faqat birinchi va oxirgi qadam, o'rtada nima bo'lgani ko'rinmaydi. Kitob muallifi Cambridge 16 dagi aynan shunday Band 6 overview'ni misol qiladi.

STEP — diagrammadagi bitta raqamlangan qadam (crushing, filtering). STAGE — kengroq tushuncha: bir nechta qadam birgalikda bitta bosqichni tashkil qiladi. Overview uchun qadamlarni 2–3 stage ga guruhlang va ularni UMBRELLA TERM (umumlashtiruvchi so'z) bilan nomlang: farming / processing, below ground / above ground, in the river / at sea.

Stage chegarasini topish usuli: mahsulot yoki jonzot SHAKLINI qachon o'zgartiradi? (o'simlik → sharbat → sirop → shakar; tuxum → lichinka → kapalak). Joy o'zgarishi (daryo → dengiz, dala → zavod) ham yaxshi chegara.

To'liq overview'da 3–4 narsa bo'ladi: jarayon turi (natural / man-made, largely mechanical), qadamlar soni va 2–3 asosiy stage, mahsulotdagi asosiy o'zgarish, kerak bo'lsa umumiy vaqt yoki joylar. Tekshiruv: overview'dagi ma'lumotni keyin body'da takrorlashga to'g'ri kelsa — u juda batafsil.

Diagramma yorliqlari odatda -ing shaklida (growing, harvesting, purifying). Ularni ko'chirmang — gapga aylantiring, ko'pincha PASSIV bilan: Harvesting → The crop is harvested. Lekin to'ldiruvchi olmaydigan (intransitive) fe'llar passivda bo'lmaydi: fall, appear, arrive, become, disappear, go. "The apples are fallen" — xato; "The apples are dropped into a bucket" — to'g'ri.

Bir xil "is + V3" tuzilmasini takrorlamaslik uchun 4 vosita: 1) maqsad — to + infinitive (The plants are crushed to extract the juice); 2) natija — which (..., which extracts the juice) yoki -ing (..., extracting the juice); 3) allow (..., allowing the juice to be extracted); 4) once / after / when + present perfect (passive): Once the crop has been harvested, it is taken to a factory. Once/after/when dan keyin WILL qo'yilmaydi.

Tabiiy jarayon (hayot sikli) tili: vaqt — last (bosqich davom etadi), take (biror ishga vaqt ketadi), spend (jonzot biror joyda vaqt o'tkazadi); o'zgarish — turn into, develop into, grow into, hatch into (evolve emas: u millionlab yillik moslashuv; transform — butunlay yangi narsaga aylanish); bosqich so'zlari — during / in this phase (period), at / during this stage ("at this phase" — noto'g'ri). Sifatlar aniq bo'lsin: "enormous, gigantic, unique" diagrammada ko'rinmasa — xato.

COHERENCE: First, ... Then, ... Next, ... Finally, ... shabloni Band 6 belgisi — examiner izohiga ko'ra, markerlar yetarli, lekin ularning gapdagi o'rnini o'zgartirish yuqoriroq ball berishi mumkin. Band 7+ uchun ZIG-ZAG: bir gap oxiridagi yangi ma'lumot keyingi gapning boshiga mavzu bo'lib o'tadi (... called fry. The fry then move ...). Har xatboshining birinchi gapi uning stage'ini aytadi (The first stage... / At the factory, ...).

Texnik diagramma — qo'rqish emas, moslashuvchanlikni ko'rsatish imkoniyati. Noun → verb: condenser → is condensed ("condensered" — Band 6 xatosi), generator → generates, grinder → is ground. Nomini bilmagan narsani tasvirlang: noun + 1–2 sifat + nima qiladi (a tall metal tower that distributes electricity). Hech bir qadamni tushirib qoldirmang va 150 so'zdan kam bo'lsa — solishtirish, joy va o'zgarishlarni kengaytiring.
formulas: Overall, + turi + qadamlar soni + 2–3 stage (umbrella term) + asosiy o'zgarish
"Overall, the eight-step process falls into two main stages: growing the beans on the farm and processing them in a factory."
Faqat birinchi va oxirgi qadam; raqamlar va vaqtlar
yorliq → subject + is/are + V3 (+ by / in / using ...)
Pulping → The skin and fruit are removed by a pulping machine.
V3 + to + infinitive | , which + fe'l | , + V-ing | , allowing sth to be V3
"The juice is heated, turning it into a syrup."
Once + sth + has/have been V3, + it is / can be V3
"Once the cherries have been picked, they are pulped."
"Once the crop will be harvested" — will yo'q
turn / develop / grow / hatch + INTO; last FOR; spend + vaqt + IN/AT
"The larva develops into a moth." "This stage lasts for two weeks."
gap oxiridagi yangi ma'lumot → keyingi gapning subject'i
"... leaving green beans. These beans are then soaked ..."
Har gap First / Next / Then bilan boshlanadi
presentation: Process'da trend bo'lmasa, overview'ga nima yozaman?
Jarayon turi, qadamlar soni, 2–3 asosiy stage (umumlashtiruvchi so'z bilan) va mahsulot qanday o'zgarishi. Vaqt yoki joy muhim bo'lsa — ular ham.
Hamma qadamni yozishim shartmi?
Ha. Process'da har bir qadam — key feature. Grafikdan farqli, bu yerda "tanlab qoldirish" yo'q, faqat tafsilot darajasini tanlaysiz.
Diagrammadagi so'zlarni ishlatsam bo'ladimi?
Texnik nomlarni (centrifuge, limestone filter) ishlatasiz, lekin -ing yorliqlarni gapga aylantirasiz va savoldagi iboralarni ko'chirmaysiz.
Jarayonda solishtirish kerakmi?
"Where relevant" — process'da bu ayniqsa muhim: eng uzun bosqich, ikki xil usul (hand / machine), hajm yoki rang o'zgarishi, tez / sekin joylar.
First, Then, Next ishlatish xatomi?
Xato emas, lekin har gapning boshida kelsa — Band 6 shabloni. Ba'zan gap o'rtasiga qo'ying (The fry then move...), ba'zan once/after bilan, ba'zan zig-zag bilan bog'lang.
Javobim 140 so'z chiqdi. Nima qilaman?
Birinchidan, qoldirilgan qadam bormi — tekshiring. Keyin: overview'ni to'liqroq qiling, har qadamga joy/vaqt/maqsad qo'shing, solishtirish qo'shing. Ortiqcha so'z emas — ortiqcha MA'LUMOT kerak.
notes: Kitobdagi misollar (losos baliq, shakar, geotermal energiya, Monarch kapalagi) Cambridge testlaridan olingan; sahifalar faqat ko'rsatish uchun. Namuna javob va diagramma — Jony Academy, ma'lumotlar mashq uchun to'qilgan.
Oldingi darslardagi "trend tili" (rose, fell) process'da ishlatilmaydi — o'quvchilar buni aralashtirib yuborishsa, darhol to'xtatib, STEP/STAGE ustuniga qayting.
Namuna javobni o'qishda passiv gaplarni ko'k, zig-zag bog'lanishni qizil bilan belgilatish — Band 7 coherence qanday ko'rinishini o'quvchilarga eng tez ko'rsatadi.
mistakes: "The process starts with growing and ends with packing." (overview)
"... falls into two main stages: farming and factory processing"
Faqat birinchi va oxirgi qadam — o'rtasi ko'rinmaydi; stage'lar nomlanmagan
"The apples are fallen into a bucket."
"The apples fall / are dropped into a bucket."
"Once the juice will be filtered, it is heated."
"Once the juice has been filtered, it is heated."
once / after / when dan keyin will emas, present perfect
"The fry changes to a smolt." / "This stage lasts to six months."
O'zgarish fe'llari INTO, davomiylik FOR bilan

how: CORE — har qanday process javobida keladigan fe'llar va so'zlar; STRONG — bosqichni aniq tasvirlash; SUPER — overview va Band 7+ bog'lanish iboralari.
Har so'z bilan coffee yoki ipak qurti diagrammasi haqida bitta gap tuzing; fe'llarni passiv yoki once + present perfect bilan ishlating.
Takror so'z: remove (23-dars) — yangi so'z sifatida sanalmaydi; bugun uni extract bilan farqlang: remove — keraksizini olib tashlash, extract — keraklisini ajratib olish.
core: The process falls into two main stages.
The final step is packing the powder into bags.
The second stage consists of three steps.
The process involves drying the beans in the sun.
Jarayon donlarni quyoshda quritishni o'z ichiga oladi.
The pupa stage lasts for about two weeks.
G'umbak bosqichi taxminan ikki hafta davom etadi.
The larva turns into a moth.
The juice is extracted from the crushed cane.
The skin is removed by a machine.
strong: The cherries can be picked manually.
Picking by hand is far more labour-intensive.
Qo'lda terish ancha ko'p mehnat talab qiladi.
The eggs hatch after ten to fourteen days.
Tuxumlardan o'n-o'n to'rt kunda qurtlar chiqadi.
An adult moth emerges from the cocoon.
The raw material is the coffee cherry.
super: The process falls into two main stages.
Coffee production is a largely mechanical process once the beans reach the factory.
Donlar zavodga yetgach, qahva ishlab chiqarish asosan mexanik jarayon.
Once the beans have been dried, they are roasted.
The cane is crushed, allowing the juice to be extracted.
Qamish eziladi va bu sharbatni ajratib olish imkonini beradi.

class_ex.title: 1-mashq: -ing yorliqdan gapga (passiv yoki aktiv)
class_ex.instr: Diagramma yorlig'ini to'liq gapga aylantiring. Fe'l passivda bo'la olmasa — aktivda yozing yoki boshqa fe'l tanlang.
items: Growing (coffee trees, 3–4 years)
Picking (by hand or by machine)
Falling (leaves → onto the ground)
Soaking (beans, water tanks)
Becoming (larva → moth)
Spinning (the syrup, in a centrifuge)
Grinding (roasted beans → powder)
Appearing (small cracks on the eggs)
answers: Coffee trees are grown for three to four years before the first harvest.
The cherries are picked either by hand or by machine.
The leaves fall onto the ground. (passiv emas!)
The beans are soaked in water tanks.
The larva becomes / develops into a moth. (passiv emas!)
The syrup is spun in a centrifuge.
The roasted beans are ground into a powder.
Small cracks appear on the eggs. (passiv emas!)
why: grow (o'stirmoq) — transitive, passiv mumkin.
either ... or — ikki usulni solishtirish uchun qulay.
fall — intransitive; o'rniga "are dropped" yoki aktiv "fall".
soak — transitive; joy "in" bilan.
become — intransitive; "is become" yo'q.
spin — spun (noto'g'ri fe'l): spin–spun–spun.
grind — ground (noto'g'ri fe'l): grind–ground–ground.
appear — intransitive; passivda bo'lmaydi.

class_ex.title: 2-mashq: Qaysi overview eng yaxshi?
class_ex.instr: Coffee diagrammasi uchun overview variantlarini o'qing. Eng to'liq va tafsilotsiz variantni tanlang va boshqalarning kamchiligini ayting.
items: A) Overall, the process begins with growing coffee trees and ends with packing the coffee.
B) Overall, coffee trees grow for 3–4 years, then cherries are picked, pulped, soaked for 24–36 hours and dried for 10–14 days.
C) Overall, the eight-step process falls into two main stages — preparing the beans on the farm and processing them in a factory — during which green beans become a brown powder.
D) Overall, coffee production is a complex and fascinating process that takes a long time.
why: Faqat birinchi va oxirgi qadam — trend kabi yozilgan; o'rtadagi stage'lar ko'rinmaydi.
Bu body'dagi ma'lumot; keyin takrorlashga to'g'ri keladi — overview emas, ro'yxat.
Qadamlar soni + 2 stage (umbrella term) + asosiy o'zgarish (green → brown powder).
"fascinating" — fikr; "a long time" — noaniq. Hech qanday asosiy xususiyat yo'q.

class_ex.title: 3-mashq: Takrorni yo'qotish — bir gapni besh xil yozish
class_ex.instr: Asosiy gap: "The beans are roasted. Then they turn brown." Uni ko'rsatilgan tuzilma bilan qayta yozing.
items: to + infinitive (maqsad)
, which ... (natija)
, + V-ing (natija)
once + present perfect passive
allowing ... to ...
answers: The beans are roasted to turn them brown.
The beans are roasted, which turns them brown.
The beans are roasted, turning them from green to brown.
Once the beans have been roasted, they turn brown.
The beans are roasted, allowing their colour to change from green to brown.
why: Nima uchun qilinadi — maqsad.
which butun oldingi gapga ishora qiladi (vergul bilan).
Reduced relative clause — qisqaroq va Band 7 uchun yaxshi.

once dan keyin will emas; tartibni ko'rsatadi, First/Then kerak emas. To'liq javobda once odatda diagrammadagi ikki qadamni bog'laydi; rangni saqlab, keyingi qadamni qo'shsak: "Once the beans have been roasted until brown, they are ground."

allow + ob'ekt + to-infinitive — "imkon bermoq". Passiv infinitive ham bo'ladi: "..., allowing the juice to be extracted". Ma'no asl gapdan chiqmasin: "allowing them to be ground" — rang o'zgarishi yo'qoladi, yangi qadam qo'shiladi.

class_ex.title: 4-mashq: Predlog va aniq so'z
class_ex.instr: Xatoni toping va tuzating (kitob Lesson 9 dagi xato turlari asosida, o'z misollarimiz).
items: This stage lasts to two weeks.
The larva develops in a moth.
At this phase, the silkworm grows much bigger.
The silkworm evolves into a moth.
The gigantic larva spins a cocoon.
Once the cocoons will be collected, they are boiled.
answers: The fully grown larva spins a cocoon.
Once the cocoons have been collected, ...
why: last + FOR (davomiylik).
O'zgarish fe'llari INTO bilan.
phase va period bilan during yoki in ishlatiladi; "at this phase" — noto'g'ri. stage va time bilan at ham, during ham mumkin.
evolve — tur millionlab yil davomida moslashadi; hayot siklida emas.
8 sm — "gigantic" emas; sifat diagrammadagi ma'lumotga mos bo'lsin.
once dan keyin will emas — present perfect passive.

class_ex.title: 5-mashq: Zig-zag — gaplarni tartiblang
class_ex.instr: Ipak qurti hayot sikli haqidagi gaplar aralashtirilgan. Referencing (it, these, this stage) va zig-zag bo'yicha to'g'ri tartibni tiklang.
items: These silkworms feed on mulberry leaves for 25 to 30 days, growing from 3 millimetres to around 8 centimetres.
The cycle begins when a female moth lays her eggs on mulberry leaves.
Once it is fully grown, each larva spins a cocoon from a single thread.
After ten to fourteen days, the eggs hatch into tiny larvae known as silkworms.
Inside this cocoon, the larva changes into a pupa, a stage that lasts for up to two weeks.
why: "These silkworms" — oldingi gapning oxiridagi "silkworms" ga ishora.
Boshlanish — hech narsaga ishora yo'q, yangi mavzu.

"it" — shu gapdagi "each larva" ga oldindan ishora qiladi (oldingi gapda esa ko'plik — silkworms); gapning o'zi to'g'ri. "fully grown" — o'sishdan keyin, shuning uchun bu gap o'sish haqidagi gapdan keyin keladi.
"the eggs" — birinchi gapning oxiridagi "eggs".
"this cocoon" — oldingi gap oxiridagi "a cocoon" — zig-zag.
class_ex.note: To'g'ri tartib: 2 → 4 → 1 → 3 → 5. Har gapning oxiridagi yangi ma'lumot keyingi gapning boshiga o'tishini chiziq bilan ko'rsating.

readings.title: Kitob: Lesson 10 — stage va step, overview, passiv, takrordan qochish

readings.title: NAMUNA JAVOB — coffee process
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna javobi (198 so'z; diagramma ma'lumotlari mashq uchun to'qilgan)
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: The diagram below shows how coffee beans are grown and prepared for sale. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.  |  REJA (2 daqiqa): turi — tabiiy + mexanik; 8 qadam; STAGE 1 farm (1–5), STAGE 2 factory (6–8); o'zgarish: cherry → green bean → brown powder; solishtirish: eng uzun bosqich, hand vs machine.
text: The diagram illustrates how coffee is produced, from the cultivation of coffee trees to the packaging of the finished product.

Overall, the eight-step process falls into two main stages: the growing and preparation of the beans on the farm, and their processing in a factory, where they are turned into a brown powder ready for sale.

The first stage is by far the longest, as coffee trees need three to four years before the first harvest. Once the red 'cherries' have ripened, they are picked either by hand, which allows only the ripe fruit to be selected, or by machine, a much faster method. A pulping machine then removes the skin and flesh, leaving green beans, which are soaked in water tanks for 24 to 36 hours. After fermentation, the beans are dried in the sun for up to two weeks, reducing their moisture from 60% to just 11%.

The factory stage is much shorter and involves only three steps. The dried beans are roasted at 200°C for 15 to 20 minutes, turning them from green to brown. In the final two steps, they are ground into a powder and sealed in airtight bags for delivery to shops.
glossary: pulp — mevaning eti; pulping — etini ajratish
paraphrases: how coffee beans are grown and prepared for sale
how coffee is produced, from the cultivation ... to the packaging
Growing / Picking / Pulping
need three to four years / are picked / a pulping machine removes
Drying — moisture 60% → 11%
are dried ..., reducing their moisture from 60% to just 11%
Roasting — green → brown
are roasted ..., turning them from green to brown

tasks.title: Namunani kitob g'oyalari bilan tekshiring
tasks.type: Og'zaki, marker bilan
tasks.instr: Passiv gaplarni ko'k, bog'lanish vositalarini qizil bilan belgilang va savollarga javob bering.
items: Overview'da qaysi umbrella term'lar bor?
Qaysi uch joyda solishtirish qilingan?
Maqsad yoki natijani ko'rsatadigan -ing / which tuzilmalarini toping.
Zig-zag misolini toping (gap oxiri → keyingi gap boshi).
Nechta gap First / Next / Then bilan boshlanadi?
Nega xatboshilar 1–5 va 6–8 qadamlar bo'yicha bo'lingan?
answers: on the farm / in a factory; growing and preparation / processing
"by far the longest" (1-bosqich) va "a much faster method" (qo'lda / mashina); "much shorter" (zavod)
"which allows only the ripe fruit to be selected", "leaving green beans", "reducing their moisture", "turning them from green to brown"
"... leaving green beans, which are soaked ..." va "... the dried beans are roasted"
Hech biri; "then" bir marta gap o'rtasida
Joy va mahsulot o'zgarishi: dala (yashil don) → zavod (jigarrang kukun)
why: Stage'larni nomlash — to'liq overview talabi.
Process'da ham "make comparisons where relevant" bajariladi.
Bir xil "is + V3" takrorlanmaydi — Grammatical Range.
Referencing orqali bog'lanish — Band 7 coherence.
Marker o'rnini o'zgartirish — Band 6 shablonidan qochish.
Xatboshi = stage; overview va body bir-biriga mos.

tasks.title: Qisqa javobni yaxshilang (140 so'zli zaif versiya)
tasks.type: Juftlikda, yozma
tasks.instr: Ustoz quyidagi zaif javobni to'liq o'qiydi: 5 qism — bitta javob, jami 138 so'z (150 dan kam). Juftlikda har qismga 4 usuldan qaysi biri kerakligini ayting: 1) stage'li overview; 2) vaqt / joy / raqam qo'shish; 3) solishtirish; 4) -ing / which / once bilan bog'lash. Keyin har qismni yaxshilab yozing — javob 170+ so'zga yetsin.
items: "The diagram shows how coffee is made and prepared for sale. Overall, the process has eight steps. It starts with growing coffee trees and ends with packing the coffee."
"First, coffee trees are grown on a farm. They need a long time to grow. Then the cherries are picked. They are picked by hand or by machine."
"Next, the cherries are pulped by a machine. Then the green beans are soaked in water tanks for some time. After that, the beans are dried in the sun and their moisture goes down."
"Then the beans are taken to a factory. There they are roasted at 200°C and they turn brown."
"Next, the beans are ground. Finally, the coffee is put into bags and it is sent to shops. In conclusion, making coffee is a long process with many steps."
answers: 1-usul (stage'li overview): "Overall, the eight-step process falls into two main stages — growing and preparing the beans on the farm, and processing them in a factory — during which green beans are turned into a brown powder." Kirish gapidagi "prepared for sale" savoldan ko'chirilgan — paraphrase qiling: "The diagram illustrates how coffee is produced, from the cultivation of coffee trees to the packaging of the finished product."

2- va 3-usul (vaqt, solishtirish): "Coffee trees need three to four years before the first harvest, so this is by far the longest step. The ripe cherries are then picked either by hand, which is more selective, or by machine, a much faster method."

4- va 2-usul (-ing / which, raqamlar): "A pulping machine removes the skin and fruit, leaving green beans, which are soaked in water tanks for 24 to 36 hours. The beans are then spread out in the sun for 10 to 14 days, reducing their moisture from 60% to 11%."

3-, 2- va 4-usul (solishtirish, vaqt, -ing) + yangi stage'ni nomlovchi birinchi gap: "The factory stage is much shorter and involves only three steps. The dried beans are roasted at 200°C for 15 to 20 minutes, turning them from green to brown."
4-usul (once) + aniq tafsilot (into a powder, airtight): "Once the beans have been ground into a powder, they are sealed in airtight bags and sent to shops." "In conclusion ..." gapi olib tashlanadi.
why: Faqat birinchi va oxirgi qadam — o'rtadagi stage'lar va asosiy o'zgarish (green beans → brown powder) yo'q: overview to'liq emas (TA). Kirish gapi savol iborasini ko'chiradi (LR).
"a long time" — noaniq; vaqt (3–4 years) va hand / machine farqi — key feature. "are picked" ikki marta takrorlangan.
Har gap "are + V3" va Then / After that bilan — mexanik (CC). 24–36 hours, 10–14 days, 60% → 11% tushib qolgan; "for some time" — noaniq.
Yangi stage yangi xatboshida o'z nomi bilan boshlanadi; zavod bosqichining qisqaligi — process'dagi solishtirish. Qovurish vaqti (15–20 minutes) tushib qolgan; "and they turn brown" → -ing natija.
Kitob: javob qisqa chiqishining sababi — qadamlar juda qisqa tasvirlangan. "and it is" takrori o'rniga once; Task 1 da xulosa shart emas, "a long process" — fikr va noaniq.

readings.title: UY VAZIFASI SAVOLI — ipak qurti hayot sikli
readings.source: Jony Academy diagrammasi (ma'lumotlar mashq uchun soddalashtirilgan, taxminiy)
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: The diagram below shows the life cycle of the silkworm and the stages in the production of silk. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

homework_intro: Bugun process diagrammasida trend emas, bosqich borligini, overview'ni stage va umbrella term bilan yozishni, -ing yorliqlarni passivga aylantirishni va takrordan qochishni o'rgandik.

Birinchi vazifa — ipak qurti diagrammasi (Reading bo'limidagi oxirgi rasm) bo'yicha to'liq javob, 20 daqiqa: 2 daqiqa reja (turi, qadamlar soni, 2 stage, asosiy o'zgarish), 15 daqiqa yozish, 3 daqiqa tekshirish. 170–200 so'z.

Ikkinchi vazifa — javobingizni ro'yxat bo'yicha tekshiring: overview'da stage'lar bormi? hech bir qadam tushib qolmadimi? kamida bitta solishtirish bormi? 3 tadan ortiq gap First/Then/Next bilan boshlanmaganmi? passivda intransitive fe'l yo'qmi?

Uchinchi vazifa — shakar jarayonining 7 qadami asosida (qadamlar 3-vazifa shartida yozilgan; kitobning Lesson 10 sahifalarida shu jarayon tahlil qilinadi) 5 ta gap: har birida boshqa tuzilma (passiv, to + infinitive, which, -ing, once + present perfect passive).

homework.title: To'liq javob: silkworm life cycle
homework.instr: Reja + 4 xatboshi, 170–200 so'z, 20 daqiqa. Overview ikkinchi xatboshida, stage'lar umbrella term bilan.
homework.answers: Namuna overview: "Overall, the diagram shows a natural five-stage cycle, in which the insect changes from an egg into a moth within roughly two months, and a separate man-made process in which cocoons are collected and turned into silk." Guruhlash: P3 — tuxum va qurt bosqichi (o'sish, 3 mm → 8 cm); P4 — pilla, g'umbak, kapalak + fermadagi ipak jarayoni.

homework.title: O'z-o'zini tekshirish ro'yxati
homework.instr: Javob ostiga 5 savolga "ha / yo'q" va dalil (gapdan misol) yozing.
homework.answers: Kalit — "ha" uchun dalil: 1) overview'da 2 stage nomlangan, masalan: "a natural life cycle" va "a man-made process of silk production"; 2) hech bir qadam tushmagan: 5 bosqich (egg, larva, cocoon, pupa, moth) va fermadagi 4 qadam (collecting, boiling, unwinding, fabric); 3) kamida bitta solishtirish: "The larval stage is the longest (25–30 days), while spinning the cocoon takes only two to three days."; 4) First / Then / Next bilan boshlangan gaplar 3 tadan ko'p emas; 5) passivda intransitive fe'l yo'q: "a moth emerges", "the larva develops into a pupa" ("is emerged", "is developed into" emas). Ustoz tekshirganda overview va intransitive fe'llarga alohida e'tibor beradi.

homework.title: 5 ta gap — 5 xil tuzilma (shakar jarayoni)
homework.instr: Shakar jarayoni qadamlari: 1) growing — shakarqamish o'stiriladi; 2) harvesting — qo'lda yoki mashinada yig'iladi; 3) crushing — qamish eziladi va sharbat ajratib olinadi; 4) purifying — sharbat ohaktosh filtri (limestone filter) orqali tozalanadi; 5) evaporating — sharbat isitiladi va siropga aylanadi; 6) separating — centrifuge shakar kristallarini siropdan ajratadi; 7) drying and cooling — kristallar quritiladi va sovutiladi, tayyor shakar olinadi. Shu qadamlar bo'yicha 5 ta gap yozing, har birida boshqa tuzilma: passiv | to + infinitive | , which ... | , + V-ing | once + present perfect passive.
homework.answers: Namuna (jarayon tartibida): passiv — "The sugar cane is grown and then harvested either by hand or by machine." / once + present perfect passive — "Once the cane has been harvested, it is crushed to extract the juice." / to + infinitive — "The juice is passed through a limestone filter to purify it." / , + V-ing — "The juice is then heated, turning it into a syrup." / , which — "The syrup is spun in a centrifuge, which separates the sugar crystals from the remaining liquid."

normativ: overview'da stage'lar, barcha qadamlar, 1+ solishtirish, 170+ so'z
har gap to'g'ri va har xil tuzilmada

kahoot.q: Process diagrammasida overview uchun nima eng muhim?
options: Asosiy stage'lar va mahsulot qanday o'zgarishi
Diagrammadagi eng katta raqam va uning o'lchov birligi
kahoot.explain: Process'da trend yo'q: qadamlarni 2–3 stage ga guruhlang va asosiy o'zgarishni ayting. Faqat boshi va oxiri — to'liq emas.

kahoot.q: Step va stage farqi qaysi javobda to'g'ri?
options: Stage bir nechta step'dan iborat bo'lishi mumkin
Stage faqat tabiiy jarayonda, step esa faqat zavodda bo'ladi
kahoot.explain: Step — bitta raqamlangan qadam; stage — kengroq bosqich. Overview'da stage'lar umbrella term bilan nomlanadi.

kahoot.q: "Harvesting" yorlig'ini gapga to'g'ri aylantiring.
kahoot.explain: Yorliq -ing shaklida; body'da uni passiv gapga aylantiramiz: subject + is/are + V3.

kahoot.q: Qaysi gap XATO?
options: The apples are fallen into a bucket.
The apples fall into a bucket.
The apples are dropped into a bucket.
kahoot.explain: fall — intransitive (to'ldiruvchi olmaydi), shuning uchun passivda bo'lmaydi. O'rniga drop ishlatiladi.

kahoot.q: Qaysi fe'lni passivda ishlatib BO'LMAYDI?
kahoot.explain: become, appear, arrive, go, disappear — intransitive; "is become" degan shakl yo'q.

kahoot.q: To'g'ri variantni tanlang: "Once the juice ___, it is heated."
kahoot.explain: once / after / when dan keyin will ishlatilmaydi; tartibni present perfect (passive) ko'rsatadi.

kahoot.q: Qaysi gap maqsadni to + infinitive bilan ko'rsatadi?
options: The plants are crushed to extract the juice.
The plants are crushed, and then the juice is extracted.
The plants are crushing to juice.
kahoot.explain: to + infinitive — nima uchun qilinishini ko'rsatadi va passiv takrorini kamaytiradi.

kahoot.q: "The juice is heated. It turns into a syrup." — eng yaxshi birlashtirish?
options: The juice is heated, turning it into a syrup.
The juice is heated, it turns into a syrup.
The juice is heated, which it turns into a syrup.
kahoot.explain: Vergul + V-ing natijani bildiradi. "..., it turns into a syrup" — comma splice (ikki gap faqat vergul bilan); "which it turns" — which dan keyin it ortiqcha.

kahoot.q: Qaysi overview eng to'liq?
options: Eight steps in two stages: farm, then factory; green beans become powder
It starts with trees and ends with bags
Trees grow for 3–4 years, the beans soak for 24–36 hours and dry for 10–14 days
It is a long and interesting process
kahoot.explain: Qadamlar soni + stage'lar + asosiy o'zgarish. Raqamlar body'ga, fikr esa Task 1 ga umuman kerak emas.

kahoot.q: Band 7+ coherence uchun kitob nimani tavsiya qiladi?
options: Marker o'rnini o'zgartirish va zig-zag bog'lanish
Bog'lovchilarni umuman ishlatmay, faqat qisqa gaplar yozish
kahoot.explain: Mexanik First/Then/Next — Band 6 belgisi. Zig-zag: gap oxiridagi yangi ma'lumot keyingi gapning boshiga o'tadi.

kahoot.q: Qaysi predlog to'g'ri: "___ this phase, the fish grows much bigger."
kahoot.explain: phase va period bilan during yoki in ishlatiladi (In this phase ham to'g'ri); "at this phase" — noto'g'ri. stage va time bilan at ham, during ham mumkin. "In the this" — ikki aniqlovchi ketma-ket.

kahoot.q: Diagrammadagi "condenser" so'zidan to'g'ri gap qaysi?
kahoot.explain: Noun'dan -er qo'shimchasini olib tashlab fe'l hosil qilinadi: condenser → condense. "condensered" — Band 6 xatosi.

kahoot.q: "The cycle ___ five stages." — to'g'ri fe'l?
kahoot.explain: comprise to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ot bilan; consist esa OF bilan: consists of five stages. "involves of" — xato.

kahoot.q: "The pupa stage ___ for about two weeks."
kahoot.explain: last for — bosqich davom etadi. spend — jonzot vaqt o'tkazadi: The larva spends a month on the leaves.

kahoot.q: "The larva ___ a moth." — to'g'risini tanlang.
kahoot.explain: develop / turn / grow into. evolve — tur millionlab yil davomida o'zgaradi, hayot siklida ishlatilmaydi.

kahoot.q: Keraksiz qismni olib tashlash: "The skin is ___ by a machine."
kahoot.explain: remove — keraksizini olib tashlash; extract — keraklisini ajratib olish (juice is extracted).

kahoot.q: "Picking by hand is far more ___ than using machines."
kahoot.explain: labour-intensive — ko'p mehnat talab qiladigan; qo'lda va mashina usulini solishtirishda qulay.

kahoot.q: "After ten days, the eggs ___ and tiny larvae appear."
kahoot.explain: hatch — tuxumdan chiqmoq. emerge — biror narsa ichidan chiqib kelmoq: a moth emerges from the cocoon.

kahoot.q: "The beans are ___ roasted and ground." — "keyinchalik" ma'nosidagi so'z?
kahoot.explain: subsequently — so'ngra; Then/Next o'rniga gap ichida ishlatib, marker o'rnini o'zgartirish mumkin.

kahoot.q: "Coffee production is a ___ process in the factory." — mashinalar bilan bajariladi.
kahoot.explain: Overview'da jarayon turini aytish foydali: natural / man-made, largely mechanical.

lessons.title: Writing Task 2 (1): Band 7 ko'nikmalari va bir gapli argument
lessons.grammar_topic: Task Response va Coherence & Cohesion: Band 6 va Band 7 farqi; argument = xulosa + sabab (premise); aniq bo'lmagan argumentning 5 sababi
lessons.vocab_topic: Argument tili: position, claim, reason, evidence, valid, relevant, justify; sabab-natija bog'lovchilari (because, since, so, therefore, as a result)
lessons.book_ref: Pauline Cullen, The Key to IELTS Writing Task 2: Lesson 1 — What skills do you need to show? (PDF 6–10), Lesson 2 — A one-sentence argument (PDF 11–16).
objectives: Task Response va Coherence & Cohesion mezonlarida (May 2023 tahriri) Band 6 ni Band 7 dan ajratadigan asosiy farqlarni bilish: aniq va rivojlantirilgan pozitsiya ("a clear and developed position"), kengaytirilgan va qo'llab-quvvatlangan g'oyalar, har xatboshida aniq markaziy g'oya, butun essay bo'yi aniq progression ("a clear progression throughout").

Task 2 da "argument" nima ekanini tushunish: pozitsiyaga ishonishingiz SABABLARI; savolning har bir turida (agree/disagree, advantages/disadvantages, problem/solution) argument nima ekanini ayta olish.
Bir gapli argumentni xulosa (conclusion) va sabablarga (premises) ajratish; xulosa gap boshida ham, oxirida ham kelishi mumkinligini bilish.
Noto'g'ri yoki aniq bo'lmagan argumentni topish: sababsiz fikr, bog'lanmagan yoki to'qilgan dalil, qarama-qarshi g'oyalar, mantiqiy sakrash, haddan tashqari kuchli so'z.
Pozitsiya "I think" so'zlari bilan emas, mantiq va til bilan aniq bo'lishini tushunish; bog'lovchilar va referencing'ni kam ishlatmaslik.
materials: Kitob sahifalari (Reading bo'limidagi ikki rasm): Lesson 1 — Band 6/7 farqlari, planning, cohesive devices; Lesson 2 — bir gapli argument va aniq bo'lmagan argumentlar.
Namuna essay (Jony Academy, 300 so'z) — har o'quvchiga chop etilgan; ikki rangli marker: xulosa (conclusion) — yashil, sabab (reason) — sariq.
Doskada jadval: CONCLUSION | REASON(S) | VALID? — dars davomida to'ldiriladi.
Tasmalar: 5-mashq uchun bog'lanmagan gaplar (har juftlikka bitta to'plam).
timeline: Kirish
Savol: "Nega ko'pchilik Writing'da 6.5 da qolib ketadi?" Javoblar doskaga; keyin kitob muallifining asosiy fikri: muammo ko'pincha grammatika emas, Task Response va Coherence'da.
Band 6 va Band 7 (Lesson 1)
Kitob sahifalari 6–7: TR va CC dagi 3 tadan farq; planning va critical thinking nima uchun kerak. 4-mashq (Band 6 mi, 7 mi?).
Cohesion: kam ishlatish ham xato (Lesson 1)
Kitob sahifasi 9: yashirin bog'lanish va referencing; 5-mashq (bog'lanmagan gaplarni ulash).
Bir gapli argument (Lesson 2)
Kitob sahifalari 11–12: xulosa + sabablar; "I think" pozitsiyani aniq qilmaydi; 1-mashq (ajratish).
Aniq bo'lmagan argumentlar
Kitob sahifalari 13–15: sababsiz fikr, to'qilgan dalil, qarama-qarshilik, mantiqiy sakrash, til muammosi; 2- va 3-mashq.
Namuna essay tahlili
Jony Academy essay'i o'qiladi; har body xatboshidagi xulosa va sabablar ranglar bilan belgilanadi; reading vazifalari.
Mini-yozish
Uy vazifasi savoli bo'yicha har o'quvchi 2 ta bir gapli argument yozadi; juftlik "valid?" ustunini tekshiradi.
Xulosa va vazifa
Uyga: 4 ta argument, 3 ta tuzatish va kirish + bitta body xatboshi.

intro: Kitob muallifining asosiy kuzatuvi: ko'p nomzodlar boshqa ko'nikmalarda 7+ oladi, lekin Writing'da 6.5 da qoladi — hatto ona tili ingliz bo'lganlar ham. Sabab ko'pincha grammatika yoki lug'at emas, balki Task Response (TR) va Coherence & Cohesion (CC) mezonlari noto'g'ri tushunilishida.

TASK RESPONSE — Band 6 dagi 3 asosiy muammo: 1) savolning hamma qismiga teng javob bermaslik (bir qismi to'liq, boshqasi yuzaki); 2) pozitsiya bor, lekin xulosalar noaniq, asoslanmagan yoki takroriy ("the conclusions drawn may be unclear, unjustified or repetitive"); 3) asosiy g'oyalarning ba'zilari yetarli rivojlanmagan yoki noaniq. Band 7 (May 2023 tahriri): "A clear and developed position is presented" — pozitsiya aniq va rivojlantirilgan: kirishda aytiladi, har body xatboshida sabablar bilan qo'llanadi va xulosagacha o'zgarmaydi.

COHERENCE & COHESION — Band 6 va 7 farqi (May 2023 tahriri): 1) Band 6 da umumiy progression bor ("a clear overall progression"), Band 7 da u BOSHIDAN OXIRIGACHA aniq ("a clear progression throughout the response"); 2) gaplar ichida va orasida bog'lanish, referencing (this, these, the latter) aniq — Band 7 da biroz kam yoki ortiqcha ishlatishga ("some over/under use") yo'l qo'yiladi, lekin bog'lanishni taxmin qilishga to'g'ri kelsa — Band 6; 3) xatboshilar: Band 6 da markaziy g'oya har doim ham aniq emas ("the central topic may not always be clear"), Band 7 da xatboshilar izchillikka xizmat qiladi va g'oyalar mantiqiy ketma-ketlikda — amalda har xatboshida aniq MARKAZIY g'oya (central topic) bo'lishi kerak.

Task 2 — rasmiy munozarali (discursive) essay. Unda "argument" alohida ma'noga ega: siz ishongan narsaning SABABLARI. Savol turiga qarab argument: nega rozisiz/rozi emassiz; nega afzalliklar kamchiliklardan ustun; nega bu muammo va nega shu yechim yaxshi; nega o'zgarish ijobiy yoki salbiy. Band 6 essaylarda aynan "nega" qismi yetarli tushuntirilmaydi yoki pozitsiyaga bog'lanmaydi.

Planning va critical thinking: odam miyasi tayyor, mantiqiy xatboshilar bilan o'ylamaydi. Tez reja qilinsa, g'oyalar yig'iladi, lekin BAHOLANMAYDI: qaysi g'oya argumentni qo'llamaydi, qayerda tushuntirish yetishmaydi — ko'rinmaydi. Natija — Band 6 ("some may be insufficiently developed or may lack clarity"). Critical thinking — kamchilik qidirish emas, g'oyalarni baholash.

Reading matnlariga taqlid qilmang: ularda asosiy g'oya ko'pincha yashirin (o'quvchi o'zi xulosa chiqaradi) — bu reading testi uchun qulay, lekin essay'da examiner'dan g'oyangizni taxmin qilishni kutish Band 6 CC demak. Firstly, however, as a result, the latter — klishe emas; ular argument yo'nalishini ko'rsatadi. Bog'lovchi faqat ma'no yoki referencing gaplarni allaqachon aniq bog'lab turganda tushirib qoldirilishi mumkin.

Bitta essay — bitta umumiy argument, u esa bir nechta kichik argumentlardan (main ideas) tuziladi. Har kichik argument = XULOSA (conclusion, sizning fikringiz) + SABAB(lar) (premise — siz o'quvchidan to'g'ri deb qabul qilishni so'ragan da'vo). Misol: "Walking to school improves children's fitness, so schools should encourage it." Xulosa: schools should encourage it. Sabab: walking improves fitness. Xulosa gap oxirida ham, boshida ham turishi mumkin (... because ...).

Har safar argument qilganingizda POZITSIYA beriladi. Shuning uchun "I think / In my opinion" ni har xatboshida yozish pozitsiyani aniq qilmaydi — faqat mantiq va til qiladi. Aslida har Task 2 savolining o'zi ham argument (da'vo + sabab), siz unga o'z argumentingiz bilan javob berasiz.

Argument aniq bo'lmasligining 5 sababi: 1) sabab yo'q — faqat da'vo; 2) dalil xulosaga mantiqan bog'lanmagan yoki TO'QILGAN ("a documentary showed that 85% of people..."); 3) bir xatboshida bir-biriga zid ikki fikr; 4) mantiqiy sakrash — o'quvchidan juda ko'p narsani o'zi tushunishni kutish; 5) til muammosi yoki haddan tashqari kuchli so'z (catastrophic, disastrous) — mavzu bunga asos bermasa, argument ishonchsiz bo'ladi.
formulas: "Cycling lanes reduce accidents, so the city should build more of them."
Faqat xulosa: "The city should build more cycling lanes."
"Schools should teach cooking because it helps young people eat more healthily."
Sabab xulosaga bog'lanmagan: "... because many people like food."
"Cities should plant more trees because they absorb pollution, which improves residents' health."
Some people believe + DA'VO. After all, ... Nevertheless, + SIZNING POZITSIYANGIZ
"Some believe robots will replace most workers. Nevertheless, many jobs still require human judgement."
Ikkala fikrni o'z fikringizdek yozish — qarama-qarshilik
"Noise makes concentration difficult. As a result, a quiet place to study can improve results."
presentation: Grammatikam yaxshi, lekin 6.5 olaman. Nega?
Ko'pincha TR va CC da: pozitsiya butun essay bo'yi aniq emas, g'oyalar tushuntirilmagan yoki xatboshida markaziy g'oya yo'q. Kitob aynan shu ikki mezonga e'tibor qaratadi.
"In my opinion" ni har xatboshida yozsam, pozitsiya aniq bo'ladimi?
Yo'q. Pozitsiya argumentlaringiz mantig'idan ko'rinadi. Bu iboralar kirish va xulosada yetarli; body'da sabablar ishlashi kerak.
Argument va misol farqi nima?
Argument — xulosa va uni qo'llaydigan sabab. Misol faqat sababni tushuntirsa foydali; xulosaga bog'lanmagan yoki to'qilgan "fakt" argumentni zaiflashtiradi.
Bog'lovchilar (Firstly, However) klishe emasmi?

Yo'q. Ular o'quvchiga argument yo'nalishini ko'rsatadi. Band 7 da biroz kam yoki ortiqcha ishlatishga yo'l qo'yiladi ("some over/under use"), lekin bog'lanish baribir aniq bo'ladi. Agar ular juda kam bo'lib, examiner bog'lanishni o'zi taxmin qilishga majbur bo'lsa — bu Band 6 CC.
Rejaga vaqt yo'q, darrov yozaman.
Tez reja — g'oyalar bor, lekin baholanmagan: noto'g'ri dalil yoki tushuntirishsiz g'oya essay'ga kirib qoladi. Kitob fikri: reja qilmaslik — testni qayta topshirish demak.
"Catastrophic" kabi kuchli so'zlar ball oshiradimi?
Faqat mavzu ularga asos bersa. Aks holda argument ishonchsiz bo'ladi. Aniqroq va odatiy sifat (serious, harmful) TR uchun foydaliroq.
notes: Bu dars — Task 2 turkumining poydevori: keyingi 6 dars (argument turlari, tushuntirish, counterargument, xatboshi, tuzilma, reja) shu "xulosa + sabab" g'oyasiga quriladi. Doskadagi CONCLUSION | REASON | VALID? jadvalini keyingi darslarda ham ishlating.
Kitob sahifalaridagi misollar (fruit / vitamin C, gorillalar, robotlar) g'oyani ko'rsatish uchun; mashqlarda o'z misollarimiz berilgan — o'quvchilar ularni kitobdagi bilan solishtirishi mumkin.
Namuna essay Jony Academy tomonidan yozilgan (300 so'z, 40 daqiqa me'yorida realistik darajada); maqsad — har body xatboshida xulosa va sabablarni ko'rsatish, "ideal" matnni yodlatish emas.
mistakes: "The government should ban junk food adverts." (va boshqa hech narsa)
"... because they encourage children to eat unhealthy food."
"For example, a survey showed that 92% of people agree."
Real, mantiqiy misol: kim, nima, qanday natija
To'qilgan statistika argumentni qo'llamaydi — Band 6 TR
"Robots will replace most jobs. ... Many jobs can never be done by robots."
Bir xatboshida zid fikr — pozitsiya noaniq
"In my opinion ... I think ... I believe ..." har xatboshida
"This could have a negative effect on ..."
Mavzu asoslamagan kuchli so'z — argument ishonchsiz

how: CORE — argument haqida gapirish uchun so'zlar (essay tahlilida ishlatamiz); STRONG — argument ichida; SUPER — Band 7+ essay iboralari.
Har so'z bilan uy vazifasi savoli (bepul jamoat transporti) haqida bitta gap tuzing.
Takror (yangi so'z sifatida sanalmaydi): evidence — 5- va 10-darslarda o'tilgan; bugun uni argument tahlilida faol ishlating ("evidence for / of").
core: Her argument is that free transport reduces traffic.
Uning argumenti — bepul transport tirbandlikni kamaytiradi.
Your position must be clear throughout the essay.
Pozitsiyangiz butun essay bo'yi aniq bo'lishi kerak.
The conclusion of this argument is that schools should teach cooking.
Bu argumentning xulosasi — maktablar pazandalikni o'rgatishi kerak.

Har asosiy g'oya uchun aniq sabab keltiring.
The writer claims that fruit keeps us healthy.
Muallif meva sog'lom saqlaydi deb da'vo qiladi.
This example is not evidence for the main point.
Bu misol asosiy fikr uchun dalil emas.
It is a valid argument because the reason supports the conclusion.
Bu asosli argument, chunki sabab xulosani qo'llaydi.

Each main idea needs to be fully developed.
Har asosiy g'oya to'liq rivojlantirilishi kerak.
A coherent paragraph has one central idea.
Izchil xatboshida bitta markaziy g'oya bo'ladi.

Yaxshi sabablar o'quvchini xulosangiz to'g'ri ekaniga ishontiradi.

class_ex.title: 1-mashq (4-bosqich, jami 20 daq.): Xulosa va sababni ajrating
class_ex.instr: Har gapda XULOSA (yozuvchining fikri) va SABAB(lar)ni toping. Xulosa gapning boshida ham, oxirida ham bo'lishi mumkin.
items: Walking to school improves children's fitness, so schools should encourage it.
Museums should be free because this allows people on low incomes to learn about their history.
Since fast food is high in salt and sugar, it should not be sold near schools.
Governments should invest in solar power, as it is becoming cheaper and it does not pollute the air.
Older employees have years of experience, which makes them valuable mentors, so companies should keep them.
Homework should be limited in primary schools because young children also need time to play.
answers: X: schools should encourage it | S: it improves fitness
X: museums should be free | S: people on low incomes can learn about history
X: it should not be sold near schools | S: it is high in salt and sugar
X: invest in solar power | S1: cheaper; S2: no air pollution
X: companies should keep them | S1: experience; S2: experience → valuable mentors
X: homework should be limited | S: children need time to play
why: so — xulosa gap oxirida.
because — xulosa boshida, sabab keyin.
Since + sabab gap boshida; xulosa bosh gapda.
Ikki sabab (premise) — ikkalasi ham to'g'ri bo'lishi kerak.
which — birinchi sababdan ikkinchisi chiqadi; zanjir.
"I think" yo'q, lekin pozitsiya aniq — mantiq orqali.

class_ex.title: 2-mashq (5-bosqich, 3-mashq bilan jami 20 daq.): Valid yoki yo'q?
class_ex.instr: Argument asoslimi? "valid" yoki "not valid" deng. Not valid bo'lsa — qanday savol tug'iladi?
items: It is raining heavily, so the football match may be cancelled.
Children will read more books if their school has a large library.
Many people dislike cooking because supermarkets sell ready meals.
Air pollution damages the lungs, so cities should limit the number of cars in the centre.
Online shopping is growing, and most people will never buy anything online.
Young drivers have less experience, so they are more likely to have accidents.
why: Sabab xulosani mantiqan qo'llaydi.
Hamma bola-chi? O'qituvchi, qiziqish, vaqt-chi? — mantiqiy sakrash.
Tayyor ovqat sotilishi odamlar pazandalikni yoqtirmasligini qanday isbotlaydi?
Sabab (sog'likka zarar) → xulosa (mashinalarni cheklash) — bog'langan.
Ikki fikr bir-biriga zid: o'sib borayotgan bo'lsa, qanday qilib "hech kim"?
Tajriba kamligi → xavf ko'proq: mantiqan bog'langan.

class_ex.title: 3-mashq (5-bosqich, 2-mashq bilan jami 20 daq.): Muammoni aniqlang va tuzating
class_ex.instr: Har gapdagi muammoni nomlang (sababsiz / to'qilgan dalil / zid fikr / mantiqiy sakrash / kuchli so'z) va gapni qayta yozing.
items: Public libraries should stay open late.
Fewer people now use cash. For example, a TV programme showed that 97% of shoppers in my city use only cards.
If teenagers use social media, the results will be catastrophic for society.
A quiet office increases profits.
Working from home saves time. Most people cannot work from home effectively. Therefore, companies should allow it.
answers: Sababsiz: "... because many students have no quiet place to study at home."
To'qilgan dalil: "For example, many shops and cafés now accept card payments only."
Kuchli so'z: "... this may have a negative effect on their sleep and concentration."
Mantiqiy sakrash: "Noise makes it hard to concentrate. As a result, a quiet office can help staff work more efficiently, which may increase profits."
Zid fikr: "Although some people cannot work effectively at home, it saves time for many employees, so companies should offer it as an option."
why: O'quvchi "nega?" degan savolga javob olishi kerak.
Aniq bo'lmagan va tekshirib bo'lmaydigan raqam hech narsani isbotlamaydi.
catastrophic — to'satdan katta halokat; mavzu bunga asos bermaydi.
Oraliq qadamni (nega va qanday) yozish kerak.
Zid fikrni o'z fikrdek emas, qarama-qarshi fikr sifatida berish (although / nevertheless).

class_ex.title: 4-mashq (2-bosqich, jami 17 daq.): Band 6 mi, Band 7 mi?
class_ex.instr: Tavsifni o'qing va qaysi band ekanini ayting. Qaysi mezon (TR yoki CC)?
items: Essay'da pozitsiya bor, lekin ikkinchi body xatboshida yozuvchi qarama-qarshi tomonga o'tib ketadi.
Har xatboshining birinchi gapi uning asosiy g'oyasini aniq aytadi.
Savol "sabablar va yechimlar"ni so'raydi; sabablar to'liq, yechim bitta gapda.
G'oyalar mantiqiy tartibda, lekin ikki gap orasidagi bog'lanishni o'quvchi o'zi taxmin qilishi kerak.
Pozitsiya kirishdan xulosagacha bir xil va har body xatboshi uni qo'llaydi.
Asosiy g'oyalar bor, lekin ba'zilari tushuntirilmagan yoki misol bilan qo'llanmagan.
why: Band 7 TR (May 2023): "A clear and developed position is presented". Pozitsiya o'zgarib ketsa, u aniq emas — Band 6: xulosalar noaniq ("unclear").
Band 6 da markaziy g'oya har doim ham aniq emas ("the central topic may not always be clear"); har xatboshida u aniq bo'lsa — Band 7 CC belgisi.
Savolning hamma qismiga teng javob berilmagan.

Bog'lanish yashirin — o'quvchi uni o'zi taxmin qiladi: Band 6 CC (May 2023: cohesion "may be faulty or mechanical due to misuse, overuse or omission"). Band 7 da biroz under-/over-use mumkin, lekin bog'lanish aniq qoladi.
Band 7 TR: "A clear and developed position is presented" — pozitsiya kirishdan xulosagacha bir xil va har body xatboshi uni qo'llaydi.
Band 6 TR (May 2023): asosiy g'oyalar o'rinli, lekin "some may be insufficiently developed or may lack clarity".

class_ex.title: 5-mashq (3-bosqich, jami 10 daq.): Bog'lanmagan gaplarni ulang
class_ex.instr: Gaplar orasida bog'lanish yo'q. Bog'lovchi yoki referencing (this, these, such) qo'shib, bitta aniq argumentga aylantiring.
items: Many young people move to big cities. Villages are losing their schools.
Prices of fresh vegetables have risen. Families buy more processed food.
Some parents give children smartphones at the age of six. Children spend less time outdoors.
answers: "Many young people move to big cities. As a result, fewer children live in villages, and many village schools are closing."
"Prices of fresh vegetables have risen. Because processed food is cheaper, many families now buy more of it."
"Some parents give children smartphones at the age of six. This early access often means that children spend less time outdoors."
why: As a result + oraliq qadam (bolalar kamaydi) — sabab-natija aniq.
Because + sabab — nega oilalar tanlovini o'zgartirgani tushuntirildi.
"This early access" — referencing; oldingi gapga aniq ishora.
class_ex.note: Kitob g'oyasi: bog'lovchini faqat ma'no yoki referencing ikki gapni allaqachon aniq bog'lasa tushirib qoldirish mumkin.

readings.title: Kitob: Lesson 1 — qanday ko'nikmalarni ko'rsatish kerak?
readings.source: Pauline Cullen, The Key to IELTS Writing Task 2, Lesson 1 (PDF 6, 7, 9)

readings.source: Pauline Cullen, The Key to IELTS Writing Task 2, Lesson 2 (PDF 11–15)

readings.title: NAMUNA ESSAY — xulosa va sabablar qayerda?
readings.qtype: Opinion essay (to what extent) — to'liq javob (Jony Academy)
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna essay'i (300 so'z, 5 xatboshi)
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: Some people believe that every university student should be required to study a foreign language, whatever their main subject. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.  |  POZITSIYA: largely agree. ARGUMENT 1: career (reason → example → conclusion). ARGUMENT 2: culture and tolerance. CONCESSION: workload → solution.
text: At many universities, students concentrate entirely on their main subject, but some people argue that learning a foreign language should be compulsory for everyone. I largely agree with this view, because a second language makes graduates more employable and broadens their understanding of other cultures.

The main reason why a foreign language should be required is that it gives graduates a clear advantage in the job market. In most fields today, from engineering to medicine, the latest research is published in English, and many of the best-paid positions are offered by international companies. A young doctor who can read medical journals in English, for instance, does not need to wait for studies to be translated and can therefore treat patients with more up-to-date methods. Since one purpose of higher education is to prepare students for work, it is reasonable for universities to make this skill compulsory.

A second, equally important benefit is that learning a language changes the way students see the world. When learners discover how another nation expresses politeness, humour or even time, they begin to realise that their own habits are not the only natural ones. As a result, they tend to become more tolerant and more effective in international teams, a quality that employers in every sector value.

Admittedly, some students already have heavy timetables, and a demanding language course could harm their main studies. However, this problem can be solved by offering shorter courses linked to each field, such as English for law students or German for engineers, rather than by removing the requirement altogether.

In conclusion, I believe that all university students should study a foreign language, since it improves their career prospects and widens their outlook. Provided that the courses are adapted to students' main subjects, the benefits clearly outweigh the extra workload.
paraphrases: should be required to study a foreign language
should be compulsory / should be required / make this skill compulsory
every university student
everyone / all university students / graduates
whatever their main subject
concentrate entirely on their main subject / adapted to students' main subjects
To what extent do you agree
I largely agree with this view

tasks.title: Essay'ni kitob g'oyalari bilan tahlil qiling
tasks.type: Og'zaki, ikki rangli marker bilan
tasks.instr: Xulosalarni yashil, sabablarni sariq bilan belgilang va savollarga javob bering.
items: Pozitsiya qayerlarda ko'rinadi va u o'zgaradimi?
2-xatboshining markaziy g'oyasi qaysi gapda?
2-xatboshidagi argumentni xulosa + sabablarga ajrating.
Doktor misoli nimani isbotlaydi? U to'qilgan statistikadan nimasi bilan farq qiladi?
3-xatboshida sabab-natija qaysi bog'lovchi bilan ko'rsatilgan?
4-xatboshi pozitsiyani zaiflashtiradimi? Nega?
Body xatboshilarida "I think" necha marta bor? Pozitsiya baribir aniqmi?
answers: Kirish (I largely agree), har body xatboshi va xulosa; o'zgarmaydi
Birinchi gap: "The main reason why ... is that it gives graduates a clear advantage in the job market."
X: universities should make it compulsory | S: research and good jobs use English; education prepares students for work
Til bilish → yangi tadqiqotlarni tez o'qish → yaxshiroq davolash; bu mantiqiy zanjir, raqam emas
"As a result" (va "When ..., they begin to realise ...")
Yo'q: kamchilik tan olinadi, lekin "However" bilan yechim beriladi va pozitsiya saqlanadi
Hech bir marta; pozitsiya sabablar orqali aniq
why: Band 7 TR (May 2023): "A clear and developed position is presented" — pozitsiya kirishdan xulosagacha o'zgarmaydi.
Band 7 CC: xatboshilar izchil, har birida aniq markaziy g'oya (Band 6 da u "may not always be clear").
Kitob, Lesson 2: har main idea — bir argument (xulosa + premise).
Dalil xulosaga mantiqan bog'langan bo'lishi kerak; to'qilgan fakt — Band 6.
Cohesive device bog'lanishni aniq ko'rsatadi — under-use yo'q.
Qarama-qarshi fikr zid g'oya sifatida emas, boshqarilgan holda beriladi (counterargument — 28-darsda batafsil; kitobda — Lesson 7).
Kitob: pozitsiyani faqat til va mantiq aniq qiladi.

homework_intro: Bugun Task 2 da Band 6 dan Band 7 ga o'tish uchun asosan Task Response va Coherence ustida ishlash kerakligini, argument esa xulosa + sabab ekanini o'rgandik.

Uy vazifasi savoli: "Some people think that public transport should be free for everyone. To what extent do you agree or disagree?" Birinchi vazifa — 4 ta bir gapli argument (2 tasi rozi, 2 tasi qarshi); har birining ostida xulosa va sababni belgilang.
Ikkinchi vazifa — 3-mashqdagi 5 xil muammodan 3 tasini o'zingiz yarating (bir gapdan) va har birini tuzating.

Uchinchi vazifa — shu savolga kirish (2 gap: paraphrase + pozitsiya) va bitta body xatboshi (100–120 so'z): birinchi gap markaziy g'oya, keyin sabab, izoh/misol, yakuniy xulosa. "I think" body'da ishlatilmasin.

homework.title: 4 ta bir gapli argument (bepul transport)
homework.instr: 2 tasi rozi, 2 tasi qarshi; har birida xulosa va sabab belgilangan; kamida bittasi "because ..., which ..." bilan.
homework.answers: Namuna: "Public transport should be free because this would encourage drivers to leave their cars at home, which would reduce traffic." / "Free transport could lower the quality of services, since companies would lose the income they need to maintain buses and trains."

homework.title: 3 ta noto'g'ri argument va tuzatish
homework.instr: Har biriga muammo nomi (sababsiz / to'qilgan dalil / zid fikr / mantiqiy sakrash / kuchli so'z) va tuzatilgan versiya.
homework.answers: Namuna (har muammo turidan bittadan — o'quvchi istalgan 3 tasini yozadi): 1) Sababsiz: "Public transport should be free." → "Public transport should be free because high fares stop many low-income families from travelling to work." 2) To'qilgan dalil: "A TV report said that 95% of drivers would switch to free buses." → "For example, drivers who now pay for both petrol and parking would have a strong reason to switch to free buses." 3) Zid fikr: "Free buses will reduce traffic. Most drivers will never use buses." → "Although some drivers will never give up their cars, free buses are likely to attract many others, so traffic should decrease." 4) Mantiqiy sakrash: "Free transport will improve students' grades." → "Free transport would help students from distant areas attend classes more regularly, which may improve their grades." 5) Kuchli so'z: "Paying for buses is a disaster for society." → "High fares can make it harder for some people on low incomes to reach their jobs." Tekshirish: muammo turi to'g'ri nomlangan va tuzatilgan gapda sabab xulosaga mantiqan bog'langan.

homework.title: Kirish + bitta body xatboshi
homework.instr: Kirish 2 gap; body 100–120 so'z: markaziy g'oya → sabab → izoh/misol → xulosa. 20 daqiqa.
homework.answers: Namuna (kirish 2 gap + body 113 so'z). KIRISH: "It is sometimes argued that buses, trams and metro services should cost passengers nothing. I largely agree with this view, provided that the lost income is replaced by public funding." BODY: "The main reason why fares should be abolished is that free public transport would make cities cleaner and less congested. Many people currently drive because buying bus tickets for a whole family can cost as much as petrol, so the car seems the more sensible choice. If buses and trains were free, this calculation would change, and a considerable number of drivers would leave their cars at home. Fewer cars on the roads would mean shorter traffic jams and cleaner air in city centres, which would benefit pedestrians and cyclists as well as passengers. It is therefore reasonable to conclude that removing fares would improve daily life for most people in large cities." Tuzilma: markaziy g'oya (1-gap) → sabab → izoh zanjiri (if ... would ...) → natija → yakuniy xulosa (It is therefore reasonable to conclude ...); body'da "I think" yo'q, to'qilgan raqam yo'q.

normativ: har birida aniq xulosa + mantiqiy sabab
aniq pozitsiya, markaziy g'oya birinchi gapda, 100+ so'z

kahoot.q: According to the book, why do many candidates get stuck at 6.5 in Writing?
options: Handwriting that is difficult to read
kahoot.explain: Muallif fikricha, muammo ko'pincha TR va CC da: pozitsiya aniq emas, g'oyalar rivojlanmagan, markaziy g'oya yo'q.

kahoot.q: Which phrase describes Band 7 Task Response in the 2023 descriptors?
options: A position only in the conclusion
kahoot.explain: Band 7 (May 2023): "A clear and developed position is presented". Band 6 da pozitsiya bor, lekin xulosalar noaniq, asoslanmagan yoki takroriy bo'lishi mumkin.

Not assessed in Task 2 at all
