kahoot.q: In Task 2, what does "argument" mean?
options: The reasons why you hold your position
Arguing with the examiner about the topic
Giving both sides exactly equal space
A list of examples with no comment
kahoot.explain: Discursive essay'da argument — nega bunga ishonishingizni tushuntiradigan sabablar.

kahoot.q: "Cycling lanes reduce accidents, so the city should build more." Which part is the conclusion?
kahoot.explain: so dan keyingi qism — yozuvchining xulosasi; "reduce accidents" — sabab (premise).

kahoot.q: Which argument is VALID?
options: Sugar damages teeth, so children should eat fewer sweets.
Many people dislike sport because gyms are so expensive.
More tourists visit the city every year, so tourism is dying.
Students will get better marks if the school has a new gym.
kahoot.explain: Shakar tishga zarar → shirinlikni kamaytirish: sabab xulosani qo'llaydi. Qolganlarida sabab xulosaga bog'lanmagan (gym narxi → sportni yoqtirmaslik), qarama-qarshilik (turistlar ko'paymoqda → turizm so'nmoqda) yoki mantiqiy sakrash (yangi sport zali → yaxshi baho) bor.

kahoot.q: "A documentary showed that 85% of people agree." What is the problem?
options: A serious grammar mistake in the verb
The sentence is much too short
There is no linking word at the start
kahoot.explain: Aniq bo'lmagan statistika fikrni tushuntirmaydi va o'quvchini ishontirmaydi — Band 6 TR belgisi.

kahoot.q: What is the most important way to make your position clear?
options: Writing "In my opinion" in every sentence
Copying the question word for word
kahoot.explain: Kitob: "I think" iboralari yetarli emas; pozitsiya argumentlaringiz mantig'i orqali ko'rinadi.

kahoot.q: Which linking word introduces a REASON?
kahoot.explain: since / because / as — sabab; so / therefore / as a result — natija yoki xulosa.

kahoot.q: "Robots will replace most jobs. Many jobs can't be done by robots." What is the problem?
options: It uses too many linking words
The language is far too extreme
It relies on an invented statistic
kahoot.explain: Zid fikrni boshqarish kerak: "Some believe ... Nevertheless, ..." — shunda pozitsiya aniq qoladi.

kahoot.q: Why should you NOT copy the style of Reading passages in an essay?
options: Their main idea is often implicit
They are usually much too short for Task 2
Their grammar is too simple for Band 7
They are written in an informal style
kahoot.explain: Reading matni o'quvchidan xulosa chiqarishni kutadi; essay'da examiner g'oyangizni taxmin qilmasligi kerak.

kahoot.q: When can you leave out a linking word?
options: When meaning or reference makes the link clear
Always, because linking words sound like clichés
Never, in any part of the essay
kahoot.explain: "This link ..." kabi referencing bog'lanishni ko'rsatsa, bog'lovchi shart emas; aks holda examiner bog'lanishni taxmin qiladi — bu Band 6 CC.

kahoot.q: "This example is not ___ for the main point." (= proof)
kahoot.explain: evidence — sanalmaydigan ot: "evidence for / of"; "evidences" deyilmaydi.

kahoot.q: "The topic does not ___ such extreme language."
kahoot.explain: justify — asoslamoq. Mavzu "catastrophic" kabi so'zni asoslamasa, argument zaiflashadi.

kahoot.q: "The last sentence ___ the first one." (= says the opposite of)
kahoot.explain: contradict — to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'ldiruvchi bilan, predlogsiz.

kahoot.q: "Learning a language should be ___ for all students." (= required)
kahoot.explain: compulsory — majburiy; compulsive — o'zini to'xtata olmaydigan (boshqa ma'no).

kahoot.q: "The benefits clearly ___ the extra workload."
kahoot.explain: outweigh — ... dan ustun bo'lmoq; advantages/disadvantages essay'larida juda foydali.

kahoot.q: "Free transport can work, ___ it is well funded."
kahoot.explain: provided that — "... sharti bilan"; pozitsiyani aniq chegaralaydi.

kahoot.q: "Good reasons ___ the reader that your conclusion is correct."
kahoot.explain: persuade sb that ... — kimnidir ishontirmoq. argue — bahslashmoq, da'vo qilmoq.

kahoot.q: "Do not make the examiner ___ your main idea." (= work out for themselves)
kahoot.explain: infer — o'quvchi yashirin ma'nodan xulosa chiqaradi; imply — yozuvchi ishora qiladi.

lessons.title: Writing Task 2 (2): Argument turlari va murakkab argumentlar
lessons.grammar_topic: Argument qurishning 4 yo'li: qo'shish (+), sabab-oqibat zanjiri (→), natijani bashorat qilish (If/When + modal) va qarama-qarshilik (If ... not / Without); ularni birlashtirish, referencing va gap uzunligi
lessons.vocab_topic: Argument tili: sabab-oqibat fe'llari (cause, lead to, result in), ishonch darajasi (will / is likely to / may) va urg'u iboralari (more importantly, in turn)
lessons.book_ref: Pauline Cullen, "The Key to IELTS Writing Task 2": Lesson 3 — Creating different types of argument (3.1–3.3), Lesson 4 — More complex arguments (4.1–4.3); PDF betlari 17–25.
objectives: Argumentni qo'shish (+) usulida qurish: bir nechta sababni teng yoki urg'u bilan (More importantly) berish va bog'lovchini referencing bilan almashtira bilish.
Sabab-oqibat zanjirini (→) yozish: bitta da'vo → birinchi oqibat → ikkinchi oqibat (This means that..., As a result, ..., in turn).

Natijani bashorat qilishda ishonch darajasini to'g'ri berish: When + present (doimiy), If + present (mumkin), If + past (ehtimoli kam); will / is likely to / may / could. Ramka (real yoki faraziy) va ishonch darajasini farqlash: would — faraziy ramka belgisi, ishonch darajasi emas.
Qarama-qarshilik orqali g'oya topish va dalillash: "Agar buni qilmasak nima bo'ladi?" — If ... does not ..., then ... / Without ..., ...
Murakkab argumentda referencing xatosidan qochish ("it" eng yaqin mos otga bog'lanib o'qiladi) va uzun-qisqa gaplarni almashtirib yozish.
Rejani belgilar bilan tuzish (+ → = ∴ ↑ ↓) va argument turi tilni belgilashini tushunish — shablon emas.
materials: Kitob sahifalari (Reading bo'limidagi 2 rasm): Lesson 3 (3.1–3.3) va Lesson 4 (4.1–4.3) — proyektorda.
Jony Academy namuna essayi (bepul jamoat transporti) va uning belgili rejasi — har o'quvchiga chop etilgan.
Doskada belgilar lug'ati: + qo'shish, → oqibat, = ya'ni, ∴ demak, ↑ oshadi, ↓ kamayadi.

Doskada "ishonch zinapoyasi": will / is certain to (100%) → is likely to / probably (75%) → may / could / might (50%). Yonida alohida — RAMKA: real (If + present → will / may) yoki faraziy (If + past → would / might).
Rangli markerlar: da'vo (ko'k), oqibat (qizil), xulosa (yashil).
timeline: Kirish
25-darsdan takror: argument = da'vo + sabab. Savol: "Bitta fikrni necha xil yo'l bilan isbotlash mumkin?"
Qo'shish (+) va urg'u (3.1)
Kitob sahifasi; teng sabablar (Firstly, In addition) va urg'u (More importantly); referencing bog'lovchi o'rnini bosishi, lekin me'yori.
Sabab-oqibat zanjiri (3.2)
Domino g'oyasi; doskada o'zbekcha misol bilan zanjir chiziladi; 1-mashq.
Natijani bashorat qilish (3.3)
Ishonch zinapoyasi: harakat qanchalik tez-tez / ehtimolli va natijaga qanchalik ishonamiz; 2-mashq.
Qarama-qarshilik (4.1)
"Agar qilmasak-chi?" savoli bilan yangi g'oya topish; 5-mashq og'zaki.
Birlashtirish, referencing, gap uzunligi (4.2–4.3)
"it" xatosi; paraphrase bilan orqaga ishora; sabab-natija gaplarini aylantirish; 3- va 4-mashq.
Namuna essay tahlili
Jony Academy essayi: har xatboshida argument turini topish, rejadagi belgilar bilan solishtirish.
Mini-yozuv
Juftlikda bitta body xatboshi rejasi: kamida 2 xil argument turi (masalan, → va +).
Xulosa va vazifa
Uyga: bitta body xatboshi (3 argument turi bilan) va L09 Mock 1 dagi Task 2 essayingizda (yoki 25-dars xatboshingizda) modallarni tekshirish.

intro: Band 7+ da murakkablik tildan emas, ARGUMENTdan keladi. C1–C2 darajasi "faqat qiyin so'z va grammatika" degani emas: murakkab g'oyani sodda va aniq tushuntira olish degani. Qaysi argument turini tanlash — rejadagi g'oyalarga bog'liq; shuning uchun tayyor shablon ishlamaydi: avval g'oya, keyin til.

1) QO'SHISH (+): bir nechta sabab qo'shilib bitta xulosaga olib keladi. Til: Firstly, Secondly, In addition, Similarly, also. Sabab — aniq dalil, xulosa — umumiy fikr. Bir sababni kuchliroq ko'rsatish uchun URG'U: More importantly, Even more importantly, What is more, Moreover.

Bog'lovchini ba'zan referencing almashtiradi: "the money raised", "these funds" oldingi g'oyaga qaytadi. Lekin hammasini olib tashlasangiz, matn yangiliklar sarlavhasiga o'xshab qoladi va o'quvchi ko'p mehnat qiladi. Band 7 Coherence & Cohesion (CC) deskriptori (May 2023) bog'lovchilarning biroz kam yoki ortiqcha ishlatilishiga ("some over/under use") yo'l qo'yadi, lekin bog'lanish baribir aniq bo'ladi; o'quvchi g'oyalar orasidagi bog'lanishni taxmin qilishga majbur bo'lsa — bu Band 6 CC belgisi (cohesion "may be faulty or mechanical due to misuse, overuse or omission"). Tavsiya: aniq signal qoldiring.

2) SABAB-OQIBAT (→): bitta da'vo boshqasiga ta'sir qiladi, u esa uchinchisiga — domino yoki zanjir. Oqibatlar — dalilingiz. Til: This means that..., This causes..., As a result, ..., in turn, If ... then .... Diqqat: This means (that) ikki vazifada keladi — natija (→) yoki tushuntirish (=); In other words esa faqat tushuntirish (=). Zanjirda This means that dan keyin haqiqiy oqibat kelsin. Zanjirni aniq tushuntirish o'z-o'zidan murakkab grammatikani talab qiladi — sun'iy qiyin gap qurish shart emas.

3) NATIJANI BASHORAT QILISH: harakatning ehtimoliy natijasi — uni qo'llash yoki rad etish sababi. RAMKA (harakat qismi): When + present = doimiy sodir bo'ladi; If + present = real, kelajakda mumkin (natijada will / may); If + past = faraziy, ehtimoli kamroq (natijada would / might / could). ISHONCH (natija qismi): will (100%), is likely to / probably (taxminan 75%), may / could / might (50%). would — ishonch darajasi emas, faraziy ramka belgisi: real zanjirdan (present) keyin sababsiz would ga o'tmang. Real: "If fares are removed, air quality is likely to improve." Faraziy: "If fares were removed, air quality would probably improve."

Qoida: ishonchingiz to'liq bo'lmasa, qat'iy bashorat qilmang. "This will solve all their problems" — haddan oshgan da'vo; "This could significantly improve the situation" — ehtiyotkor va ishonarli. Modal fe'l — pozitsiyangizni aniq ko'rsatadigan vosita.

4) QARAMA-QARSHILIK: "Agar buni qilmasak / bo'lmasa nima bo'ladi?" — g'oya tugaganda yangi g'oya topish usuli ham. Til: If ... does not ..., then ...; Without ..., .... Present + conditional — ishonchni ko'rsatadi; kamroq ishonsangiz can / may qo'shing. Shu til keyinchalik counterargument'da ham kerak bo'ladi (28-dars).

BIRLASHTIRISH va REFERENCING: bir xatboshida +, → va qarama-qarshilik aralashsa, xato ehtimoli oshadi. Band 6 ning tipik xatosi: oxiriga yangi g'oyani "In addition, it means..." bilan qo'shish — "it" eng yaqin mos otga (masalan, homelessness) bog'lanib, ma'no buziladi. Uzoqdagi g'oyaga qaytishda sinonim yoki paraphrase ishlating: "In addition, a lack of accommodation...".

USLUB: uzun va qisqa gaplarni almashtiring — o'qish oson, takror kam. Sabab-natijani aylantirib yozing: A causes B / B is caused by A / B is the result of A / A can result in B / A can lead to B / B can result from A. Rejada belgilar: + qo'shish, → oqibat, = ya'ni, ∴ demak, ↑ ↓ o'zgarish.
formulas: Har gap "Also" bilan; sabablar xulosaga bog'lanmagan
"..., which means that fewer cars enter the centre. This, in turn, reduces congestion."
Zanjirda bo'g'in tushib qolgan — mantiqiy sakrash
"If fares are removed, air quality is likely to improve." / "If fares were removed, air quality would probably improve."
Har natijaga "will" — haddan oshgan ishonch; real ramkadan keyin sababsiz "would"
"Without such support, these groups may remain isolated."
"In addition, a lack of accommodation means that rents remain high."
"In addition, it means..." — "it" noto'g'ri otga bog'lanadi
"Obesity can result from poor diet." / "Poor diet can lead to obesity."
presentation: Qaysi argument turi eng yaxshi?
Yagonasi yo'q. Reja paytida g'oyalaringiz qanday bog'langaniga qarang: alohida sabablarmi (+), zanjirmi (→), natijami (If/When). Tur tilni belgilaydi, aksincha emas.
Bog'lovchilarsiz yozsam, uslubim yuqoriroq ko'rinadimi?

Yo'q. Referencing aniq bo'lsa, bitta-ikkita bog'lovchini tushirish mumkin, lekin examiner aniq signallarni qidiradi. Bog'lovchilar juda kam bo'lib, examiner bog'lanishni o'zi taxmin qilishga majbur bo'lsa — bu Band 6 CC.
"will" bilan "may" farqi ballga ta'sir qiladimi?
Ha: modal fe'l pozitsiyangiz qanchalik ishonchli ekanini ko'rsatadi. Asossiz qat'iy bashorat mantiqni zaiflashtiradi (Task Response).
G'oya tugab qolsa-chi?
"Agar buni qilmasak / bo'lmasa nima bo'ladi?" deb so'rang — qarama-qarshilik argumenti yangi oqibatlarni beradi.
Murakkab gapni qanday yozaman?
Murakkab g'oyani aniq tushuntirsangiz, murakkab grammatika (which means, who then..., If... then...) o'zi keladi. Sun'iy uzun gap — xato manbai.
Nega "it" xavfli?
O'quvchi olmoshni eng yaqin mos otga bog'lab o'qiydi. Uzoqdagi g'oyaga qaytsangiz, uni sinonim yoki paraphrase bilan qayta ayting.
notes: Kitob sahifalari ingliz tilida; ustoz har bo'limdan keyin g'oyani o'zbekcha 1–2 gap bilan xulosalasin va darhol o'zbek hayotidan misol so'rasin (tirbandlik, uy-joy narxi, ish o'rinlari).
Kitobdagi worksheet topshiriqlari o'rniga shu darsdagi 1–5-mashqlar ishlatiladi; kitob paragraflarini o'quvchilarga ko'chirib bermang — faqat ekranda ko'rsating.
Namuna essay Jony Academy tomonidan yozilgan (Band 8 darajasi); undagi misollar umumiy bilimga asoslangan, raqam to'qilmagan.
mistakes: "In addition, it means that rents are high." (it = homelessness?)
"In addition, a lack of housing means that rents remain high."
Olmosh eng yaqin mos otga bog'lanib o'qiladi — ma'no buziladi
Zanjirda bo'g'in yo'q: "More buses → cleaner air."
"More buses → fewer cars → less exhaust → cleaner air."
Aniq signal: Firstly / As a result / More importantly
Bog'lanishni o'quvchi taxmin qilishga majbur — Band 6 CC (Band 7 da biroz over/under use mumkin, lekin bog'lanish aniq qoladi)

how: CORE — argument turlarining asosiy tili; STRONG — sabab-oqibatni aylantirish va urg'u; SUPER — Band 8 darajasidagi aniq iboralar.
Har so'z bilan namuna essay mavzusi (jamoat transporti) yoki o'z shahringiz haqida bitta argument gapi tuzing.
Takror (25-dars): outweigh, provided that — yangi so'z sifatida sanalmaydi; ularni bugungi argument gaplarida faol ishlating.
core: As a result, journey times become shorter.
Fares are high, which means that many families walk.
Yo'l haqi baland, bu ko'p oilalar piyoda yurishi degani.
Heavy traffic causes serious air pollution.
Og'ir tirbandlik jiddiy havo ifloslanishiga sabab bo'ladi.
Low wages can lead to financial stress.
Past maosh moliyaviy stressga olib kelishi mumkin.
The policy could result in fewer accidents.
Siyosat kamroq baxtsiz hodisalarga olib kelishi mumkin.
Air quality is likely to improve.
Without support, pensioners may feel isolated.
More importantly, it would make streets safer.
Undan ham muhimi, bu ko'chalarni xavfsizroq qiladi.
strong: Congestion is often the result of poor planning.
Many health problems result from inactivity.
Ko'p sog'liq muammolari kamharakatlikdan kelib chiqadi.
Rising rents put pressure on young families.
O'sayotgan ijara yosh oilalarga bosim o'tkazadi.
The state must step in to help.
What is more, the service would be cleaner.
super: Free travel has a knock-on effect on air quality.
Bepul yo'l havo sifatiga zanjirli ta'sir qiladi.
I support it, provided that it is funded properly.
Housing problems have an impact on everyone.

class_ex.title: 1-mashq: Bu qaysi argument turi?
class_ex.instr: Har gapga belgi qo'ying: + (qo'shish), → (sabab-oqibat), B (bashorat: If/When + modal), Q (qarama-qarshilik: If ... not / Without).
items: "Firstly, sport improves fitness. In addition, it teaches teamwork."
"Online shopping reduces visits to local shops, which means that many small businesses close."
"If the city built more cycle lanes, fewer people would drive to work."
"Without regular exams, many students would stop revising."
"More importantly, a second language opens doors to better jobs."
"Factories moved abroad; this, in turn, raised unemployment in the region."
why: Ikki alohida sabab qo'shilmoqda: Firstly, In addition.
Bir hodisa ikkinchisiga olib keladi: which means that.
If + past + would — ehtimoli kamroq harakat va uning natijasi.
"Agar bo'lmasa nima bo'ladi?" — Without.
More importantly — bir sababni boshqalaridan kuchliroq ko'rsatadi.
Zanjir: zavodlar ketdi → ishsizlik; "in turn" bo'g'inni ko'rsatadi.

class_ex.title: 2-mashq: Ishonch zinapoyasi
class_ex.instr: Har gapda: A) harakat — doimiy (D), mumkin (M) yoki ehtimoli kam (K)? B) natijaga ishonch — 100%, 75% yoki 50%?
items: "When students sleep well, their concentration improves."
"If schools start later, pupils will be more alert."
"If the tax were doubled, smoking would probably fall."
"If young people move abroad, the economy may lose skilled workers."
"When fuel prices rise, bus use tends to increase."
why: When + present — doimiy hodisa; improves — qat'iy natija.
If + present — kelajakda mumkin; will — to'liq ishonch (asosi bo'lishi kerak!).
If + past — faraziy ramka (ehtimoli kam); would — ramka belgisi, ishonchni "probably" beradi (~75%).
may — faqat imkoniyat.
tends to — umumiy tendensiya, ehtiyotkor ishonch.
class_ex.note: Keyin 2-gapni ehtiyotkor qilib qayta yozing: "... pupils are likely to be / may be more alert."

class_ex.title: 3-mashq: Referencing — "it" ni tuzating
class_ex.instr: Har paragraf oxiridagi gapda olmosh noto'g'ri narsaga bog'lanib qolgan. Olmoshni paraphrase bilan almashtiring.
items: "Tashkent's population is growing quickly, which means that roads are overcrowded. This causes long delays for ambulances. In addition, it pushes up the price of flats."
"Many graduates cannot find jobs in their field. As a result, they accept low-paid work, which damages their motivation. Moreover, it encourages them to emigrate."
"Fast food is cheap and quick. Children who eat it daily often gain weight, and this can lead to diabetes. In addition, it replaces family meals."
answers: "In addition, rapid population growth pushes up the price of flats."
"Moreover, the lack of suitable jobs encourages them to emigrate."
"In addition, the habit of eating fast food replaces family meals."
why: "it" = "This" (yo'llarning tiqilib qolishi)? — o'quvchi shunday o'qiydi (delays, roads — ko'plik, "it" ularga mos emas); aslida birinchi gapdagi aholi o'sishi nazarda tutilgan.
"it" = motivation? — aslida ish topolmaslik muammosi.
"it" = diabetes? — aslida fast food odati.

class_ex.title: 4-mashq: Sabab-natijani aylantiring
class_ex.instr: Qavsdagi so'z bilan gapni qayta yozing; ma'no o'zgarmasin.
items: Long working hours cause stress. (result of)
Poor public transport leads to more private cars. (caused by)
Air pollution can result in breathing problems. (result from)
Smartphone addiction is often the result of boredom. (lead to)
Cheap flights have caused a rise in tourism. (resulted in)
answers: Stress is often the result of long working hours.
An increase in the number of private cars is caused by poor public transport.
Breathing problems can result from air pollution.
Boredom can lead to smartphone addiction.
Cheap flights have resulted in a rise in tourism.
why: B is the result of A — natija oldinga chiqadi.
Passiv: B is caused by A.
result FROM — sababdan oldin; result IN — natijadan oldin.
A can lead to B — sabab egada.
result in = cause; zamon saqlanadi (have resulted).

class_ex.title: 5-mashq: "Agar qilmasak-chi?" — qarama-qarshilik argumenti
class_ex.instr: Har da'voga "If ... does not ..., then ..." yoki "Without ..., ..." bilan bitta salbiy oqibat yozing.
items: Governments should fund public libraries.
Parents should limit children's screen time.
Companies should train older employees in digital skills.
Cities should protect green spaces.
answers: Without free libraries, children from poorer families may have little access to books.
If parents do not set limits, children may spend less time on sleep and exercise.
If companies do not retrain older staff, they could lose valuable experience.
Without parks, city residents may have nowhere to exercise or relax, which can affect their health.
why: Teskari holat → tengsizlik; may — ehtiyotkor ishonch.
If ... do not ... — present; natija uchun may.
could — imkoniyat; biznes nuqtai nazaridan oqibat.
Zanjir ham qo'shildi: parklar yo'q → mashq yo'q → sog'liq.

readings.title: Kitob: Lesson 3 — Argumentning uch turi (3.1–3.3)
readings.source: Pauline Cullen, The Key to IELTS Writing Task 2 — PDF 17, 19, 20
readings.book_ref: 17: qo'shish (+) va urg'u (More importantly); 19: sabab-oqibat zanjiri (→); 20: natijani bashorat qilish — harakat va natijaga ishonch darajasi.

readings.title: Kitob: Lesson 4 — Murakkab argumentlar (4.1–4.3)
readings.source: Pauline Cullen, The Key to IELTS Writing Task 2 — PDF 22, 23, 24
readings.book_ref: 22: qarama-qarshilik (If ... not / Without); 23: turlarni birlashtirish va "it" referencing xatosi; 24: gap uzunligini almashtirish, argument rivojini belgilar bilan kuzatish, cause / result variantlari.

readings.title: NAMUNA ESSAY — to'rt argument turi bitta essayda
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna essayi (Band 8 darajasi, 306 so'z)
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: Some people believe that public transport in large cities should be free for everyone. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.  |  REJA: free PT → car = extra cost → ↓ cars → ↓ congestion → ↑ air // + low-income save money; + (MORE IMP.) young/old access; Q: without → isolated → health // cost = taxes; if no budget → ↓ quality ∴ gradually // ∴ agree, step by step.
text: In many large cities, buses and metro trains are already crowded, yet the roads remain full of private cars. It has been suggested that public transport should be made free for all passengers. I largely agree with this idea, because the benefits for the city as a whole would outweigh the cost, although some limits may be necessary.

The main argument for free travel is its effect on traffic. When a bus journey costs nothing, many drivers begin to see their car as an unnecessary expense, which means that fewer vehicles enter the city centre each morning. This, in turn, reduces congestion and shortens journey times for everyone, including those who still need to drive. As a result, air quality is also likely to improve, since exhaust fumes are one of the main sources of pollution in busy streets.

There are also social reasons for supporting this policy. Firstly, low-income families, who often live far from their workplaces, spend a considerable share of their wages on daily travel. Removing fares would leave them more money for food, housing and education. More importantly, free transport would give young people and pensioners easier access to schools, hospitals and cultural events. Without such support, these groups may remain isolated, and this isolation can gradually damage their health and well-being.

Admittedly, free travel is not truly free, as the cost must be covered by taxes. If a city cannot increase its budget, then the quality of the service could fall, and overcrowded, poorly maintained buses may discourage people from using them. For this reason, the policy should be introduced gradually, beginning with students and the elderly.

In conclusion, making public transport free would reduce traffic, improve air quality and support those on lower incomes. I therefore support the idea, provided that it is funded carefully and introduced step by step.
glossary: a considerable share of — ... ning katta qismi
paraphrases: public transport

tasks.title: Namunada argument turlarini toping
tasks.type: Rangli marker bilan
tasks.instr: Essay va rejaga qarab javob bering.
items: 2-xatboshidagi zanjirni ayting: boshlang'ich da'vo va undan keyingi 4 bo'g'in.
Zanjir bo'g'inlarini qaysi 3 ta ibora bog'laydi?
3-xatboshida qaysi sabab eng muhim deb ko'rsatilgan va qanday?
Qarama-qarshilik argumenti qaysi gapda?
"is likely to improve" — nega "will improve" emas?
"this isolation" — nega "it" emas?
4-xatboshidagi If-gapda harakat qanchalik ehtimolli?
answers: bepul yo'l → mashina ortiqcha xarajat → markazga kamroq mashina → tirbandlik kamayadi → havo tozalanadi
which means that; This, in turn; As a result
yosh va keksalarning maktab, shifoxonaga kirishi — More importantly
"Without such support, these groups may remain isolated..."
Natijaga ishonch to'liq emas (taxminan 75%) — ehtiyotkor bashorat
"it" eng yaqin birlik otga (such support) bog'lanib qolishi mumkin (groups — ko'plik); "this isolation" aniq
If + present (cannot increase) — mumkin bo'lgan holat; natija — could fall, may discourage (50%)
why: Sabab-oqibat (→) — har bo'g'in keyingisiga olib keladi.
Zanjir tili: which means that, in turn, As a result.
Qo'shish (+) + urg'u.
Qarama-qarshilik: "agar yordam bo'lmasa-chi?".

Bashorat: ramka real (When + present) bo'lib qoladi, ishonch darajasini "is likely to" beradi. 1-, 3-xatboshi va xulosadagi "would" to'g'ri: u yerda siyosatning o'zi faraziy (hali joriy qilinmagan), ya'ni ramka faraziy.
Referencing: uzoqroq g'oyaga aniq qaytish.
Harakat va natija ehtimolini alohida ko'rsatish.

homework_intro: Bugun bitta fikrni to'rt xil yo'l bilan isbotlashni o'rgandik: qo'shish, sabab-oqibat zanjiri, bashorat va qarama-qarshilik. Endi ularni o'zingiz birlashtirasiz.

Birinchi vazifa — savol: "Many young people in developing countries move from villages to big cities. Do the advantages of this trend outweigh the disadvantages?" Faqat bitta body xatboshi (110–140 so'z): kamida 3 argument turi, belgili reja bilan.

Ikkinchi vazifa — L09 Mock 1 dagi Task 2 essayingizda (JonyOS dagi Mock 1 natijangizda saqlangan) yoki 25-dars uy vazifasidagi body xatboshingizda If, when, as a result, will, would, could, might so'zlarini toping: ramka va modal ishonchingizga mosmi? Kamida 3 gapni tuzating. Bunday matni yo'q o'quvchi vazifadagi Band 6 parchasi bilan ishlaydi.
Uchinchi vazifa — CORE va STRONG ro'yxatidan 8 ta ibora bilan o'z shahringizdagi bitta muammo (tirbandlik, uy-joy, ish) haqida sabab-oqibat gaplari.

homework.title: Body xatboshi: qishloqdan shaharga ko'chish
homework.instr: Avval belgili reja (+ → ∴), keyin 110–140 so'zli xatboshi. Kamida 3 argument turi; uzoqdagi g'oyaga paraphrase bilan qayting.
homework.answers: Namuna reja: young → city = jobs → ↑ income → send money home → village families ↑ // + (MORE IMP.) skills/education // Q: without migration → rural unemployment ↑ // BUT if too many leave → villages lose workers (may) ∴ advantages > disadvantages, if managed. Namuna xatboshi (124 so'z; →, +, Q va bashorat bor): The main advantage of this trend is economic. When young people move to cities, they usually find better-paid jobs than those available in rural areas, which means that they can send money home. This income, in turn, allows their families to improve their houses and pay for their younger siblings' education. More importantly, life in a city gives young migrants access to universities and training courses, so they gain skills that are difficult to acquire in a village. Without this opportunity, many talented young people may remain unemployed or stuck in low-paid farm work. Admittedly, if too many young adults leave, villages may lose the workers they need. However, provided that this movement is managed carefully, its benefits are likely to outweigh its drawbacks.

homework.title: Modal va shart gaplarni tekshirish
homework.instr: Manba: L09 Mock 1 dagi Task 2 essayingiz (JonyOS dagi Mock 1 natijangizda saqlangan) yoki 25-dars uy vazifasidagi body xatboshingiz. 3 gap: asl variant → tuzatilgan variant → nega (ramka / ishonch darajasi). Essayi yo'q o'quvchi uchun Band 6 parchasi (5 ta xato, kamida 3 tasini tuzating): "If the government makes university free, every young person will go to university. This will solve the problem of unemployment completely, because graduates will always find good jobs. Also, it will make the country rich in a few years. If students did not pay fees, they will study harder."
homework.answers: Masalan: "This will stop crime." → "This could reduce some types of crime." — 100% ishonchga asos yo'q. Band 6 parchasi kaliti: (1) every young person will go → more young people are likely to go (hammasi — haddan oshgan da'vo); (2) This will solve the problem of unemployment completely → This could help to reduce unemployment; (3) graduates will always find good jobs → graduates are more likely to find skilled jobs; (4) Also, it will make the country rich in a few years → In the long term, a better-educated workforce may strengthen the economy ("it" noaniq + 100% da'vo); (5) If students did not pay fees, they will study harder → ramkalar aralashgan: "If students did not pay fees, they might study harder." yoki "If students do not pay fees, they may study harder."

homework.title: 8 ta sabab-oqibat gapi
homework.instr: Har gapda bitta ibora (as a result, lead to, result from, in turn...); kamida 2 gap aylantirilgan shaklda (B is the result of A).
homework.answers: Namuna: "Traffic congestion in Tashkent is largely the result of the growing number of private cars." / "Many breathing problems result from exhaust fumes." (ikkalasi aylantirilgan shakl) / "Long commutes can lead to stress and tiredness." / "Rising rents put pressure on young families; this, in turn, makes it harder for them to save money." Tekshirish: 27-dars Kirish bosqichida ustoz 2–3 o'quvchining gapini doskada tez tahlil qiladi.

normativ: reja + 3 argument turi + to'g'ri referencing, 110–140 so'z

kahoot.q: Which linker shows that one reason is stronger than the others?
kahoot.explain: More importantly — urg'u: bu sabab boshqalaridan kuchliroq. Qolganlari sabablarni teng qo'shadi.

kahoot.q: Which symbol best shows a cause-and-effect chain in a plan?
kahoot.explain: → — bir g'oya ikkinchisiga olib keladi (domino). + qo'shish, = ya'ni (tushuntirish).

kahoot.q: Choose the most suitable cautious prediction.
options: Free meals could improve pupils' concentration.
Free meals will solve every single school problem.
Free meals always make all pupils clever.
Free meals are definitely going to end poverty.
kahoot.explain: Asossiz 100% da'vo mantiqni zaiflashtiradi. could — ehtiyotkor, ishonarli bashorat.

kahoot.q: "When homeless people get shelter, their health often improves." The action is...
kahoot.explain: When + present simple — doimiy, tez-tez sodir bo'ladigan harakat.

kahoot.q: "If taxes were raised, few people would complain." The action is seen as...
kahoot.explain: If + past simple (were raised) — ehtimoli kamroq, faraziy harakat.

kahoot.q: Which modal shows about 50% certainty about a result?
kahoot.explain: will / is certain to — 100%; is likely to / probably — 75%; may / could / might — 50%. would — faraziy ramka belgisi, ishonch darajasi emas.

kahoot.q: Which sentence is a contrast argument ("what if we don't")?
options: Without libraries, poorer children may read less.
Libraries are quiet places where people can study.
Firstly, libraries lend books to local residents.
Libraries lead to more reading among children.
kahoot.explain: Without ... — "agar bo'lmasa nima bo'ladi?" savoliga javob: qarama-qarshilik argumenti.

kahoot.q: "...homelessness rises further. In addition, it means rents stay high." What is wrong?
options: "In addition" is too formal for an essay
kahoot.explain: Olmosh eng yaqin mos otga bog'lanib o'qiladi. Paraphrase kerak: "a lack of accommodation means..."

kahoot.q: Choose the correct reversal of "Poor diet can cause obesity."
options: Obesity can result from poor diet.
Obesity can result in poor diet.
Poor diet can result from obesity.
Obesity can lead to poor diet.
kahoot.explain: result FROM + sabab; result IN + natija. Ma'no o'zgarmasligi kerak.

kahoot.q: What makes writing complex at Band 7+, according to this lesson?
options: Many rare and difficult grammar structures
kahoot.explain: Murakkablik argumentdan keladi: murakkab g'oyani aniq tushuntirish. Sun'iy qiyin til — xato manbai.

kahoot.q: Why can't a fixed essay template choose your argument type?
options: Your ideas decide the type, then the language
Templates are always too short for Task 2
Linkers are not allowed in academic essays
kahoot.explain: G'oya → argument turi → til. Tartib teskari bo'lsa, bog'lovchilar g'oyaga mos kelmaydi.

kahoot.q: Removing ALL linkers from a paragraph usually...
kahoot.explain: Bog'lovchilarni referencing bilan qisman almashtirish mumkin, lekin hammasini tushirsangiz, o'quvchi bog'lanishni taxmin qiladi — bu Band 6 CC belgisi (Band 7 da biroz over/under use mumkin, lekin bog'lanish aniq qoladi).

kahoot.q: Which phrase shows the next link in a chain? Fewer cars enter the centre. This, ___, reduces congestion.
kahoot.explain: in turn — o'z navbatida: zanjirning keyingi bo'g'ini.

kahoot.q: Demand for flats ___ the number available, so rents rise.
kahoot.explain: exceed — oshib ketmoq: talab taklifdan ko'p.

kahoot.q: The state must ___ to help families who are struggling.
kahoot.explain: step in — yordamga kirishmoq, aralashmoq.

kahoot.q: I support the plan, ___ it is funded properly.
kahoot.explain: provided that — ... sharti bilan. Pozitsiyani cheklov bilan beradi.

kahoot.q: In my view, the benefits of free travel ___ the costs.
kahoot.explain: outweigh — ustun bo'lmoq (foyda > xarajat).

kahoot.q: Rising fares ___ inequality between rich and poor.
kahoot.explain: exacerbate — yomonlashtirmoq. alleviate esa aksincha — yengillashtirmoq.

kahoot.q: Free travel has a ___ effect on air quality.
kahoot.explain: a knock-on effect — zanjirli (bilvosita) ta'sir.

kahoot.q: Rising rents ___ young families.
kahoot.explain: put pressure on — bosim o'tkazmoq.

lessons.title: Writing Task 2 (3): Tushuntirish, dalil va misollar
lessons.grammar_topic: G'oyani qachon va qanday tushuntirish (fakt va fikr, perspektiva, atamani ta'riflash, "this means / in other words"), shoshilinch xulosadan qochish va misolni haqiqiy dalil sifatida ishlatish
lessons.vocab_topic: Tushuntirish va dalil tili: in other words, this means, by X I mean, in my country, thus, for instance, to illustrate; ehtiyotkorlik so'zlari (for some people, tend to)
lessons.book_ref: Pauline Cullen, "The Key to IELTS Writing Task 2": Lesson 5 — Explaining and clarifying ideas (5.1–5.3), Lesson 6 — Supporting evidence and giving examples (6.1–6.3); PDF betlari 26–37.
objectives: Fakt (tekshirsa bo'ladigan) va fikr (muhokama qilinadigan) farqini bilish; hamma uchun to'g'ri bo'lmagan fikrni modal va cheklovchi so'zlar bilan aniqlashtirish.
O'z perspektivasini examinerga tushuntirish: kontekst berish ("In my country, ...") va kalit atamani ta'riflash ("By ..., I mean ...").
"This means / which means / In other words" ni to'g'ri ishlatish: tushuntirish (=) va natija (→) farqini ajratish (In other words — faqat =; This means (that) / which means — = yoki →).
Shoshilinch xulosa (jumping to a conclusion) va savolni o'z tajribasi bilan noto'g'ri talqin qilishdan qochish — Task Response ni saqlash.
Band 6 misol xatolarini topish: shablon va to'qilgan statistika, misol emas — takror, arzimas misoldan katta xulosa.
Umumiy g'oya va aniq dalilni bog'lash: dalil → Thus, xulosa yoki xulosa → For example, dalil.
materials: Kitob sahifalari (Reading bo'limidagi 2 rasm): Lesson 5 (5.1–5.3) va Lesson 6 (6.1–6.3) — proyektorda.
Jony Academy namuna essayi (bolalarga pul boshqarishni kim o'rgatishi kerak) — har o'quvchiga chop etilgan.
Doskada ikki belgi: = (tushuntirish, ya'ni) va → (natija); ikki shakl: katta doira — umumiy g'oya, to'rtburchak — aniq dalil.
Doskada "misol testi" — 4 savol: dolzarbmi? to'qilganmi? g'oyani takrorlayaptimi? xulosadan arzimasroqmi?

O'quvchilarning o'z Task 2 ishlari (uy vazifasi uchun): Mock 1 ning Task 2 essayi (JonyOS dagi Mock 1 natijasida saqlangan) va 25–26-darslarda uyda yozilgan body xatboshilari. Bunday yozma ishi bo'lmagan o'quvchi uy vazifasidagi Jony Band 6 xatboshisi bilan ishlaydi.
timeline: Kirish
26-darsdan takror: 4 argument turi. 26-dars uy vazifasi: 2–3 o'quvchining sabab-oqibat gapi doskada tez tahlil qilinadi. Savol: "Examiner sizning shahringizni biladimi?"
Qachon tushuntirish kerak (5.1)
Hamma uchun to'g'rimi yoki faqat men uchunmi? Modal va cheklovchi so'zlar; fakt va fikr — 1-mashq.
Perspektiva va ta'rif (5.2)
Kontekst berish, atamani ta'riflash; = va → farqi — 2-mashq.
Shoshilinch xulosa (5.3)
Kitobdagi misol ekranda; savolni noto'g'ri talqin qilish Task Response ga qanday zarar berishi; o'quvchilar sababni aytadi.
Misollar: uch xato (6.1–6.2)
Band 7 / 8 / 9 talablari; to'qilgan statistika, takror "misol", arzimas misol — 3-mashq.
Boshqa usullar (6.3)
Umumiy g'oya — doira, dalil — to'rtburchak; dalil → Thus / fikr → For example — 4-mashq.
Namuna essay tahlili
Jony Academy essayi: perspektiva, ta'rif, dalil va "Thus" qayerda; misol testini qo'llash.
Mini-yozuv
5-mashq: to'qilgan misolni haqiqiy dalil bilan almashtirish, juftlikda.
Xulosa va vazifa
Uyga: o'z Task 2 ishlaringiz auditi (Mock 1 essayi, 25–26-dars xatboshilari) va bitta body xatboshi.

intro: Essayda tushuntirish uch holatda kerak: 1) kalit atamaning ma'nosini aytish; 2) g'oyangiz kontekstini (qayerda, kim uchun) berish; 3) murakkab g'oyani soddaroq qayta aytish. Asosiy savol: "Bu fikr HAMMA uchun to'g'rimi yoki faqat men va mening muhitim uchunmi?"

Hamma uchun to'g'ri bo'lmagan fikrni present simple bilan umumiy haqiqat qilib yozmang. Modal fe'llar (can, may, tend to) va cheklovchi so'zlar (some people, in many cases, for those who...) fikringizni aniq va ishonarli qiladi: "Fruit can make some people feel unwell" — "Fruit makes people unwell" dan to'g'riroq.

FAKT va FIKR: fakt — o'lchash va tekshirish mumkin (shahardagi mashinalar soni); fikr — faqat muhokama qilinadi (bu eng katta muammo). Task 2 savoli ko'pincha fakt + fikr beradi; essayingizning vazifasi — fikrni muhokama qilish va asosli pozitsiyaga kelish. Shuning uchun Task 2 da "to'g'ri javob" yo'q.

PERSPEKTIVA: sizning shahringiz examinerning shahriga o'xshamaydi. Tirbandlik, adliya, oila, ta'lim haqida yozsangiz, o'quvchiga muammoni SIZ ko'rgandek ko'rsating: "In my country, where...", "In Tashkent, most families...". Kontekstsiz dalil examinerga mantiqsiz ko'rinishi mumkin.

TA'RIF va QAYTA AYTISH: jiddiy mavzuda kalit atamani ta'riflang ("By success, I mean..."). Aniq qoida: "In other words" — FAQAT = (xuddi shu fikrni boshqacha, aniqroq aytish); undan keyin natija kelmaydi. "This means (that) / which means" — = (tushuntirish) yoki → (natija) bo'lishi mumkin: "Rising prices mean fewer people can buy a home" (rejada →). Rejada belgini qo'ying: = bo'lsa — In other words yoki This means (that); → bo'lsa — This means (that) yoki As a result (In other words emas). Aralashtirsangiz, mantiq buziladi.

SHOSHILINCH XULOSA: yetarli dalilsiz tez qaror — "He is late every day, so he is lazy." Imtihonda bu ikki xil zarar beradi: argument mantiqsiz bo'ladi va savolni o'z tajribangiz bilan noto'g'ri talqin qilsangiz (masalan, "travelling" ni faqat "driving" deb o'qisangiz) Task Response pasayadi. Yechim: reja paytida savolni qayta o'qing, perspektivani ochiq ayting, mavzudan chetga chiqqan gapni o'chiring.

DALIL — nega bu fikrga ishonganingiz. Band descriptorlarda: band 7 da g'oyalar "overgeneralise" qilishi yoki fokusdan chiqishi mumkin; band 8 da g'oyalar dolzarb, yaxshi kengaytirilgan va qo'llab-quvvatlangan ("relevant, well extended and supported"); band 9 da to'liq kengaytirilgan. Ya'ni "har xatboshida misol bo'lsin" — yetarli emas: misol fikrni ISBOTLASHI kerak.

Band 6 dagi uch tipik xato: 1) SHABLON — har xatboshi oxirida mexanik "For example" va to'qilgan statistika ("a 35% reduction in..."); 2) MISOL EMAS — oldingi fikrni boshqa so'z bilan takrorlash; 3) ARZIMAS MISOL — kichik kundalik holatdan katta xulosa (sumka sotib olish → global turizm qulaydi).

Boshqa usullar: umumiy g'oya keng, dalil aniq. Har doim "For example" shart emas — dalil gapning o'zida bo'lishi mumkin ("including firefighters and the police"). Ikki tartib: A) avval dalil, keyin "Thus, ..." xulosa; B) avval fikr, keyin "For example, ..." dalil. Eng muhimi: dalilni ko'rib xulosa chiqaring, xulosaga dalil to'qimang.
formulas: "Online classes can be isolating for some students."
"Online classes are isolating." — umumiy haqiqat emas
"In Uzbekistan, where family budgets are discussed openly, ..."
"By managing money, I mean budgeting, saving and understanding loans."
Atamani har kim o'zicha tushunadi deb o'ylash
In other words, / This means that ... (tushuntirish)
"Many cities have more people than homes. In other words, many residents have nowhere to live."
"In other words" dan keyin yangi g'oya yoki natija (→) — natija uchun "This means that / As a result"
"Many sign contracts without reading them. Thus, a school course would protect them."
umumiy g'oya. For example, aniq holat.
"Parents teach by example. For instance, children watch them plan a shopping list."
"For example" dan keyin fikr takrori yoki to'qilgan raqam
presentation: Qanday bilaman, g'oyani tushuntirish kerakmi?
O'zingizdan so'rang: "Boshqa davlatdagi odam buni shu zahoti tushunadimi va rozi bo'ladimi?" Yo'q bo'lsa — kontekst, ta'rif yoki cheklovchi so'z qo'shing.
Statistika yozsam kuchliroq ko'rinmaydimi?
To'qilgan raqam examinerga g'alati ko'rinadi va ko'pincha fikrni isbotlamaydi. Umumiy bilim va aniq holat (kim, qayerda, nima bo'ladi) ishonchliroq.
Har xatboshida "For example" bo'lishi shartmi?
Yo'q. Dalil gap ichida ham bo'lishi mumkin (such as, including). "For example" kerak bo'lganda — ta'kidlash uchun alohida gapda.
O'z shahrim haqida yozsam bo'ladimi?
Ha, bu yaxshi dalil. Faqat kontekstni tushuntiring va misolni savol bilan bog'lang.
"This means" ni qayerda ishlataman?
Tushuntirish yoki boshqacha qarash uchun (=), yoki natija uchun (→). Rejada belgini qo'yib, qaysi biri ekanini tekshiring. "In other words" esa faqat = uchun — natijadan oldin ishlatilmaydi.
Mavzudan biroz chetga chiqsam nima bo'ladi?
Task Response pasayadi. Savolda yo'q narsani uzoq tushuntirish — ko'p so'z, kam ball. Chetga chiqqan gapni o'chiring.
notes: Kitobdagi band 6–6.5 parchalarni o'quvchilarga ko'chirib bermang; ekranda ko'rsating va xatoni og'zaki toping. Mashqlar uchun shu darsdagi o'z gaplarimiz ishlatiladi.
3-mashqdagi "to'qilgan statistika" ataylab yozilgan xato misol; o'quvchilarga aytib qo'ying — bunday raqamni essayda ishlatmaslik kerak.
Namuna essayda raqam to'qilmagan; dalillar — umumiy bilim va o'zbek hayotidan tanish holatlar (bozor, muddatli to'lov ilovalari).
mistakes: "Fast food makes people ill." (umumiy haqiqat sifatida)
"Eating fast food every day can harm people's health."
Hamma uchun to'g'ri emas — modal va cheklov kerak
"For example, 73% of workers in my city are stressed."
"For example, many office workers in Tashkent spend two hours a day in traffic."
"For example, if buses are good, people use buses."
"For example, the Tashkent metro is full every morning with commuters."
"Online shopping is convenient, so local economies will collapse."
"..., so some small local shops may lose customers."
Perspektivani aytish: "In my city, most people travel by car, so..."
Savolni noto'g'ri talqin — Task Response pasayadi

how: CORE — tushuntirish va dalil berish tili; STRONG — ehtiyotkor va aniq ifodalar; SUPER — Band 8 uchun perspektiva va xulosa iboralari.
Har ibora bilan o'z shahringiz yoki namuna essay mavzusi (pul boshqarish) haqida bitta gap tuzing.
Takror so'zlar: evidence, claim, relevant (25-dars) va this means that (26-dars) — yangi so'z sifatida sanalmaydi; bugun ularni tushuntirish va dalil gaplarida faol ishlating.
core: In other words, many residents have nowhere to live.
Boshqacha aytganda, ko'p aholining yashash joyi yo'q.
This means that families have less to spend.
Bu oilalarning sarflashga kamroq puli qolishi degani.
By success, I mean a stable and happy life.
Muvaffaqiyat deganda barqaror va baxtli hayotni nazarda tutaman.
There is little evidence for this claim.
The writer's claim is not supported.
For instance, children help at the bazaar.
Your example must be relevant to the question.
A fact can be verified; an opinion cannot.
Explain the context for your idea.
strong: Remote work can be lonely for some people.
Masofaviy ish ba'zi odamlarda yolg'izlik hissini uyg'otishi mumkin.
Young adults tend to buy on credit.
A pensioner's perspective on the city differs.
Do not jump to a conclusion about the question.
Every child needs this, regardless of background.
Kelib chiqishidan qat'i nazar, har bir bola bunga muhtoj.
super: To illustrate this, consider instalment apps.
Buni ko'rsatish uchun muddatli to'lov ilovalarini olaylik.
This is particularly true in large cities.
Do not go off on a tangent about driving.
A Band 9 essay presents fully extended, well-supported ideas.
Band 9 essayida to'liq kengaytirilgan, yaxshi asoslangan g'oyalar beriladi.

class_ex.title: 1-mashq: Fakt yoki fikr? Hamma uchun to'g'rimi?
class_ex.instr: Har gap: F (fakt — tekshirsa bo'ladi) yoki O (fikr — muhokama qilinadi). Agar O bo'lsa va hamma uchun to'g'ri bo'lmasa, uni modal yoki cheklovchi so'z bilan qayta ayting.
items: "The number of cars in Tashkent has grown in the last ten years."
"Traffic is the worst problem in modern cities."
"Studying abroad makes students more independent."
"IELTS Writing Task 2 requires at least 250 words."
"Working from home is boring."
"Children who read every day learn new words faster."
answers: O — "Traffic is one of the most serious problems in many large cities."
O — "Studying abroad can make students more independent."
O — "Working from home can feel isolating for some people."
O — "Children who read every day tend to learn new words faster."
why: Statistika bilan tekshiriladi.
Baho — "eng yomon" muhokama qilinadi; cheklov bilan ehtiyotkor.
Ko'pchilik uchun to'g'ri, lekin hamma uchun emas — can.
Imtihonning rasmiy talabi — tekshirsa bo'ladi.
Shaxsiy his — some people bilan cheklash.
Kuzatuvga asoslangan umumlashtirish — tend to xavfsizroq.

class_ex.title: 2-mashq: = yoki →? "This means" to'g'ri ishlatilganmi?
class_ex.instr: Har gapda ibora tushuntirish (=) yoki natija (→) ekanini ayting. Qoida: "In other words" — faqat =; "This means (that) / which means" — = yoki →. Agar ibora noto'g'ri ishlatilgan bo'lsa (keyingi gap na tushuntirish, na natija; yoki "In other words" dan keyin natija kelgan), "xato" deng va tuzating (to'g'ri ibora yoki mantiqan bog'langan davom).
items: "Rents in the capital have doubled, which means that many young couples live with their parents."
"Many villages have no secondary school. In other words, children must travel to the district centre to study."
"Online learning is flexible. This means that the internet was invented in the last century."
"The city lacks affordable housing. In other words, ordinary workers cannot pay for a flat near their job."
"Fuel prices have risen sharply. This means that taxis have become more expensive."
answers: xato — bu natija (→): "As a result" yoki "This means that" kerak
xato — bog'lanish yo'q; masalan: "This means that students can study at their own pace."
why: Ijara oshdi → natija: ota-ona bilan yashash.
Maktab yo'q → shuning uchun bolalar tuman markaziga qatnaydi: bu qayta aytish emas, NATIJA. "In other words" faqat = uchun; natijada "As a result, ..." yoki "This means that ..." ishlatiladi.
Keyingi gap birinchisini tushuntirmaydi ham, natijasi ham emas — mantiqiy bog'lanish yo'q.
Xuddi shu muammo odamlar nuqtai nazaridan qayta aytilgan.
Sabab → natija.

class_ex.title: 3-mashq: Misol testidan o'tadimi?
class_ex.instr: Har parchada misol muammosini nomlang: T (to'qilgan statistika / shablon), R (misol emas — takror), A (arzimas misoldan katta xulosa) yoki OK (yaxshi dalil).
items: "Governments should support local farmers. For example, a 47% rise in farm profits was recorded in one region after such a policy."
"Public libraries are useful. For example, if there are libraries, people can use them."
"Social media lets us share holiday photos easily. Therefore, it will destroy traditional family life."
"Learning a second language widens job opportunities. In Uzbekistan, for instance, many tourism and IT companies require English from new staff."
"Exercise is important. An example of this is that exercising is good for people."
why: Aniq, lekin manbasiz raqam — to'qilgan ko'rinadi va fikrni tushuntirmaydi.
"Misol" birinchi gapni takrorlaydi.
Arzimas dalil (surat almashish) → juda katta xulosa (oila buziladi).
Aniq, tanish, dolzarb holat fikrni isbotlaydi.
Misol belgisi bor, lekin mazmun — takror.

class_ex.title: 4-mashq: Dalil → Thus / Fikr → For example
class_ex.instr: Har juftlikni ikki tartibda yozing: A) dalil + "Thus, ..."; B) fikr + "For example, ...". Kerak bo'lsa referencing qo'shing.
items: Fikr: public transport reduces inequality. Dalil: pensioners and students in Tashkent travel cheaply by metro to hospitals and universities.
Fikr: school uniforms can reduce pressure on families. Dalil: parents do not have to buy fashionable clothes for every school day.
Fikr: remote work suits some jobs better than others. Dalil: programmers can work online, while nurses and bus drivers cannot.
answers: A) Pensioners and students in Tashkent can reach hospitals and universities cheaply by metro. Thus, public transport helps reduce inequality. / B) Public transport helps reduce inequality. For example, pensioners and students in Tashkent can travel cheaply by metro.

A) With uniforms, parents do not need to buy fashionable clothes for every school day. Thus, uniforms can reduce financial pressure on families. / B) Uniforms can reduce pressure on families. For instance, parents do not have to buy fashionable clothes for every day.

A) Programmers can easily work online, whereas nurses and bus drivers cannot. Thus, remote work suits some jobs better than others. / B) Remote work suits some jobs better than others. For example, programmers can work online, while nurses cannot.
why: Aniq dalil birinchi — xulosa "Thus" bilan mantiqan kelib chiqadi.
"For instance" — "For example" ning sinonimi; takrordan qochish.
Qarama-qarshi misol (whereas) ham dalil bo'la oladi.

class_ex.title: 5-mashq: To'qilgan misolni haqiqiy dalilga almashtiring
class_ex.instr: Har gapdagi "misol"ni o'chirib, o'rniga umumiy bilim yoki o'z tajribangizdan aniq, dolzarb dalil yozing (raqamsiz).
items: "Tourism helps the economy. For example, 89% of people in Samarkand work in tourism."
"Children should learn to cook. For example, a study showed that 60% of teenagers cannot boil an egg."
"Technology makes life easier. For example, technology is very useful for everyone."
answers: "For example, in Samarkand and Bukhara, many families earn a living from guesthouses, crafts and guided tours."
"For instance, students who move to another city for university often rely on expensive fast food because they have never learned to cook."
"For instance, paying bills or booking a doctor's appointment can now be done on a phone in minutes, instead of waiting in a queue."
why: To'qilgan foizdan ko'ra tanish, tekshirsa bo'ladigan holat ishonchliroq.
Dalil fikrga bevosita bog'langan: pishirishni bilmaslik → muammo.
Asl gap misol emas edi — takror; endi aniq holat.

readings.title: Kitob: Lesson 5 — Tushuntirish, perspektiva, shoshilinch xulosa
readings.source: Pauline Cullen, The Key to IELTS Writing Task 2 — PDF 26, 27, 29
readings.book_ref: 26: qachon tushuntirish kerak, modal bilan aniqlashtirish, fakt va fikr; 27: perspektiva, atamani ta'riflash, = belgisi; 29: shoshilinch xulosa va savolni noto'g'ri talqin qilgan yuqori darajali nomzod misoli.

readings.title: Kitob: Lesson 6 — Dalil va misollar
readings.source: Pauline Cullen, The Key to IELTS Writing Task 2 — PDF 32, 33, 34, 35
readings.book_ref: 32: dalil nima va band 7/8/9 talablari, 1-muammo — shablon va to'qilgan misol; 33: 2-muammo — misol emas, takror; 34: 3-muammo — arzimas misoldan katta xulosa; 35: umumiy g'oya va aniq dalil, "Thus" va "For example" tartibi.

readings.title: NAMUNA ESSAY — perspektiva, ta'rif va dalil
readings.qtype: Discuss both views + opinion — to'liq javob (Jony Academy)
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna essayi (Band 8 darajasi, 293 so'z)
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: Some people think that schools should teach children how to manage money. Others believe that this is the responsibility of parents. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.  |  REJA: parents: habits at home = daily practical lessons; UZ: bazaar, budgets discussed // schools: DEF (money = interest, loans, online payments); instalment apps → sign without reading; parents can't explain ∴ school = equal protection // my view: both — theory + practice (allowance) // ∴ schools main role.
text: Financial skills such as budgeting and saving are essential in adult life, but there is disagreement about who should teach them. While some argue that this is a family matter, I believe schools are now better placed to provide this knowledge, although parents still have an important role to play.

Those who see money as a family responsibility point out that children acquire most of their habits at home. In other words, a child who watches his parents plan a weekly shopping list or save for a holiday is receiving practical lessons every day that no textbook can offer. In my country, Uzbekistan, where household budgets are often discussed openly, children are regularly asked to help at the bazaar, so many learn to count change and compare prices from an early age.

However, not every family has this knowledge to pass on. By managing money, I mean more than handling cash: it includes understanding interest, loans and online payments. Instalment apps now allow young adults to buy a new phone with a single click, and many of them sign agreements without reading the conditions. Parents who grew up before these services existed can rarely explain the risks involved. Thus, a school course taught by trained teachers would give every child the same basic protection, regardless of their background.

In my view, the two approaches should work together rather than compete. Schools can provide the theory, while parents can show how it is applied in real life, for instance by giving children a small weekly allowance and allowing them to make their own mistakes with it.

In conclusion, although families naturally shape children's attitudes to money, the growing complexity of modern finance means that schools should take the main responsibility for teaching these skills.
glossary: be better placed to — ... ga ko'proq qodir bo'lmoq
paraphrases: teach children how to manage money
provide this knowledge, teaching these skills, a school course
the responsibility of parents
a family matter, a family responsibility
manage money
financial skills, budgeting and saving, handling cash
give your own opinion
I believe, In my view

tasks.title: Namunada tushuntirish va dalilni toping
tasks.type: Doira (umumiy g'oya) va to'rtburchak (dalil) bilan
tasks.instr: Essay va rejaga qarab javob bering.
items: Muallif o'z perspektivasini qaysi ibora bilan ochadi?
Qaysi kalit atama ta'riflangan va nega bu kerak?
2-xatboshidagi "In other words" — tushuntirish (=) mi yoki natija (→) mi?
3-xatboshida dalil → xulosa tartibi qayerda?
4-xatboshida dalil qanday berilgan — alohida "For example" gap bilanmi?
Essayda to'qilgan raqam bormi? Nega bu yaxshi?
Xulosadagi "means that" — = yoki →?
answers: "In my country, Uzbekistan, where household budgets are often discussed openly, ..."
"managing money" — faqat naqd pul bilan ishlash emas: foiz, kredit va onlayn to'lovlar ham
= — umumiy fikr (odatlar uyda) aniq holat bilan qayta aytilgan
Instalment apps ... sign without reading ... parents can rarely explain → "Thus, a school course..."
Yo'q — gap ichida: "for instance by giving children a small weekly allowance..."
Yo'q; dalillar tanish, tekshirsa bo'ladigan holatlar — ishonchli
why: Perspektiva: examiner o'zbek oilasini ko'rgandek bo'ladi.
Ta'rif pozitsiyani asoslaydi: ota-onalar yangi xizmatlarni bilmasligi mumkin.
"In other words" dan keyin — tushuntirish (=), yangi g'oya yoki natija emas.
A tartib: aniq dalil → umumiy xulosa.
"For example" shart emas; dalil gap ichida ham bo'ladi.
To'qilgan statistika — Band 6 shablon belgisi.
"mean" natijani ham bildiradi — rejada →.

homework_intro: Bugun g'oyani qachon tushuntirish kerakligini va misol qachon haqiqiy dalil bo'lishini o'rgandik. Uyda o'z essaylaringizni shu ko'z bilan tekshirasiz.

Birinchi vazifa — o'z Task 2 ishlaringizni oling: Mock 1 ning Task 2 essayi (JonyOS dagi Mock 1 natijangizda saqlangan) va 25–26-darslarda uyda yozgan body xatboshilaringiz. Ularda "For example", "In other words", "This means" iboralarini toping. Har biriga misol testini qo'llang: dolzarbmi? to'qilganmi? takrormi? arzimasmi? = yoki →? Bunday ishingiz bo'lmasa, 1-vazifadagi Jony Band 6 xatboshisi bilan ishlang.

Ikkinchi vazifa — savol: "In many countries, more people are choosing to live alone. Is this a positive or negative development?" Bitta body xatboshi (120–150 so'z): perspektiva ("In my country, ..."), bitta ta'rif yoki qayta aytish va "Thus" bilan xulosa. To'qilgan raqam yo'q.
Uchinchi vazifa — CORE va STRONG ro'yxatidan 8 ibora bilan o'z shahringiz haqida tushuntirish va dalil gaplari.

homework.title: Essay auditi (Mock 1 essayi va o'z xatboshilaringiz)
homework.instr: Kamida 4 ta misol yoki "this means / in other words" gapi: asl gap → muammo turi (T / R / A yoki = / → xatosi) → tuzatilgan gap. Manba: Mock 1 ning Task 2 essayi (JonyOS dagi Mock 1 natijangizda saqlangan) va 25–26-darslardagi body xatboshilaringiz. O'z ishingiz bo'lmasa — Jony Band 6 xatboshisi: "Free university education benefits society as a whole. For example, 65% of graduates in my city find a job in their first month. An example of this is that free education is good for people. More young people will be able to study. In other words, universities will need more teachers and buildings. However, some students waste their first year, so free education will destroy the economy."
homework.answers: Masalan: "For example, 80% of students use phones in class." → T → "For instance, many pupils check messages during lessons, which distracts them." • Jony Band 6 xatboshisi kaliti: 1) "For example, 65% of graduates in my city..." → T → "For instance, many capable students from low-income families cannot pay tuition fees, so society loses the doctors and engineers they could have become." 2) "An example of this is that free education is good for people." → R → "For example, a free place allows a talented student from a village to train as a doctor and return to work in their home region." 3) "In other words, universities will need more teachers and buildings." → = / → xatosi (bu natija, qayta aytish emas) → "This means that universities will need more teachers and buildings." 4) "..., so free education will destroy the economy." → A → "..., so part of the funding may be wasted unless universities monitor students' progress."

homework.title: Body xatboshi: yolg'iz yashash
homework.instr: Reja (doira / to'rtburchak), keyin 120–150 so'z. Perspektiva, ta'rif yoki qayta aytish, dalil → Thus.
homework.answers: Namuna reja: (doira) living alone → independence // [to'rtburchak] in Uzbekistan, young people traditionally live with parents until marriage; those who rent alone in Tashkent learn to cook, pay bills, manage time ∴ Thus, living alone can build independence // = In other words, they learn adult responsibilities earlier.

homework.title: 8 ta tushuntirish / dalil gapi
homework.instr: Har gapda bitta ibora (in other words, by ... I mean, for instance, thus, tend to, regardless of ...).
homework.answers: Namuna gaplar: "In Tashkent, where public transport is cheap, students tend to travel to university by metro." • "By financial independence, I mean paying your own rent and bills." • "Students who rent a flat alone have to cook, pay bills and plan their own time. Thus, living alone can teach practical skills quickly." Ustoz keyingi darsda eng yaxshi 3 gapni doskaga yozadi.

normativ: perspektiva + ta'rif/qayta aytish + dalil → Thus, to'qilgan raqamsiz

kahoot.q: Which statement is a FACT, not an opinion?
options: The number of cars in the city has doubled.
Pollution is the most important problem.
kahoot.explain: Fakt tekshiriladi (sanash mumkin). Qolganlari — baho, faqat muhokama qilinadi.

kahoot.q: Which sentence is best when an idea is NOT true for everyone?
options: Milk can cause stomach problems for some people.
Milk causes stomach problems for all adults.
Milk always makes people ill, whatever their age.
Everyone feels unwell after drinking milk.
kahoot.explain: Modal (can) + cheklov (for some people) fikrni aniq va ishonarli qiladi.

kahoot.q: "In other words" should be followed by...
options: an explanation of the previous idea
a completely new and unrelated argument
a result of the previous idea
kahoot.explain: In other words — faqat =: oldingi fikrni boshqacha, aniqroq aytish. Natija (→) uchun This means that / As a result; yangi, bog'lanmagan g'oya — xato.

kahoot.q: "Rising prices mean fewer people can buy homes." Here "mean" shows...
kahoot.explain: "mean" natijani ham bildiradi: narx oshdi → kamroq odam uy oladi.

kahoot.q: How can you show the examiner your local perspective?
kahoot.explain: Kontekst beriladi: examiner muammoni siz ko'rgandek ko'radi.

kahoot.q: "He was late three times, so he is lazy." This is an example of...
kahoot.explain: Yetarli dalilsiz tez xulosa. Kechikishning boshqa sabablari bo'lishi mumkin.

kahoot.q: A candidate reads "travelling to work" but writes only about driving. What suffers most?
kahoot.explain: Savolni o'z tajribasi bilan noto'g'ri talqin — mavzudan chiqish. Perspektivani ochiq aytish kerak.

kahoot.q: "For example, 73% of workers in my city feel stressed." (no source) The main problem?
options: It looks like an invented statistic
It uses the wrong tense for a general fact
kahoot.explain: To'qilgan raqam ishonchni yo'qotadi va ko'pincha fikrni tushuntirmaydi.

kahoot.q: "Buses are useful. For example, if there are buses, people use them." The problem?
options: The example only repeats the idea
It needs a statistic to be convincing
kahoot.explain: Misol emas — oldingi fikr takrori. Dalil aniq holat bo'lishi kerak.

kahoot.q: Which is a trivial example leading to an extreme conclusion?
options: Buying a bag online → global tourism will collapse
Cheap metro fares → students reach university easily
kahoot.explain: Arzimas kundalik holatdan juda katta xulosa — mantiqsiz.

kahoot.q: Evidence first, then the point. Which word best starts the second sentence?
kahoot.explain: A tartib: aniq dalil → "Thus," umumiy xulosa. B tartib: fikr → "For example," dalil.

kahoot.q: At which band are ideas "relevant, well extended and supported"?
kahoot.explain: Band 7 da g'oyalar haddan tashqari umumlashishi mumkin; band 8 da dolzarb va asoslangan; band 9 da to'liq.

kahoot.q: By success, I ___ a stable job and a happy family.
kahoot.explain: By X, I mean ... — kalit atamani ta'riflash.

kahoot.q: A fact can be ___; an opinion can only be discussed.
kahoot.explain: verify — tekshirmoq, tasdiqlamoq.

kahoot.q: Which makes the claim cautious? Young adults ___ buy phones on credit.
kahoot.explain: tend to — moyil bo'lmoq: umumlashtirishni yumshatadi.

kahoot.q: Every child needs this skill, ___ their background.
kahoot.explain: regardless of — ... dan qat'i nazar.

kahoot.q: Do not ___ about driving if the question is about work.
kahoot.explain: go off on a tangent — mavzudan chetga chiqmoq.

kahoot.q: A pensioner's ___ on city life is different from a student's.
kahoot.explain: perspective on — ... ga nuqtai nazar.

kahoot.q: There is little ___ to support this claim.
kahoot.explain: evidence — sanalmaydigan ot: "an evidence" / "evidences" deyilmaydi.

kahoot.q: Your example must be ___ to the question.
kahoot.explain: relevant to — ... ga tegishli, dolzarb.

lessons.title: Writing Task 2 (4): Counterargument — argumentni kuchaytirish
lessons.grammar_topic: Counterargument: qarshi fikrni tan olish (concede) va rad etish (refute); savol turiga qarab yondashuvni tanlash (A/B/C); pozitsiyani butun essay bo'yi aniq saqlash
lessons.vocab_topic: Concede va refute tili: Admittedly, It is true that, Some people may argue, Having said that, Although, Nevertheless
lessons.book_ref: Pauline Cullen, The Key to IELTS Writing Task 2 — Lesson 7: Strengthening your argument: counterarguments (7.1 Presenting a counterargument; 7.2 Conceding and refuting; 7.3 Dealing with problems), PDF 38–47.
objectives: Counterargument nima ekanini tushuntira olish: o'z argumenti + qarshi fikrni tan olish + uni rad etish; bu argumentni zaiflashtirmaydi, aksincha kuchaytiradi.
Savol turiga qarab yondashuvni tanlash: faqat "To what extent do you agree or disagree?" / "Do you agree or disagree?" savollarida tanlov bor (A, B yoki C); boshqa turlarda ikkala tomon majburiy.
Qarshi fikrni boshqa odamlarning fikri sifatida belgilash (Some people argue..., Opponents claim...) va uni aniq rad etish (Having said that, However, Although...).
Band 6.5 ning asosiy xatosini ko'rish va tuzatish: qarshi fikr yozuvchining o'z fikridek yozilib, pozitsiya noaniq bo'lib qolishi.
Counterargument'ni mexanik ravishda har essayga qo'shmaslik: faqat argumentni kuchaytirsa va yozuvchi uni boshqara olsa.
Bitta xatboshida concede + refute qilib, pozitsiyani butun essay bo'yi saqlagan holda yozish.
materials: Kitob sahifalari (Reading bo'limidagi ikki rasm): 7.1–7.2 va 7.2–7.3 — proyektorda.
Jony Academy namuna essayi (uy vazifasi haqida, 307 so'z) — har o'quvchiga chop etilgan; ikki rangli marker: ko'k — yozuvchi pozitsiyasi, qizil — qarshi fikr.
Doskada sxema: POSITION → COUNTERARGUMENT → CONCEDE → REFUTE → POSITION.
Doskada ikki ustun: CONCEDE (Admittedly, It is true that, Some people may argue) va REFUTE (Having said that, Nevertheless, However, Although / While).
Taymer: 5-mashq uchun 12 daqiqa.
timeline: Takrorlash
27-dars: argumentni tushuntirish va dalil — 2 ta talaba o'z P3 xatboshisini o'qiydi.
Counterargument nima? (7.1)
Ish taklifi misoli: qaror + "bilaman, siz ... deb o'ylashingiz mumkin" + "lekin...". Nima uchun bu argumentni kuchaytiradi.
Savol turi va yondashuv
Agree/disagree savolida A, B, C yondashuvlar; boshqa savollarda ikkala tomon majburiy (1-mashq).
Concede va refute tili (7.2)
Kitob jadvallari: pozitsiya, qarshi fikr, tan olish, rad etish; bog'lovchilar (2- va 3-mashq).
Band 6.5 muammolari (7.3)
"In contrast, governments cannot..." tipidagi xato; mahbuslar haqidagi xatboshining 4 muammosi; 4-mashq.
Namuna essay tahlili
Ko'k va qizil marker bilan pozitsiya va qarshi fikrni belgilash; 3-xatboshidagi concede–refute zanjiri.
Amaliyot: counterargument xatboshisi
5-mashq: juftlikda uch mavzudan biriga concede + refute xatboshisi, 12 daqiqa; ikki juftlik o'qiydi.
Xulosa va vazifa
Uyga: tillar yo'qolishi haqida to'liq essay (40 daqiqa) va eski essaydagi counterargument'ni qayta yozish.

intro: COUNTERARGUMENT — sizning fikringizga qarshi bo'lgan, boshqa odamlar aytishi mumkin bo'lgan fikr. Kuchli yozuvchi uni yashirmaydi: avval tan oladi, keyin nima uchun baribir o'z fikrida qolishini ko'rsatadi. Bu o'quvchiga "men masalaning barcha tomonini o'ylab ko'rib qaror qildim" degan ishonch beradi.

Kitobdagi misol mazmuni: odam chet eldagi yangi ishga ketishga qaror qildi. "Bilaman, bu yerda lavozim ko'tarilishini boy berishim mumkin, LEKIN maosh yuqori va ko'proq narsa o'rganaman" — bu uch qism: 1) ARGUMENT (qaror va sabab); 2) qarshi fikrni TAN OLISH (acknowledge / concede); 3) uni RAD ETISH (refute — noto'g'ri yoki kuchsiz ekanini ko'rsatish).

SAVOL TURI MUHIM. "Discuss both views", "Is this a positive or negative development?", "Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?" savollarida ikkala tomonni ko'rib chiqish MAJBURIY. Faqat "To what extent do you agree or disagree?" (va General Training dagi "Do you agree or disagree?") savollarida tanlov bor. Ikki qismli savollarda (masalan, "Why is this happening? What can be done about it?") A/B/C tanlovi yo'q: ikkala savolga ham javob berish majburiy — kirishda ikkalasiga qisqa javob, keyin har biriga alohida body xatboshi.

Agree/disagree savolida uch yondashuv: A — ikkala tomonni ko'rib, xulosaga kelish; B — faqat o'zingiz qo'shilgan tomon; C — o'z tomoningiz + qarshi fikrni eslab, uni rad etish. Muallif tajribasida A eng xavfsiz va Band 7 ga eng ko'p olib chiqqan yo'l; B da ko'pincha savolning bir qismi e'tibordan chetda qoladi va fikrlar takrorlanadi; C — kuchli, lekin boshqarish qiyin va odatda Band 8 darajasida yaxshi chiqadi.

C yondashuv qachon mos? Mavzu bo'yicha kuchli, aniq fikringiz bo'lsa. Yondashuvni oldindan qat'iy qoida qilib olmang — savolga bo'lgan tabiiy munosabatingizga qarab tanlang. Muhimi: pozitsiyangiz BUTUN ESSAY BO'YI aniq bo'lsin (Task Response, Band 7 talabi).

BAND 6.5 XATOSI: qarshi fikr yozuvchining o'z fikridek yoziladi. "In contrast, governments cannot be held responsible..." — bu gap signal so'z bilan boshlansa ham, yozuvchi unga qo'shilayotgandek o'qiladi; natijada essayda ikki qarama-qarshi pozitsiya paydo bo'ladi va examiner yozuvchi aslida nima deb o'ylashini bilmaydi.

TIL QOIDASI: qarshi fikrni boshqa odamlarga BIRIKTIRING — "Some people argue that...", "Opponents of X claim that...". "It is thought that..." yoki "It is felt that..." dan qoching: bu kimning fikri ekanini ko'rsatmaydi. "Staying in one job is good because..." deb yozsangiz — bu SIZNING argumentingiz, counterargument emas.

Tan olish (concede): Admittedly, ... / It is true that ... / Some people may argue that ... / That may be true for some people. Rad etish (refute): Having said that, ... / Nevertheless, ... / However, ... / Although ..., ... / While ..., ... Rad etishdan keyin albatta SABAB yozing — nima uchun qarshi fikr sizni ishontirmaydi.

Counterargument'ni har xatboshiga "ball uchun" qo'shmang. Kitobdagi mahbuslar haqidagi xatboshi 4 muammoni ko'rsatadi: markaziy g'oya yo'q; pozitsiya noaniq; kontekst tushuntirilmagan; murakkab so'zlar fikrni yashirgan. Yechim: examinerni boshqa davlatdagi hamkasbingizdek tasavvur qiling va unga fikringizni oddiy, aniq tushuntiring.
formulas: "I largely disagree, because short, well-planned tasks help children build knowledge and independence."
Kirishda va xulosada bir xil bo'lsin
"Opponents of homework say that children need time to play and rest."
"It is thought that..." emas — kimning fikri?
Qarshi fikrning to'g'ri qismini tan olish
"It is true that some schools set long, repetitive exercises."
Tan olish — rozilik emas; qisqa bo'lsin
Nima uchun qarshi fikr sizni ishontirmaydi
"Having said that, this is an argument against badly designed homework, not against homework itself."
"Thus, the real problem lies in the amount of work, and it can be solved without abolishing homework."
presentation: Counterargument yozsam, fikrim zaif ko'rinmaydimi?
Yo'q, agar uni rad etsangiz. Qarshi fikrni bilib turib o'z fikrida qolish — o'ylab qilingan qaror belgisi. Rad etilmagan counterargument esa pozitsiyani buzadi.
Har agree/disagree essayida counterargument shartmi?
Yo'q. Uch yondashuvning istalgani Band 9 gacha olib chiqishi mumkin. Counterargument faqat argumentni kuchaytirsa va uni boshqara olsangiz kerak.
"Discuss both views" savolida ham shunday tanlov bormi?
Yo'q. U yerda ikkala fikrni ham muhokama qilish majburiy; tanlov faqat agree/disagree savollarida.
Counterargument essayning qayerida bo'ladi?
Ikkala variant mumkin: o'z argumentingizdan keyin yoki oldin. Muhimi — xatboshi sizning pozitsiyangiz bilan tugasin ("Therefore, I completely agree...").
"In contrast" bilan boshlasam, qarshi fikr ekani tushunarli emasmi?
Yo'q. "In contrast" faqat farqni bildiradi, kimning fikri ekanini emas. "Some people argue that..." yoki "Admittedly, opponents claim..." bilan boshlang.
Passiv "It is believed that..." akademik emasmi?
Grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri, lekin essayda muammo: examiner bu SIZNING fikringizmi yoki boshqalarnikimi, bilmaydi. Pozitsiya aniq bo'lishi uchun "I believe" yoki "some people argue" yaxshiroq.
notes: O'quvchilar ko'pincha "qanday qoida?" deb so'raydi. Aniq javob: agree/disagree savolida yondashuvni o'zingiz tanlaysiz; boshqa savollarda ikki tomon majburiy. Bu darsda A yoki C bilan yozishni mashq qilamiz.
Namuna essayda C yondashuvi ishlatilgan: 2-xatboshi — o'z argumentimiz, 3-xatboshi — qarshi fikr tan olinib, rad etilgan. O'quvchilar ko'k/qizil marker bilan buni o'zlari topsin.
Kitobdagi mahbuslar haqidagi xatboshi va uning to'g'ri versiyasini (kitobdagi havola) matn sifatida ko'chirmang — sahifa rasmidan o'qing va muammolarni og'zaki muhokama qiling.
