class_ex.title: 1-mashq: Savol turi — yondashuvni tanlash mumkinmi?
class_ex.instr: Har savolga ayting: yondashuvni tanlash mumkinmi (A/B/C) yoki ikkala tomon majburiymi? Qisqa sabab bilan.
items: Some people think that all museums should be free to visit. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Some people prefer to live in a big city, while others prefer the countryside. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
More and more people now work from home. Is this a positive or negative development?
Online shopping is replacing high-street shops. Do the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?
Advertising aimed at children should be banned. Do you agree or disagree?
answers: Tanlov bor: A, B yoki C
Ikkala tomon (ijobiy va salbiy) tortiladi, keyin xulosa
Ikkala tomon majburiy + qaysi biri ustun
Tanlov bor: A, B yoki C (General Training shakli)
why: "To what extent do you agree or disagree?" — kitobdagi yagona "tanlovli" savol turi.
"Discuss both views" — ikkala fikr alohida muhokama qilinmasa, savolning yarmi javobsiz.
Positive/negative deyish uchun ikkala tomonni tortib ko'rish kerak.
"Outweigh" — ikki tomonni solishtirish talabi.
"Do you agree or disagree?" ham agree/disagree turi — tanlov bor.

class_ex.title: 2-mashq: Qismlarni belgilang — P, C, CON, R
class_ex.instr: Mavzu: "Museums should be free. To what extent do you agree?" Har gap nima: P (yozuvchi pozitsiyasi), C (counterargument), CON (tan olish), R (rad etish)?
items: I strongly agree that entry to public museums should be free.
Some people argue that visitors value a museum more if they pay for it.
It is true that free events are sometimes treated less seriously.
However, research on free museum days shows that visitors spend just as long looking at exhibitions.
Critics also claim that museums would lose vital income.
Therefore, I remain convinced that free entry benefits society as a whole.
why: "I strongly agree" — yozuvchining o'z pozitsiyasi.
"Some people argue" — fikr boshqalarga biriktirilgan.
"It is true that" — qarshi fikrning bir qismi tan olinmoqda.
"However" + dalil — qarshi fikr nima uchun ishontirmasligi.
"Critics claim" — yangi qarshi fikr; undan keyin rad etish kerak bo'ladi.
"Therefore, I remain convinced" — xatboshi yozuvchi pozitsiyasi bilan yopiladi.
class_ex.note: 5-gapdan keyin rad etish yo'q — bu xatboshining zaif joyi. O'quvchilardan unga bitta refute gapi qo'shishni so'rang.

class_ex.title: 3-mashq: Qaysi versiya pozitsiyani aniq saqlaydi?
class_ex.instr: Har juftlikda yozuvchi fikrini aniq saqlagan (Band 7+) versiyani tanlang.
items: Writer's view: cities need more cycle lanes. A) In contrast, cycle lanes are dangerous and expensive. B) Some people argue that cycle lanes are expensive; however, they cost far less than new roads.
Writer's view: exams are useful. A) It is thought that exams cause stress. B) Admittedly, exams cause some stress. Nevertheless, they teach students to work under pressure.
Writer's view: tourism helps local people. A) Although tourism can raise prices, it creates thousands of local jobs. B) Tourism raises prices, and it creates thousands of local jobs.

Writer's view: children should learn to cook at school. A) Some parents say that cooking is a family responsibility. That may be true, but many families no longer cook at home. B) Cooking is a family responsibility. Many families no longer cook at home.
why: A variantda qarshi fikr yozuvchining o'z fikridek — pozitsiya ikkiga bo'lingan.
A — kimning fikri noma'lum va rad etilmagan; B — tan olish + rad etish + sabab.
"Although" birinchi qismni tan olib, ikkinchi qismni ustun qiladi; B da ikkala fikr teng.
A da qarshi fikr ota-onalarga biriktirilgan va rad etilgan; B da yozuvchi o'ziga zid gapiradi.

class_ex.title: 4-mashq: Band 6.5 → Band 7: pozitsiyani aniq qiling
class_ex.instr: Yozuvchi fikri qavsda berilgan. Gapni qayta yozing: qarshi fikrni boshqalarga biriktiring va rad eting.
items: (fikr: remote work is positive) In contrast, working from home makes people lonely.
(fikr: public transport should be free) It is felt that free transport is too expensive for the state.
(fikr: zoos are useful) Zoos are cruel because animals live in small cages.
(fikr: university should not be free) Free education is fair because everyone gets the same chance.
(fikr: social media harms teenagers) On the other hand, social media helps teenagers keep in touch with friends.
answers: Admittedly, some remote workers feel lonely. Having said that, regular online meetings and shared office days can solve this problem.
Some people argue that free public transport would cost the state too much. However, the savings from reduced congestion and pollution could cover much of this cost.
Critics claim that zoos are cruel because animals live in small cages. While this was true in the past, modern zoos provide large habitats and protect endangered species.
Supporters of free tuition say it gives everyone the same chance. Nevertheless, it is funded by all taxpayers, including those who never benefit from a degree.
It is true that social media helps teenagers keep in touch with friends. However, this benefit is outweighed by the anxiety that constant comparison can cause.
why: "In contrast" kimning fikri ekanini aytmaydi; "Admittedly" + "Having said that" + yechim.
Passiv "It is felt" o'rniga "Some people argue" — fikr egasi aniq; rad etishda sabab bor.
Asl gap yozuvchining o'z da'vosidek; "Critics claim" + "While..." bilan rad etildi.
"Supporters of... say" qarshi fikrni ajratadi; "Nevertheless" + adolat haqidagi sabab.
"On the other hand" ikki teng tomon beradi; "outweighed by" yozuvchining tanlovini ko'rsatadi.

class_ex.title: 5-mashq: Counterargument xatboshisi (12 daqiqa)
class_ex.instr: Bitta mavzuni tanlang. Tuzilma: qarshi fikr (boshqalarga biriktirilgan) → tan olish → rad etish + sabab/misol → o'z pozitsiyangiz. 80–100 so'z.
items: Fikringiz: everyone should learn a second foreign language at school (agree).
Fikringiz: people should not be allowed to use mobile phones while walking in city centres (disagree).
Fikringiz: celebrities should use their fame to support social causes (agree).
answers: Namuna xatboshi (94 so'z): "Some people argue that learning one foreign language is already difficult enough for most pupils and that a second one would overload the timetable. It is true that many students struggle to reach a good level in their first foreign language. Having said that, a second foreign language is usually easier to learn than the first, because pupils already know how to memorise vocabulary and notice grammar patterns. Even a basic level can open doors to jobs and travel. Therefore, I firmly believe that every pupil should learn a second foreign language at school."

Namuna xatboshi (88 so'z): "Supporters of a ban claim that pedestrians who stare at their phones cause accidents and put drivers at risk. Admittedly, distracted walkers do sometimes step into the road without looking. Nevertheless, a ban would be impossible to enforce, since the police could not stop every person who checks a map or answers a call. Safety campaigns and better-designed crossings at busy junctions would be far more effective. Thus, although pedestrians should certainly take care, I do not believe that using a phone while walking should be made illegal."

Namuna xatboshi (96 so'z): "Critics say that celebrities have no expertise in social issues and may spread oversimplified or even misleading messages. There is some truth in this; a famous singer is rarely an expert on climate science or public health. However, their fame can raise money and attention far more quickly than most official campaigns. For example, a single post from a well-known actor can persuade thousands of people to donate blood or give to a disaster appeal. For this reason, I believe that celebrities should use their influence to support good causes, ideally with advice from genuine experts."
why: Tekshiruv: 1) qarshi fikr kimniki — aniqmi? 2) tan olish qisqami? 3) rad etishdan keyin sabab bormi? 4) oxirgi gap yozuvchi pozitsiyasimi?
Tekshiruv: "Admittedly" dan keyin yozuvchi qarshi fikrga to'liq qo'shilib ketmasin.
Tekshiruv: "There is some truth in this" — tan olish; "however" — burilish nuqtasi.

readings.title: NAMUNA ESSAY: counterargument bilan (C yondashuv)
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna javobi (307 so'z; 4 xatboshi: 51 + 103 + 108 + 45)
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: Some people believe that primary school children should not be given any homework. To what extent do you agree or disagree?  |  REJA: pozitsiya — asosan qarshiman; P2 — o'z argumentim (mashq + mustaqillik); P3 — qarshi fikr (dam olish, oila) → tan olish → rad etish (muammo miqdor va turda); xulosa.  |  TAQQOSLASH — shu savolga A YONDASHUVIDA REJA: 1) kirish — ikki fikr + pozitsiya (asosan qarshiman: uy vazifasi kerak); 2) P2 — uy vazifasini bekor qilish tarafdorlari: dam olish, o'yin, oila bilan vaqt ("Some people argue that...", adolatli bayon); 3) P3 — o'z tomonim (uy vazifasi foydali): mashq + mustaqillik va nima uchun bu tomon kuchliroq; 4) xulosa — qisqa, mazmunli uy vazifasi kerak, faqat miqdori cheklansin.
text: It is sometimes argued that young children already spend long enough at school and should be free from homework in the evenings. Although I accept that too much homework can be harmful, I largely disagree with this view, because short, well-planned tasks help children build both their knowledge and their independence.

The main reason I support homework is that it allows pupils to practise what they have learned while it is still fresh. A single lesson on multiplication or spelling is rarely enough on its own; unless children repeat the skill a day later, much of it is quickly forgotten. Ten or fifteen minutes of practice at home can therefore make the next lesson far more productive, because the teacher does not have to start again from the beginning. Homework also develops a habit that pupils will need throughout their education: organising their own time and finishing a task without an adult beside them.

Admittedly, opponents of homework have a valid point when they say that children need time to play, rest and be with their families. It is true that some schools set long, repetitive exercises which leave young learners tired and resentful. Having said that, this is an argument against badly designed homework, not against homework itself. If teachers keep tasks short and meaningful, such as reading a story with a parent or measuring objects around the house, homework can actually bring families together rather than keep them apart. Thus, the real problem lies in the amount and type of work, and it can be solved without abolishing homework altogether.

In conclusion, I disagree that primary pupils should have no homework at all. While excessive assignments can certainly do more harm than good, a small amount of carefully chosen work reinforces learning, builds independence and can even involve parents more closely in their children's education.
glossary: while it is still fresh — hali yangi, esdan chiqmagan paytda
paraphrases: should not be given any homework
should be free from homework / have no homework at all
primary school children
young children, pupils, young learners
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
I largely disagree with this view
some people believe
it is sometimes argued / opponents of homework

tasks.instr: Ko'k marker — yozuvchi pozitsiyasi, qizil — qarshi fikr. Keyin savollarga javob bering.

3-xatboshi qanday tugaydi va nima uchun bu muhim?
Kirishdagi "Although I accept that..." qismi nima qiladi?
answers: Kirishning 2-gapi ("I largely disagree") va xulosaning 1-gapi ("I disagree that...")
"opponents of homework have a valid point when they say..."
"It is true that some schools set long, repetitive exercises..."
"Having said that" — bu yomon tuzilgan uy vazifasiga qarshi dalil, uy vazifasining o'ziga emas
"Thus, the real problem lies in..." — yozuvchi pozitsiyasi bilan
Qarshi fikrni kirishdayoq qisqa tan oladi — essay tuzilmasini oldindan ko'rsatadi
why: Kirish va xulosadagi pozitsiya bir xil — "clear throughout".
"Admittedly" + "opponents" — o'quvchi bu yozuvchining fikri emasligini darhol tushunadi.
Tan olish qisqa — ikki gap; yozuvchi unga to'liq qo'shilib ketmaydi.

Bu C yondashuvning belgisi: bir tomon + qarshi fikrni rad etish.

homework_intro: Bugun counterargument'ni o'rgandik: qarshi fikrni boshqalarga biriktirish, qisqa tan olish, sabab bilan rad etish va xatboshini o'z pozitsiyangiz bilan yopish.

Birinchi vazifa — to'liq essay, 40 daqiqa, 260–320 so'z (kamida 250). Savol: "Every year several languages die out. Some people think that this is not important because life will be easier if there are fewer languages in the world. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?" (Mazmuni: har yili dunyoda bir necha til yo'qolib ketadi; ba'zilar buni muhim emas deb hisoblaydi, chunki tillar kam bo'lsa, hayot osonroq bo'ladi.) Yondashuvni o'zingiz tanlang (A yoki C) va tanlovingizni bitta gap bilan asoslang. Bitta xatboshida counterargument (tan olish + rad etish) bo'lsin.
Ikkinchi vazifa — eski essaylaringizdan birini oling: counterargument bormi? U rad etilganmi? Pozitsiyangiz aniqmi? Bitta xatboshini bugungi til bilan qayta yozing.
Uchinchi vazifa — 6 ta "tan olish + rad etish" jufti, har birida boshqa bog'lovchi (Admittedly / It is true that / Although / While / Having said that / Nevertheless).

homework.title: To'liq essay: yo'qolayotgan tillar
homework.instr: SAVOL: "Every year several languages die out. Some people think that this is not important because life will be easier if there are fewer languages in the world. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?" 260–320 so'z (kamida 250), 40 daqiqa. Yondashuvni o'zingiz tanlang (A yoki C) va essay ustiga bitta gap bilan asoslang (masalan: "I have chosen approach C because I hold a strong view and the 'easier communication' argument is easy to refute."). A reja: kirish (ikki fikr + pozitsiyangiz) → 1-tomon: siz qo'shilmagan fikr, boshqalarga biriktirilgan → 2-tomon: siz qo'shilgan fikr va nima uchun u kuchliroq → xulosa (pozitsiya takrori). Bu savolda ikki tomon: tillar kam bo'lsa, muloqot osonroq / har til bilan madaniyat va bilim yo'qoladi. C reja: pozitsiya → o'z argumentingiz → counterargument (tan olish + rad etish) → xulosa. Ikkala yondashuvda ham bitta joyda concede + refute bo'lsin (A da — 1-tomondan 2-tomonga o'tishda) va pozitsiya butun essay bo'yi aniq qolsin. Ko'k/qizil marker bilan o'zingiz tekshiring.
homework.answers: Namuna pozitsiya: "Although a world with fewer languages might make international communication slightly easier, I strongly disagree that the loss of languages is unimportant, because each language carries a unique culture and body of knowledge." Namuna refute: "Having said that, people can already communicate through a shared second language without giving up their own."

homework.title: Eski counterargument'ni qayta yozish
homework.instr: Oldingi va yangi versiyani yonma-yon yozing; o'zgarishlarni tagiga chizing.
homework.answers: Ustoz tekshiradi: qarshi fikr kimga biriktirilgan, rad etishda sabab bormi, oxirgi gap yozuvchinikimi.

homework.title: 6 juft: tan olish + rad etish
homework.instr: Mavzular erkin; har juftda bog'lovchi boshqa bo'lsin.
homework.answers: Misol: "While online lessons are convenient, they cannot replace face-to-face feedback."

normativ: 260–320 so'z (kamida 250), pozitsiya aniq, counterargument rad etilgan

kahoot.q: Which sentence clearly signals a counterargument, not the writer's own view?
options: Some people argue that homework is a waste of time.
Homework is a waste of time.
It is thought that homework is a waste of time.
In contrast, homework is a waste of time.
kahoot.explain: "Some people argue" fikrni boshqalarga biriktiradi. Qolganlari yozuvchining o'z fikridek yoki egasi noma'lum.

kahoot.q: Which word is used to CONCEDE a point?
kahoot.explain: Admittedly — "tan olish kerakki". Therefore va Consequently — natija, Furthermore — qo'shimcha.

kahoot.q: Which phrase is used to REFUTE a counterargument?
kahoot.explain: Having said that — burilish: tan olingan fikrdan keyin yozuvchi o'z pozitsiyasiga qaytadi.

kahoot.q: In which question type can you choose to discuss only the side you agree with?
options: To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?
Is this a positive or negative development?
kahoot.explain: Faqat agree/disagree savolida A, B yoki C tanlash mumkin. Qolgan turlarda ikki tomon majburiy.

kahoot.q: What does 'refute' mean?
options: Show that an opinion is wrong
Accept that an opinion is partly valid
Give an example from your life
kahoot.explain: Refute — fikrning noto'g'ri yoki kuchsiz ekanini ko'rsatish. "Partly valid" deb qabul qilish — concede.

kahoot.q: What is the most common Band 6.5 counterargument problem?
options: The writer seems to agree with the opposing view
The paragraph is too short to develop the idea
It uses too many linking words and phrases
It includes a personal example from the writer's life
kahoot.explain: Qarshi fikr yozuvchining o'z fikridek yoziladi — pozitsiya ikkiga bo'linadi va "clear throughout" bo'lmaydi.

kahoot.q: Complete: '___ tests cause some stress, they motivate many students.'
kahoot.explain: Although + gap, + asosiy gap. Despite dan keyin ot keladi; However va Admittedly ikki gapni bunday bog'lamaydi.

kahoot.q: Which order is typical for a counterargument move?
kahoot.explain: Avval qarshi fikr aytiladi, keyin uning to'g'ri qismi tan olinadi, so'ng sabab bilan rad etiladi.

kahoot.q: Why is 'It is felt that...' risky in a Task 2 essay?
options: The examiner can't tell whose opinion it is
It is grammatically wrong in formal writing
Passive voice is banned in IELTS Writing Task 2
It is too informal for an academic essay
kahoot.explain: Passiv grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri, lekin kimning fikri ekanini yashiradi — pozitsiya noaniq bo'ladi.

kahoot.q: Which approach does the author mainly use in model answers to agree/disagree questions?
options: A: look at both sides, then conclude
B: discuss only the side you agree with
kahoot.explain: Muallif A ni afzal ko'radi: u bilan o'quvchilarni Band 7–7.5 ga chiqargan. C faqat kuchli fikr bo'lganda.

kahoot.q: When should you include a counterargument?
options: Only when it strengthens your argument
In every body paragraph of the essay
Only in the conclusion, as a final point
kahoot.explain: Mexanik qo'shilgan counterargument foyda bermaydi. Faqat argumentni kuchaytirsa va boshqara olsangiz.

kahoot.q: Counterargument: 'Some say uniforms limit creativity.' Which sentence refutes it?
options: However, creativity is shown in work, not in clothes.
Indeed, uniforms really do limit creativity.
In addition, uniforms are expensive for families.
For example, many schools around the world have uniforms.
kahoot.explain: However + sabab — qarshi fikr ishontirmasligini ko'rsatadi. Qolganlari unga qo'shiladi yoki mavzudan chetga chiqadi.

kahoot.q: 'Opponents of homework ___ a valid point.'
kahoot.explain: have a valid point — asosli fikrga ega bo'lmoq.

kahoot.q: Choose the closest meaning of 'concede'.
kahoot.explain: Concede — qisman to'g'ri deb tan olish, admit. Deny va reject — teskari ma'no.

kahoot.q: 'This is an argument against badly designed homework, not against homework ___.'
kahoot.explain: homework — birlik, jonsiz ot: itself. "Homework itself" — uy vazifasining o'zi.

kahoot.q: 'Excessive assignments' are assignments that are…
kahoot.explain: Excessive — me'yordan ortiq.

kahoot.q: 'Too much homework can do more harm than ___.'
kahoot.explain: do more harm than good — foydadan ko'ra zarari ko'p.

kahoot.q: Which phrase means 'a view that is the opposite of yours'?
kahoot.explain: Opposing view — qarama-qarshi fikr; counterargument shu fikrdan tuziladi.

kahoot.q: 'The real problem lies ___ the amount of work.'
kahoot.explain: lie in — ... da yotadi (sabab ... da).

kahoot.q: 'Abolish homework altogether' means…
kahoot.explain: Abolish — butunlay bekor qilish; altogether — to'liq.

lessons.title: Writing Task 2 (5): Xatboshi yozish — progression va development
lessons.grammar_topic: Body paragraph: aniq markaziy mavzu (Point), tushuntirish va kengaytirish (Explain, Expand), savolga bog'lash (Link); aniq referencing (olmoshlar), uzun gaplarni bo'lish, har da'voga izoh
lessons.vocab_topic: Xatboshi tili: topic sentence, claim, support, referencing; ta'sir va natija iboralari (play a crucial role in, lead to, reduce, encourage)
lessons.book_ref: Pauline Cullen, The Key to IELTS Writing Task 2 — Lesson 8: Paragraph writing (8.1 Progression and development; 8.2 Coherence and cohesion problems; 8.3 Task response issues), PDF 48–57.
objectives: Progression (Coherence and Cohesion) va development (Task Response) farqini bilish: bitta argumentdagi muammo butun essay bahosini tushiradi.

Olmoshlarni (they, them, their, this) aniq ishlatish: olmosh eng yaqin mos otga yoki gap egasiga qaytadi (mantiq hal qiladi); oldinda ikki ko'plik guruh bo'lib, mantiq hal qilmasa — otni takrorlash yoki sinonim qo'yish.
Bir nechta g'oyali uzun gapni 2–3 gapga bo'lish — bog'lovchi va kerak joyda modal fe'l (may, can, could) bilan.
PEEL tuzilmasi: birinchi gap — bitta aniq markaziy mavzu; oxirgi gap — xatboshidagi dalilga mos xulosa va savolga bog'lanish (ortiqcha da'vosiz).
Har da'vo uchun "qanday? nega?" savoliga javob beruvchi izoh yozish; savoldan chetga olib ketadigan fikrni reja paytida o'chirish.
O'z xatboshisini ovoz chiqarib o'qib, takror va noaniq joylarni topish.
materials: Kitob sahifalari (Reading bo'limidagi ikki rasm): 8.1–8.2 va 8.3 — proyektorda.

Jony Academy namuna essayi (transport byudjeti, 286 so'z) — har o'quvchiga chop etilgan, lekin diktoglossdan (5-mashq) KEYIN tarqatiladi; uch rangli marker: P (birinchi gap), E (izoh/misol), L (oxirgi gap).
Doskada PEEL sxemasi: POINT → EXPLAIN → EXPAND (misol, natija) → LINK (savolga qaytish).
Doskada "uy" rasmi: to'liq qurilgan (Band 9), yaxshi qurilgan (8), yetarli (7), chala (6) — kitobdagi o'xshatish.
5-mashq uchun: namuna essayning 3-xatboshisi (ustoz o'qiydi) va bo'shliqli varaq — 5-mashqdagi 6 ta gap, javobsiz (chop eting: 1 varaq × o'quvchilar soni); kuchliroq o'quvchilar uchun bo'sh qog'oz.
timeline: Takrorlash
28-dars: counterargument — 2 ta talaba uy vazifasidagi concede + refute juftini o'qiydi.
Progression va development (8.1)
Uy o'xshatishi; kitobdagi maktab haqidagi xatboshi va A–E muammolar ro'yxati.
Referencing va uzun gaplar (8.2)
Olmosh eng yaqin mos otga yoki gap egasiga qaytadi; ikki ko'plik guruh bo'lib, mantiq hal qilmasa — otni takrorlash; noaniq "they"; 4 g'oyali gapni bo'lish (1- va 2-mashq).
Markaziy mavzu va oxirgi gap
PEEL: birinchi gap nima va'da qiladi, oxirgi gap nimani isbotlaydi; ortiqcha da'vo (3-mashq).
Development: da'vo va izoh (8.3)
Kitobdagi jadval mantiqi: da'vo → izoh → "bu ishonarlimi?"; mavzudan chetga chiqish (4-mashq).
Diktogloss (5-mashq)
Namuna essay hali tarqatilmagan. Ustoz 3-xatboshini 2 marta o'qiydi; o'quvchilar bo'shliqli varaqni xotiradan to'ldiradi (kuchliroqlar — butun xatboshini tiklaydi), keyin javoblar tekshiriladi.
Band 9 xatboshi va namuna essay
Endi Jony Academy essayi tarqatiladi: o'quvchilar tiklagan 3-xatboshini asl matn bilan solishtiradi. Kitobdagi Band 9 xatboshi (sahifadan) va essaydagi P, E, L ni rangli marker bilan belgilash.
O'z P va L gaplaringiz (6-mashq)

Uy vazifasi savoli bo'yicha bitta body paragraph'ning birinchi (P) va oxirgi (L) gapini yozish; juftlikda tekshirish: P bitta g'oyami, L dalildan katta emasmi? Ustoz 2 ta ishni ovoz chiqarib o'qitadi.
Xulosa va vazifa
Uyga: to'liq essay (40 daqiqa), eski essaydagi ikki body paragraph'ni tekshirib, birini PEEL bo'yicha qayta yozish va ovoz chiqarib o'qish daftari.

intro: Kitobning asosiy g'oyasi: bitta argument ichidagi kichik muammolar (noaniq olmosh, bog'lanmagan gaplar) butun essayning bahosiga ta'sir qiladi. Uy o'xshatishi: har bir g'isht (argument) mustahkam bo'lsa — uy to'liq qurilgan (Band 9); g'ishtlar bo'sh bo'lsa — uy chala (Band 6, "inadequately developed").

PROGRESSION — fikrlar bir-biridan mantiqan kelib chiqishi (Coherence and Cohesion). U uch narsa orqali ko'rinadi: ma'no bog'liqligi, bog'lovchi so'zlar va REFERENCING (olmosh yoki sinonim bilan oldingi fikrga qaytish). DEVELOPMENT — har bir fikr yetarli tushuntirilgani (Task Response).

OLMOSH QOIDASI: they / them / their "oxirgi tilga olingan otga" emas, ENG YAQIN MOS otga yoki gap egasiga qaytadi — qaysi biri ekanini mantiq hal qiladi: "Employers often give graduates training because they need skilled staff" — they = employers (gap egasi): oxirgi ot "training", eng yaqin ko'plik ot "graduates", lekin malakali xodimga muhtoj — ish beruvchilar. Oldinda ikki ko'plik guruh bo'lib, mantiq ham yordam bermasa, olmosh noaniq: "Teachers mentor children, and they learn..." — kim o'rganadi? Bunday joyda otni takrorlang. Kitobdagi xatboshida 13 ta olmoshdan 7 tasi noaniq edi. Hammasini almashtirish shart emas — faqat chalkash joyda otni qaytaring: the students, the teachers, these children.

UZUN GAP MUAMMOSI: Band 6.5 da ko'p uchraydi — bitta gapda 3–4 g'oya, bir nechta "which". Yechim: 2–3 gapga bo'ling, bog'lovchi (As a result, This means that, In turn) va kerak joyda modal fe'l (may, could, can) qo'shing — ayniqsa isbotlab bo'lmaydigan da'volarda.

PEEL: P — Point (asosiy fikr), E — Explain (tushuntirish), E — Expand (misol, natija), L — Link (savolga qaytish). Birinchi va oxirgi gap xatboshining "ramkasi": birinchisi bitta aniq markaziy mavzuni e'lon qiladi (markaziy mavzu doim ham aniq bo'lmasa — Band 6: "the central topic may not always be clear", 2023 deskriptorlari), oxirgisi xatboshi nimani isbotlaganini aytadi.

BIRINCHI GAP XATOSI: juda uzun va aniq bo'lmagan birinchi gap (kitobdagi misolda "bolalarning karyerasi" tilga olinadi, lekin keyin umuman gapirilmaydi). Birinchi gap xatboshining HAQIQIY asosiy g'oyasini qisqa aytsin: "Schools have a great deal of influence on children's behaviour."

OXIRGI GAP XATOSI: dalildan kattaroq xulosa. Xatboshida ota-onalar haqida bir so'z bo'lmasa, "schools are much more important than parents" deb bo'lmaydi. Xulosa faqat xatboshidagi dalilga tayanadi: "Therefore, schools play a significant role in shaping behaviour."

DEVELOPMENT: har da'voga "QANDAY? NEGA?" deb savol bering. "Through books and group activities children learn right from wrong" — qanday qilib? Izoh bo'lmasa, da'vo ochiq qoladi. Mavzuga aloqasi kam fikr (kitobda — bolalar buyuk rahbarlar kiyimini kiyib, xarakteri o'zgarishi) qanchalik uzun tushuntirilsa, xatboshi savoldan shuncha uzoqlashadi — uni REJA paytida o'chiring.

O'Z-O'ZINI TEKSHIRISH: mashq paytida xatboshini ovoz chiqarib o'qing — qoqilgan joyingiz odatda noaniq joy. Imtihonda buni ichingizda "baland ovozda" o'qish orqali qiling. Kitobdagi yana bir mashq — Band 9 xatboshini tinglab, bo'shliqlarni to'ldirish; biz buni 5-mashqda o'z xatboshimiz bilan qilamiz.
formulas: "Cycling to work can bring significant health benefits."
"Regular cycling is moderate exercise, so it strengthens the heart and helps people maintain a healthy weight."
"For example, someone who cycles for 15 minutes each way gets 30 minutes of exercise a day without spending any extra time in a gym."
Har gap P ga xizmat qilsin
"Therefore, encouraging people to cycle to work is a practical way to improve their health."
they → the students; this problem; these services
Eng yaqin mos ot yoki gap egasi; ikki guruh va noaniq — otni takrorlang
presentation: Progression va development farqi nima?
Progression — fikrlar bir-biriga qanday bog'langani (CC). Development — har fikr qanchalik to'liq tushuntirilgani (TR). Ikkalasi bitta xatboshida birga tekshiriladi.
Olmoshni ko'p ishlatish yomonmi?
Yo'q, agar aniq bo'lsa. Muammo — "they" ikki xil guruhni (teachers va children) bildira oladigan joyda. U yerda otni qaytaring.
Uzun gap — murakkab grammatika, bu Band 7 uchun yaxshi emasmi?
Murakkab gap aniq bo'lsa yaxshi. To'rtta "which" bilan ulangan gap o'qib bo'lmaydigan bo'lsa, Coherence pasayadi. Aniq 2–3 gap afzal.
Oxirgi gap har doim "Therefore" bilan boshlanadimi?
Shart emas: Thus, For this reason, As a result ham bo'ladi. Muhimi — xatboshi nimani isbotlaganini aytish va savolga bog'lash.
Xatboshining o'rtasida yangi g'oya paydo bo'lsa-chi?
O'zingizdan so'rang: u birinchi gapdagi mavzuga xizmat qiladimi? Yo'q bo'lsa — o'chiring. Yozish paytida o'ylash chetga olib ketadi; shuning uchun reja kerak.
Kitobdagi Band 9 xatboshi juda oddiy ko'rinadi — nega Band 9?
Chunki har gap markaziy mavzuga xizmat qiladi, izohlar ishonarli, bog'lanishlar aniq, xulosa dalilga mos. Fikrni oddiy va aniq ifodalash — yuqori mahorat.
notes: Kitobdagi maktab haqidagi xatboshi va uning Band 9 versiyasini matn sifatida tarqatmang — sahifa rasmidan birga o'qing. 5-mashq (diktogloss) uchun Jony Academy xatboshisidan foydalaning. Diktogloss namuna essay tarqatilishidan OLDIN o'tkaziladi — aks holda o'quvchilar matnni ko'rib turadi va mashq ma'nosini yo'qotadi.
3-mashqdagi "ortiqcha da'vo" (over-claiming) — Band 6.5 essaylarning eng ko'p uchraydigan yashirin xatosi. Har o'quvchi o'z oxirgi gapini "bu xatboshida isbotlanganmi?" deb tekshirsin.
Keyingi darsda (30-dars) PEEL xatboshilari to'liq essay tuzilmasiga — kirish va xulosa bilan — birlashtiriladi.
mistakes: "Teachers guide children, and they learn to share." (kim o'rganadi?)
"Teachers guide children, and the children learn to share."
Olmosh ikki guruhni bildira oladi — otni qaytaring
2–3 gap + As a result / This means that
Birinchi gap — xatboshida keyin tilga olinmaydigan mavzu
"Therefore, schools are more important than parents." (ota-onalar tilga olinmagan)

how: CORE — xatboshi tuzilmasi tushunchalari; STRONG — ta'sir va natija fe'llari; SUPER — Band 8 xulosa va bog'lash iboralari.

Namuna essaydan STRONG ro'yxatidagi so'zlarni toping — 6 tadan 4 tasi essayda bor (encourage va lead to yo'q). Keyin 6 ta STRONG so'zning har biri bilan o'z mavzuingizda (masalan, maktab yoki sog'liq) yangi gap tuzing.
core: Each paragraph needs one clear central topic.
Har xatboshiga bitta aniq markaziy mavzu kerak.
Start with a short, precise topic sentence.
Qisqa va aniq asosiy gap bilan boshlang.
Every claim should be supported by an explanation.
Har da'vo izoh bilan qo'llab-quvvatlanishi kerak.
Support your point with a realistic example.
Delete any idea that is not relevant to the question.
Savolga aloqasi yo'q har qanday fikrni o'chiring.
Clear referencing helps the reader follow your ideas.
Aniq havola o'quvchiga fikrlaringizni kuzatishga yordam beradi.
"As a result" is a useful cohesive device.
This idea needs to be developed further.
Bu fikrni yanada kengroq tushuntirish kerak.
Your conclusion must match the evidence in the paragraph.
Xulosangiz xatboshidagi dalilga mos bo'lishi kerak.
strong: Better buses reduce traffic in the city centre.
Yaxshiroq avtobuslar shahar markazidagi tirbandlikni kamaytiradi.
Cheap fares encourage drivers to leave their cars at home.
Arzon narxlar haydovchilarni mashinasini uyda qoldirishga undaydi.
Poor sleep can lead to lower exam results.
Yomon uyqu past imtihon natijalariga olib kelishi mumkin.
Congestion costs cities millions every year.
Tirbandlik shaharlarga har yili millionlab zarar keltiradi.
Public transport is a more sustainable choice.
super: Schools play a crucial role in shaping a child's character.
Maktablar bola xarakterini shakllantirishda hal qiluvchi rol o'ynaydi.
this is only part of the picture
Academic knowledge is only part of the picture.
Akademik bilim — masalaning faqat bir qismi.
ðɪs ɪz ˈəʊnli pɑːt əv ðə ˈpɪktʃə
From this point of view, road building seems reasonable.
Shu nuqtai nazardan, yo'l qurish o'rinli ko'rinadi.
Public transport deserves a larger share of funding.
Jamoat transporti mablag'ning kattaroq ulushiga loyiq.

class_ex.title: 1-mashq: Olmosh kimga qaytadi?
class_ex.instr: Xatboshi: "Parents often give children tablets because they (1) are busy after work. While they (2) are playing games, they (3) can cook or answer emails. However, teachers report that they (4) find it harder to concentrate in class, and they (5) have to repeat instructions more often." Har olmosh kimni bildiradi? Qaysilari noaniq?
items: (1) they
(2) they
(3) they
(4) they
(5) they
answers: parents — aniq (gap egasi; mantiq ham shuni ko'rsatadi)
children — noaniq (gap egasi va oldingi "they" — parents)
children — noaniq (eng yaqin ot ham, gap egasi ham — "teachers"!)
teachers — mantiqan to'g'ri, lekin xavfli (oldinda ikki guruh: teachers va children)
why: Oxirgi otlar — children, tablets, lekin olmosh gap egasiga (parents) qaytadi. Oldinda ikki guruh (parents, children) bor, ammo mantiq bir ma'noli: ishdan keyin band bo'lgan — ota-onalar, shuning uchun aniq. Demak qoida "oxirgi ot" emas: eng yaqin mos ot yoki gap egasi, tanlovni mantiq hal qiladi.
O'yin o'ynaydigan — bolalar, lekin olmosh buni ko'rsatmaydi: "While the children are playing games".
Ovqat pishiradigan — ota-onalar: "the parents can cook".
Eng xavfli joy: "they" o'qituvchilarga qaytgandek o'qiladi. "these children find it harder..."

Ko'rsatmani o'qituvchilar takrorlaydi — mantiq yordam beradi. Lekin (4) "these children" deb tuzatilgach, eng yaqin ot bolalar bo'lib qoladi: oldinda ikki ko'plik guruh bor, otni qaytaring — "and the teachers have to repeat...".
class_ex.note: Tuzatilgan versiya: "...While the children are playing games, their parents can cook or answer emails. However, teachers report that these children find it harder to concentrate in class, and the teachers have to repeat instructions more often."

class_ex.title: 2-mashq: Uzun gapni 2–3 gapga bo'ling
class_ex.instr: Har gapni 2–3 aniq gapga bo'ling. Bog'lovchi (As a result, This means that, In turn) va kerak joyda modal fe'l (may, can, could) qo'shing.
items: Students who spend hours on social media every evening often sleep less, which means they feel tired in class, which makes it harder for them to concentrate, and so their results fall, which worries their parents.

Cities that build more parks improve residents' health because people exercise more when they have green spaces near their homes and also the air becomes cleaner which reduces illnesses such as asthma that are common in children.

Working from home saves time that people used to spend travelling which they can use for their families or hobbies but it also makes them feel isolated because they do not see colleagues which reduces their motivation.
answers: Students who spend hours on social media every evening often sleep less. As a result, they may feel tired in class and find it harder to concentrate. Over time, their results can fall, which understandably worries their parents.

Cities that build more parks can improve residents' health. When people have green spaces near their homes, they tend to exercise more. In addition, trees make the air cleaner, which may reduce illnesses such as asthma in children.

Working from home saves the time that people used to spend travelling, and they can use it for their families or hobbies. However, remote workers may feel isolated because they rarely see colleagues. In turn, this isolation could reduce their motivation.
why: Uch "which" zanjiri uzildi; "may" va "can" da'voni ehtiyotkor qildi — har kim ham baho yo'qotmaydi.
Uch g'oya — uch gap: da'vo, birinchi sabab, ikkinchi sabab ("In addition").
Ijobiy va salbiy tomon "However" bilan ajratildi; "this isolation" — aniq referencing.

class_ex.title: 3-mashq: Eng yaxshi birinchi / oxirgi gap
class_ex.instr: Xatboshi mazmuni berilgan. Eng mos birinchi yoki oxirgi gapni tanlang.
items: Mazmun: kutubxonalar bepul internet, o'qish joyi va ishsizlar uchun kurslar beradi. BIRINCHI gap? A) Libraries were first built many centuries ago. B) Public libraries provide valuable services for people with limited money. C) Many people prefer reading e-books nowadays.

Mazmun: jismoniy tarbiya darsi keyingi darslarda diqqat va kayfiyatni yaxshilaydi. OXIRGI gap? A) Therefore, PE is far more important than every other subject. B) Therefore, regular PE lessons can support learning in other subjects. C) Therefore, parents should exercise more too.

Mazmun: turistlar kichik qishloqlarga ish o'rinlari olib keladi. BIRINCHI gap? A) Tourism can bring much-needed employment to rural areas. B) Tourism is a big industry with many advantages and disadvantages for countries, people and the environment. C) I visited a small village last summer.

Mazmun: fast food arzon va band ishchilar uchun qulay. OXIRGI gap? A) Thus, it is understandable why busy workers often choose fast food. B) Thus, fast food is the main cause of all health problems. C) Thus, the government must close fast-food restaurants.
why: B xatboshining haqiqiy markaziy g'oyasini aytadi; A va C — mavzudan tashqari.
A — ortiqcha da'vo (boshqa fanlar tilga olinmagan); C — yangi mavzu.
B juda keng va ko'p g'oyali; C — shaxsiy hikoya, markaziy mavzu emas.
B va C xatboshidagi dalilga tayanmaydi — sog'liq yoki taqiq haqida gap yo'q edi.

class_ex.title: 4-mashq: Da'vo va izoh — yetarlimi?
class_ex.instr: Har da'vo uchun ayting: izoh yetarli / yetarli emas / mavzuga aloqasiz. Yetarli bo'lmasa, "qanday? nega?" savoliga javob beruvchi gap qo'shing.
items: Online courses help people in rural areas, for instance through the internet.
Learning to cook at school improves health, because pupils who can prepare simple meals are less likely to rely on processed food.
Museums make people better citizens. When they visit museums, they often wear smart clothes.
Public transport reduces pollution.
Team sports teach cooperation, because players must share responsibilities and rely on each other to win.
answers: Yetarli emas: "...because they can study at a good university without moving to a city or paying expensive rent."
Mavzuga aloqasiz: kiyim fuqarolik bilan bog'liq emas — o'rniga "they learn about their country's history and values"
Yetarli emas: "...because one full bus can replace dozens of private cars."
why: "Through the internet" — vosita, izoh emas (kitobdagi "through books or group activities" kabi).
Sabab (because...) da'voni aniq tushuntiradi.
Kitobdagi "rahbarlar kiyimini kiyish" misoli kabi: izoh bor, lekin ishonarsiz va savoldan uzoqlashtiradi.
Faqat da'vo — izohsiz "inadequately developed".
Da'vo + sabab + natija (to win).

class_ex.title: 5-mashq: Diktogloss — Band 8 xatboshini tiklash
class_ex.instr: Namuna essay hali tarqatilmagan — matnni ko'rmasdan ishlang. Ustoz namuna essayning 3-xatboshisini ikki marta o'qiydi (yozmasdan tinglang). Keyin bo'shliqli varaqni xotiradan to'ldiring — har bo'shliqda bitta so'z (12 daqiqa, tekshirish bilan).
items: However, in major cities, public transport offers a far more ___ solution to everyday problems.
A single metro train can carry more than a thousand passengers, ___ the same number of people would need hundreds of cars and far more space.
When services are fast and ___, many drivers choose to leave their cars at home.
...which reduces congestion and air pollution ___ the same time.
By contrast, experience in many countries shows that new roads soon ___ with extra traffic.
Therefore, spending on public transport is the more ___ way to keep cities moving.
why: P — birinchi gap: markaziy mavzu ("far more effective").
E — solishtirish bog'lovchisi; "whereas" ikki qismni qarama-qarshi qo'yadi.
Shart gapi: qachon haydovchilar mashinani qoldiradi.
Kichik so'zlar (predloglar) eshitilmasa, ular yozuvda ham tushib qoladi — kitobdagi mashqning asosiy g'oyasi.
Expand — qarama-qarshi dalil (yo'llar muammoni hal qilmaydi).
L — xulosa savolga qaytadi va dalilga mos.
class_ex.note: Kuchliroq o'quvchilar bo'shliqlarsiz, toza qog'ozga butun xatboshini tiklashga harakat qilsin. Tekshirgandan keyin namuna essay tarqatiladi — o'quvchilar o'z variantini asl xatboshi bilan solishtiradi.

class_ex.title: 6-mashq: O'z xatboshingizning P va L gaplari
class_ex.instr: Uy vazifasi savoli: "Some people believe that schools should teach children only academic subjects, while others think that schools should also teach practical life skills, such as managing money and cooking. Discuss both views and give your own opinion." Hayotiy ko'nikmalar haqidagi body paragraph uchun birinchi gap (P), 2 ta izoh (E — faqat kalit so'zlar) va oxirgi gap (L) yozing (5 daqiqa). Juftlikda 2 daqiqa tekshiring: P bitta aniq g'oyami? L faqat E dagi dalilga tayanadimi?
items: P — birinchi gap (bitta markaziy mavzu)
E — 2 ta izoh (kalit so'zlar)
L — oxirgi gap (xatboshi nimani isbotladi + savolga bog'lash)
answers: Namuna: "On the other hand, there are strong reasons for teaching practical life skills at school."
Namuna: many school leavers cannot plan a budget → debt; pupils who can cook depend less on fast food
Namuna: "Therefore, teaching basic life skills can prepare pupils for adult life in a way that academic subjects alone cannot."
why: Qisqa, bitta g'oya — "clear central topic": hayotiy ko'nikmalar nima uchun kerak. Pul va ovqat — shu g'oyaning dalillari; karyera kabi alohida mavzu qo'shilmaydi.
Har izoh "qanday? nega?" savoliga javob beradi — da'vo ochiq qolmaydi.
Xulosa E dagi dalildan katta emas ("schools are more important than parents" kabi da'vo yo'q) va savolga qaytadi.
class_ex.note: Oxirgi 1 daqiqa: ustoz 2 ta o'quvchining P va L gaplarini ovoz chiqarib o'qitadi va sinf bilan tekshiradi. Uyda shu gaplar asosida to'liq essay yoziladi.

readings.title: Kitob: 8.1–8.2 — progression, referencing va markaziy mavzu
readings.source: Pauline Cullen, The Key to IELTS Writing Task 2, Lesson 8 (PDF 48, 49, 50, 53)
readings.book_ref: 48: uy o'xshatishi va maktab haqidagi asl xatboshi; 49: grammatikasi tuzatilgan versiya va A–E muammolar; 50: bog'lovchilar va 13 ta olmosh mashqi; 53: PEEL — birinchi va oxirgi gap muammosi.

tasks.title: Sahifalar bo'yicha savollar
tasks.type: Og'zaki
tasks.instr: Sahifalarni ekranda ko'rib, o'zbekcha qisqa javob bering.
items: Uy o'xshatishi nimani ko'rsatadi?
49-betdagi A–E muammolardan qaysilari CC ga, qaysilari TR ga tegishli?
50-betdagi mashqda olmoshlar qaysi uch guruhga qaytishi mumkin?
Olmoshning ma'nosi qachon aniq bo'ladi?
53-betga ko'ra, birinchi gapning muammosi nima?
Oxirgi gap nima uchun ishonarsiz?
answers: Alohida argumentlardagi muammolar (CC) butun essayning rivojlanishiga (TR) ta'sir qiladi
A, B, C — Coherence and Cohesion; D, E — Task Response
Olmosh qaytadigan ot bitta va aniq bo'lganda (eng yaqin mos ot yoki gap egasi); oldinda bir nechta guruh bo'lib, mantiq hal qilmasa — noaniq
Juda uzun va karyera haqida — bu mavzu keyin umuman tilga olinmaydi
Ota-onalardan muhimroq deydi, lekin xatboshida ota-onalar yo'q
why: Band 9 — to'liq qurilgan uy, Band 6 — chala.
Kitob 8.2 da CC, 8.3 da TR muammolarini alohida ko'radi.
Uch guruh bo'lgani uchun "they" oson chalkashadi.
Shuning uchun kerakli joyda otni qaytarish kerak.
Haqiqiy markaziy g'oya — maktabning bola xulqiga ta'siri.
Xulosa dalildan katta — "a significant one" yetarli.

readings.title: Kitob: 8.3 — da'vo va izoh, Band 9 xatboshi
readings.source: Pauline Cullen, The Key to IELTS Writing Task 2, Lesson 8 (PDF 54, 56)
readings.book_ref: 54: da'vo — izoh — izoh sifati jadvali va mavzudan chetga chiqish; 56: Band 9 xatboshi va tuzilma bo'yicha 3 ta kuzatuv.

tasks.title: Development va Band 9 xatboshi
tasks.type: Og'zaki
tasks.instr: 54-betdagi jadvalni va 56-betdagi Band 9 xatboshini o'qing.
items: Jadvaldagi birinchi da'vo uchun izoh nima uchun yetarli emas?
Qaysi g'oya xatboshining deyarli yarmini egallaydi va nima uchun muammo?
Muallif fikricha, yozuvchi mavzudan qanday uzoqlashib ketgan?
Band 9 xatboshining birinchi va oxirgi gapi nima qiladi?
O'rtadagi har bir gap qanday talablarga javob beradi?
answers: U o'qituvchi QACHON yo'l-yo'riq berishini aytadi, QANDAY qilib emas
Buyuk rahbarlar kiyimini kiyish — xulqni o'zgartirishi ishonarsiz va savolga aloqasi kam
Yozish paytida o'ylagan, fikrni o'chirmasdan kengaytirib ketgan
Birinchisi markaziy mavzuni e'lon qiladi; oxirgisi dalilga tayangan xulosa qiladi va pozitsiyani ko'rsatadi
Savolga va asosiy g'oyaga aloqador, xulosani qo'llab-quvvatlaydi, aniq bog'langan, mantiqiy tartibda
why: "Qanday? nega?" — development testi.
Muhim fikrlar (guruh ishlari, mentorlik) esa kam tushuntirilgan.
Yechim — reja va tanqidiy fikrlash yozishdan OLDIN.
Bu PEEL dagi P va L.
Bu 4 talab — o'z xatboshingizni tekshirish ro'yxati.

readings.title: NAMUNA ESSAY: PEEL xatboshilari
readings.qtype: Discuss both views — to'liq javob (Jony Academy)
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna javobi (286 so'z; 4 xatboshi: 49 + 87 + 104 + 46)
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: Some people think that governments should spend more money on public transport, while others believe that building better roads for cars is more important. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.  |  REJA: pozitsiya — jamoat transporti (katta shaharlarda); P2 — yo'llar tarafdorlari (qishloq, biznes); P3 — jamoat transporti (sig'im, tirbandlik, yangi yo'llar tez to'ladi); xulosa.
text: Some people believe that governments should spend most of their transport budget on roads, while others feel that buses, trains and metro systems deserve priority. Although there are reasonable arguments for improving roads, I believe that investment in public transport brings greater and longer-lasting benefits, particularly in large cities.

Supporters of road building argue that cars remain essential for many people. In rural areas and small towns, buses and trains are often infrequent or do not exist at all, so a private car is the only practical way to reach work, hospitals or shops. Better roads also help businesses, because goods delivered by lorry arrive faster and more cheaply when motorways are wide and well maintained. From this point of view, it is understandable that some people regard road improvement as a priority for the economy.

However, in major cities, public transport offers a far more effective solution to everyday problems. A single metro train can carry more than a thousand passengers, whereas the same number of people would need hundreds of cars and far more space. When services are fast and affordable, many drivers choose to leave their cars at home, which reduces congestion and air pollution at the same time. By contrast, experience in many countries shows that new roads soon fill with extra traffic, so the original problem returns within a few years. Therefore, spending on public transport is the more sustainable way to keep cities moving.

In conclusion, although roads play an important role, especially outside major cities, I am convinced that public transport deserves a larger share of government funding, because it moves more people in less space and with less pollution, and even benefits drivers by keeping the roads clearer.
glossary: deserve priority — birinchi navbatga loyiq bo'lmoq
regard X as — X ni ... deb hisoblamoq
paraphrases: spend more money on public transport
investment in public transport / deserves a larger share of government funding
building better roads for cars
road building / road improvement
some people think ... others believe
supporters of road building argue / others feel
Discuss both views and give your own opinion
P2 — road view, P3 — public transport view + I believe / I am convinced

tasks.title: PEEL ni toping
tasks.type: Og'zaki
tasks.instr: 2- va 3-xatboshilarda P, E, L ni uch rang bilan belgilang, keyin savollarga javob bering.
items: 2-xatboshining markaziy mavzusi (P) qaysi gap?
2-xatboshida qaysi ikki izoh (E) bor?
2-xatboshining oxirgi gapi nega yozuvchining pozitsiyasini buzmaydi?
3-xatboshida "which reduces congestion" dagi "which" nimaga qaytadi?
3-xatboshida qaysi gap qarama-qarshi dalil beradi?
Oxirgi gap (L) dalildan katta da'vo qiladimi?
answers: "Supporters of road building argue that cars remain essential for many people."
Qishloq joylarda transport yo'qligi va yo'llar biznesga yordam berishi (yuk tashish)
"it is understandable that some people regard..." — fikr boshqalarga biriktirilgan
Butun oldingi qismga: haydovchilar mashinani uyda qoldirishiga
"By contrast, ... new roads soon fill with extra traffic"
Yo'q — faqat sig'im, tirbandlik va ifloslanish haqidagi dalilga tayanadi
why: Qisqa, bitta g'oya — "clear central topic".
Har izoh "nega" savoliga javob beradi: because, so.
Discuss both views: qarshi fikr adolatli, lekin yozuvchiga tegishli emas (28-dars).
Relative clause natijani ko'rsatadi; referencing aniq.
Expand — solishtirish orqali asosiy fikr kuchaytirildi.
"The more sustainable way" — xatboshidagi dalillarning mantiqiy yig'indisi.

homework_intro: Bugun body paragraph'ni ichidan qurishni o'rgandik: aniq markaziy mavzu, har da'voga izoh, aniq olmoshlar, qisqa aniq gaplar va dalilga mos oxirgi gap.

Birinchi vazifa — to'liq essay, 40 daqiqa, 260–320 so'z (kamida 250). Savol (doskaga yoki ekranga yozing): "Some people believe that schools should teach children only academic subjects, while others think that schools should also teach practical life skills, such as managing money and cooking. Discuss both views and give your own opinion." Mazmuni: maktab faqat akademik fanlarni o'rgatsinmi yoki pul boshqarish, ovqat pishirish kabi hayotiy ko'nikmalarni ham? Har body paragraph PEEL bo'yicha; 6-mashqdagi P va L gaplaringizdan foydalaning.

Ikkinchi vazifa — eski essaylaringizdan ikki body paragraph'ni oling va quyidagi savollar bilan tekshiring: olmoshlar aniqmi? birinchi gap bitta markaziy mavzumi? oxirgi gap dalilga mosmi? Birini qayta yozing.
Uchinchi vazifa — o'z xatboshingizni ovoz chiqarib o'qing va qoqilgan joylarni belgilang; ularni qanday tuzatganingizni qisqa yozing.

homework.title: To'liq essay: akademik fanlar va hayotiy ko'nikmalar
homework.instr: Savol: "Some people believe that schools should teach children only academic subjects, while others think that schools should also teach practical life skills, such as managing money and cooking. Discuss both views and give your own opinion." 260–320 so'z (kamida 250), 40 daqiqa. Har body paragraph: P (1 gap) → E → E → L. Yozib bo'lgach, har paragrafda P va L ni tagiga chizing.
homework.answers: Namuna P (2-xatboshi): "Those who favour a purely academic curriculum argue that schools have limited time." Namuna L (3-xatboshi): "Therefore, teaching basic life skills can prepare pupils for adult life in a way that academic subjects alone cannot."

homework.title: Eski body paragraph'ni qayta yozish
homework.instr: Oldingi va yangi versiya yonma-yon; o'zgargan olmosh, bo'lingan gap va yangi oxirgi gapni belgilang.
homework.answers: Ustoz tekshiradi: markaziy mavzu aniqligi, da'vo–izoh, referencing, oxirgi gap dalilga mosligi.

homework.title: Ovoz chiqarib o'qish daftari
homework.instr: 3 ta qoqilgan joy: asl gap — muammo — tuzatilgan gap.
homework.answers: Misol: "Teachers often help pupils after they finish their lessons." — "they" noaniq (teachers yoki pupils?) — "...after the pupils finish their lessons."

normativ: 260–320 so'z (kamida 250), ikki fikr + o'z fikri, PEEL xatboshilar
markaziy mavzu aniq, oxirgi gap dalilga mos

kahoot.q: In PEEL, what does the first P stand for?
kahoot.explain: P — Point: xatboshining asosiy fikri. Keyin Explain, Expand va Link.

kahoot.q: What should the first sentence of a body paragraph do?
kahoot.explain: Band 7 talabi — har xatboshida aniq markaziy mavzu. Birinchi gap uni e'lon qiladi.

kahoot.q: A pronoun such as 'they' usually refers back to…
options: the nearest suitable noun or the subject
the very first noun in the whole paragraph
the main topic of the essay question
any noun that the reader happens to choose
kahoot.explain: Olmosh odatda eng yaqin mos otga yoki gap egasiga qaytadi — mantiq hal qiladi. Oldinda ikki ko'plik guruh bo'lib (teachers, children), mantiq hal qilmasa — otni takrorlang.

kahoot.q: 'Teachers help pupils so that they learn to share.' Which version is clearest?
options: ...so that the pupils learn to share.
kahoot.explain: "They" teachers yoki pupils bo'lishi mumkin — otni qaytarish noaniqlikni yo'qotadi.

kahoot.q: Parents are never mentioned in the paragraph. Which final sentence is best?
options: Therefore, schools play a significant role in shaping behaviour.
Therefore, schools are far more important than parents.
Therefore, parents are responsible for everything.
kahoot.explain: Xulosa faqat xatboshidagi dalilga tayanadi. Ota-onalar haqida dalil bo'lmasa, ular bilan solishtirib bo'lmaydi.

kahoot.q: One sentence contains four ideas and three 'which' clauses. What should you do?
options: Split it into 2–3 sentences with clear links
Add one more relative clause to make it complex
Remove all the linking words between the ideas
Change the whole sentence into the passive
kahoot.explain: Ko'p g'oyali zanjir Coherence ni pasaytiradi. 2–3 gap + As a result / This means that.

kahoot.q: Progression of ideas is mainly assessed under which criterion?
kahoot.explain: Progression — fikrlarning mantiqiy bog'lanishi: CC. Development esa Task Response ga tegishli.

kahoot.q: How fully ideas are explained (development) is mainly assessed under…
kahoot.explain: Kitob: "inadequately developed" — Band 6 Task Response; "well-developed" — Band 8.

kahoot.q: An idea in your paragraph drifts away from the question. What is the best fix?
options: Delete it at the planning stage
Add an invented example to it
kahoot.explain: Aloqasiz fikrni qancha ko'p tushuntirsangiz, shuncha savoldan uzoqlashasiz. Reja paytida o'chiring.

kahoot.q: 'Dressing up as leaders ___ encourage children to read about them.' Which is most cautious?
kahoot.explain: May — ehtimol. Isbotlab bo'lmaydigan da'volarda modal fe'l fikrni ishonarliroq qiladi.

kahoot.q: What does the L in PEEL do?
options: Links the paragraph back to the question
Lists further examples to support the point
Lengthens the paragraph with extra details
kahoot.explain: Link — xatboshi nimani isbotlaganini aytadi va savolga qaytaradi.

kahoot.q: Why read your practice paragraphs aloud?
options: To notice repetition and unclear parts
To check the spelling of names
kahoot.explain: Noaniq joyda qoqilasiz — bu tuzatish kerak bo'lgan joy. Imtihonda buni ichingizda qilasiz.

kahoot.q: 'Schools play a crucial role ___ shaping a child's character.'
kahoot.explain: play a role in + -ing — ... da rol o'ynamoq.

kahoot.q: 'Teachers impart knowledge.' 'Impart' means…
kahoot.explain: Impart — bilimni yetkazmoq, o'tkazmoq.

kahoot.q: 'Congestion' in a city means…
kahoot.explain: Congestion — tirbandlik. "reduces congestion and air pollution".

kahoot.q: If buses are 'infrequent', they come…
kahoot.explain: Infrequent — kam-kam. Qishloq joylarda avtobuslar kam qatnaydi.

kahoot.q: 'Cycling to work saves money and improves fitness ___ the same time.'
kahoot.explain: at the same time — bir vaqtning o'zida.

kahoot.q: A 'sustainable' solution is one that…
options: is very cheap to introduce right now
kahoot.explain: Sustainable — uzoq muddat davom eta oladigan va zarar keltirmaydigan.

kahoot.q: 'Public transport deserves a larger ___ of government funding.'
kahoot.explain: a larger share of — ... ning kattaroq ulushi (ot).

kahoot.q: 'From this point of ___, road building seems reasonable.'
kahoot.explain: from this point of view — shu nuqtai nazardan.

lessons.title: Writing Task 2 (6): Essay tuzilmasi — kirish, body, xulosa
lessons.grammar_topic: Band 7 essay tuzilmasi: kirish (kontekst + masala + qisqa thesis), body paragraflar (birinchi va oxirgi gap — argument xaritasi), xulosa (kamida 2 gap: xulosa + savolga javob)
lessons.vocab_topic: Essay qismlari tili: kontekst berish, masalani aytish, pozitsiya, yakunlash
lessons.book_ref: Pauline Cullen, The Key to IELTS Writing Task 2 — Lesson 9: Essay structure (PDF 58–66): 9.1 Introduction (5 muammo), 9.2 Body paragraphs (3 muammo), 9.3 Conclusion.
objectives: Kirish, body va xulosa essayda qanday "ramka" hosil qilishini tushunish: kirish argumentni tanishtiradi, xulosa uni yig'ib pozitsiyani aniq aytadi.
Savolni shoshmasdan o'qib, umumiy mavzu (topic), fokus (kim/nima), aniq MASALA (issue) va temalarni ajrata olish.
Band 7 kirish yozish: savolga mos birinchi gap, so'zma-so'z "tarjima" emas — ma'noni paraphrase qilish, xohlasa bitta gapli thesis.
Body paragraflarning birinchi va oxirgi gaplari argument xaritasini tuzishini va har gap bir vazifa bajarishini ko'rsata olish.
Kamida ikki gapli xulosa yozish: asosiy fikrlar xulosasi + savolga aniq javob; yangi fikr qo'shmaslik.
Tayyor essaydagi tuzilma xatolarini topib, tuzata olish.
materials: Kitob sahifalari (Reading bo'limida ikki rasm): Introduction muammolari va Body/Conclusion — proyektorda.
Jony Academy namuna essayi (tartibi bilan chop etilgan) — har o'quvchiga.
Uch rangli marker: kirish (ko'k), body birinchi/oxirgi gaplari (yashil), xulosa (qizil).
Doskada "essay ramkasi" sxemasi: INTRO → BP1 → BP2 → CONCLUSION, har birining vazifasi.
Kahoot (20 savol) — dars oxirida.
timeline: Kirish
Savol: "Kirishni qachon yozish kerak — birinchimi yoki reja tuzilgandan keyinmi?" Javoblar doskaga; kitob g'oyasi: kirish oxirgi reja qarori.
Kirish: 5 muammo (kitob 9.1)

Savolni noto'g'ri tushunish, umumiy boshlash, "tarjima", kirishda mini-argument, savolni qaytarib tugatish. 1- va 2-mashqlar bilan. Kitob rasmi (1-rasm) bo'yicha 6 ta og'zaki savol — Reading bo'limida.
Kirish oxiri va thesis
3-mashq: kirishning oxirgi gapi — qaysi biri yaxshi? Thesis = bitta qisqa gap.
Body paragraflar (kitob 9.2)
Bloklar sxemasi; uzun chalkash gaplar; ikkinchi paragrafning zaiflashishi. 4-mashq: gap vazifalari. Kitob rasmi (2-rasm) savollari 1–4.
Xulosa (kitob 9.3)
4 tipik xato (2-rasm savollari 5–6); 5-mashq: xulosa diagnostikasi.
Namuna essay tahlili
O'quvchilar uch rang bilan ramkani belgilaydi; birinchi/oxirgi gaplardan xarita tuzadi.
Kahoot
20 savol: tuzilma qoidalari va dars lug'ati.
Xulosa va uy vazifasi
Uyga: yangi savol uchun kirish, 4 ta "xarita" gap va xulosa.

intro: Kitobning asosiy g'oyasi: kirish va xulosa birgalikda ishlaydigan RAMKA. Kirish qanday argument bo'lishini (va ehtimol pozitsiyani) tanishtiradi, xulosa esa argumentni yig'ib, pozitsiyani aniq aytadi. Ramka ichida body paragraflar turadi.

Kirish birinchi paragraf, lekin YOZUVNING boshlanishi emas: avval savol haqida o'ylash va butun argumentni rejalash kerak. Kirish o'quvchiga faqat ikki narsani aytadi: mavzu va fokus (kontekst) hamda muhokama qilinadigan asosiy masala.

1-muammo — savolni shoshib o'qish: o'quvchi faqat umumiy mavzuni (masalan, "ta'lim") ko'radi va aniq masala o'rniga umuman mavzu haqida yozadi. Yechim: "should", "should also", "the only way", "the best way" kabi da'vo so'zlarini topguncha o'qing; temalarni (masalan: ota-ona, maktab, tarbiya) oldindan yozing.

2-muammo — boshlanish gapi. "This is a controversial topic" kabi yodlangan gaplar ko'pincha noto'g'ri, juda umumiy gaplar esa savolga aloqasiz. Yechim: birinchi gap umumiy mavzuni + kim/nima haqida ekanini birlashtirsin va savolga mos bo'lsin.

3-muammo — so'zma-so'z "tarjima": har so'zni sinonimga almashtirish g'ayritabiiy til beradi va ma'noni o'zgartiradi ("should" ≠ "must", "children" ≠ "teenagers"). Tabiiy so'zlarni ("some people", "children", "teachers") qoldiring; ma'noni talqin qiling, strukturani o'zgartiring (aktiv → passiv, fe'l → ot). Keyin "The view that..." bilan murojaat qiling.

4-muammo — kirishda mini-argument. Thesis statement yozish mumkin, lekin: pozitsiyangizni oldindan aniq bilgan holda, BITTA qisqa gapda va body paragraflardagi argumentga mos holda. Uzun kirish takror va chalkash paragraflashga olib keladi (CC Band 7 ga to'siq).

5-muammo — kirishni savolning oxirgi qatorini qaytarib tugatish ("In this essay I will discuss both views and give my opinion") yoki "I will now prove that...". Examiner nima uchun yozayotganingizni biladi — unga NIMA haqida yozayotganingiz kerak. Shaxssiz yozing: "This essay will argue...".

BODY: har paragraf bitta katta blok; ichidagi har gap kichik blok (dalil, tushuntirish, misol). Birinchi va oxirgi gaplar markaziy mavzuni ko'rsatadi va birgalikda butun argumentning XARITASINI tuzadi — shu xarita orqali "barcha qismlarga javob berdimmi?" deb tekshirasiz. Band 6.5 muammolari: dalilsiz da'volar, haddan uzun gaplar, ikkinchi paragrafning zaiflashishi yoki takrori.

XULOSA: kamida ikki gap. Birinchisi asosiy fikrlarni (body paragraflarning birinchi/oxirgi gaplaridan) yig'adi, oxirgisi savolga ANIQ javob beradi (qanchalik rozisiz, afzalliklar ko'pmi, ijobiy yoki salbiy). Yangi fikr, kelajak haqidagi bashorat yoki umumiy "chiroyli" gap — xavfli: tushuntirilmagan yangi g'oya bo'lib qoladi.
formulas: "How children learn to behave well is a question that concerns every family and every school."
"While some argue that this is mainly the job of parents, others believe teachers should share it."
"Numerous individuals think youths must be educated by educational scholars."
"In my view, parents should lay the foundations, but schools should reinforce them."
"On the other hand, there are strong reasons why schools should also teach good behaviour."
Mavzusiz boshlanish: darhol misol yoki ikkinchi da'vo
"This suggests that schools can fill important gaps that families cannot."
Asosiy fikrlar xulosasi + savolga javob (≥ 2 gap)
"In conclusion, ... I therefore believe that the responsibility should be shared..."
Bitta gap; faqat bitta fikr; yangi g'oya
presentation: Kirish necha gapdan iborat bo'lishi kerak?
Qat'iy qoida yo'q. Odatda 2–3 gap: kontekst, masala va (xohlasangiz) bitta gapli thesis.
Savoldagi so'zlarni umuman ishlatmaslik kerakmi?
Yo'q. Katta bo'laklarni ko'chirmang, lekin "some people", "children", "teachers" kabi eng tabiiy so'zlarni saqlang. Ma'noni boshqa struktura bilan ayting.
Kirishga thesis yozish shartmi?
Shart emas. Yozsangiz — pozitsiyangizni reja bilan aniqlab olgandan keyin, bitta gapda va body paragraflarga mos qilib.
"In this essay I will discuss..." nima uchun zaif?
Savolning oxirgi qatorini qaytaradi va yozish jarayoniga e'tibor qaratadi. "This essay will argue that..." yoki umuman mavzuning o'zi yaxshiroq.
Body paragrafim yaxshimi, qanday tekshiraman?
Faqat birinchi va oxirgi gaplarni o'qing: markaziy mavzu va savolga bog'lanish aniqmi? Barcha paragraflarning shu gaplari argument xaritasini bersin.
Xulosada kelajak haqida bashorat qilsam bo'ladimi?
Faqat yangi, tushuntirilmagan g'oya kiritmasa. Xavfsiz yo'l: fikrlarni yig'ish va savolga aniq javob berish.
notes: Kitob sahifalari faqat ko'rsatish uchun; tushuntirishni o'zbekcha, o'z so'zingiz bilan bering. Kitobdagi essay namunalarini sinfda o'qib chiqish shart emas — asosiy g'oyalar grammar bo'limida.
Namuna essay savoli kitobdan (PDF 58), javob matni — Jony Academy'niki. O'quvchilar uchun: bu yagona to'g'ri javob emas, tuzilma namunasi.
29-dars (xatboshi) bilan bog'lang: paragraf ichidagi progression bugun butun essay darajasiga ko'tariladi. Keyingi dars — reja (T.P.W.C) va Band 6 xatolari.
mistakes: "This is a controversial topic." bilan boshlash
Yodlangan gap ko'pincha noto'g'ri va hech narsa aytmaydi
Takror va chalkash paragraflash — CC pasayadi
"In this essay I will discuss both views..."
"This essay will argue that..." yoki umuman tashlab ketish
TR: pozitsiya aniq emas yoki yangi g'oya rivojlanmagan

how: CORE — essay qismlarini nomlash va tasvirlash uchun; STRONG — examiner tilida (band descriptorlar); SUPER — Band 7+ uchun tabiiy iboralar. Takror (yangi so'z sifatida sanalmaydi): position (25-, 28-dars), relevant (25-, 27-, 29-dars), central topic (29-dars), go off on a tangent (27-dars), consistent (3-dars) — bugun essay tuzilmasi haqida gapirganda qayta ishlating.
Har so'z bilan bugungi namuna essay yoki o'z essayingiz tuzilmasi haqida bitta gap tuzing.
core: The first sentence introduces the general topic.
Identify the specific issue before you plan.
The focus of this essay is children and schools.
Bu essayning fokusi — bolalar va maktablar.
Keep your thesis statement to one sentence.
Make your position clear throughout the essay.
Pozitsiyangizni butun essay davomida aniq qiling.
Paraphrase the idea, not every single word.
Har bir so'zni emas, g'oyani boshqacha ifodalang.
Each body paragraph needs one central topic.
Har body paragrafga bitta markaziy mavzu kerak.
The conclusion summarises the main points.
Every theme must be relevant to the question.
Har bir tema savolga tegishli bo'lishi shart.
The introduction briefly outlines the argument.
strong: Your final sentence must address the question directly.
Oxirgi gapingiz savolga bevosita javob berishi shart.
The introduction and conclusion frame your argument.
Kirish va xulosa argumentingizni ramkaga oladi.
The thesis should reflect the argument in the body.
Tezis body'dagi argumentni aks ettirishi kerak.
Schools can reinforce the values taught at home.
Maktablar uyda o'rgatilgan qadriyatlarni mustahkamlashi mumkin.
Parents lay the foundations of good behaviour.
super: Your opening sentence should set the context.
Weak second paragraphs often go off on a tangent.
Zaif ikkinchi paragraflar ko'pincha mavzudan chetga chiqib ketadi.
Do not lose the thread of the argument in the second body paragraph.
Ikkinchi body paragrafda argument ipini yo'qotmang.
Schools play a supporting but essential role.
Maktablar yordamchi, lekin muhim rol o'ynaydi.

class_ex.title: 1-mashq: Qaysi birinchi gap yaxshi?
class_ex.instr: Savol: "Some people think that museums and art galleries should be free for everyone. Others believe visitors should pay. Discuss both views and give your own opinion." Har birinchi gapga baho bering: yaxshi yoki muammo (qanday muammo?).
items: "This is a controversial topic in today's modern world."
"Since ancient times, people have created art."
"Museums and galleries play an important part in the cultural life of most cities."
"Nowadays, tourism is one of the fastest-growing industries."
"Whether cultural institutions should charge for entry is a question many city councils face."
answers: Muammo — juda umumiy, masalaga yetib bormaydi
why: Kitob 2-muammosi: bunday gap aslida hech narsa aytmaydi va ko'pincha rost emas.
Umumiy gap savoldagi aniq masalaga (to'lov) aloqasiz.
Muzeylar/galereyalar va shaharlar — savol fokusi; keyingi gap masalani aytadi.
Aloqasiz tema kiritildi — keyin essay mavzudan chetga chiqadi.
Kontekstni belgilab, masalaga tabiiy o'tadi.

class_ex.title: 2-mashq: Paraphrase yoki "tarjima"?
class_ex.instr: Savol gapi: "Some people think that schools should teach children how to manage money." Har variantga: OK yoki muammo, va nega.
items: "Numerous individuals consider that educational institutions must instruct youths in financial management."
"Some people believe that children should be taught how to handle money at school."
"Some people think teenagers must learn about banks."
"Some people hold the view that financial skills should be part of the school curriculum."
"Some people think that schools should teach children how to manage money."
why: Har so'z sinonimga almashtirilgan — g'ayritabiiy til; "must" ≠ "should".
Tabiiy so'zlar saqlangan, struktura passivga o'zgargan.
Ma'no o'zgargan: teenagers ≠ children, must ≠ should, banks ≠ managing money.

Tabiiy "some people" va "should" saqlangan, ma'no talqin qilingan: think → hold the view; "teach children how to manage money" → "financial skills should be part of the school curriculum" (fe'l → ot birikma). Diqqat: "... is widely held" deb yozilsa ma'no kuchayadi (some → ko'pchilik) — bu ham ma'noni o'zgartirish. "The view that..." iborasi esa essay ichida shu fikrga qayta murojaat qilish uchun (kitob tavsiyasi).
So'zma-so'z ko'chirma — ko'chirilgan so'zlar sanalmaydi.

class_ex.title: 3-mashq: Kirishning oxirgi gapi
class_ex.instr: Har variant kirish oxiriga to'g'ri keladimi? Yaxshi yoki zaif, va nega.
items: "In this essay I will discuss both views before giving my own opinion."
"This essay will argue that free entry brings greater benefits to society."
"I will now prove that museums should be free."
"Free entry increases visitor numbers because people do not have to pay, and although museums lose money, governments can support them, so I agree."
"In my view, basic entry should be free, although special exhibitions may reasonably charge a fee."
why: Savolning oxirgi qatorini qaytaradi (kitob 5-muammosi).
Shaxssiz, bitta gapli thesis — pozitsiya aniq.
Yozish jarayoniga e'tibor; examiner nima uchun yozayotganingizni biladi.
Mini-argument (4-muammo) — body'da takrorlanadi.
Qisqa thesis; body'dagi argumentga mos bo'lsa — Band 7+.

class_ex.title: 4-mashq: Har gapning vazifasi (namuna essay, 2-paragraf)
class_ex.instr: Namuna essayning 2-paragrafidagi har gapning vazifasini ayting: introducing an argument / giving a reason / showing an effect / explaining / giving an example / concluding.
items: "Those who believe that parents are responsible point to the time and influence that families have."
"Children spend their earliest years at home, and it is there that they first learn basic values... by copying the adults around them."
"A child who sees his parents apologise when they are wrong, for example, is likely to do the same."
"Furthermore, parents know their own children far better than any teacher, so they can correct bad behaviour in a way that suits each child."
"For these reasons, the family is naturally the first place where right and wrong are learned."
answers: giving a reason + showing an effect
why: Markaziy mavzu — birinchi gap.
Nima uchun ota-onaning ta'siri katta ekanini tushuntiradi.
"for example" — oldingi fikrni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.
"so" — sabab va natija bir gapda.
"For these reasons" — paragrafni yakunlab, savolga bog'laydi.

class_ex.title: 5-mashq: Xulosa diagnostikasi
class_ex.instr: Muzey savoliga yozilgan xulosalar. Har biridagi muammoni ayting: juda qisqa / faqat bitta fikr / savolga javob yo'q / yangi fikr / muammo yo'q. Bitta xulosada bir nechta muammo bo'lishi mumkin.
items: "To sum up, museums should be free."
"In conclusion, there are arguments on both sides of this debate, and both are important."
"In conclusion, free entry helps tourism. In my view, museums should be free."
"To sum up, free entry widens access but reduces income. In the future, all museums will probably become virtual."
"In conclusion, free entry widens access to culture, while charges help museums survive. On balance, I believe basic entry should be free, with fees only for special exhibitions."
why: Bitta gap — fikrlar xulosasi yo'q.
Pozitsiya aytilmagan — "give your own opinion" bajarilmagan. Bundan tashqari bitta umumiy gap: asosiy fikrlar yig'ilmagan.
Ikkala tomon emas, faqat bitta fikr yig'ilgan.
Virtual muzeylar — essayda muhokama qilinmagan yangi g'oya. Bundan tashqari pozitsiya aytilmagan — "give your own opinion" bajarilmagan.
Ikkala tomon yig'ilgan + savolga aniq javob.

readings.title: Kitob: Kirishdagi 5 muammo va yechimlari
readings.source: Pauline Cullen, The Key to IELTS Writing Task 2, Lesson 9 (PDF 58, 60–62)
readings.book_ref: 9.1 The Introduction: savolni noto'g'ri tushunish; boshlanish gapi (A–D mashqi); so'zlarni "tarjima" qilish; kirishda argument (thesis); kirishni tugatish.

tasks.title: Sahifa bo'yicha savollar (9.1 The Introduction)
tasks.type: Og'zaki
tasks.instr: Ustoz rasmni ekranda ko'rsatadi (2-bosqich), o'quvchilar o'zbekcha qisqa javob beradi. Har savol boshida rasmning qaysi qismi ekani yozilgan.
items: Rasm boshi (Essay structure): kirish va xulosa birgalikda nima qiladi, vazifasi qanday farq qiladi?
9.1 boshi: kirish o'quvchiga qaysi ikki savolga javob beradi?
Problem 1: ota-ona va maktab savolida umumiy mavzu nima va qaysi temalar tabiiy ravishda chiqadi?
Problem 2: "This is a controversial topic" kabi boshlanishning xavfi nima, birinchi gap nimani birlashtirishi kerak?
Problem 3: nega "teenagers" va "must" yaxshi sinonim emas, kitob qaysi paraphrase usullarini tavsiya qiladi?
Problem 4–5: thesis yozish uchun 3 shart nima va kirishni qanday gaplar bilan tugatmaslik kerak?
answers: Argumentni ramkaga oladi: kirish argumentni (va ehtimol pozitsiyani) tanishtiradi, xulosa argumentni yig'ib, pozitsiyani aniq aytadi.
Essayning mavzusi va fokusi nima (kontekst)? Qaysi asosiy masala muhokama qilinadi?
Umumiy mavzu — bolalarga yaxshi xulqni o'rgatish; temalar — tarbiya (parenting), ta'lim (education), intizom (discipline).
Yodlangan gap ko'pincha rost emas (masala aslida bahsli emas yoki oddiy). Birinchi gap umumiy mavzuni va savol kimga/nimaga qaratilganini (children, parents, schools) birlashtirsin.
teenagers ≠ children, must ≠ should — ma'no o'zgaradi. Tabiiy so'zlarni (some people, teachers, children) saqlang, ma'noni talqin qiling, strukturani o'zgartiring (aktiv → passiv, fe'l → ot).

Pozitsiya va asosiy argumentni oldindan bilish; bitta gapda qisqa overview; body'dagi argumentni aniq aks ettirish. "In this essay I will discuss these two views..." va "I will now prove that..." bilan tugatmang; "This essay will discuss..." shaxssizroq.
why: Ramka ichida body paragraflar turadi.
Kirish — yozuvning boshlanishi emas: avval savolni o'ylash va reja, keyin kirish.
Temalarni oldindan yozish aloqasiz temani kiritishdan saqlaydi (kitob misoli: 29-darsda ko'rilgan namuna xatboshidagi "leaders" temasi).
Birinchi gap umumiy bo'lishi mumkin, lekin savolga mos bo'lsin.
Keyin fikrga "The view that... / The idea that..." bilan qayta murojaat qilish mumkin.
Kirishdagi mini-argument takror va chalkash paragraflashga olib keladi — Band 7 CC uchun to'siq.

readings.title: Kitob: Body paragraflar va xulosa
readings.source: Pauline Cullen, The Key to IELTS Writing Task 2, Lesson 9 (PDF 63–66)
readings.book_ref: 9.2 Body paragraphs: bloklar sxemasi, 3 muammo (markaziy mavzu yo'qligi, uzun gaplar, ikkinchi paragrafning zaifligi); 9.3 Conclusion: 4 muammo; o'z essaylaringizni tekshirish savollari.

tasks.title: Sahifa bo'yicha savollar (9.2 Body paragraphs, 9.3 Conclusion)
tasks.type: Og'zaki
tasks.instr: Ustoz rasmni ekranda ko'rsatadi (4- va 5-bosqichlar), o'quvchilar o'zbekcha qisqa javob beradi. Har savol boshida rasmning qaysi qismi ekani yozilgan.
items: 9.2 boshidagi "building block" sxemasi: body paragraf qanday qismlardan tuziladi?
Problem 1 sxemasi (claim → another claim → unrelated invented example): bunday paragrafda nima yetishmaydi va natijasi qanday?
Problem 2: uzun chalkash gaplarning sababi nima va yechimi qanday?
Problem 3: Band 6.5 essaylarida ikkinchi body paragrafda nima bo'ladi va buni qanday tekshirasiz?
9.3: xulosadagi 4 ta katta muammo qaysilar va yechim nima?
Rasm oxiri (Extra practice): bu tekshiruv savollari nima uchun kerak va qayerda ishlatiladi?
answers: Asosiy fikr (main idea or point) → dalil, tushuntirish va misollar (kichik bloklar) → xulosa va savolga bog'lash.
Dalil va tushuntirish bloklari yo'q, aniq markaziy mavzu yo'q, misol to'qilgan va aloqasiz — argument tekshiruvga dosh bermaydi, pozitsiya noaniq, CC pasayadi.

Murakkab grammatikani ko'rsatish uchun bir gapga ko'p g'oya qo'shiladi. Yechim: gap uzunligini aralashtirish va har gapning vazifasini bilish (introducing an argument, giving a reason, showing an effect, explaining, giving an example, concluding).

Argument ipi yo'qoladi: ikkinchi paragraf noaniq, mavzudan chetga chiqadi (go off on a tangent) yoki asosiy fikrlarni takrorlaydi. Har paragrafning birinchi va oxirgi gaplari argument xaritasini bersin — savolning barcha qismlariga javob berilganini shu bilan tekshiring.
Juda qisqa (bitta gap); faqat bitta fikr yig'ilgan; savolga javob yo'q; yangi fikr. Yechim: kamida 2 gap — body'ning birinchi/oxirgi gaplaridan xulosa, oxirgi gapda savolga aniq javob.
O'z eski Task 2 essaylaringizning kirish, body va xulosasini tekshirish uchun. Ular 2-uy vazifasida ishlatiladi: eski essayni tekshirib, bitta qismini qayta yozasiz.
why: Markaziy mavzu birinchi va oxirgi gaplardan aniqlanadi; oradagi gaplar uni tushuntiradi va qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.
Band 6–6.5 body paragraflarining tipik sxemasi.
Grammatika va lug'atni TR va CC dan oldinga qo'ymang.
Sababi ko'pincha — rejasiz, juda erta yozishni boshlash.
Kelajak bashorati faqat yangi, tushuntirilmagan g'oya kiritmasa mumkin.
Tekshiruv savollari uy vazifasi bo'limida o'zbekcha yozilgan.

readings.title: NAMUNA ESSAY — ramka: kirish, body, xulosa
readings.qtype: Discuss both views — to'liq javob (Jony Academy)
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna javobi (298 so'z; 4 paragraf). Savol — kitobdagi misol (PDF 58), javob matni o'zimizniki.
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: Some people believe that parents should be responsible for teaching children right from wrong. Others think that schools should also teach children to behave well. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
text: How children learn to behave well is a question that concerns every family and every school. While some people argue that this is mainly the job of parents, others believe that teachers should share this responsibility. In my view, parents should lay the foundations, but schools have an important role in reinforcing them.

Those who believe that parents are responsible point to the time and influence that families have. Children spend their earliest years at home, and it is there that they first learn basic values, such as honesty and kindness, mainly by copying the adults around them. A child who sees his parents apologise when they are wrong, for example, is likely to do the same. Furthermore, parents know their own children far better than any teacher, so they can correct bad behaviour in a way that suits each child. For these reasons, the family is naturally the first place where right and wrong are learned.

On the other hand, there are strong reasons why schools should also teach good behaviour. At school, children face situations that rarely occur at home: they must share with thirty classmates, follow rules that apply to everyone and resolve conflicts without a parent's help. Teachers are therefore in a unique position to show why fairness and respect matter in a wider community. Moreover, not every child receives clear guidance at home, and school may be the only place where these children see consistent standards. This suggests that schools can fill important gaps that families cannot.

In conclusion, parents have the earliest and deepest influence on children's values, while schools teach them how to apply these values among other people. I therefore believe that the responsibility should be shared, with parents taking the lead and schools playing a supporting but essential role.
glossary: in a unique position — alohida (qulay) holatda
paraphrases: teaching children right from wrong
how children learn to behave well; basic values
parents should be responsible
this is mainly the job of parents
schools should also teach
teachers should share this responsibility
give your own opinion
In my view, ... / I therefore believe that ...

tasks.title: Essay xaritasi: birinchi va oxirgi gaplar
tasks.type: Ramka
tasks.instr: Faqat shu gaplarni o'qing — argument tushunarli bo'ladimi?
head: Qism
Birinchi gap (vazifa)
Oxirgi gap (vazifa)
rows: Kontekst: bolalar xulqi — oila va maktab

tasks.title: Namunani tekshiring
tasks.type: Uch rang bilan belgilash
tasks.instr: Har savolga namunadan misol keltiring.
items: Kirishning birinchi gapi savoldagi qaysi so'zlarni saqlagan, qaysilarini talqin qilgan?
Thesis bormi? U body paragraflarga mos keladimi?
2-paragrafdagi misol qaysi da'voni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi?
3-paragrafda maktab tomoni qanday dalil bilan ko'rsatilgan?
Xulosaning qaysi gapi savolga javob beradi?
Xulosada yangi fikr bormi?
answers: "children", "behave well" saqlangan; "right from wrong" → "learn to behave well", "parents/schools" → "every family and every school"
Ha: "parents should lay the foundations, but schools have an important role in reinforcing them" — body 1 va body 2 ga mos
Bolalar qadriyatlarni kattalarga taqlid qilib o'rganadi
