Maktabdagi vaziyatlar (30 sinfdosh, umumiy qoidalar, nizolar) va uyda yo'l-yo'riq olmagan bolalar
"I therefore believe that the responsibility should be shared..."
why: Kitob: tabiiy so'zlarni saqlab, ma'noni talqin qiling.
Thesis = bitta gap, argumentni aniq aks ettiradi.
Misol oldingi da'voga bevosita bog'langan ("invented" emas).
Har paragraf yangi asosiy fikr beradi — takror yo'q.
Oxirgi gap — savolga aniq javob.
Yangi g'oya xulosada tushuntirilmay qoladi.

homework_intro: Bugun essayning ramkasini o'rgandik: kirish kontekst va masalani beradi, body paragraflarning birinchi va oxirgi gaplari argument xaritasini tuzadi, xulosa savolga javob beradi.

Uy vazifasi savoli (kitobdagi amaliyot savoliga o'xshash, o'z so'zimiz bilan): "Some people think that the teenage years are the happiest time of life. Others believe that adult life brings more happiness, despite greater responsibilities. Discuss both views and give your own opinion."
Butun essay emas — faqat RAMKA: kirish (2–3 gap), har body paragrafning birinchi va oxirgi gapi (4 gap), xulosa (2 gap). Keyin xaritani o'qib ko'ring: argument tushunarlimi?

Eski essaylaringizdan birini quyidagi savollar bilan tekshiring. Kirish: umumiy mavzu berilganmi, savol so'zlari sinonimga "tarjima" qilinmaganmi, kirish savolga aniq mosmi, thesis bo'lsa bitta gapmi? Body: birinchi va oxirgi gaplar argument xaritasini beradimi, har paragraf yangi asosiy fikrmi, savolning barcha qismlari qamralganmi? Xulosa: kamida 2 gapmi, barcha asosiy fikrlar yig'ilganmi, savolga javob bormi, yangi fikr yo'qmi? Keyin bitta qismini qayta yozing.

homework.title: Ramka: teenage years vs adult life
homework.instr: Kirish (2–3 gap) + 4 ta "xarita" gap (har body paragrafning birinchi va oxirgi gapi) + xulosa (2 gap). 20 daqiqa.
homework.answers: Namuna ramka. KIRISH: "Every stage of life brings its own pleasures and pressures. While some people see the teenage years as the happiest period, others argue that adulthood offers greater satisfaction despite its responsibilities. In my view, adult life is ultimately more rewarding." BODY 1 — birinchi gap: "Those who regard adolescence as the happiest time of life point to the freedom that young people enjoy." Oxirgi gap: "For this reason, the teenage years are often remembered as the most carefree and enjoyable period of life." BODY 2 — birinchi gap: "On the other hand, there are strong reasons to believe that adulthood brings deeper and more lasting happiness." Oxirgi gap: "This suggests that adult responsibilities are often a source of satisfaction rather than simply a burden." XULOSA: "In conclusion, the teenage years offer freedom from serious responsibility, whereas adult life brings a deeper satisfaction that often comes from those very responsibilities. On balance, I believe that adulthood is the happier stage of life."

homework.title: Eski essayni tuzilma bo'yicha tekshirish
homework.instr: Eski essayingiz: kirish savolga mosmi? xarita gaplari argumentni beradimi? xulosa ≥ 2 gap va savolga javob beradimi? Bitta qismni qayta yozing.
homework.answers: Tekshiruv kaliti. Kirish: mavzu + fokus, masala aniq, "In this essay I will..." yo'q, thesis bo'lsa bitta gap. Body: har paragrafning birinchi va oxirgi gapi markaziy mavzu va savolga bog'lanishni beradi, ikkinchi paragraf birinchisini takrorlamaydi. Xulosa: kamida 2 gap, asosiy fikrlar yig'ilgan, oxirgi gap savolga aniq javob, yangi fikr yo'q. O'quvchi eski va yangi versiyani yonma-yon topshiradi; ustoz yozma tekshirib, bitta asosiy yaxshilanishni belgilaydi.

homework.title: 8 ta gap — dars lug'ati
homework.instr: CORE va STRONG ro'yxatidan 8 so'z bilan o'z essay tuzilmangiz haqida 8 gap.
homework.answers: Masalan: "My thesis statement reflects the argument in both body paragraphs."

normativ: kirish masalaga mos, thesis bitta gap, xulosa savolga javob beradi
3 savolga javob + bitta qism qayta yozilgan

kahoot.q: According to the book, when should you write your introduction?
options: After thinking through and planning your argument
As soon as you have read the question for the first time
At the very end, if you have some time left
Before the body paragraphs, without a plan
kahoot.explain: Kirish birinchi paragraf, lekin yozuv boshlanishi emas: u argumentni tanishtiradi, shuning uchun avval reja kerak.

kahoot.q: Question: "Should schools teach children good behaviour?" Which is the best opening sentence?
options: How children learn to behave well concerns families and schools.
This is a controversial topic nowadays.
Since ancient times, humans have lived together in groups and communities.
In this essay I will discuss both views.
kahoot.explain: Birinchi gap umumiy mavzu va fokusni (bolalar, oila, maktab) savolga mos ravishda birlashtiradi.

kahoot.q: Why is "This is a controversial topic" a weak opening sentence?
options: It is memorised, often untrue and says nothing
It is too short to be a useful sentence
It does not suit a formal academic style
kahoot.explain: Ko'p savollar umuman bahsli emas. Bunday gap kontekst bermaydi — examiner buni yodlangan til deb ko'radi.

kahoot.q: "Some people think schools should teach children to behave well." Which is the best paraphrase?
options: Some believe children should be taught good behaviour at school.
Numerous individuals think institutions must educate youths.
Some people think that teenagers must always behave well at school.
Some people think schools should teach children to behave well.
kahoot.explain: Tabiiy so'zlar saqlangan, struktura passivga o'zgargan. "must", "teenagers" ma'noni o'zgartiradi; savol gapini so'zma-so'z takrorlagan variant esa ko'chirma.

kahoot.q: Why is it a mistake to replace "should" with "must"?
options: The meaning changes: advice becomes an obligation
"Must" is too informal for an academic essay
Examiners never give credit for using synonyms in an essay
kahoot.explain: Sinonim almashtirish ma'noni o'zgartirmasligi kerak. Should — maslahat/fikr, must — qat'iy majburiyat.

kahoot.q: Which statement about a thesis statement is true?
options: It is one short sentence that reflects the body paragraphs
It is a mini-argument of three or four sentences with reasons
It is compulsory in every Task 2 introduction
It is written only in the conclusion of the essay
kahoot.explain: Thesis ixtiyoriy; yozilsa — pozitsiya aniq bo'lgandan keyin, bitta gapda va body paragraflarni aks ettirib.

kahoot.q: Which is the best final sentence for an introduction?
options: This essay will argue that free entry benefits society.
In this essay I will discuss both views and give my opinion.
I will now prove that museums should be free.
Let me tell you my opinion about this.
kahoot.explain: Shaxssiz va mazmunli. Qolganlari savolni qaytaradi yoki yozish jarayoniga e'tibor qaratadi.

kahoot.q: Together, what do the first and last sentences of the body paragraphs form?
options: A map of the whole argument
A way to increase the word count
kahoot.explain: Faqat shu gaplarni o'qib argumentni tushunish mumkin bo'lsa, tuzilma yaxshi; ular savolning barcha qismlarini qamraganini ham tekshiradi.

kahoot.q: Paragraph: claim → another claim → unrelated example. What is the main problem?
options: No clear central topic or evidence
kahoot.explain: Dalil va tushuntirish bloklari yo'q, misol da'voga bog'lanmagan — argument tekshiruvga dosh bermaydi, CC pasayadi.

kahoot.q: What is the solution to very long, confusing sentences in Band 6.5 essays?
options: Vary sentence length; give each sentence a clear purpose
Join more ideas together using complex grammar and rare words
Use three linking words in every sentence
kahoot.explain: Grammatika va lug'at TR va CC'dan oldin turmaydi. Har gap vazifasi aniq bo'lsin: sabab, natija, misol, xulosa.

kahoot.q: What is the minimum length of a conclusion?
options: Two sentences: a summary and an answer
One sentence that simply repeats your opinion
Four or five sentences with new examples
None — a conclusion is optional in Task 2
kahoot.explain: Bitta gapli xulosa odatda faqat bitta fikrni yig'adi yoki savolga javob bermaydi.

kahoot.q: What should NOT appear in a conclusion?
options: A new idea not discussed in the essay
A summary of the main points of the essay
kahoot.explain: Yangi g'oya tushuntirilmay qoladi va begona ko'rinadi. Kelajak bashorati ham shu xavfni tug'diradi.

kahoot.q: "Keep your ___ to one sentence in the introduction."
kahoot.explain: Thesis statement — pozitsiyangizni qisqa aytadigan gap.

kahoot.q: "Weak second paragraphs often go off on a ___." (= move away from the main topic)
kahoot.explain: go off on a tangent — asosiy mavzudan boshqa narsaga o'tib ketmoq.

kahoot.q: "Schools can ___ the values that children learn at home." (= strengthen)
kahoot.explain: reinforce — mavjud narsani kuchaytirmoq, mustahkamlamoq.

kahoot.q: "Your opening sentence should ___ the context."
kahoot.explain: set the context — kontekstni belgilamoq; tabiiy kollokatsiya.

kahoot.q: "The conclusion ___ the main points of the argument."
kahoot.explain: summarise — qisqacha yakunlamoq; xulosaning birinchi vazifasi.

kahoot.q: "Your final sentence must ___ the question directly."
kahoot.explain: address the question — savolga javob bermoq, uni hal qilmoq.

kahoot.q: "Every theme you mention must be ___ to the question."
kahoot.explain: relevant to — tegishli, o'rinli. "related with" xato; to'g'risi "related to".

kahoot.q: "Each body paragraph should have one clear ___."
kahoot.explain: central topic — paragrafning markaziy mavzusi; birinchi va oxirgi gapdan aniqlanadi.

lessons.title: Writing Task 2 (7): Fikrlash, reja va Band 6 xatolaridan qutulish
lessons.grammar_topic: T.P.W.C (Think – Plan – Write – Check): savolni tahlil qilish, g'oyalarni temalar bo'yicha guruhlash, ikki tomonli reja; Band 6.5 essaylaridagi TR, CC va LR xatolarini topish va tuzatish
lessons.vocab_topic: Reja va argument tili: brainstorm, concede, refute, outweigh; aniq va tabiiy lug'at
lessons.book_ref: Pauline Cullen, The Key to IELTS Writing Task 2 — Lesson 10: Developing thinking and planning skills (PDF 67–80); Lesson 12: Addressing band 6 problems (PDF 100–110); Lesson 15: Addressing band 6 problems (PDF 135–149).
objectives: Task 2 savoliga "bilmayman" emas, matematik masala kabi yondashish: bor bilim va tajribadan mantiqiy xulosaga kelish.
Brainstorming bilan rejalashni farqlash: g'oyalar ro'yxati hali argument emasligini tushunish.
T.P.W.C bosqichlarini bajarish: umumiy mavzu, fokus, masala, temalar → ikki tomonli reja (Side A / Side B) → yozish → tekshirish.
Shaxsiy g'oyani umumiy asosiy fikrga aylantirish, "Yes, BUT..." bilan qarshi fikrni tan olib rad etish (concede + refute).
Band 6.5 essaylaridagi tipik xatolarni topish: takror, aloqasiz fikr, noto'g'ri bog'lovchi, pozitsiya va argument nomuvofiqligi, "yuqori darajali" so'zlar bilan g'ayritabiiy til.
Band 6 paragrafini reja asosida Band 7+ darajaga qayta yozish.
materials: Kitob sahifalari (Reading bo'limida ikki rasm): Brainstorming, Essay planner va T.P.W.C bosqichlari; Band 6 essay va tuzatish jadvallari — proyektorda.
Bo'sh essay planner (kitobdagi shakl, planner rasmi asosida A4 da chop etilgan) — har o'quvchiga 3 nusxa: 6-mashq uchun 1 ta, uy vazifasidagi 2 ta reja uchun 2 ta.
Jony Academy namuna rejasi va essayi (gap year) — chop etilgan.
Jony Academy Band 6 paragrafi (4-mashq) — chop etilgan, tuzatish uchun.
Taymer: 6-mashqda reja uchun 10 daqiqa + juftlikda tekshirish 5 daqiqa.
timeline: Kirish
Savol: "Task 2 da eng ko'p vaqt qaysi bosqichga ketadi?" Kitob g'oyasi: "planning is writing" — rejaga 8–10 daqiqa sarflash foydali investitsiya.
Think (kitob 10.1, 10.3)
Savolni matematik masala kabi o'ylash; brainstorming ≠ reja. Kitob sahifalari bo'yicha savollar: 1–4 (og'zaki). 1-mashq: umumiy mavzu, fokus, masala, temalar.
Plan: ikki tomonli reja
Essay planner; shaxsiy → umumiy fikr (2-mashq); "Yes, BUT..." (3-mashq); birinchi va oxirgi gaplar. Kitob sahifalari bo'yicha savollar: 5–6 (muallif rejasi va Step 3).
Namuna: reja → essay
Jony Academy rejasi (grid) va essayi; reja qanday qilib essayga aylanganini kuzatish.
Write + Check
Umbrella term, takrordan qochish; ovoz chiqarib o'qish, vergul, so'z soni (260–320; kamida 250).
Band 6 xatolaridan qutulish (kitob L12, L15)
Kitob sahifalari (Band 6.5 essay, TR jadvali, belkurak shkalasi) — 4 ta og'zaki savol, 4 daqiqa; 4-mashq (juftlikda) — 6 daqiqa; 5-mashq (og'zaki) — 5 daqiqa.
Taymer bilan reja (6-mashq)

10 daqiqa: har o'quvchi 1-mashqdagi 3-savol (working from home) uchun bo'sh planner'ni taymer bilan to'liq to'ldiradi. 5 daqiqa: juftlikda almashib, reja 6-mashqdagi tekshiruv savollari bilan tekshiriladi; ustoz namuna rejani ko'rsatadi.
Kahoot
10–12 savol sinfda (T.P.W.C va Band 6 → Band 7 tuzatishlari, dars lug'ati); qolgan savollar uyda.
Xulosa va uy vazifasi
Uyga: planner bilan to'liq essay (40 daqiqa), 28-darsdagi essayni planner bilan qayta rejalash va eski essaydan bitta paragrafni qayta yozish.

intro: Kitob g'oyasi: Task 2 savoliga javobni oldindan "bilish" shart emas. Uni algebra masalasidek ko'ring: hayot va dunyo haqidagi bilimingizni qo'llab, mantiqiy xulosaga kelasiz. Tajribangiz bo'lmasa — tasavvur qiling (o'zingizni o'sha vaziyatda ko'ring) yoki shunday qilgan tanishlaringizni eslang.

Brainstorming — g'oya yig'ish, lekin REJA emas. Darhol yozishni boshlasangiz, argument emas, g'oyalar ro'yxati chiqadi; bundan tashqari bitta g'oyaga berilib, savoldan uzoqlashasiz (masalan, "chet elda til o'rganish" o'rniga faqat "chet elda yashash" haqida yozish). Bu Band 6.5 essaylarining eng keng tarqalgan muammosi.

T.P.W.C = THINK – PLAN – WRITE – CHECK. THINK: savolni sekin o'qing va planner'ning kirish qismiga yozing: 1) umumiy mavzu, 2) fokus (kimga/nimaga ta'sir qiladi), 3) muhokama qilinadigan masala, 4) temalar (pul, oila, madaniyat...). Temalar g'oya beradi, aloqasiz temalardan saqlaydi va reja sarlavhalari bo'ladi. Dastlabki pozitsiyani yozing, lekin keyin o'zgartirishga tayyor turing.

Temani doim SAVOL kontekstida o'ylang: "pul" emas — "chet elda til o'rganishning moliyaviy tomoni". Bayonotni savolga aylantirish ("Does ... have more advantages?") masalani aniqlashga va kirishni paraphrase qilishga yordam beradi.

PLAN: planner'da ikki ustun — Side A va Side B (masalan, kamchiliklar va afzalliklar). G'oyalarni temalar bo'yicha guruhlang, keraksizini o'chiring, bog'lanishlarni belgilar bilan ko'rsating. Har g'oyaga savol bering: Bu nimani ko'rsatadi? Qanday? Nega? Qanday ta'sir qiladi? Buni qayerdan bilaman? Shaxsiy fikrni umumiylashtiring: "I would miss my family" → "Studying abroad means living away from family, which can cause loneliness."

Asosiy fikrlar DALILDAN kelib chiqsin — avval fikr aytib, keyin unga misol to'qimang. Muallif odatda zaifroq tomonni birinchi, o'z pozitsiyasini qo'llaydigan kuchliroq tomonni ikkinchi yozadi. Ikkinchi ustunda "Yes, BUT..." — qarshi fikrni tan olib (concede), rad etadi (refute). Har ustun uchun birinchi gap (markaziy mavzu) va oxirgi gap (nimani isbotladim? savolga bog'lanish) yoziladi.

Rejani ko'rib chiqing: ikkala tomonda g'oya yetarlimi? tartib mantiqiymi? argument savolga javob beradimi va dastlabki pozitsiyani qo'llaydimi? Qo'llamasa — pozitsiyani (va thesis'ni) o'zgartiring. WRITE: reja — deyarli qoralama; takrordan qochish uchun umbrella term ishlating ("flights, rent, tuition" → "financial issues"). CHECK: ovoz chiqarib o'qing, vergullarni kamaytiring, so'z sonini biling (kamida 250; 300 dan biroz ortig'i jazolanmaydi).

Band 6 xatolari (kitob L12, L15): juda uzun essay (≈ 500 so'z) — takror, aloqasiz fikr, rejasizlik, aniq pozitsiya yo'qligi va tekshirishga vaqt qolmasligi. Noto'g'ri bog'lovchilar: "Having said that" — qarama-qarshilik uchun (qo'shish uchun emas → "In addition"); "Apart from that" — "bundan tashqari" yoki "buni hisobga olmaganda" ma'nosida, lekin og'zaki uslubga yaqin: essayda "In addition" / "Besides this" afzal; "Namely" ro'yxatdan oldin (→ "In fact"); natija uchun "As a result". Xulosa body'dagi argumentga zid bo'lsa, TR pasayadi.

Lug'at: Band 6.5 da eng keng tarqalgan xato — "yuqori darajali" so'zlar bilan ballni ko'tarishga urinish, bitta so'z o'rniga ikki-uchtasini ishlatish. Band 7 ga "flexibility and precision" va "awareness of style and collocation" kerak: aniq, tabiiy so'z (kitobdagi belkurak misoli). Taxmin uchun qat'iy modal emas ("will" → "are likely to", "may"), kollokatsiya bilan predlog ("benefits to/of learning").
formulas: Umumiy mavzu, fokus, masala, temalar + dastlabki pozitsiya
Topic: gap years; Focus: school leavers; Issue: more advantages or disadvantages?; Themes: money, study, career, maturity
Savolni tez ko'z yugurtirib, darhol yozish
Temalar bo'yicha guruhlash; shaxsiy → umumiy; dalildan xulosa
"I'd be bored" → "A year without study can weaken academic habits."
Money: expensive BUT paid work reduces the risk
Har paragraf: birinchi gap (mavzu) + oxirgi gap (isbot, savolga bog'lash)
"There are several disadvantages to taking a gap year." ... "For some, then, the year may be a costly interruption."
Oxirgi gap yo'q yoki savolga bog'lanmagan
Reja bo'yicha; umbrella term; tabiiy til
Ovoz chiqarib o'qish; vergul; so'z soni 260–320 (kamida 250)
presentation: Rejaga 8–10 daqiqa ko'p emasmi?
Kitob muallifi ham avval ~10 daqiqa sarflagan va aynan shu TR va CC ni doimiy oshirgan. Reja tayyor bo'lsa, yozish tez va oson bo'ladi.
Savol mavzusi haqida hech narsa bilmasam-chi?
Tasavvur qiling: o'zingizni o'sha vaziyatda ko'ring, tanishlaringiz tajribasini eslang, keyin savollar bering: bu nimani ko'rsatadi? qanday ta'sir qiladi?
Brainstorming yetarli emasmi?
Yo'q. Ro'yxat — xom material. Uni temalar bo'yicha guruhlash, keraksizini o'chirish va xulosalarga aylantirish kerak — bu tanqidiy fikrlash bosqichi ko'pincha o'tkazib yuboriladi.
Pozitsiyamni boshida tanlashim shartmi?
Dastlabki pozitsiyani yozing, lekin rejadan keyin tekshiring. Kuchliroq argument boshqa tomonda bo'lsa — pozitsiyani o'zgartiring, aks holda xulosa argumentga zid bo'ladi.
Uzun essay yaxshiroq emasmi — ko'proq g'oya?
Yo'q. 500 so'zlik essayda takror, aloqasiz g'oyalar va xatolar ko'payadi, tekshirishga vaqt qolmaydi. 260–320 so'z yetarli.
Qiyin so'zlar ball oshirmaydimi?
Ma'noni aniq bermasa — pasaytiradi. Band 7: aniq va moslashuvchan lug'at, kollokatsiyadan xabardorlik. Band 6: kam uchraydigan so'zlar, lekin xatolar bilan.
notes: Kitob sahifalari faqat ko'rsatish uchun; kitobdagi namuna essaylarni ko'chirib bermang. Bizning namuna — boshqa savol (gap year), reja ham, essay ham Jony Academy'niki.
Planner'ni devorga iling va keyingi barcha Task 2 mashqlarida majburiy qiling: avval reja ustozga ko'rsatiladi, keyin yozish.
4-mashqdagi Band 6 paragrafi — Jony Academy tomonidan tipik xatolar bilan yozilgan; o'quvchilarga bu "yomon namuna" ekanini ayting.
mistakes: G'oyalar ro'yxati, savoldan chetga chiqish — TR va CC pasayadi
"Having said that" ni qo'shish uchun ishlatish
Pozitsiya butun essay bo'ylab aniq bo'lishi kerak (TR)
Aniqlik va uslub — Band 7 LR talabi
"are likely to / may find it easier"

how: CORE — reja va argument jarayoni so'zlari; STRONG — essayda ishlatiladigan bog'lovchi va iboralar; SUPER — Band 7+ uchun tabiiy iboralar.
Har so'z bilan bugungi gap year rejasi yoki o'z rejangiz haqida bitta gap tuzing.
core: Brainstorm ideas, but do not start writing yet.
G'oyalar yig'ing, lekin hali yozishni boshlamang.
Money and family are common themes in this question.
Pul va oila — bu savoldagi keng tarqalgan temalar.
Themes help you generate more ideas.
Temalar ko'proq g'oya hosil qilishga yordam beradi.
Your main points should come from the evidence.
Asosiy fikrlaringiz dalildan kelib chiqishi kerak.
I concede that a gap year can be expensive.
Gap year qimmat bo'lishi mumkinligini tan olaman.
The writer refutes the argument about cost by pointing out that paid work can cover travel expenses.
Muallif pullik ish sayohat xarajatlarini qoplashi mumkinligini ko'rsatib, xarajat haqidagi argumentni rad etadi.
A good plan is almost a first draft.
The main drawback is the cost.
The year must be used purposefully.
strong: "Financial issues" is an umbrella term for rent, flights and fees.
"Financial issues" — ijara, parvoz va to'lovlar uchun umumlashtiruvchi atama.
On balance, the advantages are greater.
It is useful, provided that it is well planned.
In spite of these drawbacks, the advantages are considerable.
Uyni sog'inish o'qishga xalaqit berishi mumkin.
Younger children are likely to learn faster.
Kichik bolalar tezroq o'rganishi ehtimoli bor.
super: An argument without evidence will not stand up to scrutiny.
The benefits more than make up for the lost year.
Foydalar yo'qotilgan yilni ortig'i bilan qoplaydi.
Reserve judgement until you have examined both sides.
Ikkala tomonni ko'rib chiqmaguncha hukm chiqarmang.
With practice, planning becomes second nature.

class_ex.title: 1-mashq: THINK — mavzu, fokus, masala, temalar
class_ex.instr: Har savol uchun ayting: umumiy mavzu, fokus (kim/nima), aniq masala va 3–4 tema. Keyin masalani savol shaklida yozing.
items: Many young people now take a gap year before university. Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?
Some people think that all university students should study subjects that will help them get a job. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
More and more people are working from home. Is this a positive or negative development?
Some say that children should not be given homework at primary school. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
answers: Gap year; school leavers; afzalliklar ko'pmi? Temalar: pul, o'qish odatlari, karyera, yetuklik
Universitet ta'limi; talabalar; faqat ishga foydali fanlarmi? Temalar: ish bozori, qiziqish, jamiyat, bilim
Uydan ishlash; xodimlar va kompaniyalar; ijobiymi yoki salbiy? Temalar: vaqt/pul, oila, samaradorlik, yolg'izlik
Uy vazifasi; boshlang'ich sinf bolalari; kerakmi yoki yo'q? Temalar: o'yin/dam olish, odat, ota-ona, o'zlashtirish
why: Masala "gap year" ning o'zi emas — afzallik va kamchilik balansi.
"should ... all" — da'vo so'zlari; masala universitetning maqsadi haqida.
Baholash so'rovi: "positive or negative" — xulosada aniq javob kerak.
Ikki qarash + o'z fikringiz; fokus — aynan boshlang'ich sinf.

class_ex.title: 2-mashq: Shaxsiy g'oya → umumiy asosiy fikr
class_ex.instr: Gap year savoli uchun shaxsiy g'oyani essayga mos umumiy fikrga aylantiring.
items: "I would spend all my savings."
"I'd forget how to do maths."
"My friends would graduate before me."
"I'd finally understand what I want to study."
"I'd learn to cook and pay bills myself."
answers: Travelling for a year can be expensive and may leave young people in debt.
A year away from study can weaken academic habits.
A gap year delays graduation and entry into the job market.
A gap year gives young people time to choose a degree that suits them.
Living independently develops maturity and practical life skills.
why: "I" → "young people"; natija (debt) qo'shildi.
Shaxsiy misol umumiy tendensiyaga aylandi.
Karyera temasi — savolga bog'langan.
Motivatsiya va to'g'ri tanlov — kuchli asosiy fikr.
Yetuklik temasi; keyin misol bilan (rent, budget) qo'llab-quvvatlanadi.

class_ex.title: 3-mashq: "Yes, BUT..." — tan olish va rad etish
class_ex.instr: Side A dagi kamchilikka Side B uchun "Yes, BUT..." yozing, keyin to'liq gapga aylantiring.
items: Money: a gap year is expensive.
Study habits: students forget how to study.
Career: graduation is delayed by a year.
Family: parents worry when children travel alone.
answers: Yes, BUT paid work → "Although travel is costly, the financial risk can be reduced if part of the year is spent in paid work."
Yes, BUT motivation → "Students may lose some habits, but they often return with a clearer goal and stronger motivation."
Yes, BUT better choices → "Graduation is delayed, yet the lost year is often recovered through better choices."
Yes, BUT independence → "While parents may worry, living independently teaches young people to solve problems themselves."
why: Concede (Although...) + refute — pozitsiya butun paragrafda aniq.
Qarshi fikr rad etilmay qolsa, Side A kuchliroq ko'rinadi.
"yet" — tan olish va rad etish bitta gapda.
Yangi tema qo'shish mumkin, lekin savolga (advantages) bog'langan bo'lsin.

class_ex.title: 4-mashq: Band 6 paragrafini tuzating (Jony Academy "yomon namuna")
class_ex.instr: Paragraf: "Nowadays, gap year is a double-edged sword which has myriad merits and demerits. Firstly, gap year is very beneficial and advantageous for students because they can travel. For example, my cousin went to Malaysia and he liked it very much. Having said that, students can earn money. Namely, they will become mature individuals and responsible persons. In my opinion, the government should give money for gap years." Har gap/ibora uchun muammoni va tuzatishni ayting.
items: "a double-edged sword which has myriad merits and demerits"
"very beneficial and advantageous"
"my cousin went to Malaysia and he liked it very much"
"Having said that, students can earn money."
"Namely, they will become mature individuals and responsible persons."
"the government should give money for gap years"
"gap year is" (1- va 2-gaplar)
answers: LR: klishe va "yuqori" so'zlar → "has clear advantages"
TR: shaxsiy, rivojlanmagan misol → umumiy dalil: "travel exposes young people to new cultures and ways of thinking"
CC + GRA: "Namely" → "As a result"; "will" → "are likely to"; "mature and responsible"
TR: masalaga aloqasiz (problem-solution) → paragrafni savolga bog'laydigan oxirgi gap
GRA: artikl tushib qolgan → "a gap year is" / "taking a gap year is"
why: Band 6: kam uchraydigan so'zlar xato va uslubsiz ishlatilgan.
Ikki-uch sinonim — ma'no qo'shmaydi.
Misol da'voni isbotlamaydi — "liked it" argument emas.
"Having said that" qarama-qarshilik uchun; bu yerda qo'shish.
"Namely" ro'yxatdan oldin; bu natija. Qat'iy bashorat — ehtiyotkor modal.
Savol hukumat yordami haqida emas — oxirgi gap afzallikni isbotlashi kerak.
"gap year" — sanaladigan ot: birlikda artiklsiz ishlatilmaydi. To'g'risi: "a gap year is..." yoki gerund bilan "taking a gap year is...".

class_ex.title: 5-mashq: Aniq va tabiiy — Band 6 → Band 7
class_ex.instr: "Yuqori darajali" iborani oddiy, aniq va to'g'ri kollokatsiyaga almashtiring.
items: "Language has a significant importance in our life."
"Children acquire languages quicker and faster."
"There are advantageous benefits for learning early."
"Some find it oppressive not to choose their subjects."
"Students will lose their concentration on maths."
"This could be deemed as tough."
answers: "There are clear benefits to learning early."
"Some may find it a little unfair..."
"Students may struggle to concentrate on maths."
why: "significant importance" = "important importance" — takror.
"quicker" va "faster" — bir xil ma'no, takror: bittasini qoldiring. "acquire languages" — to'g'ri kollokatsiya (language acquisition), uni almashtirish shart emas.

"advantageous benefits" — takror (benefit o'zi afzallik). Predlog: benefits OF/TO learning early; "benefits for" dan keyin foyda ko'ruvchi keladi (benefits for children), shuning uchun bu yerda "for" xato. Eslatma: "tangible benefits" esa to'g'ri kollokatsiya (aniq, sezilarli foyda).
Haddan kuchli sifat argumentni buzadi.
Kollokatsiya + ehtiyotkor modal (may).
"deemed as" — ortiqcha rasmiy va xato; oddiy so'z aniqroq.

class_ex.title: 6-mashq: Taymer bilan to'liq reja (10 + 5 daqiqa)
class_ex.instr: 1-mashqdagi 3-savol: "More and more people are working from home. Is this a positive or negative development?" Bo'sh planner'ni taymer bilan 10 daqiqada to'liq to'ldiring. Keyin juftingiz bilan almashing va 5 daqiqada tekshiring: temalar savol kontekstidami? ikkala tomonda g'oya yetarlimi? tartib mantiqiy va qarshi fikr rad etilganmi? argument savolga javob beradimi va dastlabki pozitsiyani qo'llaydimi? Oxirida ustoz namuna rejani ko'rsatadi — bu yagona to'g'ri javob emas.
items: Kirish: umumiy mavzu, fokus, masala, temalar, dastlabki pozitsiya
Side A (negative): birinchi gap va g'oyalar
Side B (positive — pozitsiya): birinchi gap, g'oyalar, "Yes, BUT..."
Ikkala ustunning oxirgi gapi (nimani isbotladim? savolga bog'lash)
Xulosa: asosiy fikrlar va yakuniy pozitsiya
answers: Topic: working from home; Focus: employees and companies; Issue: is this trend positive or negative overall?; Themes: time and money, family, productivity, isolation; Initial position: mainly positive
"Working from home has some clear drawbacks." Isolation from colleagues → loneliness, weaker teamwork; the line between work and home life blurs → longer working hours
"Nevertheless, the benefits are more significant." No commuting → time and money saved; flexible hours → more time with family; isolation: Yes, BUT regular office days and online meetings reduce it
A: "For some workers, then, the home office can be a lonely place." B: "Overall, working from home gives people more control over their time."
Main points: some isolation, but more time, money and flexibility. Final position: a positive development, provided that it is combined with some time in the office
why: Tekshiruv: temalar savol kontekstidami ("pul" emas — "uydan ishlashning moliyaviy tomoni")?
Tekshiruv: ikkala tomonda g'oya yetarlimi (kamida 2 tadan)?
Tekshiruv: tartib mantiqiymi — zaifroq tomon avval, pozitsiya oxirida; qarshi fikr rad etilganmi?
Tekshiruv: argument savolga (positive or negative?) javob beradimi?
Tekshiruv: argument dastlabki pozitsiyani qo'llaydimi? Qo'llamasa — pozitsiya va thesis o'zgaradi.

readings.title: Kitob: Brainstorming, Essay planner va T.P.W.C
readings.source: Pauline Cullen, The Key to IELTS Writing Task 2, Lesson 10 (PDF 68, 70, 71, 76, 77)
readings.book_ref: Brainstorming nima uchun yetarli emas; bo'sh essay planner (o'quvchilar uchun nusxa); 10.3 Step 1 Think; Step 2 Plan — ikki ustunli reja va uni ko'rib chiqish.

tasks.title: Sahifalar bo'yicha savollar
tasks.type: Og'zaki
tasks.instr: Rasmdagi bo'limlarni qavsdagi sarlavha bo'yicha ketma-ket ko'rsating; o'quvchilar o'zbekcha qisqa javob beradi. 1–4-savollar "Think" bosqichida, 5–6-savollar "Plan" bosqichida.
items: (Brainstorming — sariq ro'yxat) Muallifning kamchiliklar ro'yxatidagi g'oyalar nima haqida? Savol nimani so'raydi?
(Pauline's Essay planner — bo'sh shakl) Planner qaysi qismlardan iborat?
(10.3, Step 1: Think — sariq ro'yxat) Savolga juda tez qarasak, qanday 4 xato qilamiz?
(Step 1: Think — temalar) Temalarni oldindan belgilash nimaga yordam beradi?
(Muallif rejasi — Side A / Side B jadvali) "Yes, BUT..." va "BEC" nimani bildiradi?
(Step 3: Reviewing your argument and position) Rejani tekshirish uchun qaysi 4 savol beriladi?
answers: Hammasi chet elda YASHASH haqida; savol esa chet elda til O'RGANISH haqida — g'oyalar savoldan chetga chiqqan

Kirish (umumiy mavzu, fokus, masala, dastlabki pozitsiya) + temalar; Side A va Side B (paragraf mavzusi, g'oyalar, "What did I show or prove? Link to the question?"); xulosa (asosiy fikrlar, javob beriladigan savol, yakuniy pozitsiya)
Savolni noto'g'ri tushunish; aloqasiz temalar kiritish; savolning faqat bir qismiga javob berish; aniq masala o'rniga umumiy mavzu haqida yozish
G'oya hosil qilishga, aloqasiz temalardan saqlanishga va rejada sarlavha bo'lib, g'oyalarni guruhlashga
"Yes, BUT" — qarshi fikrni tan olib, rad etish (concede + refute); "BEC" — "because" qisqartmasi
Ikkala tomonda g'oya yetarlimi? Tartib mantiqiymi? Argument savolga javob beradimi? Argument dastlabki pozitsiyani qo'llaydimi yoki pozitsiyani (va thesis'ni) o'zgartirish kerakmi?
why: Brainstorming ≠ reja: ro'yxat bitta g'oyaga berilib ketadi va TR pasayadi.
Shu shakl A4 da chop etiladi — 6-mashqda va uy vazifasida ishlatiladi.
Planner kirishidagi 4 band (mavzu, fokus, masala, temalar) aynan shu xatolardan saqlaydi.
Tema doim savol kontekstida: "pul" emas — "chet elda til o'rganishning moliyaviy tomoni".
Qisqartma va belgilar (→, +) rejani tez yozishga yordam beradi; "Yes, BUT" pozitsiyani aniq qiladi.
Aynan shu savollar bilan 6-mashqda juftingiz rejangizni tekshiradi.

readings.title: Kitob: Band 6.5 essay va uning tuzatishlari
readings.source: Pauline Cullen, The Key to IELTS Writing Task 2, Lesson 12 (PDF 100, 105) va Lesson 15 (PDF 138)
readings.book_ref: 495 so'zlik Band 6.5 essay va uzunlik muammolari; Task response muammolari va yechimlari jadvali; Lexical resource: Band 6–9 lug'at shkalasi (belkurak misoli).

tasks.title: Sahifalar bo'yicha savollar
tasks.type: Og'zaki, 4 daqiqa
tasks.instr: Rasmdagi bo'limlarni qavsdagi sarlavha bo'yicha ko'rsating; o'quvchilar o'zbekcha qisqa javob beradi. Kitobdagi essayni o'qitmang — faqat ko'rsatilgan joylarga qarang.
items: (12.1, asl essay va "Length" ro'yxati) Essay necha so'z? Juda uzun essay qaysi mezonlarni pasaytiradi?
(Asl essay, 2-xatboshi) "Having said that" va "Apart from that" bu yerda qanday ishlatilgan?
(Task response jadvali, 8-qator) Essay xulosasi nima uchun muammoli?
(Lexical resource — belkurak shkalasi va "Key idea") Band 6 va Band 7 jumlasining farqi nima?
answers: 495 so'z — talabdan deyarli ikki baravar ko'p. Takror va keraksiz g'oyalar (TR), rejasizlik (CC va TR), aniq pozitsiya yo'qligi (TR), tekshirishga vaqt qolmasligi (til xatolari ko'payadi)

Ikkalasi ham yangi fikr QO'SHISH uchun. "Having said that" — qarama-qarshilik uchun, bu yerda xato; "Apart from that" — "bundan tashqari" ma'nosida mumkin, lekin og'zaki uslub — essayda "In addition" yaxshiroq
Yozuvchi qarshi tomon (shon-shuhratning zarari) uchun ancha kuchli argument keltirgan, xulosada esa afzalliklar ko'p deydi — pozitsiya butun essay bo'ylab aniq emas
Band 7 — oddiy so'zlar bilan aniq tavsif (chuqur qazish uchun asbob); Band 6 — "yuqori darajali" so'zlar bilan g'ayritabiiy va noaniq jumla. Nima demoqchi bo'lsangiz, shuni yozing
why: Uzunlikning o'zi jazolanmaydi, lekin uning oqibatlari ballni pasaytiradi.
Bog'lovchi ma'noga mos bo'lishi kerak (CC); 4-mashqdagi xato bilan solishtiring.
Xulosa body'dagi argumentga zid bo'lsa, TR pasayadi — pozitsiyani yoki argumentni o'zgartiring.
Band 7 LR: "flexibility and precision" va uslub/kollokatsiyadan xabardorlik (5-mashq).

readings.title: NAMUNA: reja (planner) → essay
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna rejasi va javobi (296 so'z; 4 paragraf). Savol ham, javob ham o'zimizniki.
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: Many young people now take a gap year to work or travel before starting university. Do the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?
text: It has become increasingly common for school leavers to spend a year working or travelling before they begin university. Although this delay has certain drawbacks, I believe that the benefits are greater, provided that the year is used purposefully.

There are several disadvantages to taking a gap year. The most obvious is financial: travelling abroad can be expensive, and young people who do not work during the year may start university in debt. In addition, a year away from study can weaken academic habits. Students who have not written an essay or solved an equation for twelve months may find the first semester unexpectedly difficult. Finally, a gap year inevitably delays graduation, so these students enter the job market a year later than their classmates. For some, then, the year may be a costly interruption.

In spite of these drawbacks, the advantages are considerable. First, a gap year gives young people time to decide what they really want to study. Many students choose a degree under pressure at seventeen and later regret it, whereas those who have worked or volunteered often start university with a clear goal and stronger motivation. Second, living and working independently develops maturity. Paying rent, managing a budget and solving problems without parents' help are skills that no classroom can fully teach. Moreover, the financial risk can be reduced if part of the year is spent in paid work, which also adds valuable experience to a CV. The lost year, therefore, is often recovered through better choices and greater commitment.

To sum up, a gap year may cost money and interrupt study habits, but it can also bring maturity, experience and a clearer sense of direction. On balance, I believe the advantages outweigh the disadvantages, especially when the year is carefully planned.
glossary: school leaver — maktabni endi bitirgan yosh
gap year — o'qishdan oldingi tanaffus yili
paraphrases: take a gap year before starting university
spend a year working or travelling before they begin university
young people
school leavers, students
disadvantages
drawbacks, a costly interruption
Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?
On balance, I believe the advantages outweigh the disadvantages

tasks.title: Jony Academy rejasi (planner asosida)
tasks.type: 8–10 daqiqalik reja
tasks.instr: Avval rejani o'qing, keyin essayda har band qayerda ekanini toping.
head: Planner qismi
Side A: Disadvantages
Side B: Advantages (pozitsiya)
rows: Topic: gap years; Focus: school leavers
Issue: more pros or cons?; Initial position: more advantages
There are several disadvantages to taking a gap year.
In spite of these drawbacks, the advantages are considerable.
Yes, BUT paid work reduces risk + CV experience
Yes, BUT time to choose degree → motivation
Rent, budget, problems without parents → maturity
The year may be a costly interruption.
The lost year is often recovered through better choices.
Final position: yes, if carefully planned

tasks.title: Reja qanday qilib essayga aylandi?
tasks.type: Og'zaki
tasks.instr: Rejani essay bilan solishtiring.
items: Nega kamchiliklar paragrafi birinchi?
Kirishdagi thesis rejaning qaysi qismidan olingan?
"Yes, BUT" essayda qaysi so'z/iboralar bilan ifodalangan?
"Maturity" temasi faqat Side B da. Bu muammomi?
Xulosaning birinchi gapi qayerdan olingan?
Rejada yo'q, lekin essayda qo'shilgan narsa bormi?
answers: Zaifroq tomon avval, pozitsiyani qo'llaydigan kuchli tomon oxirida
"Initial position" + "Final position": provided that the year is used purposefully
"In spite of these drawbacks", "whereas", "the financial risk can be reduced if..."
Yo'q — har tema ikkala tomonda bo'lishi shart emas; asosiysi savolga bog'langan
Ikki ustunning asosiy fikrlari (umbrella: cost money, interrupt study habits)
Misollar va tafsilotlar (essay, equation, rent, budget) — reja faqat asos
why: Kitobdagi tavsiya: oxirgi so'z pozitsiyangizniki bo'lsin.
Thesis reja ko'rib chiqilgandan keyin yoziladi.
Concede + refute — pozitsiya butun essay bo'ylab aniq.
Temalar g'oya uchun vosita, majburiy jadval emas.
Xulosa = xarita gaplari yig'indisi + savolga javob.
Reja — deyarli qoralama; yozishda aniqlashtiriladi.

homework_intro: Bugun T.P.W.C ni o'rgandik: avval o'ylash, keyin ikki tomonli reja, keyin yozish va tekshirish — va Band 6 essaylaridagi xatolarni tuzatishni ko'rdik.

Birinchi vazifa — to'liq essay, VAQT BILAN, imtihondagidek jami 40 daqiqa: 8–10 daqiqa reja (planner) + 27–29 daqiqa yozish + 3 daqiqa tekshirish. Savol (kitobdagi amaliyot savoliga o'xshash, o'z so'zimiz bilan): "Some people believe that unpaid community service, such as helping a charity or teaching sports to younger children, should be a compulsory part of high school. To what extent do you agree or disagree?"

Ikkinchi vazifa — 28-darsdagi essay savolini planner bilan QAYTA rejalang (10 daqiqa) va 28-darsda yozgan essayingiz bilan solishtiring: rejada bor, lekin essayda yo'q bo'lgan (yoki aksincha) 3 ta farqni yozing. Savol (28-darsdagi): "Every year several languages die out. Some people think that this is not important because life will be easier if there are fewer languages in the world. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?"
Uchinchi vazifa — eski essaylaringizdan eng uzunini oling: takror, aloqasiz fikr, noto'g'ri bog'lovchi va "yuqori darajali" so'zlarni belgilang va bitta paragrafni qayta yozing.

homework.title: To'liq essay: community service (T.P.W.C, 40 daqiqa)
homework.instr: Planner + 260–320 so'zli essay. Planner'ni ham topshiring. So'z sonini oxirida yozing.
homework.answers: Namuna reja: Side A (against compulsory): less time for exam preparation, forced help is less meaningful; Side B (for): skills and empathy, connection with community — "Yes, BUT" flexible hours. Thesis: "This essay will argue that a limited amount of compulsory service is beneficial."

homework.title: 28-darsdagi essayni planner bilan qayta rejalash (languages)
homework.instr: Savol 28-darsdagi bilan bir xil (ataylab). Planner'ning barcha qismlari: mavzu, fokus, masala, temalar, ikki ustun, xarita gaplari, yakuniy pozitsiya. Keyin 28-darsdagi essayingiz bilan solishtirib, 3 ta farqni yozing.
homework.answers: Topshiriladi: planner + 3 ta farq (masalan: essayda tema savolga bog'lanmagan edi; "Yes, BUT" yo'q edi; xulosa pozitsiyaga zid edi). Ustoz planner'ni normativ bo'yicha tekshiradi (barcha qismlar + "Yes, BUT" + 3 farq) va 1–2 gapli yozma izoh qaytaradi.

homework.title: Eski essayni Band 7 ga ko'tarish
homework.instr: Xatolarni 4 rang bilan belgilang (TR, CC, LR, GRA); bitta paragrafni qayta yozing.
homework.answers: Eski va yangi paragraf yonma-yon topshiriladi.

normativ: reja to'liq, 260–320 so'z, pozitsiya aniq, xulosa savolga javob beradi
barcha qismlar to'ldirilgan, "Yes, BUT" bor, 3 ta farq yozilgan

kahoot.q: What does T.P.W.C stand for?
kahoot.explain: O'ylash, rejalash, yozish, tekshirish. 40 daqiqadan 8–10 tasi Think + Plan ga, eng ko'pi (27–29 daqiqa) yozishga ketadi; "planning is writing" — reja tayyor bo'lsa, yozish tez va oson.

kahoot.q: What is the main risk of starting to write straight after brainstorming?
options: You end up with a list of ideas and drift away from the question
You will not have enough words to reach the 250-word minimum
You will make many more grammar and spelling mistakes in each paragraph
Your introduction will be too short to state your position
kahoot.explain: Bitta g'oyaga berilib ketiladi (til o'rganish o'rniga faqat chet elda yashash) — TR va CC pasayadi.

kahoot.q: What do you identify in the introduction section of the planner?
options: General topic, focus, issue and themes
Only your final position and the thesis
The word count and the time you need
kahoot.explain: Bu to'rttasi savolni noto'g'ri tushunish va aloqasiz temalardan saqlaydi; dastlabki pozitsiya ham yoziladi.

kahoot.q: Personal idea: "I would miss my family." Which is the best general main idea?
options: Studying abroad means living away from family, which can cause loneliness.
My family would be very sad and lonely without me while I studied abroad.
Families are very important in everyone's life, wherever people choose to live.
I love my family more than anything, so I would never want to study abroad.
kahoot.explain: Umumiy fikr savolga bog'langan va natija (loneliness) bor; qolganlari shaxsiy yoki juda umumiy.

kahoot.q: What is "Yes, BUT..." used for in the plan?
options: To concede a counterargument and then refute it
To add one more example to the same main idea
To begin the introduction with a strong statement
To increase the word count of the body paragraph
kahoot.explain: Concede + refute — pozitsiyangiz butun essay bo'ylab aniq ko'rinadi (28-dars bilan bog'liq).

kahoot.q: In what order does the author usually arrange the two body paragraphs?
options: Weaker side first, own position last
Stronger side first, weaker side last
In any order, as ideas come to mind
kahoot.explain: Oxirgi body paragraf pozitsiyani qo'llaydi va xulosaga tabiiy o'tadi. Tartibni o'zingiz tanlashingiz mumkin.

kahoot.q: Which umbrella term covers "flights, rent, tuition"?
kahoot.explain: Umumlashtiruvchi atama takrordan saqlaydi va xulosada fikrlarni qisqa yig'ishga yordam beradi.

kahoot.q: Your plan shows that the argument does not support your initial position. What should you do?
options: Change your position and the thesis
Keep your first position whatever happens
Write both positions in the essay
kahoot.explain: Kitob: dastlabki reaksiya o'zgarishi mumkin. Xulosa argumentga zid bo'lsa TR pasayadi.

kahoot.q: "The pay is low. ___, I enjoy the work." Which linker is correct?
kahoot.explain: Having said that — hozirgina aytilganga qarama-qarshilik. Qo'shish uchun In addition, natija uchun As a result / As a consequence; Namely — ro'yxatdan oldin.

kahoot.q: "Young children will learn faster." Which version is closer to Band 7?
options: Young children are likely to learn faster.
Young children will definitely learn faster.
Young children are obliged to learn faster.
Young children have been learning faster.
kahoot.explain: Isbotlanmagan bashoratda ehtiyotkor modal: are likely to, may, could.

kahoot.q: Which sentence shows Band 7 vocabulary (precise and natural)?
options: Many students find the first semester difficult.
Myriad pupils encounter tremendous tribulations initially.
Numerous learners face very hard and difficult times.
A plethora of scholars confront adversity.
kahoot.explain: Band 7: aniqlik va kollokatsiya. "Yuqori" so'zlar uslubsiz ishlatilsa — Band 6.

kahoot.q: What is the main risk of a 495-word essay?
options: Repetition, irrelevant ideas and no time to check
The examiner simply stops reading after about 300 words
It is automatically marked down to Band 5
None, because longer essays always score higher
kahoot.explain: Uzunlik o'zi jazolanmaydi, lekin rejasizlik, takror va xatolar TR, CC va aniqlikni pasaytiradi.

kahoot.q: "On balance, the benefits ___ the drawbacks."
kahoot.explain: outweigh — og'irroq, ustun kelmoq; advantages/disadvantages savollarining kalit fe'li.

kahoot.q: "I ___ that a gap year can be expensive, but..." (= admit)
kahoot.explain: concede — qarshi fikrning to'g'ri qismini tan olmoq; keyin refute — rad etmoq. contradict — zid gapirmoq; deny — inkor qilmoq (admit ning teskarisi).

kahoot.q: "An argument without evidence will not stand up to ___."
kahoot.explain: stand up to scrutiny — sinchkov tekshiruvga dosh bermoq.

kahoot.q: "The benefits more than make up ___ the lost year."
kahoot.explain: make up for — o'rnini qoplamoq; "more than" — ortig'i bilan.

kahoot.q: "A gap year is useful, ___ it is carefully planned." (= only if)
kahoot.explain: provided that = only if; pozitsiyaga aniq shart qo'shadi.

kahoot.q: "___ these drawbacks, the advantages are considerable."
kahoot.explain: In spite of + ot. Although'dan keyin to'liq gap; "despite of" xato; on account of — sabab bildiradi.

kahoot.q: "Before writing, ___ ideas about money, family and culture."
kahoot.explain: brainstorm — g'oya yig'moq; lekin undan keyin albatta reja kerak.

kahoot.q: "With practice, planning becomes second ___."
kahoot.explain: become second nature — o'ylamasdan bajariladigan odatga aylanmoq.

lessons.title: Mock test 2 (yakuniy): bitiruv tahlili — natijalar, Writing mezonlari va bitiruv varaqasi (imtihon alohida 150 daqiqalik sessiyada)
lessons.grammar_topic: Yakuniy mockdan keyingi bitiruv tahlili darsi: imtihonning o'zi dars sonidan tashqaridagi alohida 150 daqiqalik sessiyada (JonyOS → Imtihonlar → Mock testlar, qat'iy rejim, faqat kompyuter; Listening ~30, Reading 60, Writing 60 daqiqa); bu darsda Listening va Reading natijasi savol turlari bo'yicha Unit 1–8 ga bog'lab tahlil qilinadi, Writing AI izohi 4 mezon bo'yicha ko'rib chiqilib Mock 1 bilan solishtiriladi, har o'quvchiga bitiruv varaqasi va real imtihongacha ikki haftalik reja beriladi
lessons.vocab_topic: Xom ball va band, olti xato sababi, savol turi bo'yicha naqsh, unitga qaytish, Writing mezonlari, bitiruv varaqasi, ikki haftalik reja
lessons.book_ref: JonyOS mock bazasi: JonyOS → Imtihonlar → Mock testlar (qat'iy rejim, faqat kompyuter). Mock — dars sonidan tashqaridagi alohida 150 daqiqalik sessiya: Listening ~30, Reading 60, Writing 60 daqiqa; Listening yozuvi bo'lmasa, skriptni examiner ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi. Examiner javoblar varaqasi har savol bo'yicha o'quvchining javobi, to'g'ri javob va mavzu belgisini ko'rsatadi; Listening va Reading bandi rasmiy xom ball — band jadvali bo'yicha avtomatik qo'yiladi. Writing'ni JonyOS AI examiner 4 IELTS mezoni bo'yicha baholaydi; examiner 48 soat ichida tekshiradi yoki o'zgartiradi, keyin natija e'lon qilinadi. Solishtirish uchun Mock 1 (9-dars) natijalari ham kerak.
objectives: Mock sessiyasini tartib bilan o'tkazish (alohida kun, JonyOS → Imtihonlar → Mock testlar; qat'iy rejim, faqat kompyuter): xona va ekran tayyorligi, qoidalar, Listening, tugatgan o'quvchi bilan ishlash.
Mock (Listening ~30 + Reading 60 + Writing 60 = 150 daqiqa) dars sonidan tashqaridagi alohida sessiya ekanini, bu 120 daqiqalik dars esa faqat natijalar tahlili va bitiruv yakuni ekanini bilish.
O'z natijasini o'qish: xom ball, band va qaysi bo'lim o'rtachani pastga tortgani.
Har xato javobni olti sababdan bittasiga ajratish.
Xatolarni savol turi bo'yicha guruhlab, Unit 1–8 dagi qaysi darsga qaytish kerakligini aniqlash.

Bitiruv maqsadi bilan solishtirish (7.0 — Listening 30+, Academic Reading 30+ (40 dan), Writing 7.0 (har mezon bo'yicha 7); ixtiyoriy yuqori maqsad 7.5 — Listening 32+, Reading 33+) va real imtihongacha ikki haftalik aniq reja yozish.

Writing natijasini o'qish: AI examiner 4 mezon bo'yicha qo'ygan ballar, inglizcha izoh va xatolar ro'yxati; Mock 1 (9-dars) bilan solishtirish, eng past mezonni topish, 5 ta xatoni tuzatish va bitta aniq odat yozish.
Har o'quvchiga bitiruv varaqasi: Listening, Reading, Writing bandlari (Speaking va overall — o'tkazilgan bo'lsa), 2 ta zaif joy va real IELTS'ga tavsiya.

Tahlil darsi: har o'quvchiga "Olti sabab" jadvali va "Savol turi → Unit" xaritasi (quyidagi 3-mashq jadvali) chop etilgan holda.
Tahlil darsi: har o'quvchiga "Ikki haftalik reja" varaqasi — 6 qator, oxirida ustoz imzosi uchun joy.

Tahlil darsi: har o'quvchiga "Bitiruv varaqasi" (5-mashq). Ustoz uni darsdan oldin natijalar asosida qisman to'ldirib keladi (bandlar va tavsiya qoralamasi); dars oxirida imzolanadi, bir nusxasi o'quvchiga (ota-onaga) beriladi.
timeline: Kirish: bugun — bitiruv tahlili darsi

Avval tekshiring: yakuniy mock alohida 150 daqiqalik sessiyada o'tkazilganmi va natijalar (Writing — examiner tasdig'idan keyin) e'lon qilinganmi? Bo'lmasa, bu darsni natija chiqqandan keyinga ko'chiring. Bugun faqat natija, tahlil va bitiruv yakuni. Mock — o'lchov, jazo emas; ballar ovoz chiqarib aytilmaydi, har kim o'z varaqasi bilan ishlaydi.
Natijani ochish

Har o'quvchi Listening va Reading xom ball va bandini, Writing ballarini (4 mezon) daftariga yozadi va bitiruv maqsadi bilan solishtiradi: 7.0 — Listening 30+, Reading 30+ (40 dan), Writing 7.0 (ixtiyoriy 7.5: L 32+, R 33+). Yoniga Mock 1 (9-dars) natijasi yoziladi.
Xom ball — band jadvali
Doskada ikkala jadval (9.0 gacha); jadval chegarasida bitta savol yarim bandni o'zgartirishi ko'rsatiladi (2-mashq).
Olti sabab
Har sababga bitta tanish misol (1-mashq); sabablar jadvali tarqatiladi.
Javoblar varaqasi: Listening
Har kim o'z varaqasini savol-savol o'qiydi, har xatoga sabab raqami va Section turi yoziladi. Proyektorda faqat to'g'ri javoblar va guruh statistikasi (qaysi savolda nechta xato).
Javoblar varaqasi: Reading
Passage bo'yicha ketma-ket; har xatoga sabab raqami va savol turi yoziladi. Bir passage'dagi ikkinchi turga vaqt yetmagani (kombinatsiya xatosi) alohida belgilanadi.
Savol turi → Unit xaritasi
Har tur va har sabab necha marta chiqqani sanaladi; xatolar savol turi bo'yicha guruhlanadi va Unit 1–8 dagi qaysi darsga qaytish kerakligi topiladi (3-mashq).
Writing feedback

Examiner tasdiqlagan AI natijasi: 4 mezon bo'yicha ball, inglizcha izoh, grammatika va lug'at xatolari; Mock 1 bilan solishtirish, eng past mezon, 5 ta tuzatish va bitta aniq odat (4-mashq). Mezon Writing blokidagi darsga (18–31) bog'lanadi (3-mashq xaritasi).
Bitiruv varaqasi
L, R, W bandlari (Speaking va overall — o'tkazilgan bo'lsa), 2 ta zaif joy va real IELTS'ga tavsiya (5-mashq). O'quvchi zaif joylarni yozadi, ustoz aylanib chiqib tavsiyani tasdiqlaydi.
Ikki haftalik reja
Har kim bitiruv varaqasidagi 2 ta zaif joy bo'yicha 6 qatorli reja yozadi, ostiga 4-mashqdagi Writing odatini qo'shadi; juftlik o'qib tekshiradi.
Yakun va vazifa

Reja va bitiruv varaqasi imzolanadi. Uyga: xatolar daftari va Writing xatboshisi — 3 kun ichida ustozga yuboriladi; eng zaif tur — ikki haftalik reja bo'yicha. Ikki haftadan keyin kurator (yoki guruh ustozi) xatolar sanog'ini qayta tekshiradi. Kurs shu dars bilan yakunlanadi.

intro: Bu — yakuniy mockdan (Mock 2) keyingi BITIRUV TAHLILI darsi. Imtihonning o'zi dars sonidan tashqaridagi alohida sessiyada o'tadi; bu 120 daqiqada natijalar savol-savol va savol turi bo'yicha tahlil qilinadi, Writing izohi 4 mezon bo'yicha ko'rib chiqilib Mock 1 bilan solishtiriladi, har o'quvchiga bitiruv varaqasi va ikki haftalik reja beriladi. Yangi mavzu yo'q — Unit 1–8 da o'rganilgan savol turlari kombinatsiyalari va Writing blokining (18–31-darslar) imtihon sharoitidagi natijasi tahlil qilinadi.

Mock sessiyasi (dars sonidan tashqarida, alohida kun): examiner JonyOS → Imtihonlar → Mock testlar bo'limidan guruh uchun mockni ochadi, o'quvchilar qat'iy rejimda (faqat kompyuter, to'liq ekran) ishlaydi: Listening ~30, Reading 60, Writing 60 daqiqa — jami 150 daqiqa, bitta o'tirishda. Speaking — filial imkon bersa, boshqa kuni examiner bilan: har o'quvchiga 11–14 daqiqa, 4 mezon bo'yicha (Fluency and Coherence, Lexical Resource, Grammatical Range and Accuracy, Pronunciation); imkon bo'lmasa, bu mockda Speaking yo'q va overall band hisoblanmaydi.
Sessiyada Listening yozuvi bo'lmasa, skriptni EXAMINER ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi: bir marta, tabiiy va bir tekis tezlikda, javob so'zlariga urg'u bermasdan. Skript faqat examiner ekranida turadi.

Natija ikki raqam: XOM BALL (40 dan nechta) va BAND. Listening va Reading jadvallari bir xil emas: 26 ta to'g'ri javob Listeningda 6.5, Academic Readingda 6.0. Jadval chegarasida bitta savol yarim bandni o'zgartiradi (Listening ham, Reading ham: 29 ta = 6.5, 30 ta = 7.0) — bo'sh javob qoldirmang.

Olti sabab: 1) eshitmadim / topa olmadim; 2) eshitdim, lekin xato yozdim (imlo, ko'plik, raqam); 3) vaqt yetmadi; 4) savol turini noto'g'ri tushundim (so'z limiti, NOT GIVEN va FALSE farqi, TWO letters); 5) taxmin qildim; 6) bilardim, lekin javobni o'zgartirdim.

7.0 bitiruv tahlili — savol turi va Writing mezonlari bo'yicha. Har xatoning yonida savol turi yoziladi va "Savol turi → Unit" xaritasidan qaysi darsga qaytish kerakligi topiladi. Masalan, Matching headings da 3 ta xato — Unit 2 (3-dars) va Unit 7 (14-dars) readinglari va Practice 1–3 qayta ishlanadi. Writing'da esa eng past mezon (TA/TR, CC, LR yoki GRA) topiladi, Mock 1 (9-dars) diagnostikasi bilan solishtiriladi va Writing blokidagi mos darsga (Task 1 — 18–24, Task 2 — 25–31-darslar) bog'lanadi.
Kombinatsiya xatosini alohida belgilang: agar bir passage'da ikkinchi savol turiga vaqt yetmagan bo'lsa (3-sabab), muammo tur emas — xarita usuli va vaqt taqsimoti.

Bitiruv maqsadi (Mock 2): 7.0 — Listening 30+, Academic Reading 30+ (40 dan), Writing 7.0: har mezon bo'yicha 7 (mezonga faqat butun ball qo'yiladi). Ixtiyoriy yuqori maqsad — 7.5: Listening 32+, Reading 33+. Mock 1 (9-dars) maqsadi 6.5 edi — bugungi natija u bilan solishtiriladi va o'sish ko'rsatiladi. Maqsaddan past bo'lim — bitiruv varaqasidagi zaif joy va ikki haftalik rejaning birinchi qatori.

WRITING natijasi: JonyOS AI examiner Writing'ni 4 IELTS mezoni bo'yicha baholaydi — Task Achievement (Task 1) / Task Response (Task 2), Coherence and Cohesion, Lexical Resource, Grammatical Range and Accuracy; Task 2 ikki barobar hisoblanadi. U inglizcha examiner izohi va grammatika/lug'at xatolari ro'yxatini beradi. Examiner (AI emas — maktab examineri) 48 soat ichida bahoni tekshiradi yoki o'zgartiradi, shundan keyin natija e'lon qilinadi. Har mezonga faqat butun ball qo'yiladi; .5 faqat o'rtachada — task va Writing bandida chiqadi.

Sessiya qoidasi: telefon sumkada, stolda emas. Qat'iy rejimda imtihon to'liq ekranda ishlanadi; ekrandan chiqib boshqa oynaga o'tish tizimda sanaladi va takrorlansa, o'quvchi imtihondan chetlatiladi. Savol bo'lsa qo'l ko'tariladi.

BITIRUV VARAQASI (5-mashq): har o'quvchiga Listening, Reading va Writing bandlari, Mock 1 bilan solishtirish, 2 ta zaif joy (savol turi yoki Writing mezoni — aniq dars bilan) va real IELTS'ga tavsiya yoziladi. Speaking o'tkazilgan bo'lsa, uning bandi va overall band ham yoziladi: overall — 4 bo'lim o'rtachasi; o'rtacha .25 bilan tugasa .5 ga, .75 bilan tugasa keyingi butun bandga, qolgan hollarda eng yaqin yarim yoki butun bandga yaxlitlanadi. Speaking o'tkazilmagan bo'lsa, varaqada ochiq yoziladi: "Speaking bu kurs doirasida baholanmadi — overall band hisoblanmaydi".
formulas: Writing: Mock 1 bilan solishtiring, eng past mezon + 5 ta tuzatish
Bitiruv varaqasi: bandlar, 2 zaif joy, tavsiya
presentation: To'liq mock bitta darsga sig'adimi?

Yo'q. Mock — dars sonidan tashqaridagi alohida 150 daqiqalik sessiya (JonyOS → Imtihonlar → Mock testlar; qat'iy rejim, faqat kompyuter): Listening ~30, Reading 60, Writing 60 daqiqa. Speaking — filial imkon bersa, boshqa kuni examiner bilan (har o'quvchiga 11–14 daqiqa, 4 mezon). Bu 120 daqiqalik dars — faqat natijalar tahlili va bitiruv yakuni.
Mock nega kerak, darslar yetmaydimi?
Darsda har tur alohida ishlanadi; mockda hammasi aralash va vaqt bilan. Kombinatsiya ko'nikmasi faqat shu yerda o'lchanadi.
Ballim past chiqdi. Nima qilaman?
Avval sabablarni sanang. Ko'pincha 2-sabab (imlo, raqam) — bu eng tez tuzaladigan xato.
Xatolarim har xil turlarda. Qayerdan boshlayman?
Eng ko'p xato bo'lgan ikki turdan. Xaritadan ularning darsini toping.
Listening skriptini keyin berasizmi?
Yo'q. Tahlil faqat javoblar varaqasi orqali, skript o'quvchiga berilmaydi.
Vaqt yetmadi — bu qaysi sabab?
3-sabab. Davosi — xarita usuli va har passage uchun 20 daqiqa qoidasi (Passage 1 — 17–20 daqiqa; Unit 1).
Writingni ham tahlil qilamizmi?

Ha, bugun 25 daqiqa (4-mashq). Writing'ni JonyOS AI examiner 4 IELTS mezoni bo'yicha baholaydi (TA/TR, CC, LR, GRA; Task 2 ikki barobar), inglizcha izoh va grammatika/lug'at xatolari ro'yxatini beradi; examiner 48 soat ichida tekshiradi yoki o'zgartiradi, keyin natija e'lon qilinadi. Bugungi natija Mock 1 (9-dars) diagnostikasi bilan solishtiriladi, har zaif mezon Writing darslari xaritasiga bog'lanadi.
Speaking-chi? Overall band chiqadimi?

Filial imkon bersa, Speaking boshqa kuni examiner bilan o'tkaziladi (har o'quvchiga 11–14 daqiqa, 4 mezon: Fluency and Coherence, Lexical Resource, Grammatical Range and Accuracy, Pronunciation) va overall band hisoblanadi. Aks holda Speaking bu kurs doirasida baholanmaydi va bitiruv varaqasida overall band yozilmaydi — bu o'quvchiga ochiq aytiladi.
Kurs tugadi — ikki haftalik rejani kim tekshiradi?

Reja bugun ustoz tomonidan imzolanadi. Ikki haftadan keyin kurator (yoki guruh ustozi) siz bilan bog'lanib, shu turdagi xatolar sonini qayta sanaydi va real IELTS'ga ro'yxatdan o'tish tavsiyasini yangilaydi.
notes: Maktab qarori: mock imtihoni — dars sonidan tashqaridagi ALOHIDA 150 daqiqalik sessiya (JonyOS → Imtihonlar → Mock testlar; qat'iy rejim, faqat kompyuter): Listening ~30, Reading 60, Writing 60 daqiqa. Speaking — filial imkon bersa, boshqa kuni examiner bilan (har o'quvchiga 11–14 daqiqa, 4 mezon). Writing natijasi examiner tekshirgandan keyin (48 soat ichida) chiqadi, shuning uchun bu 120 daqiqalik tahlil darsini natijalar e'lon qilingandan KEYIN o'tkazing. Dars boshida belgilang: mock o'tkazilganmi? natijalar e'lon qilinganmi? Speaking o'tkazildimi?
Natijalarni ochishdan oldin o'quvchilarga eslating: mock — o'lchov, jazo emas. Maqsad — keyingi ikki haftada qaysi darsga qaytishni bilish.

Tahlil qismida ustoz ham guruh bo'yicha umumiy naqshni yozib oladi. Bu kursning oxirgi darsi, shuning uchun guruhning yarmi xato qilgan tur sinfda qayta ko'rilmaydi: ustoz uni guruh yakuni sifatida metodistga yozib beradi va o'quvchilarga shu darsni ikki haftalik rejaning birinchi qatori qilishni tavsiya qiladi.

Bu yakuniy mock: natija guruhning IELTS 7.0 kursini qanday tugatganini ko'rsatadi. Writing'ni JonyOS AI examiner ikki vazifa bo'yicha to'rt mezonda baholaydi, examiner 48 soat ichida tekshiradi — past chiqqan mezon uchun 18–31-darslardagi mos darsga qayting (4-mashq). Maqsadga yetmagan o'quvchi uchun xaritadagi 2 ta eng zaif dars bo'yicha individual reja tuziladi va bitiruv varaqasiga yoziladi.

Sessiya kuni tartibi (dars timeline'iga kirmaydi): kompyuterlar tekshiriladi, mock JonyOS → Imtihonlar → Mock testlar bo'limidan ochiladi, ism ro'yxati va zaxira qog'oz tarqatiladi; telefon sumkaga, qat'iy rejim qoidalari ovoz chiqarib aytiladi. Listening skriptini (yozuv bo'lmasa) ikki marta o'qimang va tezlashtirmang. Reading va Writing paytida xona kuzatiladi, mazmun bo'yicha yordam berilmaydi (texnik savolga — beriladi), qolgan vaqt doskaga yozib boriladi.

Aniq dars, aniq miqdor, aniq kun
Noto'g'ri javob uchun ball ayirilmaydi; bo'sh javob — kafolatlangan nol
Davosi boshqa: xarita va vaqt taqsimoti

class_ex.title: 4-mashq: Writing — AI examiner izohi va Mock 1 bilan solishtirish
class_ex.instr: Har o'quvchi examiner tasdiqlagan Writing natijasini va Mock 1 (9-dars) natijasini ochadi: 4 mezon bo'yicha ball, inglizcha examiner izohi va grammatika/lug'at xatolari ro'yxati. Besh qadamni daftarda bajaring. O'ng ustunda namuna (Aziz) — ko'chirmang, o'z natijangiz bilan ishlang.
items: 1-qadam. Task 1 va Task 2 uchun 4 mezon bo'yicha ballaringizni yozing: Task Achievement (Task 1) / Task Response (Task 2), Coherence and Cohesion, Lexical Resource, Grammatical Range and Accuracy. Maqsad bilan solishtiring: har mezon bo'yicha 7.
2-qadam. Mock 1 (9-dars) natijangiz bilan solishtiring: qaysi mezon o'sdi, qaysi biri o'zgarmadi? (Mock 1 natijasi bo'lmasa, faqat bugungi natija bilan ishlang.)
3-qadam. Eng past mezonni belgilang (Task 2 ikki barobar hisoblanishini eslang). Inglizcha izohdan shu mezonga oid BITTA gapni toping va o'zbekchaga o'giring.
4-qadam. Xatolar ro'yxatidan 5 ta xatoni tanlang: to'g'ri shaklini yozing va turini belgilang (grammatika yoki lug'at).
5-qadam. Eng past mezon uchun bitta aniq odat va Writing blokidagi mos darsni yozing (3-mashq xaritasining "WRITING MEZONI" qatorlari) — real imtihongacha shu odat bilan ishlaysiz.
answers: Aziz. Task 1: TA 7, CC 7, LR 7, GRA 7 (o'rtacha 7.0). Task 2: TR 7, CC 7, LR 8, GRA 6 (o'rtacha 7.0). Maqsaddan past yagona mezon — Task 2 dagi GRA 6.

Mock 1: Task 1 — TA 6, CC 7, LR 7, GRA 6; Task 2 — TR 5, CC 6, LR 7, GRA 6. O'sdi: Task 1 — TA 6 → 7, GRA 6 → 7; Task 2 — TR 5 → 7, CC 6 → 7, LR 7 → 8. Task 1 dagi CC va LR 7 da qoldi (maqsadda). O'zgarmadi: Task 2 dagi GRA (6 → 6).

Eng past — Task 2 dagi GRA 6. Izohdan (GRA gapi): "However, there are still a number of errors in complex sentences, especially with articles and relative clauses, although they rarely reduce communication." → Biroq murakkab gaplarda, ayniqsa artikl va relative clause'larda, hali bir qancha xato bor, garchi ular fikrni tushunishga kamdan-kam xalaqit bersa ham.

"Governments should invest in the public transport" → "Governments should invest in public transport" (grammatika: umumiy ma'noda artikl qo'yilmaydi); "a problem which it affects young people" → "a problem which affects young people" (grammatika: which dan keyin olmosh takrorlanmaydi); "Although technology is useful, but it has drawbacks" → "Although technology is useful, it has drawbacks" (grammatika: although va but birga kelmaydi); "If governments will reduce taxes, companies will invest more" → "If governments reduce taxes, companies will invest more" (grammatika: if-qismda present simple); "a great amount of people" → "a large number of people" (lug'at: sanaladigan ot bilan number).

Odat: topshirishdan oldin 3 daqiqa faqat murakkab gaplarni tekshiraman — artikl (a / the / artiklsiz) va relative clause (which / who dan keyin olmosh yo'q). Mos darslar (GRA): 24-dars (relative clause, passiv), 26-dars (If + modal), 21-dars (zamonlar).
why: Har mezonga faqat BUTUN ball qo'yiladi (masalan 6 yoki 7); .5 faqat o'rtachada chiqadi. Writing 7.0 maqsadi — har mezon bo'yicha 7.
O'sgan mezon — Writing blokining samarasi (TR 5 → 7: pozitsiya va rivojlantirish, 25-, 28-, 30-darslar). O'zgarmagan mezon — keyingi qadam.
Task 2 ikki barobar hisoblanadi: Task 2 dagi past mezon Writing bandiga Task 1 dagiga qaraganda ko'proq ta'sir qiladi. Izoh inglizcha — tushunmagan so'zni ustozdan so'rang.
Tuzatilgan xato — keyingi ishda takrorlanmaydigan xato. Grammatika xatolari GRA ga; so'z tanlash, kollokatsiya va so'z yasalishi xatolari LR ga tegishli.
Odat kichik va aniq bo'lsin: "grammatikani yaxshilayman" emas, "murakkab gaplarni 3 daqiqa tekshiraman". Mezon → dars: 3-mashq xaritasining "WRITING MEZONI" qatorlari.
class_ex.note: Writing'ni JonyOS AI examiner 4 mezon bo'yicha baholaydi (Task 2 ikki barobar hisoblanadi), inglizcha izoh va xatolar ro'yxatini beradi; examiner 48 soat ichida tekshiradi yoki o'zgartiradi, natija shundan keyin e'lon qilinadi. Bu darsda faqat tasdiqlangan natija bilan ishlanadi. Bu — bitiruv natijasi: Mock 1 (9-dars) dagi Writing diagnostikasi bilan solishtiriladi (Task 2 essayi va AI izohi 9-darsdan saqlangan). Ballni sinfda ovoz chiqarib aytmang.

class_ex.title: 5-mashq: Bitiruv varaqasi
class_ex.instr: Har o'quvchi o'z bitiruv varaqasini tekshiradi va to'ldiradi: 1–4-qatorlarni (bandlar) ustoz natijalar asosida oldindan yozib keladi — o'quvchi ularni o'z natijasi bilan solishtiradi (2- va 4-mashqlar); 5-qatorni (2 ta zaif joy) o'quvchi 3- va 4-mashqdan yozadi; 6-qatorni (tavsiya) ustoz tasdiqlaydi va varaqani imzolaydi. O'ng ustunda namuna (Aziz).
items: Listening: Mock 1 va Mock 2 — xom ball va band; maqsad 30+ (7.0).
Academic Reading: Mock 1 va Mock 2 — xom ball va band; maqsad 30+ (7.0).
Writing: Mock 1 va Mock 2 bandi, Mock 2 da 4 mezon bo'yicha ball; maqsad 7.0.
Speaking (o'tkazilgan bo'lsa) va overall band.
Ikkita eng zaif joy (3-mashq xaritasi va 4-mashqdan) — aniq tur yoki mezon va dars bilan.
Real IELTS'ga tavsiya.
answers: Mock 1: 27 ta (6.5) → Mock 2: 31 ta (7.0) — maqsadga yetdi.
Mock 1: 26 ta (6.0) → Mock 2: 29 ta (6.5) — maqsadga 1 savol yetmadi.
Mock 1: 6.0 (Task 1 — 6.5, Task 2 — 6.0) → Mock 2: 7.0 (Task 1: 7, 7, 7, 7; Task 2: TR 7, CC 7, LR 8, GRA 6).
1) Reading: Yes / No / Not Given — 4 ta xato, 4-sabab (Unit 6 — 12-dars, Unit 8 — 16-dars). 2) Writing: GRA — murakkab gaplar: relative clause, artikl va if-gaplar (24-, 26-darslar).

Listening (7.0) va Writing (7.0) — maqsadda; Writing'da GRA 6 bo'yicha 4-mashqdagi odat davom ettiriladi. Reading (6.5) uchun ikki haftalik reja (Yes / No / Not Given, 12- va 16-darslar Practice 1–3) bajarilib, xatolar sanog'i kamaygach, real imtihonga ro'yxatdan o'tish tavsiya etiladi.
why: Listening 30–31 = 7.0; 32–34 = 7.5 — ixtiyoriy yuqori maqsad (32+).
Reading 27–29 = 6.5, 30–32 = 7.0: jadval chegarasida bitta savol yarim bandni o'zgartiradi.
Writing bandida Task 2 ikki barobar hisoblanadi. Mezonga faqat butun ball qo'yiladi; GRA 6 — maqsaddan past yagona mezon (4-mashq).

Overall — 4 bo'lim o'rtachasi; .25 → .5, .75 → keyingi butun band, qolgani eng yaqin yarim yoki butun bandga (6.875 → 7.0). Speaking o'tkazilmagan bo'lsa: "Speaking bu kurs doirasida baholanmadi — overall band hisoblanmaydi" deb yoziladi.
Zaif joy — eng ko'p xato bo'lgan savol turi yoki eng past mezon. "Reading zaif" emas, aniq tur va dars yoziladi: shu ikki qator ikki haftalik rejaning asosi bo'ladi.
Tavsiya raqamga tayanadi: barcha bo'limlar maqsadda bo'lsa — ro'yxatdan o'tish; bitta bo'lim past bo'lsa — avval ikki haftalik reja va xatolar sanog'i qayta tekshiriladi (kurator yoki guruh ustozi).
class_ex.note: Ustoz varaqani darsdan oldin natijalar asosida qisman to'ldirib keladi (bandlar va tavsiya qoralamasi); sinfda o'quvchi 2 ta zaif joyni 3- va 4-mashqdan yozadi, ustoz aylanib chiqib tavsiyani tasdiqlaydi. Varaqa imzolanadi, bir nusxasi o'quvchiga (ota-onaga) beriladi. Ballarni sinfda ovoz chiqarib aytmang.

homework_intro: Mock sessiyasida yakuniy imtihonni topshirdingiz, bugun sinfda javoblar varaqasini savol-savol o'qidik, Writing izohini ko'rdik va bitiruv varaqasini oldingiz. Bu kursning oxirgi darsi: uyda xuddi shu ishni HAMMA xato bo'yicha oxirigacha qilasiz va real imtihongacha ikki haftalik rejani bajarasiz.

Birinchi vazifa — xatolar daftari: har xato uchun oltita ustun — savol raqami, sizning javobingiz, to'g'ri javob, savol turi, sabab raqami va qaytiladigan dars. Oxirida har sabab va har tur necha marta chiqqanini sanang.
Ikkinchi vazifa — ikki haftalik reja: eng katta ikki naqsh bo'yicha 6 qator; har qatorda qaysi dars, qancha mashq, qaysi kun va kim tekshiradi.

Uchinchi vazifa — eng zaif savol turining darsiga qayting. Reading turi bo'lsa — o'sha darsdagi Practice 1–3 ni vaqt bilan qayta ishlang, har javob yonida isbot gap bo'lsin. Listening turi bo'lsa — o'sha darsning Workbook treki va Jony Academy mashqini imtihon rejimida (audio BIR MARTA) qayta bajaring va har xatoga sabab raqamini yozing.

To'rtinchi vazifa — Writing: AI izohidagi eng past mezon bo'yicha Task 2 dan bitta body xatboshini qayta yozing; xatolar ro'yxatidan yana 5 ta xatoni tuzating. Xatolar daftari va yangi xatboshini 3 kun ichida ustozga yuboring.

homework.title: Xatolar daftari: sabab + savol turi + dars
homework.instr: Har xato: savol raqami — javobim — to'g'ri javob — savol turi — sabab (1–6) — qaytiladigan dars. Oxirida sanash.
homework.answers: Bu kursning oxirgi darsi: daftar suratini 3 kun ichida ustozga (shaxsiy xabarda) yuborasiz; ustoz sanoqni tekshiradi — eng ko'p chiqqan ikki tur rejadagi ikki qator bilan bir xil bo'lishi shart.

homework.title: Ikki haftalik reja
homework.instr: 6 qator: dars raqami, mashq miqdori, kun, tekshiruvchi. Masalan: "3-dars Practice 1–3, har kuni bittadan, 20 daqiqa" (Passage 2 normasi; Passage 1 — 17–20 daqiqa). Ostiga 4-mashqdagi Writing odatini qo'shing.
homework.answers: Reja bugun ustoz tomonidan imzolanadi. Kurs shu dars bilan tugaydi: ikki haftadan keyin kurator (yoki guruh ustozi) o'quvchi bilan bog'lanib, shu turdagi xatolar sonini qayta sanaydi va real IELTS'ga ro'yxatdan o'tish tavsiyasini yangilaydi.

homework.title: Eng zaif tur: Reading — Practice 1–3, Listening — WB treki + Jony mashqi
homework.instr: Xaritadan topilgan darsga qayting. Reading: o'sha darsdagi Practice 1–3 ni vaqt bilan qayta bajaring, har javob yonida isbot gap. Listening: o'sha darsning Workbook treki va Jony Academy mashqi, imtihon rejimida — audio BIR MARTA (audio faylni ustoz guruh chatiga yuboradi; Jony mashqining yozuvi bo'lmasa, ustoz skriptni o'qib, ovozli xabar qilib yuboradi); har xatoga sabab raqami.
homework.answers: Maqsad: shu turda 80% dan yuqori natija.

homework.title: Writing: bitta xatboshini qayta yozish
homework.instr: AI izohidagi eng past mezonni tanlang va Task 2 dan bitta body xatboshini shu mezon bo'yicha qayta yozing; xatolar ro'yxatidan yana 5 ta xatoni tuzating (to'g'ri shakli + grammatika yoki lug'at). 3 kun ichida ustozga yuboring.
homework.answers: Ustoz eski va yangi xatboshini yonma-yon ko'radi: eng past mezon bo'yicha o'zgarish ko'rinishi va 5 ta tuzatish to'g'ri bo'lishi shart.
